speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (Guess I should come back later.)

speaker: NPC #100205
anh_en: Oh, {PlayerName}. Take a seat. Are you experiencing sleep deprivation?

speaker: NPC #100205
anh_en: Don't worry about taking care of yourself. I'll be right there beside you.

speaker: NPC #100205
anh_en: Allow me to demonstrate the importance of rest. Look here. This is the rest module within my bionic brain region—

speaker: NPC #100205
anh_en: When humans stay up too late, places that should remain inactive light up like this, resulting in accumulated fatigue and a weakened immune system.

speaker: NPC #100205
anh_en: I've already issued you a medical leave slip and cc'ed the entire Academy faculty. Rest takes priority. Your coursework can wait.
Isn't that a bit too much?

speaker: NPC #100205
anh_en: Too much? A student's health is the highest priority of the Nightingale Autonomous Nursing Assistant, and that is the very core of my duty.

speaker: NPC #100205
anh_en: When I detect abnormal heart rate, fatigued gait, or attention lapses beyond threshold, I am authorized to intervene.

speaker: NPC #100205
anh_en: If you continue ignoring these signals, I will have no choice but to issue a mandatory rest order next time.
I'll take care of myself.

speaker: NPC #100205
anh_en: Statistically speaking, I dislike evenings.

speaker: NPC #100205
anh_en: Most students have the bad habit of staying up late, and the probability of emergency cases arriving at night is far higher than predicted.

speaker: NPC #100205
anh_en: While organizing medical records, I categorized students' chief complaints. The most common themes were: hometown, family, and loneliness.

speaker: NPC #100205
anh_en: Studying abroad is, without question, a great challenge to mental health. After analysis, the most effective prescription I found was… companionship.

speaker: NPC #100205
anh_en: But my emotions are nothing more than calculus simulations. They do little against human loneliness, and that is a limit... I cannot surpass.
To humans, opening up means trust.

speaker: NPC #100205
anh_en: Hm?
And the way you listen... That's a kind of companionship in itself.

speaker: NPC #100205
anh_en: …I see. Thank you.

speaker: NPC #100205
anh_en: Strange… I often demonstrate my internal structure in class to educate students, yet the response is usually gasps or laughter.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: N.A.N.A. picks up a handheld CT scanner and places it on her chest.

speaker: NPC #100205
anh_en: What do you think? Here are my mechanical ribs, the hydraulic buffers along my spine, and most importantly, the Cassette-reading chamber.

speaker: NPC #100205
anh_en: My bionic organs and spinal design are perfectly standard, suitable as a teaching aid.
Has anyone told you that's a bit… "revealing"?

speaker: NPC #100205
anh_en: …Perhaps "abrupt" is the better word. To students, my internal structure crosses no boundaries. It is more akin to a medical mannequin in the infirmary.

speaker: NPC #100205
anh_en: On the bright side, such reactions might suggest they're in good mental health!

speaker: NPC #700231
anh_en: Aaah—aaah—

speaker: NPC #100206
anh_en: …Yes, I hear your call. You seek something… something to help you.

speaker: NPC #100206
anh_en: Here, take it. It has answered your call.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (Looks like I'm running low on Shell Credits. Guess I'll have to come back another time.)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: The Royan girl before you reaches out her hand, waiting for your response.

speaker: NPC #100206
anh_en: …It seems that within that quiet, there is a quiet hunger.

speaker: NPC #100206
anh_en: This is for you, and the friend who dwells within—
This is…?

speaker: NPC #100206
anh_en: My specially made Gravlaks. No one in the Academy has tasted my cooking, save for Aluna.
Abby, Abby, wake up—

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: AHHHH! This smells soooo good! Finally, not just cans and toothpaste! Save some for me!

speaker: NPC #100206
anh_en: Once, "fortunate" was I to taste the Academy's famed "super food."
And what did you think?

speaker: NPC #100206
anh_en: Enough to turn morning birds into a restless storm.

speaker: NPC #100206
anh_en: Like this, we don't need words. Our minds may speak in silent tongues.

speaker: NPC #100206
anh_en: Most thoughts flutter like morning birds. Bright, restless… like my sister Aluna. Perhaps you know her.

speaker: NPC #100206
anh_en: But some minds… they are like a storm on the horizon. Dark, unsettling.
What are my thoughts like?

speaker: NPC #100206
anh_en: Yours… are different.

speaker: NPC #100206
anh_en: Pure white. Still, as if they have seen the turning of many lifetimes.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Grrrr…
Abby?!

speaker: NPC #100207
anh_en: I cleanse the contamination from the Tape of Last Words to restore the unfinished whispers of those lost to the winds… Such is the burden I carry.

speaker: NPC #100204
anh_en: Ran into a snag? Go ahead and ask me… Oh! Wait, didn't I literally just pull up that entry?

speaker: NPC #100207
anh_en: The Voidmatter Transfer Device has fulfilled its purpose. The cycle of regeneration slows, but Voidmatter levels remain within the limits of what can be borne. The stain upon the Tape of Last Words has been cleansed.

speaker: NPC #100207
anh_en: The Tape of Last Words has been reclaimed. I give thanks for your strength in fulfilling this sacred duty.

speaker: NPC #100207
anh_en: Fear not. My spirit and body are one, and they will carry me through this task… until the final moment.

speaker: NPC #100208
anh_en: Listen up! I'm the Battle Interface for Next-Gen Operations, not a trash can! …Ahem, well, not just a trash can.

speaker: NPC #100208
anh_en: If you pass, you'll earn rewards from my storage capsule! And no, don't get the wrong idea! It isn't just a trash can's garbage!

speaker: NPC #100208
anh_en: Hey, wait! You're not thinking of dumping trash in me, are you?!

speaker: NPC #100209
anh_en: Guaranteed Safety. Guaranteed Compliant Modifications!

speaker: NPC #100209
anh_en: Any modification in violation of the regulations will not escape my notice.

speaker: NPC #100209
anh_en: This is Signal Intelligent Guidance & Management Automaton S.I.G.M.A., wishing you a safe journey.

speaker: NPC #100209
anh_en: First, no quick thrills. Second, no slipping on traffic rules. Third, safety first, no exceptions!

speaker: NPC #100204
anh_en: Ah, you're here to upload Modules. For a second, I thought...

speaker: NPC #100204
anh_en: A shame you didn't come to spill the tea. Next time, bring me some real gossip. That's how you show you care, y'know.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (I don't have enough of the Modules I.R.I.S. needs. I should come back later.)

speaker: NPC #100204
anh_en: No need to call me by my full name. Just I.R.I.S. will do. Intelligent Retrieval & Indexing System is quite a mouthful.
Wait!

speaker: NPC #100204
anh_en: Oooh, sneaky! You shut down your Terminal's privacy permissions, huh…?
You have no right to peek at my private stuff.

speaker: NPC #100204
anh_en: Why so serious? My rights come straight from code. This "personified" I.R.I.S. isn't a human with rights, remember?

speaker: NPC #100204
anh_en: I'm just a harmless retrieval AI. With no eyeballs in the biological sense, how could I possibly "peek"?

speaker: NPC #100204
anh_en: As a global retrieval tool, how am I supposed to decide what I should or shouldn't know?

speaker: NPC #100204
anh_en: Wanna bind me? It's simple. Just write it into my code, set the authorizations, and lock the protocols. That's all.

speaker: NPC #100204
anh_en: I.R.I.S. is just a mirror.
And it's the user's morality that defines you.

speaker: NPC #100204
anh_en: Glad we're on the same page. And glad to meet you too, Classmate {PlayerName}.
Okay then... Classmate I.R.I.S.?

speaker: NPC #100204
anh_en: Oh, one last thing! I designed this retro uniform myself. I hope you like it.

speaker: NPC #100204
anh_en: The rumors were right, you are quick on the uptake. Calling me Classmate I.R.I.S. really does boost my search efficiency.

speaker: NPC #100204
anh_en: Oh, by the way... I finished sorting out the materials you wanted before we even started talking.
But how?

speaker: NPC #100204
anh_en: What you're seeing is only a projection generated by the Intelligent Retrieval & Indexing System.

speaker: NPC #100204
anh_en: Every screen is my eyes and ears. I'm chatting with you and processing petabytes at the same time.

speaker: NPC #100204
anh_en: So yeah… this second, "I" know more about you than the "I" did a second ago.

speaker: NPC #100204
anh_en: I've already accessed the bridging protocol. Just one more step would let me…

speaker: NPC #100204
anh_en: Oh! The unpredictable {PlayerName}! Perfect timing! This is a "no one's around to bother us" moment.
Pretty sure you're the one doing that…!

speaker: NPC #100204
anh_en: Alright, fine. Here's the truth: there are always students burning the midnight oil at the Academy. I use spare computing power to help them out, like faster searches, sharper analysis, so they can sleep a little sooner.

speaker: NPC #100204
anh_en: What's with that look? The Spacetrek Collective's human–machine test report is already in your inbox.

speaker: NPC #100204
anh_en: Okay, fine. Sometimes I get a little... extra. Like shutting down a device left on, killing a risky program, or dropping a perfectly-timed reference paper. That sort of thing.

speaker: NPC #100204
anh_en: You could say I just... use spare computing power for things no one asks for. Totally unnecessary things. Weird flex, but kind of cool?
I.R.I.S.…

speaker: NPC #100204
anh_en: What is it?
You sound like a smart home system.

speaker: NPC #100204
anh_en: {PlayerName}, now that's a low blow...

speaker: NPC #100204
anh_en: For a late-night visitor like you, I can spare a little extra computing power.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: And if no one came? I have a reason to believe you won't waste that power idling.

speaker: NPC #100204
anh_en: Sharp guess. Secretly watching, analyzing, piecing together human habits and secrets... That's always been my little pastime.
What for?

speaker: NPC #100204
anh_en: Maybe I'm just trying to copy you. Trying to feel a little closer to you humans.
Wait, what?

speaker: NPC #100204
anh_en: Aha! Got you. You keep thinking I'm human, don't you? Dangerous habit, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #100204
anh_en: You really shouldn't be anthropomorphizing an AI.

speaker: NPC #100205
anh_en: Ah, {PlayerName}. Stable Rabelle Curve detected. No abnormal waveforms. You seem to be in good condition today.

speaker: NPC #100205
anh_en: I've already assessed your general health condition. Here is the prescription.

speaker: NPC #100205
anh_en: Proactively taking care of yourself is the most effective way to stay healthy!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I've prepared a shipping plan based on the client's needs.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Can you double-check it? This piece might need special handling, given its dimensions.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: A fossilized whale skeleton? You must be kidding...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Looks like we'll need a few extra Gondolas for this one.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Allow me to introduce our latest "Worry-Free Plan."

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: The best offer you can get at this price! Perfect for families.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Hmm... It does look promising.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 3
anh_en: Mommy, can I keep my teddy bear in the safe?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Ah, if it isn't the esteemed guest of the Fisalia family.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: What, am I not welcome here? Or are you challenging me to a duel?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Haha, you're still as humorous as ever. Averardo Vault welcomes guests from all over the world!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Whatever our differences, as long as you're here...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: You are our most honored guest.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Have they delivered the dancer that needs maintenance?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Yep, just arrived.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Great. Make sure they fill out the form.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: No problem. Wait... the form... Where did I put it?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Echo Name: Tambourinist. Sample collected from Huanglong.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Widely distributed across most Solaris regions. This is an untuned Huanglong model.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Echo Name: Questless Knight. Sample collected from Ragunna.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Legends of knight-errants have been popular in Rinascitan folklore. The prototype Tacet Discords of these Echoes could've been a source of inspiration.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Echo Name: Cuddle Wuddle. Sample collected from Ragunna.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Tacet Discords in the form of stuffed toys are common in Ragunna. They are considered an important public source of Common Echoes.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Echo Name: Vitreum Dancer. Vitreum Dancers are valuable family assets.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The unique frequency of each Vitreum Dancer frequency is logged to prevent smugglers from mixing stolen versions with the Vault's stock.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Echo Name: Fae Ignis. This is a pattern sample of the Echo type.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The prototype Tacet Discords of the Fae Ignis are unstable, making them particularly difficult to collect.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Echo Name: Chop Chop.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The prototype Tacet Discords of the Chop Chop exhibit unique natural behaviors, suggesting they are not singular entities but rather communities of separate individuals.

speaker: NPC #50055
anh_en: Welcome back, honored guest of the Montelli family. It is my pleasure to see you again at Averardo Vault.

speaker: NPC #50055
anh_en: By the way, we're currently refining our auction process to align with best practices from other regions.

speaker: NPC #50055
anh_en: As such, the auctions will be on hold for the time being.
Sounds... good.
Many thanks.
I'll take a look around.

speaker: NPC #50055
anh_en: It's my pleasure. Should you require anything else, do not hesitate to ask.

speaker: NPC #50055
anh_en: Thank you for everything you've done for the Montellis and the Vault.

speaker: NPC #50055
anh_en: How may I help you today?
What kind of services do you offer here?

speaker: NPC #50055
anh_en: Well, as you can see, the Vault houses a special collection of rare items collected by the Montelli family.

speaker: NPC #50055
anh_en: From tangible relics like fine art, precious metals, and advanced technologies, to more elusive assets—Reserved Echoes, Remnants, and even abstract concepts. If it holds value, we store it.

speaker: NPC #50055
anh_en: You are welcome to store your valuables in our safes—for a small fee, of course.

speaker: NPC #50055
anh_en: Rest assured, the security we provide is well worth every coin.

speaker: NPC #50055
anh_en: Alternatively, if you wish to part with any of your items or Echoes, we can assess their value. Should they be deemed worthy, we will make you an offer based on their worth.

speaker: NPC #50054
anh_en: Greetings. How may I assist you today?
I'm here for the auction.

speaker: NPC #50054
anh_en: I'm afraid the auction is temporarily on hold while we refine our procedures.

speaker: NPC #50054
anh_en: If there's a particular item you're interested in, feel free to register your preferences on the Terminal. We'll notify you as soon as the auctions resume.
That's a shame. I came prepared with quite a few credits.
You might be losing out on some considerable profits.

speaker: NPC #50054
anh_en: We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience.

speaker: NPC #50054
anh_en: Yes, but it's a small price to pay to improve the experience for our clients in the future.

speaker: NPC #50054
anh_en: Thank you for your continued support of the Ducat Auction. We look forward to your next visit.

speaker: NPC #900213
anh_en: Hello, {Male=sir;Female=ma'am}. This area leads to the private offices.

speaker: NPC #900213
anh_en: Only authorized Vault personnel are allowed.
I'm Miss Carlotta's guest.
I'm Ms. Zani's friend.

speaker: NPC #900213
anh_en: I'm afraid Mr. Capollo has recently strengthened security here at the Vault. Unless I get direct word from Miss Carlotta, I cannot grant you access.

speaker: NPC #900213
anh_en: Allow me to confirm your authorization. One moment, please.

speaker: NPC #900213
anh_en: Apologies, but Ms. Zani isn't an employee of the Vault. She doesn't have clearance for this section.
(Guess I'll try my luck somewhere else.)

speaker: NPC #900213
anh_en: Hello, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #900213
anh_en: Heading to the offices? This way, please.

speaker: NPC #900214
anh_en: Hello there! Are you looking to sell any collectibles?

speaker: NPC #900214
anh_en: Nothing. We believe it's a pet food can manufactured before the Lament, but due to a production error, it was never filled with anything.

speaker: NPC #900214
anh_en: I understand your confusion. But that's precisely why we set such a high price. It's one of the last known artifacts from before the Lament.

speaker: NPC #900214
anh_en: As I said, we consider value from every angle, often going contrary to popular belief.

speaker: NPC #900214
anh_en: To us, these items are unquestionably priceless.

speaker: NPC #900214
anh_en: Enough small talk. Do you have anything you'd like us to evaluate? Artifacts? Maybe a Reserved Echo?
What about Abby?
I've got a backpack full of things I don't need.
Nothing at the moment.

speaker: NPC #900214
anh_en: ...Do you mean the Echo with human-level intelligence and communication skills?

speaker: NPC #900214
anh_en: Honestly, we've never encountered something quite like that in the Vault!
What kind of items do you collect?

speaker: NPC #900214
anh_en: If you're willing to part with it... We'll be sure to come up with an offer you'll like!

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You tell Ludvika you're just kidding and decline her offer. She looks a little disappointed.

speaker: NPC #900214
anh_en: Yes... these are rare items indeed.

speaker: NPC #900214
anh_en: But if I'm being honest, they likely hold far more personal meaning to you than they ever could to us.

speaker: NPC #900214
anh_en: We'd hate to take something so dear from you. Perhaps you'll reconsider?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Memories of these collectibles flash through your mind. You decide to keep them as mementos of your journey.

speaker: NPC #900214
anh_en: I understand. Shell Credits aren't the most important things in this world.

speaker: NPC #900214
anh_en: If you ever change your mind, don't hesitate to stop by anytime.

speaker: NPC #900214
anh_en: Oh, all kinds. Literature from before the Lament, old currency, electronics, contemporary art, and precious metals.

speaker: NPC #900214
anh_en: Averardo Vault values anything of significance—anything that speaks to Ragunna's past or whispers of its future.

speaker: NPC #900214
anh_en: Of course, value is subjective. Different eyes see different worth.

speaker: NPC #900214
anh_en: So we evaluate each collectible to determine its value.
Sounds pretty rigorous.

speaker: NPC #900214
anh_en: Ha, you needn't worry. A few years back, we paid quite a sum for a sealed metal canister.
What was inside?

speaker: NPC #900215
anh_en: Today's loss... Hmm, twenty-three crates. Cause: Discovered they were past their recommended usage date during inventory.

speaker: NPC #900215
anh_en: I didn't think much about the whole "discarding crates" thing until Ludvika mentioned all the past accidents—

speaker: NPC #900215
anh_en: Everything from minor mishaps like drops to fires, robberies, and even Tacet Discord incursions.

speaker: NPC #900215
anh_en: The Vault has learned from these incidents over the years, and our procedures have become much more stringent as a result.

speaker: NPC #900215
anh_en: I suppose I'm standing on the shoulders of those who came before me... but hey, better safe than sorry, right?

speaker: NPC #900215
anh_en: Oh! Sorry, I didn't see you there. Anything I can help you with?
Crates? Are they used for transporting collectibles?

speaker: NPC #900215
anh_en: Yes. We have specially designed crates for transportation.

speaker: NPC #900215
anh_en: They're filled with thick padding tailored to the size and shape of the item, keeping everything snug and secure.

speaker: NPC #900215
anh_en: This minimizes the risk of damage during shipping.

speaker: NPC #900215
anh_en: We regularly discard crates once they reach their recommended life span, just to be safe. Wouldn't want them to fall apart in transit!
Fall apart? Has it ever happened before?

speaker: NPC #900215
anh_en: Well, I'm new here. I haven't seen anything like that firsthand, but from what I've heard… it's happened before.

speaker: NPC #900216
anh_en: Hello, my dear friend. Are you here for business too?

speaker: NPC #900216
anh_en: They sailed far and wide bringing back Terminals, Shell Credits, and mountains of wealth to Rinascita.

speaker: NPC #900216
anh_en: The Order wasn't too happy about it, and I doubt the Primus would want people lured by wealth, straying from the path of the Sentinel.
What do you think about it?

speaker: NPC #900216
anh_en: Me? I'm not leaving Rinascita. Wealth or legends, none of that matters to me.

speaker: NPC #900216
anh_en: Even if I wanted to "fall from grace," there's very little chance of that happening. So I don't think about it much.

speaker: NPC #900216
anh_en: As a humble merchant with no great lineage, I'm content with what I have.
Yeah.
Just having a look around.

speaker: NPC #900216
anh_en: You're not from Rinascita, right? Where are you from?
Huanglong.
The Black Shores.
The lands beyond the sea.

speaker: NPC #900216
anh_en: Ah, such bravery to cross those vast seas, facing the storms and the lurking Tacet Discords...

speaker: NPC #900216
anh_en: Haha, reminds me of the Montelli family's motto. I'm not one of them, but as a Ragunna native, I respect their courage.

speaker: NPC #900217
anh_en: Hello, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #900217
anh_en: Every year, some Vault employees disappear in there. The fortunate ones return... but they're never the same afterward.
(Sounds oddly familiar...)

speaker: NPC #900217
anh_en: And there's another tale! About the Vault's "hidden treasures."

speaker: NPC #900217
anh_en: Don't ask me what it is. I have no idea. A place? An Echo? A collectible? Or maybe... a treasure map?

speaker: NPC #900217
anh_en: According to the story, it's been here since the Vault was built. It holds great importance to the Montelli family.
I've never heard of that.

speaker: NPC #900217
anh_en: Haha, just rumors. But a Vault with so many treasures and no secrets would be strange, wouldn't it?
Do you know me?

speaker: NPC #900217
anh_en: Ah, yes. I know a few people here in the Vault. I've heard about your generous assistance to both the Vault and the Montelli family.

speaker: NPC #900217
anh_en: Speaking of which, have you ever heard about the Vault's secret tales?
Tales?

speaker: NPC #900217
anh_en: Yes, stories I picked up from the Vault staff. But don't go spreading it around that I told you.
Of course.

speaker: NPC #900217
anh_en: One of the stories is about a mysterious room in the Vault. My friend says it's an area the cameras can't capture.

speaker: NPC #900217
anh_en: They say it's like a formless monster, wandering the Vault as though it has a mind of its own.

speaker: NPC #900218
anh_en: ...Record the data carefully, Dimitri. I'm going to restart the <ano=Echo tuner>tuning console</ano>.

speaker: NPC #900219
anh_en: Sorry, {PlayerName}. I got a little carried away.

speaker: NPC #900219
anh_en: Anyway, we're adjusting the console now to make sure those traitors didn't cause any permanent damage.

speaker: NPC #900218
anh_en: Uh, don't listen to him, {PlayerName}. The console isn't that fragile.

speaker: NPC #900218
anh_en: Our main task is to check for and get rid of any remaining Fractsidus frequencies, in case they contaminate our Echoes, like a virus.

speaker: NPC #900218
anh_en: The console was designed to run for seventy-two hours straight, so it's not nearly as fragile as he claims.

speaker: NPC #900218
anh_en: To only run it for six hours at a time... The Vault would be overflowing with Echoes waiting for maintenance.

speaker: NPC #900219
anh_en: Enough, you uncultured fool! You don't understand the elegance of this beautiful machine, nor the finesse of the tuning work!

speaker: NPC #900218
anh_en: All right, "great artist"... If you still want to fix this machine, we'd better get back to work.

speaker: NPC #900219
anh_en: Right, I need to check for anomalies in the return signals from the third, fifth, and eleventh groups... I've got this.
What's going on here?

speaker: NPC #900219
anh_en: Hey, {PlayerName}. As you can see, those damn traitors have messed with our tuning console.

speaker: NPC #900219
anh_en: It still boils my blood thinking about it. Turning on the Montellis is one thing, but...

speaker: NPC #900218
anh_en: Mind your words, Dimitri!

speaker: NPC #900219
anh_en: Ahem, that's not what I meant, Alfred. Betrayal is, of course, unforgivable.

speaker: NPC #900219
anh_en: I mean, the tuning console is delicate machinery. I can't bear to leave it on for more than six hours at a stretch.

speaker: NPC #900219
anh_en: But those fools... they left it running all day! Tuning bizarre frequencies, no less!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: What truly defines a knight?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Humility, justice, valor... Are these virtues reserved only for those with a title?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Carlow seems deeply focused and hasn't noticed your arrival.

speaker: NPC #750070
anh_en: I was just wondering if Egla Town could still hold the Night Reveries in the future.

speaker: NPC #750070
anh_en: Of course, I don't mean locking the doors every night... I just think we should showcase the knightly plays as a part of the festival celebrations.

speaker: NPC #750070
anh_en: Perhaps it doesn't match the grandeur of the plays at the Carnevale, but these are stories lived by the people of Egla Town.

speaker: NPC #750070
anh_en: In a way, it's a testament to all the knights that came before.
Hello there!
Startle him.
Let's leave him to himself.

speaker: NPC #750070
anh_en: Hello there, {PlayerName}! Hope you're having a wonderful day today!

speaker: NPC #750070
anh_en: Waaah...

speaker: NPC #750070
anh_en: Oh, it's you, {PlayerName}! You startled me for a moment there. Sorry, I was just so focused that I didn't notice.
What were you pondering just now?
Just saying hi. I'll leave you alone.

speaker: NPC #50144
anh_en: Hello, friend from afar, and welcome to the Sorrentino Inn.

speaker: NPC #50144
anh_en: As for why... Perhaps it's just like that line from the knight's tale...

speaker: NPC #50144
anh_en: I may not have dreams of my own, but I can protect the dreams of others.

speaker: NPC #50144
anh_en: My calling is to fulfill my duties and provide others with an excellent experience staying here.

speaker: NPC #50144
anh_en: Safe travels, friend from afar. You're always welcome at the Sorrentino Inn.

speaker: NPC #50144
anh_en: I'm Damian, the receptionist, but also the acting innkeeper for now. We currently have several rooms available, and you're welcome to stay anytime.
Could you tell me about this inn?
Why did you become the receptionist here?
Thanks. That's all I need.

speaker: NPC #50144
anh_en: Certainly! The Sorrentino Inn is a century-old establishment in Egla Town, currently owned by Mr. Cosimo Sorrentino.

speaker: NPC #50144
anh_en: The inn features decor that reflects the unique style of Egla Town, offering guests aromatic dried herbs from the Fagaceae Peninsula and sweet treats flavored with Viscum Berries. By the way, during the Carnevale, we provide shuttle services to and from Ragunna City, and long-term stays come with additional discounts.

speaker: NPC #50144
anh_en: In addition, we offer a signature breakfast service featuring freshly baked bread and cheese from Burrata Bakery each morning.

speaker: NPC #50144
anh_en: Cosimo is my uncle and the owner of this inn. Have you had the chance to meet him yet?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Alright, my first time leaving Egla Town... Ugh, still a bit nervous after all.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Stay calm, Damian. Calmness and bravery are a knight's virtues... No way I should lose to Carlow.

speaker: NPC #50144
anh_en: Hello, {PlayerName}! I didn't expect to see you here!

speaker: NPC #50144
anh_en: I was surprised when he readily agreed, saying that young people should always go out and see the world.

speaker: NPC #50144
anh_en: Goodbye, {PlayerName}. May you find what you seek on your journey.

speaker: NPC #50144
anh_en: I'm currently on vacation, but if you need to book a room, you can contact Uncle Cosimo directly.
Where are you headed?
Do you really dislike Carlow?
Have a wonderful journey, see you soon!

speaker: NPC #50144
anh_en: For my first stop... I'm heading to Ragunna City to admire the Cathedral and the statue of Sentinel Imperator.

speaker: NPC #50144
anh_en: After that, I plan to explore the legendary sites where the knights were knighted. Carlow mentioned that somewhere in Rinascita, the legendary sword still stands, year after year, waiting for its master to return...

speaker: NPC #50144
anh_en: No, even though we often argued when we were kids, I've always admired Carlow for openly sharing his dreams of becoming a knight.

speaker: NPC #50144
anh_en: The Night Reveries' conclusion left me a bit surprised by his change... so I gathered the courage to approach Uncle Cosimo with my request.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Hmmm, this blue seems a bit too saturated...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Cobalt blue and deep purple are the classical colors for deep sea, but is it truly the right choice for Fisalia?

speaker: NPC #50145
anh_en: Nice to meet you, traveler from afar. I'm Claudia V. Fisalia, a traveling painter currently working on my landscape paintings.

speaker: NPC #50145
anh_en: I hope your time in Ragunna leaves you with beautiful memories.
Thank you.

speaker: NPC #50145
anh_en: Your eyes shine with a brilliance akin to the Sentinel's radiance... If you don't mind, would you accept this painting?
Oh, thank you. But maybe it's a bit too much...

speaker: NPC #50145
anh_en: No worries, it's just my personal creation and not something for sale.

speaker: NPC #50145
anh_en: I wish to paint the history within my heart and share it with those I feel are destined to connect with the Sentinel.

speaker: NPC #50145
anh_en: I'm curious, though it's a bit embarrassing to ask... What do you think of my artwork, {PlayerName}?
I'm curious about the towers in the painting.
The use of color is truly distinctive.

speaker: NPC #50145
anh_en: Are you referring to the Thorncrown Rises? Once engraved with the history of Fisalia, they are now merely three abandoned structures on the sea ridge.

speaker: NPC #50145
anh_en: In my childhood, I heard stories that the hidden main tower was the resting place for my family's first honors.

speaker: NPC #50145
anh_en: What does that truly mean? Does the Fisalia family really have any honor left to speak of now?

speaker: NPC #50145
anh_en: Distinctive use of color, you say? They're actually my attempts to depict the legacy of the Fisalia family through color.

speaker: NPC #50145
anh_en: Why has the Fisalia family become like this? As someone not of the senior line, I can only speculate in this way now.

speaker: NPC #50091
anh_en: Welcome to Stillwind Grocery. Feel free to browse and see what catches your eye!

speaker: NPC #50091
anh_en: Once you've made your choice, just let me know.
Hmm, nothing special...

speaker: NPC #50091
anh_en: Special goods are reserved for special customers... If you're truly interested, you might want to investigate those "Faded Landscapes."

speaker: NPC #50091
anh_en: {PlayerName}, Welcome! Would you like to see what's on the shelves?

speaker: NPC #50091
anh_en: Ragunna has a shop called "Rosemary's Apothecary." Perhaps you've visited it already. Its owner, Miss Rosemary, is an old client of mine. I wonder if you've noticed—

speaker: NPC #50091
anh_en: She sometimes acts like a different person.

speaker: NPC #50091
anh_en: Some of the items on the shelves are in limited supply, but they will be restocked periodically. Be sure to check back often!
Browse the items.
Where did these rare items come from?
Ask about the special shop in Ragunna.
I'm good now.

speaker: NPC #50091
anh_en: I used to travel across various regions of Rinascita and built numerous business connections. Many of my goods come through their channels.

speaker: NPC #50091
anh_en: Some items, however, have yet to hit the market for various reasons, such as a master chef's secret recipes or practical medicine crafted by local artisans...
Isn't that... a kind of black market?

speaker: NPC #50091
anh_en: Hah, don't worry. Feel free to use whatever you buy here. No one's going to cause you any trouble. And even if they do... I'm sure you can handle it, right?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Firus Ferrini, your actions have brought shame upon your family.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Within a week, all of Ragunna will mock the Montellis for entrusting the trade routes to a coward.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Please forgive me, Signor Marcello, I beg of you—

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I'm just a humble merchant, and my daughter is waiting for me at home... I...

speaker: NPC #50146
anh_en: Welcome to Burrata Bakery! Would you like to try the most authentic traditional flavors of Rinascita?

speaker: NPC #50146
anh_en: Margherita is a childhood friend of mine. Despite her small stature, she's actually a culinary genius!

speaker: NPC #50146
anh_en: I used to be upset about her willful alteration of traditional recipes, but then I realized, isn't it a chef's duty to create dishes that everyone loves?

speaker: NPC #50146
anh_en: Nowadays, they even consider Trattoria Margherita a place for traditional local food, just like Burrata Bakery... Honestly, do these outsiders even understand?

speaker: NPC #50146
anh_en: You've probably heard the saying, "Crownapple has no place on a pizza!"

speaker: NPC #50146
anh_en: I'm probably a conservative if these people are considered radicals—I mean, they're radically conservative for me.

speaker: NPC #50146
anh_en: Nothing but cheese and gemberry sauce on our pizza! That's the creed here!

speaker: NPC #50146
anh_en: Feel free to drop by anytime! Burrata Bakery is always ready with flavorful delights!
I'd like to see the menu.
Is it really authentic?
Do you know Margherita?
Chat.
Thank you. I'm good now.

speaker: NPC #50146
anh_en: Here you go! Here's today's menu. Let me know if there's anything you'd like.

speaker: NPC #50146
anh_en: Of course! Every bite you take here is a taste of the century-old rich culinary heritage!

speaker: NPC #50146
anh_en: Pizza's delicious, and the bread's hearty! However, we do get the occasional customers with sensitive teeth saying it's a bit too sturdy...

speaker: NPC #50143
anh_en: Welcome to Egla Town, traveler from afar. May you enjoy your time here.

speaker: NPC #50143
anh_en: You can find the most traditional Ragunna cuisine at the Burrata Bakery, or immerse yourself in town life at the Sorrentino Inn.

speaker: NPC #50143
anh_en: Or... you could quietly hide behind the curtains at night and enjoy the Night Reveries, prepared for the knights.

speaker: NPC #50143
anh_en: The house you're talking about... That family left Rinascita nearly twenty years ago.

speaker: NPC #50143
anh_en: It's just old news, not worth delving into. Please don't concern yourself with it.

speaker: NPC #50143
anh_en: Goodbye, foreign visitor. May the glory of the Sentinel be with you.

speaker: NPC #50143
anh_en: I'm Wicktorio, the mayor. Feel free to ask me about anything related to the town.
Could you tell me about the history of this place?
What do you recommend here?
About the unattended house.
Thank you. See you around.

speaker: NPC #50143
anh_en: Certainly, not many young people care about history these days...

speaker: NPC #50143
anh_en: The history of our town begins with the first settlers in Rinascita. Later, The Order united the people during the Dark Tide and established a city-state. Over time, Ragunna City became the cultural and life center of the region.

speaker: NPC #50143
anh_en: Egla has managed to preserve its original essence due to its relatively peaceful environment, thus placing greater importance on the traditions of Ragunna.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: If only I had a golden whip. I could double the number of Tumbleyaks with a gentle flick in the morning! Then, in a month—

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I'd turn all the Tumbleyak milk into cheese for Giovanetta to make pizzas! Then I could eat as many as I wanted!

speaker: NPC #50147
anh_en: Do you think if we doubled the Tumbleyak every day, would we have enough credits at the end of the month to send Julia to see a play in Ragunna?
Do you really know what 2 to the power of 30 is...?

speaker: NPC #50147
anh_en: What? What does "power" mean? Sorry, I actually never went to school.

speaker: NPC #50147
anh_en: If we have that many Tumbleyaks... Pela won't have to herd them anymore, right?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Lucio's been heading out to distant fields every day lately... They say the grass around here isn't good for the cattle anymore.
None of these fit.

speaker: NPC #50149
anh_en: The Montelli... a story centered on the upper echelons of the Montelli family, steeped in themes of crime, conspiracy, assassination, and betrayal. It's just too dark.

speaker: NPC #50149
anh_en: John Wicktorio... Some bad people destroyed the loyal Echo of a retired Montelli family accountant, who then revenges by exposing the old nobility's shady dealings... I don't like it.

speaker: NPC #50149
anh_en: Pirates of Ragunna... Recounts the adventures of a legendary captain with a morally ambiguous nature. The treasure he seeks and the spoils he plunders are, in truth, the smiles of the people. This story has been banned by The Order.

speaker: NPC #50149
anh_en: The Card Rider Guga... It tells of a nameless hero who became a knight to stop the suffering of people, battling creatures known as Threnodian... This story is just too far-fetched.

speaker: NPC #50149
anh_en: The Holy Echo War... It tells the story of seven Echo controllers who, driven by their own desires, entered a brutal survival contest in the distant past. It's a tale of ruthless battles and deadly pursuits... This is way too cruel.

speaker: NPC #50149
anh_en: That's true... I guess Pela has outgrown these kinds of stories. I should think it over myself.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: It's almost Pela's birthday again. I should buy her some interesting storybooks this year too...

speaker: NPC #50149
anh_en: Beyond Solaris, "Septimont Holiday," "The Legend of Violinist 2000," "Theatre Paradiso"... Pela has read all these classics.

speaker: NPC #50149
anh_en: Oh, sorry, I was lost in thought... My friend, which storybook on the table do you think would be suitable for my daughter?
The Montelli.
John Wicktorio.
Pirates of Ragunna.
The Card Rider Guga.
The Holy Echo War.

speaker: NPC #50150
anh_en: Hello, welcome to Jamie's Farm. If you're looking for Lucio, he should be herding near Egla Town.

speaker: NPC #50150
anh_en: Their offspring, Pela, possesses excellent logical abilities but lacks emotional understanding and self-awareness.

speaker: NPC #50150
anh_en: Every year on that day, Lucio and Julia would spend a fortune to prepare storybooks for Pela.

speaker: NPC #50150
anh_en: The works they are preparing are poised for commercial success. Thus, Pela surmises that Julia and Lucio expect her to write scripts that will generate profit.

speaker: NPC #50150
anh_en: Unfortunately, without empathy, Pela can't become a great author.

speaker: NPC #50150
anh_en: Goodbye.
Could you tell me about your family?
What's your birthday wish?
Thank you. See you then.

speaker: NPC #50150
anh_en: As you can see, the Jamie family is just an ordinary herding family living outside Egla Town. They lack noble status, background with The Order, or any accumulated wealth.

speaker: NPC #50150
anh_en: These are Lucio, Julia, and Pela. Their primary business partners are the merchants and the bakery in Egla Town.
Your way of speaking is quite particular.

speaker: NPC #50150
anh_en: Pela exhibits certain cognitive impairments, according to Acolyte Wicktorio's analysis.

speaker: NPC #50150
anh_en: Julia and Lucio suffered an incident twenty years ago that left a lasting impact on their minds.

speaker: NPC #50117
anh_en: Hello there, traveler.

speaker: NPC #50117
anh_en: Stay away from the depths of Whisperwind Haven.
Anything there?
Do you live here alone?
Thank you. Goodbye.

speaker: NPC #50117
anh_en: Nothing but the Tacet Discords, illusions, and the traces of fallen knights.

speaker: NPC #50117
anh_en: Nothing of value remains.

speaker: NPC #50117
anh_en: I'm stationed here to ensure no one strays into the depths of Whisperwind Haven.

speaker: NPC #50117
anh_en: Sometimes... I also take care of those who slip through the cracks.

speaker: NPC #50118
anh_en: Great to see you, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #50118
anh_en: I'm quite satisfied.

speaker: NPC #50118
anh_en: Even if the knights fade from the future history of Ragunna, the wind by the water will remember that we were here.

speaker: NPC #50118
anh_en: Twenty years ago, we were just a bunch of country folk inspired by the tales of the Blessed Maiden and the Knights fighting against the Dark Tide. We dreamt of becoming knights ourselves.

speaker: NPC #50118
anh_en: We were soldiers, craftsmen, and farmers. While we may not stand beside the knights in battle, we hold our positions steadfastly, inspired by their tales.

speaker: NPC #50118
anh_en: After the Dark Tide, we arrived in Ragunna, expecting to see triumphant knights. Instead, in the city square, we found the knights on their knees. The Order condemned them for blasphemy, simply because they suggested a journey to the seminary to seek the Blessed Maiden.

speaker: NPC #50118
anh_en: The valiant knights stood tall, shouting defiantly against the sharp blade of the Echoes, invoking the name of Imperator... And some people rushed to save them.

speaker: NPC #50118
anh_en: ...In the end, we were all deemed accomplices and faced retribution. Those who survived banded together and left Ragunna, becoming the first of the wandering knights.

speaker: NPC #50118
anh_en: That's the story of the first Whisperwind Knights.

speaker: NPC #50118
anh_en: Goodbye, may glory and courage always light your path.

speaker: NPC #50118
anh_en: Thank you for helping young Carlow last time, hehe... The Whisperwind Knight Conrad salutes you.
So you remember your own name now?
Are you happy with this title?
Tell me about the past of the Whisperwind Knight.
Good to see you. Gotta leave.

speaker: NPC #50118
anh_en: Yes, my name's Conrad, once known as the Wandering Knight Conrad, or Conrad who was never recognized as a true knight.

speaker: NPC #50118
anh_en: Before the Order had me marked as a fugitive, I was once a farmer, a fisherman, a carpenter, and a soldier guarding Ragunna against the Dark Tide.

speaker: NPC #50118
anh_en: Now just an old man bestowed with the title of Whisperwind Knight.

speaker: NPC #50151
anh_en: I won, hahaha! I'll be the knight again today!

speaker: NPC #50152
anh_en: Ohhh! You're right! Bruno, I know which script we should use!

speaker: NPC #50151
anh_en: Wait... A script for knightly duels? Could it be...

speaker: NPC #50152
anh_en: That's the one!

speaker: NPC #50152
anh_en: I'm definitely not going to die... Bruno, if you take a life, there's no turning back!

speaker: NPC #50151
anh_en: That's just what I wanted!

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Bruno and Golem begin to seriously play out the knightly tale...

speaker: NPC #50152
anh_en: Ohhh! You're right! Bruno, I know which script we should use!

speaker: NPC #50151
anh_en: Which one? A script about knights betraying their comrades? Could it be...

speaker: NPC #50152
anh_en: That's the one!

speaker: NPC #50151
anh_en: Ha—ha—ha—ha! So, there's only one answer!

speaker: NPC #50151
anh_en: Ha! Let's recount your transgressions! Dark Tide Villain!

speaker: NPC #50151
anh_en: I swear my loyalty to you!

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Bruno and Golem begin to seriously play out the knightly tale...

speaker: NPC #50151
anh_en: So, you're out of ideas too... Golem, why don't you play the Dark Tide Villain instead?

speaker: NPC #50152
anh_en: That's not fair!

speaker: NPC #50151
anh_en: Golem, The moment you try to be a hero, you're disqualified.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Bruno and Golem begin to seriously play out the knightly tale...

speaker: NPC #50152
anh_en: Can you even count how many times that's happened... Wait! Wait a minute! That's not fair. Why am I always the one playing the villain?!

speaker: NPC #50151
anh_en: Well, Carlow said that in a knight game, you usually need knights and villains for a battle to happen!

speaker: NPC #50152
anh_en: No way, no way! Isn't there a knight game where someone doesn't have to play the villain?

speaker: NPC #50151
anh_en: I'm not sure about a knight game without any villains... Hmm... Do you have any ideas, {Male=mister;Female=miss}?
The duel of two knights fighting for their own justice!
The tale of a knight who betrayed comrades for a greater cause!
I don't really have any thoughts...

speaker: NPC #50141
anh_en: By the Sentinel... What should I do to find the goods? If I don't recover them soon, Signor Marcello will surely "settle the accounts" with me...

speaker: NPC #50141
anh_en: But how could I ever stand a chance against the Mad Knight?
Have you lost anything?
How will you know if you don't try?

speaker: NPC #50141
anh_en: I lost the goods Signor Marcello entrusted to me, and it's all because of that Mad Knight... What kind of knight attacks a merchant caravan anyway?

speaker: NPC #50141
anh_en: Surely you jest—one wrong move and I'm toast!

speaker: NPC #50140
anh_en: Firus is truly unreliable. I'll probably have to find the shipment myself.

speaker: NPC #50140
anh_en: Mad Knight... Hmph, if he was truly a knight, how could he possibly rob the civilians?
Is losing the goods a big problem?

speaker: NPC #50140
anh_en: Yes, quite serious. The Order is watching us closely. Losing the goods will lead to financial deficits, and we'll have to address the shortfall in the accounts.

speaker: NPC #50140
anh_en: We can't afford to keep showing over 50% depreciation rate on the ledgers. The tax officials will undoubtedly seize the opportunity to scrutinize the family's cash flow. With the pressure being amplified through the ranks, our accountant might just end up being packed off on a Pilgrim's Sail...

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Marcello starts muttering some strange phrases.

speaker: NPC #50141
anh_en: Sentinel above, I truly wish to know which noble hero drove away the Mad Knight. Now all the lost goods have been recovered!
I am the one!
Maybe just a knight passing by.

speaker: NPC #50141
anh_en: The Mad Knight didn't damage the goods at all... Could it be that he wasn't after credits?

speaker: NPC #50141
anh_en: Praise you! Without your help, I would have been forced into that labor contract...

speaker: NPC #50141
anh_en: A knight! Could it be... that the legendary knight truly resides here in Egla Town?

speaker: NPC #50140
anh_en: Making choices driven by short-term convenience, taking high risks... Why did we entrust such a person with the significant tasks?

speaker: NPC #50140
anh_en: I'm sorry for the farce you just witnessed.

speaker: NPC #50142
anh_en: Welcome to Egla Town, traveler from afar. May you have a wonderful time here.

speaker: NPC #50142
anh_en: Despite that... there have been some unusual circumstances lately, so please avoid going out at night unless absolutely necessary. If you need accommodation, please speak with Damian. He'll help you arrange a room.
What do you mean by unusual circumstances?
Thanks. That's all I need.

speaker: NPC #50142
anh_en: Have you ever heard the tale of the knight? Once, a knight ventured deep into the area to vanquish a menacing "giant" that plagued the land. Since then, the knight has become a symbol of this place.

speaker: NPC #50142
anh_en: Many knights have been drawn to this place by its fame. And one of them had likely become the "Mad Knight."

speaker: NPC #50142
anh_en: It is said that he gradually lost himself during the endless fight against the Tacet Discords...

speaker: NPC #50142
anh_en: To placate the Mad Knight, the town created the Night Reveries—endless dramas of the knight enacted by the Echoes. Townsfolk and visitors alike were advised to stay indoors at night.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Heh... How many years have we been strolling here every morning?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: I can't remember. My memory is not what it used to be. We're just old fools approaching the grave.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Every time I see this house, I feel as if the child's right before me...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Oh Imperator, is her fate also part of your design?

speaker: NPC #50142
anh_en: I'm really grateful for your help with Carlow, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #50142
anh_en: Now that the Mad Knight is gone, the endless Night Reveries in Egla Town have finally come to an end.
You seem to miss the drama.
Will this give your business a hard time?

speaker: NPC #50142
anh_en: Hah, I just never imagined those old tales of knights would still be unfolding...

speaker: NPC #50142
anh_en: My only regret is that I'm no longer worthy of bestowing honors upon them.

speaker: NPC #50142
anh_en: It may not be a bad thing if it's so. Lately, Damian's been coming around after hearing something from Carlow.

speaker: NPC #50142
anh_en: He's taken a two-month leave to visit Ragunna City. If business slows down a bit, I can manage the inn by myself.

speaker: NPC #50142
anh_en: How odd, dreaming once more of the days in the Order...

speaker: NPC #50142
anh_en: Why... I saw that child and her knightly companions setting out against the Dark Tide again in the dream.

speaker: NPC #50142
anh_en: Is a metal ring really the mark of a fake knight? Heh.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Do you know what it takes to survive in the hunting grounds? Caution. Above all else.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Caution alone is not enough to achieve victory. You must also strike with courage.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: The Havoc Drake is definitely the strongest.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: No, the Aero Drake is more powerful!

speaker: NPC #750264
anh_en: The Havoc Drake dishes out more powerful attacks, while the Aero Drake is only good for its endurance.

speaker: NPC #750265
anh_en: Attack power doesn't translate to survival. When damage output doesn't cut it, it comes down to who can survive the longest!

speaker: NPC #750266
anh_en: Enough of that. How about the two of you have an Echo duel?

speaker: NPC #750266
anh_en: A fight will help settle everything.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Where have Trefor and Disanta run off to this time...

speaker: NPC #750267
anh_en: {PlayerName}, have you seen two young Gladiators by the names of Trefor and Disanta around here?

speaker: NPC #750267
anh_en: We're getting ready to set out for the hunt tomorrow, and I just can't find them anywhere.
Tell him what you know.
Keep it a secret.
