anh_en: You won. I yield.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Hm... How can I stick around here a little longer?

speaker: NPC #850033
anh_en: ...Tch, no way I'm fooling the Doc. She's too sharp.
Doctor Marcia's doing what's best for you.
You just want to play the game, don't you?

speaker: NPC #850033
anh_en: Hey! You think I'm a coward? I'm a Gladiator through and through! There's nothing in me but honor!

speaker: NPC #850033
anh_en: I'm not hiding, it's just... I...

speaker: NPC #850033
anh_en: ...Alright, you got me. I want to play Peaks of Prestige!

speaker: NPC #850033
anh_en: Huh? That's not the point.

speaker: NPC #850033
anh_en: Don't get me wrong, Marcia's nice to us...

speaker: NPC #850033
anh_en: But it's about the game! I'm here for Peaks of Prestige!

speaker: NPC #850033
anh_en: Ha, I knew you'd understand, Apex Duelist! Our duelist spirits sure are kindred!

speaker: NPC #850033
anh_en: But if I want to stay...
So, what's your plan?

speaker: NPC #850033
anh_en: I thought about throwing a fight, getting roughed up, but no Gladiator worth his salt would ever do that.

speaker: NPC #850033
anh_en: And it'd only mean more trouble for Marcia... She deserves that time to rest.

speaker: NPC #850033
anh_en: This leaves me with one option... faking an illness.
You really think that's going to work?

speaker: NPC #850033
anh_en: It should... maybe? But my squad's not heading out anytime soon. I doubt she'd believe a fake injury.

speaker: NPC #850033
anh_en: Aha! I'll just say I have stomach pains. No wounds, no way to prove it.

speaker: NPC #850033
anh_en: I'll go ask her for some medicine... Ow! My leg! Guess I'm not healed after all.
What are you doing here?

speaker: NPC #850033
anh_en: Dr. Marcia says my leg is as good as new. If this keeps up, I'll be out of here for sure...

speaker: NPC #850033
anh_en: But damn it, I don't want to leave yet...
I get it. Safer here than out on the field.

speaker: NPC #850008
anh_en: May applause greet you, Apex Duelist.
They just want to play the game.

speaker: NPC #850008
anh_en: Yes, well. Obsession with dueling isn't healthy either. Fortunately, I've developed an effective treatment.
Planning to beat them in a duel?
Are you taking their game modules away?
You don't seem too busy today.

speaker: NPC #850008
anh_en: Hehe, I tried. They just came back shouting about "duelist spirit" and "deck bonds" like it meant something to me.

speaker: NPC #850008
anh_en: Truth be told, I sometimes find myself admiring the resilience and energy they show, despite their injuries.

speaker: NPC #850008
anh_en: I wanted to, but it'd only make them dig their heels in deeper...

speaker: NPC #850008
anh_en: You remember why I introduced the game, don't you? It was to get them to cooperate, to follow treatment.

speaker: NPC #850008
anh_en: But now, one problem is solved and another created.

speaker: NPC #850008
anh_en: So my new solution is to add extremely bitter but nutritious ingredients to their potions.

speaker: NPC #850008
anh_en: Right now, they can still choke them down. But there's a limit to what they can stomach.

speaker: NPC #850008
anh_en: Once I find that limit, they won't fake illnesses anymore, I think.

speaker: NPC #850008
anh_en: Indeed. Most of the patients are well on the mend.
Sounds a little scary...
It might just work.

speaker: NPC #850008
anh_en: Well, it's time to brew up another batch. See you next time, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #850008
anh_en: The next few days will just be routine checkups and nutrition supplements.

speaker: NPC #850008
anh_en: Of course... a few are faking it, trying to stick around longer.
Wait, you noticed?

speaker: NPC #850008
anh_en: Naturally. I'm a doctor. One glance is all it takes.

speaker: NPC #850008
anh_en: See the one lurking by the door? Probably brainstorming his next fake symptom as we speak.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Huh... What the... Why is this potion so bitter...

speaker: NPC #850033
anh_en: Ugh, this thing's so bitter... Tastes even worse than before...

speaker: NPC #850033
anh_en: No, I will not turn tail. Even if a mountain stands before me, I'll smash it to rubble. That's the Gladiator way!

speaker: NPC #850033
anh_en: That means I've got only one road ahead now.

speaker: NPC #850033
anh_en: Apex Duelist, I beg you, train me!

speaker: NPC #850033
anh_en: I have to defeat Dr. Marcia! Only then can I stay here and duel in peace... and never taste this vile potion again.
But she's one of the Lords of Prestige...
Great spirit, but...

speaker: NPC #850033
anh_en: No more excuses! Time to throw aside fear and hesitation. Show me the strength of a real Apex Duelist!
Let's do it.
Not now.

speaker: NPC #850033
anh_en: Then let the duel begin!

speaker: NPC #850033
anh_en: No worries! Whenever you're ready.

speaker: NPC #850033
anh_en: Oh hey, it's you, Apex Duelist!

speaker: NPC #850033
anh_en: As you can see, I challenged Dr. Marcia and lost. As a penalty, I have to drink this cursed potion.

speaker: NPC #850033
anh_en: Her potions keep getting worse. At this rate, I'll drop dead from bitterness before she catches me faking it.
Might be time to head back to the hunting grounds.
That's not impossible...

speaker: NPC #850033
anh_en: Ah, there you are, Apex Duelist!

speaker: NPC #850033
anh_en: Let's get today's training started.
Not now.
Let the duel begin!

speaker: NPC #850033
anh_en: It's alright. I'll be here waiting.

speaker: NPC #850033
anh_en: Okay. Let's do it!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: ...Ahhh, at last... Sweet liberty! Retirement!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: The success of Peaks of Prestige is just the beginning. I'm sure there'll be more backers jumping on board soon...

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: Years of labor, years of exploitation. And now, my agent has the audacity to ask me for overtime? I'll make sure they know...

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: I'm heading straight to my agent, and I'm slamming my resignation right in his face! Ha, it's been a long time coming!

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: After all these years, I'm finally about to live my dream! I'll buy a boat at Riccioli Islands and live out my days as a fisherman!

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: You know, I wouldn't even put syrup or nuts on my honeycakes trying to save every Credit I had. Folks laughed and said it was just a plain old pancake.

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: Haha, now just imagining the look on my manager's face, and the other House members... I could just...

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: Ahem... Anyway, wish me luck. My new life's waiting!
Good luck.
Chase your dreams, my friend.

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: Haha! Once I'm free, I'll treat you to a feast!

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: You can't chain a free and fearless soul!
You seem fired up, Raul.

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: Oh, Apex Duelist!

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: Of course I am. Thanks to that final duel, Peaks of Prestige has taken the whole city by storm.

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: And guess who made a fortune off it? Me. I'm so close to my dream!

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: To the Tide with the masters, the agents, the Gladiators! I, Raul, will be free!
Congratulations.
(He seems... like a completely different person.)

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: No, no, no... it's over... My retirement... my savings...

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: Ah...{PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: My manager said Ragunna's new trade routes are flooding Rinascita with Shell Credits, so everything's inflated?

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: What kind of excuse is that?! I can't live with it...
Sounds like your manager is lying to you.
So it's all the Montellis' fault, huh?
It's still cheaper than Jinzhou...

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: I know. But it's on me too. Should've paid more attention to prices earlier.

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: It's not like I can blame the Montellis. Heard they got hit by a disaster... whale rains or something, wrecked their cathedral.

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: They were just trying to rebuild their city. Somehow made a fortune while they were at it, I guess.

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: What?! An egg in Jinzhou costs HOW much?! And they dare to call it "affordable"?!

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: Hmph... I really thought one million Shell Credits would be enough... Turns out it's already lost a fifth of its value...
What's wrong?

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: Just thinking about it makes my chest hurt. Every Credit was earned with my blood, sweat, and tears.

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: Looks like my retirement plans are being postponed.

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: Thanks for listening to this, {PlayerName}. Guess all I can do is keep working.
You're back to your old self again.
The resignation didn't go well?

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: It's all meaningless... Work, life... meaningless...

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: If prices keep rising, I'll be finished before I even begin... All these years of effort, for what?
Wait, prices are rising?

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: Yeah. My manager handled all my expenses before so I never really checked the numbers. I just ate whatever was cheapest.

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: I went to the shop the other day to start planning ahead, and let me tell you...

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: ...Prices are soaring! I swear, years ago—no, decades ago—it was never this bad!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: ...Focus... Deep breath in, deep breath out...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: That's right. Forget about money for a second.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Come, challengers.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Want to take on the Lord of Prestige? Please... be my guest.

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: Ah, we meet again.
That doesn't sound like you.

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: Heh, that's my manager's spiel. Just another trick to get more out of me.

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: But enough about that. Complaining never makes life easier... it just knocks you down harder and drags you further into the muck.
Sure.
Maybe later.

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: Alright, let's duel.

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: Take your time. I'm not going anywhere.

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: So, you up for a duel? Not many challengers around today.
You...

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: Yes, your eyes don't deceive you. I'm back where I first started—a Gladiator fighting for honor, haha.

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: And yeah, I'm busy most nights, too. Sacrificing my rest for side gigs.

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: These days, I barely get three hours of sleep. But hey, at least I can steal a few hours away from my manager's tight schedule.

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: You see, at night I become a Lord of Prestige dueling would-be challengers.
That's rough.

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: Yeah. But duel payouts have gone up a bit, so it's halfway decent now. Ha, otherwise I really would've quit.

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: Live with hope and passion. If you fall, rise again...

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: Welcome back, Apex Duelist.

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: Got a moment? Fancy a duel? I don't mind losing, as long as there's a Credit in it.
Sure.
Maybe later.

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: Alright, let's duel.

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: Take your time. I'm not going anywhere.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Come, child! Witness the unbreakable bond I share with my wife!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Bond? You don't say, Uncle Cromer.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Looks like I'll have to use my special move...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I... I will not lose!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: You just won't give up, will you, Grandpa Gaferro?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Alright, looks like I'll have to...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Easy, everyone! Form a proper line to claim your game modules!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Hey, when do I get my shot at the Apex Duelist?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: By the rules, you'll need to collect six Medals of Prestige first. Good luck!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Muahahaha! I'm reclaiming everything you stole today, Gallus!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Take a bite out of my hatred and wrath!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: I-it's nice to see you so passionate, Aunt Agatha...

speaker: NPC #850005
anh_en: Ah, {PlayerName}! Great to see you again!

speaker: NPC #850005
anh_en: I want to shine like you do, {PlayerName}. But... do you think I can?
Of course you can.
You're already very brilliant.
Just follow your heart.

speaker: NPC #850005
anh_en: Haha... that's very kind of you.

speaker: NPC #850005
anh_en: Thank you, {PlayerName}. I'll work hard, you'll see.

speaker: NPC #850005
anh_en: Speaking of... would you like a quick duel? It'd be great practice for me!
Sounds good.

speaker: NPC #850005
anh_en: I've been leveling up, {PlayerName}! You won't be able to crush me so easily this time!
Maybe another time.

speaker: NPC #850005
anh_en: Ahem, I would like to interview you, if that's alright...

speaker: NPC #850005
anh_en: Oh, too busy? No worries! You can always swing by for a duel when you're free!

speaker: NPC #850005
anh_en: What's it like to be the Apex Duelist? Standing in the center of the Colosseum, all eyes on you... It must feel incredible.
It's... pretty shiny, I guess.
At this point, I've become kind of immune to it.

speaker: NPC #850005
anh_en: Oh, wow...

speaker: NPC #850005
anh_en: ...Ha, I'm happy for you! Congrats!

speaker: NPC #850005
anh_en: By the way, I've always wanted to thank you. Slipped my mind last time.

speaker: NPC #850005
anh_en: Because of you, I finally see what true brilliance looks like.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Hm... Tomorrow's another day to shine!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Come on, Liliania! You can do it!

speaker: NPC #850005
anh_en: Eh? Oh, it's you, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #850005
anh_en: I see... Thanks.

speaker: NPC #850005
anh_en: I'll work twice as hard! I have to show everyone my brightest self!
That's the spirit.

speaker: NPC #850005
anh_en: I have to step up my dueling game too. No more easy losses for Liliania!

speaker: NPC #850005
anh_en: Oh! I remember this movie where an idol loved wearing blue.

speaker: NPC #850005
anh_en: Every time she lost, she'd fall flat on her face from way up high. Took her months to recover...
Huh???
That sounds terrifying...

speaker: NPC #850005
anh_en: Heh, just special effects. But losing does sting. It makes you question everything you worked hard for...

speaker: NPC #850005
anh_en: Well, I didn't feel that way when I lost to you, though. I mean, you did beat Furius the Firebrand himself, so no shame there.
What's wrong, Liliania?

speaker: NPC #850005
anh_en: But I'm not giving up. I'll keep pushing for all those who believe in me!
You look a little down.

speaker: NPC #850005
anh_en: It's nothing... I'm just a little worried...

speaker: NPC #850005
anh_en: I'm not sure I have enough energy to juggle being an idol and a Lord of Prestige.

speaker: NPC #850005
anh_en: Which do you think matters more, dueling or performing?
Both matter in their own way.
What really counts is bringing joy to others.
Just do what you do best.

speaker: NPC #850006
anh_en: Ah, you're the duelist who earned Liliania's respect.

speaker: NPC #850006
anh_en: Looking back... I do feel kinda bad about that. But hey, I'll own up to it.

speaker: NPC #850032
anh_en: I understand you.

speaker: NPC #850006
anh_en: Appreciate it. After that first show, I started seeing her all over the city.

speaker: NPC #850006
anh_en: Always practicing, performing, talking to people about how she could improve...

speaker: NPC #850006
anh_en: In just a few months, she turned into a whole new person. Watching it all happen, I became one of her biggest fans.

speaker: NPC #850006
anh_en: Her hard work, her spirit, not giving up even once... That's what makes her shine.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: She'd be overjoyed to know how much you cared.

speaker: NPC #850006
anh_en: Haha... no need. We don't want to burden her. Better she focuses on herself, that's all we want.

speaker: NPC #850032
anh_en: I-I swear... if she ever performed in the Colosseum... I could die happy!

speaker: NPC #850006
anh_en: Back for another duel with her?
Not today. Just dropping by.

speaker: NPC #850006
anh_en: ...I see. You've got a good taste, then.

speaker: NPC #850032
anh_en: Y-Yeah... anyone who supports Liliania must have a good heart...

speaker: NPC #850006
anh_en: I mean, who wouldn't be moved seeing how hard she works, right?
You too?

speaker: NPC #850006
anh_en: Of course. Though to be honest, her performance didn't really impress me at first.

speaker: NPC #850006
anh_en: Her singing, her dancing... None of it felt polished. I thought, "This is never gonna win anyone over."

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: ...Aww, Liliania's smile is too adorable...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Could I... um, capture it somehow? Then, you know...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Yeah! We could turn it into a banner for her next show! Liliania is gonna love it!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Check this out! Just got my hands on this beauty!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: No way?! The golden Feilian Beringal!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: That's right. Wrestled it away from Hanson.

speaker: NPC #850087
anh_en: I'll trade you Hecate for it! Please! It's the last card I need for my deck!

speaker: NPC #850086
anh_en: No can do. This isn't just any Feilian Beringal, it's the supreme, limited edition that glows!

speaker: NPC #850087
anh_en: ...I'll throw in one—No, three Fusion Dreadmanes on top!

speaker: NPC #850086
anh_en: Tempting... let me think it over.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: ...Looking for Echoes? I've got plenty of rare ones.

speaker: NPC #850001
anh_en: Ah, greetings, Apex Duelist {Male=Sir;Female=Miss}!

speaker: NPC #850001
anh_en: Mr. Furius was right: nothing drives a man better than passion.
It's crowded here.
You seem busy.

speaker: NPC #850001
anh_en: Yes, as you can see, the line is packed with folks eager for their Peaks of Prestige module.

speaker: NPC #850001
anh_en: Hard to believe that just days ago, almost no one in Septimont had even heard of this game...

speaker: NPC #850001
anh_en: Thankfully, that final duel sparked quite a lot of interest.

speaker: NPC #850001
anh_en: Mr. Furius is busy sweet-talking sponsors, so he left me on module duty for all the new recruits.

speaker: NPC #850001
anh_en: I'm giving out dozens a day now, plus running crash courses. Exhausting work, to be honest.

speaker: NPC #850001
anh_en: Still, I enjoy seeing everyone fall in love with Peaks of Prestige. Sweeps all the weariness away.

speaker: NPC #850088
anh_en: ...Hello there, {Male=Sir;Female=Miss}! You must be a duelist!

speaker: NPC #850088
anh_en: Oh-oh sure. No one loves dueling more than I do!

speaker: NPC #850088
anh_en: It's not just fun. There's big money in it—Ahem, I mean, honor! Which is surely more important!

speaker: NPC #850088
anh_en: So? Anything catch your eye?
Not interested.
This is way too overpriced.

speaker: NPC #850088
anh_en: Tch... Fine, your loss.

speaker: NPC #850088
anh_en: Victory's worth more than a few measly Credits, you know.

speaker: NPC #850088
anh_en: When you change your mind, I'll be right here.

speaker: NPC #850088
anh_en: You've got that desire for power and victory in your eyes.

speaker: NPC #850088
anh_en: Luckily for you, power isn't as far away as you think, my friend. All you need is a little... assistance...
Assistance?
You're a duelist too?

speaker: NPC #850088
anh_en: That's right! I've got the rarest Peaks of Prestige Echoes you'll ever lay eyes on.

speaker: NPC #850088
anh_en: With these beauties, no rival can stand against you!

speaker: NPC #850088
anh_en: Of course, these treasures weren't easy to come by. So... a fair price is to be expected, yes?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Peaks of Prestige? That's just a game to kill time.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Stop wasting time on this nonsense. You were born for the arena!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: You just don't get it...

speaker: NPC #850089
anh_en: Say what you will, son. But I won't stand by and watch you throw your life away like this.

speaker: NPC #850090
anh_en: —A Gladiator who's never won a single fight? Now I'm your second shot at glory, is that it?

speaker: NPC #850089
anh_en: Watch your tongue!

speaker: NPC #850089
anh_en: A true Gladiator fights in the sacred arena, under the eyes of the crowd, with steel and courage.

speaker: NPC #850089
anh_en: And then there's this, Peaks of Prestige. You call that combat?

speaker: NPC #850090
anh_en: But Father, everyone loves Peaks of Prestige!

speaker: NPC #850090
anh_en: Isn't victory what matters? In the arena or not, the goal's the same.

speaker: NPC #850089
anh_en: Gladiating is a Septimotian tradition. Don't you compare it with a child's game!

speaker: NPC #850090
anh_en: You're not defending tradition. You're just afraid of what you don't know!

speaker: NPC #850089
anh_en: Afraid? I am a Gladiator—

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: ...I'm not entirely sure this is a good thing, Mr. Scipius.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Do you mean Peaks of Prestige? No need for concern. It so far remains under our oversight.

speaker: NPC #850091
anh_en: Greetings, {Male=Mr.;Female=Ms.} {PlayerName}. Your duel in the Colosseum left quite an impression.
It will help other regions learn about Gladiator culture.
It will bring in a lot of profit for the city.
It's going to cause chaos.

speaker: NPC #850092
anh_en: ...I see. Thank you. It seems you and Mr. Scipius think alike.

speaker: NPC #850092
anh_en: Profit... a valuable point, no doubt. Thank you.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: As you explain some of the issues arising in the city due to Peaks of Prestige, Scipius and Saveria's faces grow serious.

speaker: NPC #850092
anh_en: So you believe Peaks of Prestige's popularity has come with a cost..

speaker: NPC #850092
anh_en: Indeed, there have been reports of abuse and manipulation. Do you believe we should step in?

speaker: NPC #850091
anh_en: Hehe, calm yourself, Saveria. I doubt {PlayerName} meant it that way.

speaker: NPC #850091
anh_en: Yes, Peaks of Prestige has brought a few social problems. But like most trends, the fever will pass.

speaker: NPC #850091
anh_en: Allow me to introduce myself. I am Scipius, and this is Saveria, my associate.

speaker: NPC #850091
anh_en: When it does, I believe reason will prevail. Fear of the unfamiliar should never be the excuse to deny something new.

speaker: NPC #850092
anh_en: You're right, Mr. Scipius. Perhaps I should try playing Peaks of Prestige myself, to truly understand it.

speaker: NPC #850092
anh_en: Your insight has been valuable. We'll make sure the Ephor hears it. Thank you for your cooperation, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #850092
anh_en: A pleasure, Mr. {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #850091
anh_en: As you may have guessed, we represent the Ephor's Palace.
So the game caught your attention too?

speaker: NPC #850091
anh_en: Yes, Peaks of Prestige is the most popular game in Septimont. It is our duty to stay informed.

speaker: NPC #850092
anh_en: May I ask you something, Mr. {PlayerName}?
Of course.

speaker: NPC #850092
anh_en: Thank you. In your opinion, what will Peaks of Prestige bring to Septimont?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Lollo Hitman is now offering a beta version of the Peaks of Prestige backup dueling service!

speaker: NPC #850093
anh_en: Oh! Hello there, {PlayerName}!
Sounds... useful?
That goes against the duelist spirit.

speaker: NPC #850093
anh_en: Well, right now the only "backup" available is me. And I, uh... just hit a 20-duel losing streak.

speaker: NPC #850093
anh_en: Hmm... thing is, the only "backup" available is me. And I, uh... just hit a 20-duel losing streak.

speaker: NPC #850093
anh_en: Oh, wait! Aren't you the Apex Duelist? Any chance you'd do a few duels?
Not a chance.
I've got another idea.

speaker: NPC #850093
anh_en: Huh? Another idea...?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You suggest to Mayou that he could use the location tracking feature from the Lollo app to build a system that pairs nearby duelists.

speaker: NPC #850093
anh_en: ...Hmm, you mean we could work with Mr. Furius to build a duel pairing system to connect nearby players for a fight?
You are...

speaker: NPC #850093
anh_en: That's brilliant. Thank you, {PlayerName}!

speaker: NPC #850093
anh_en: I'm Mayou, Maji's brother. He told me all about you. Said you helped him launch a bunch of Lollo apps...

speaker: NPC #850093
anh_en: Figured I'd come lend a hand with marketing here in Septimont.
Are you here to make me fix more cars?
Or beat someone up?

speaker: NPC #850093
anh_en: Hahaha... don't worry, Lollo Fixit and Lollo Hitman are solid products now... I think.

speaker: NPC #850093
anh_en: Actually, I heard a game called Peaks of Prestige is all the rage here.

speaker: NPC #850093
anh_en: So I added a new feature to Lollo Hitman. It lets duelists call for backup during matches!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: You know how it is. Gladiator business is not easy these days. The top teams are eating the rest alive.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: So now we're chasing gimmicks? Really?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Gimmick, huh? Heh...

speaker: NPC #850353
anh_en: ...With all due respect, Blaise, I doubt the House head will approve this plan.

speaker: NPC #850353
anh_en: The Grandinos have all but written him off. Loaded him up with menial tasks.

speaker: NPC #850094
anh_en: Exactly, more like a hired servant than a Gladiator... Ha, only the Grandinos would waste talent like that.

speaker: NPC #850094
anh_en: He's a goldmine, Caprio! A walking, breathing goldmine!

speaker: NPC #850353
anh_en: ...I don't quite follow, Blaise.

speaker: NPC #850094
anh_en: He's no good in the arena, but he's Raul the Dustbound, one of the Lords of Prestige!

speaker: NPC #850094
anh_en: Bring some money, go to the Grandinos, and buy him out.

speaker: NPC #850353
anh_en: I'm concerned the Grandinos won't let him go that easily.

speaker: NPC #850094
anh_en: Ever heard of that old tale from Huanglong? If you want to sell a cat, put it next to a priceless antique cat bowl...

speaker: NPC #850094
anh_en: But we'll flip the script: We offer them a deal, a joint exhibition tournament, all expenses on us. We pay, they gain.

speaker: NPC #850094
anh_en: Our condition is to borrow their best duelist, to which they'll say no, of course. Then we act like we're willing to settle for Raul instead.

speaker: NPC #850094
anh_en: Doesn't matter. I've saved up enough to fund a Peaks of Prestige team myself.

speaker: NPC #850353
anh_en: A genius move, Blaise. I'll speak to them immediately.

speaker: NPC #850094
anh_en: Hehe, once Raul is ours. I'll have him dueling twenty hours a day.

speaker: NPC #850094
anh_en: You've seen it. This game is sweeping the streets.

speaker: NPC #850094
anh_en: We have to act fast before the other Houses catch on, while their rusted minds are still stuck in the past.

speaker: NPC #850353
anh_en: Blaise...

speaker: NPC #850094
anh_en: Let me finish, Caprio. By the time they realize it, we'll be known as the patrons behind Septimont's greatest Peaks of Prestige team!

speaker: NPC #850353
anh_en: ...Sigh.

speaker: NPC #850094
anh_en: Tell me, Caprio, do you know Raul? From House Grandino?

speaker: NPC #850353
anh_en: The Gladiator? I heard he's a bit of a joke.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Peaks of Prestige duel footage from the finals! Not to be missed!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Witness the epic clash between the Apex Duelist and Conqueror of Prestige!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Comes with the champions' deck lists! Only 500 Shell Credits!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Hello, good sir! Got a moment? I'd love to tell you about...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: ...Not buying, not joining cults.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: No, no! I just want to introduce you to our game, Peaks of Prestige!

speaker: NPC #850095
anh_en: Ah, you are the Apex Duelist, right?

speaker: NPC #850095
anh_en: Haha, you bet. You are the motivation for duelists everywhere now.

speaker: NPC #850095
anh_en: Thanks to you, my footage business has been booming. Made myself a nice little fortune.
Glad to hear it.

speaker: NPC #850095
anh_en: Haha, you're just as generous as the stories say. Not like Mr. Furius. He tried to charge me for using his footage...

speaker: NPC #850095
anh_en: Not that I blame him. To be fair, I hear he wants to promote Peaks of Prestige to other regions. New matches, bigger stages.

speaker: NPC #850095
anh_en: Everything needs money. I'm sure he's got his hands full. Hope it works out for him.
That's me.
You just want the new footage, right?

speaker: NPC #850095
anh_en: Haha... I could deny it, but that'd make me a lousy merchant.

speaker: NPC #850095
anh_en: The truth is I genuinely want the game to thrive. It's a win-win, isn't it?

speaker: NPC #850095
anh_en: Finally! I've always wanted to meet you in person.

speaker: NPC #850095
anh_en: You look stronger in person than in the footage. So this is the aura of the best duelist in Septimont.
Footage? What footage?

speaker: NPC #850095
anh_en: That final match in the Colosseum.

speaker: NPC #850095
anh_en: You versus Mr. Furius. The legendary duel that settled who truly is the best Peaks of Prestige duelist in Septimont.

speaker: NPC #850095
anh_en: The line for that footage stretches from the Colosseum to the hunting grounds!
Is it really that popular...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Hmmm... Mr. Furius really has no business sense.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: If I were running things, Peaks of Prestige ads would be all over Ragunna by now...

speaker: NPC #850096
anh_en: Hello there! You've got that duelist look about you.

speaker: NPC #850096
anh_en: Normal business competition? You must be new around here.

speaker: NPC #850096
anh_en: From sponsored gladiating teams to snack stalls, everything here is a battleground.

speaker: NPC #850096
anh_en: Ever heard of a "trade war"? It's not what you read about in books. No spies or sabotage.

speaker: NPC #850096
anh_en: That's not what we do in Septimont.
Then what do you do?

speaker: NPC #850096
anh_en: Very simple. We settle it in the arena. Each sends in their own Gladiators. Losers bow out, winners take all.

speaker: NPC #850096
anh_en: Strength is what rules. The strong rise, the weak get crushed. It's the law of nature, simple and effective.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: So... you're going to "compete" with other agents?

speaker: NPC #850096
anh_en: Ugh, don't remind me. Mr. Furius must've seen this coming, but he... he's all about peace.

speaker: NPC #850096
anh_en: Otherwise, he wouldn't have made Peaks of Prestige to replace Gladitorial matches.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: I am. And you are?

speaker: NPC #850096
anh_en: He forbade us from using violence or directly confronting each other. Break that rule, and you're out.

speaker: NPC #850096
anh_en: So now, we have to find... other ways.

speaker: NPC #850096
anh_en: I'm an agent. I just landed the rights to distribute Peaks of Prestige from Mr. Furius himself.

speaker: NPC #850096
anh_en: Too bad it's not an exclusive deal. To be honest, Mr. Furius has no clue how business works...

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: What exclusive deal?

speaker: NPC #850096
anh_en: You know, locking the whole supply chain—production to retail—under my control.

speaker: NPC #850096
anh_en: But he didn't go for my proposal. Instead, he split it among a dozen agents. I'm just one of them.

speaker: NPC #850096
anh_en: I'm a decent merchant, but the other agents are playing a different game. Just thinking about it gives me chills...

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Sounds like normal business competition.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I might lose someday!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: But not today, and definitely not to you!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Bring it on!

speaker: NPC #850294
anh_en: My Tick Tack never loses!

speaker: NPC #850098
anh_en: Useless, useless, useless! My Clang Bang is the strongest!

speaker: NPC #850294
anh_en: Did you just say my Tick Tack is useless?!

speaker: NPC #850294
anh_en: There are no useless Echoes, only useless duelists! Let's go, Tick Tack, show her what we got!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: You a duelist too? Fancy a quick round? I'm bored to death.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Was thinking the same.

speaker: NPC #850099
anh_en: Ugh, can't believe I let you win this.

speaker: NPC #850100
anh_en: I'll take the victory. Good duel.

speaker: NPC #850099
anh_en: Wait, one more round! The train's not here yet!

speaker: NPC #850100
anh_en: Train? Oh, you missed it already.

speaker: NPC #850099
anh_en: Re-really? How?

speaker: NPC #850100
anh_en: Three of them actually, when we were dueling.

speaker: NPC #850100
anh_en: So... another round?

speaker: NPC #850099
anh_en: ...Sure, the train's gone anyway. I'm not losing again!

speaker: NPC #850005
anh_en: Hi there, {PlayerName}! Ready for a practice duel?
Sure, let's duel.

speaker: NPC #850005
anh_en: You won't crush me like last time!
Maybe another time.

speaker: NPC #850005
anh_en: No problem! Whenever you're ready.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Hehe, you see, I haven't broken any laws.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Not under our beloved Ephor's watch. I'd never do that...

speaker: NPC #850088
anh_en: ...W-wait, sir, this is all just a misunderstanding!

speaker: NPC #850088
anh_en: She's the very sun that lights our path! She speaks words of wisdom and justice...

speaker: NPC #850295
anh_en: Enough. Out of respect for your... admiration, I'll let you off this time. But you will surrender every Echo you've illegally obtained.

speaker: NPC #850295
anh_en: Then you will delete the Peaks of Prestige module and swear on the sun that you'll never do this again.

speaker: NPC #850088
anh_en: But... I-I paid for those... Ugh, fine.

speaker: NPC #850088
anh_en: By the light of the sun, I swear, if I ever do this again, let whatever doom fall upon me.

speaker: NPC #850295
anh_en: That's enough. Now move along.

speaker: NPC #850088
anh_en: ...Sigh. Thank you, good sir.

speaker: NPC #850295
anh_en: I've been watching you for quite some time. You buy Echoes on the cheap from kids and rookies, then flip them for a tidy profit.

speaker: NPC #850295
anh_en: You've disrupted Septimont's market balance. I don't think I misunderstood anything.

speaker: NPC #850088
anh_en: W-Wait! Please, allow me to defend... er, I mean, explain myself!

speaker: NPC #850088
anh_en: I've never scammed anyone! All I did was redistribute the Echoes to those who needed them! They were unwanted scraps, I swear!

speaker: NPC #850088
anh_en: The Ephor taught us wasting is the worst of all sins.

speaker: NPC #850088
anh_en: Think about it! Without me, those Echoes would be wasting away in someone's Terminal. How tragic is that?!

speaker: NPC #850295
anh_en: …Did the Ephor really say that?

speaker: NPC #850088
anh_en: She did, she must have! The Ephor is the embodiment of all virtue, right?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Well, it's all gone... Gotta start over again.

speaker: NPC #850088
anh_en: Hey, it's you. You're late, though. I'm out of stock. The authorities took everything.

speaker: NPC #850088
anh_en: Luckily, I was quick enough—wait, no—I mean, thanks to my reverence for the Ephor, they decided to spare me.
(Maybe your crime just wasn't serious enough...)

speaker: NPC #850088
anh_en: Anyway, no more Echo sales for me... If they catch me again, I won't get off so easy.

speaker: NPC #850088
anh_en: So, what should I sell next... Hmmm, I'll figure it out later.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Pairing players... How do I make it fair?

speaker: NPC #850093
anh_en: {PlayerName}! I-I need your help!

speaker: NPC #850093
anh_en: Thanks again, {PlayerName}. Your suggestions are gold! But I'll need more data to fine-tune the system...

speaker: NPC #850093
anh_en: I'll do my best to get the new Lollo Hitman: Peaks of Prestige expansion out to everyone soon!
What's wrong?

speaker: NPC #850093
anh_en: I added a Peaks of Prestige duel pairing function to Lollo Hitman, but people aren't enjoying it.

speaker: NPC #850093
anh_en: Everyone's complaining about the pairings saying the skill gap is too big. Pros get no thrills, and rookies just get crushed.

speaker: NPC #850093
anh_en: Please help me, {PlayerName}!
Match players strictly by win rate.
Split real duels from training duels.

speaker: NPC #850093
anh_en: Makes sense, though might be tough to implement.

speaker: NPC #850093
anh_en: Oh! That way, new players won't be stuck in tough matches from the start, and they could actually meet veterans willing to help them improve!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: ...Tell me, son. What's my deck still missing?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Hmm... Lemme think.

speaker: NPC #850089
anh_en: Hmm, very convincing. Alright, let's do it your way then.

speaker: NPC #850090
anh_en: Exactly, Father! Besides, Peaks of Prestige is fun, right?

speaker: NPC #850089
anh_en: Haha... It is. I used to teach you swordplay. Now you're teaching me deck combos. What a world.

speaker: NPC #850090
anh_en: Heheh!

speaker: NPC #850090
anh_en: Told you, I'm a pro.
You two seemed at odds before.
Managed to settle things?

speaker: NPC #850089
anh_en: Ah, it's you. Sorry you had to see that last time.

speaker: NPC #850089
anh_en: I gave it some thought. Maybe Galeazzo had a point.

speaker: NPC #850089
anh_en: I was chasing something I never quite reached. Gladiating was everything to me, but it never worked out.

speaker: NPC #850089
anh_en: That obsession blinded me. I forgot to look beyond the arena. But Galeazzo helped me see things clearer.

speaker: NPC #850089
anh_en: Victory matters, no matter where you earn it.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Clang Bang's price has tripled... Absolutely mad.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Chap's bound to get caught sooner or later.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Well, you were right. He got caught, haha.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Hope the Ephor gave him what he deserved.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Echo prices are back to normal.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Yeah, now I can finally afford the new deck. Praise the Ephor!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: This is overpriced. That much for a Hoochief...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: ...Sorry, I didn't catch that. Did you say something was overpriced?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Oh, yeah, that guy over there. He's practically a monopolist around here.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: ...Putini, what hour is it?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Not sure, Master. Why?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I've got this feeling like I'm forgetting something important...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Great. Now I can get the Echoes I want!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Thank you for bringing this to our attention. If anything like this happens in the future, don't hesitate to contact us.

speaker: NPC #850004
anh_en: Hey there, my friend!

speaker: NPC #850003
anh_en: Ugh... Duels are fun and all, but they're wrecking our schedule. We can't keep going like this.

speaker: NPC #850004
anh_en: ...Y-you're right! No matter. We can still make it. I am Agrippa the Ironheart. Time to show you why they call me that!

speaker: NPC #850003
anh_en: Got it, Master!

speaker: NPC #850003
anh_en: Good to see you again, Apex Duelist! Here for a duel?
Don't you two have work to do?

speaker: NPC #850003
anh_en: Work... wait, Master! Today's the day we're supposed to deliver!

speaker: NPC #850004
anh_en: Bah, still got some stock left. We'll manage. Now come on, let's duel.

speaker: NPC #850003
anh_en: Master, you forgot! We delivered the last of the stock days ago! The warehouse is emptier than your pockets!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Hmph... the wound is healing well. You'll be free to leave in a few days.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Appreciate the care, Dr. Marcia. But I can't say I'll miss this place...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Then stay safe during your hunt, Gladiator.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Beep—Folks, nobody saw this coming, nobody at all.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: The contender we all expected to go far just got knocked out by a rookie!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Beep—Look! The referee's raising the hand! Scratchy's run has hit a snag right from the start!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Let's all watch the replay—oh my, what a massive, massive rookie blunder!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Warning, warning—broadcast line failure—The referee, it's the referee!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: The referee charged to the front riding an Echo in the blink of an eye!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: A spectator just broke through the security staff! And he actually took off his shirt!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Zzzzzt—Is that a battle dance in support of the contender?! The Gladiator stepped forward.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: How the hell am I supposed to fix this thing?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: What kind of glitch could possibly scramble this many channels together?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Nope, doesn't work... Maybe a good solid kick then?

speaker: NPC #850077
anh_en: Now this is a pain... I've never run into a problem like this before...

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The staff is now trying to persuade the broadcast Echo to behave with earnest words.

speaker: NPC #850077
anh_en: Ah, got it. Sadly, I'm not a Resonator myself. Oh, I wonder if you might be willing to lend a hand? If you manage to fix it, I'll offer you a reward on behalf of the municipal authority.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: I'll do my best.
It looks like the Echo's frequencies got mixed up from switching lines too quickly. But with your help, it recovers in no time.

speaker: NPC #850077
anh_en: Oh wow! That's incredible, thank you so much!

speaker: NPC #850077
anh_en: Give it a kick!? I was just about to say the same thing! I guess great minds think alike!

speaker: NPC #850078
anh_en: Devastating strike detected. Warning, warning—

speaker: NPC #850077
anh_en: Oh sure, "folks say the broadcast Echo's down, go fix it!" Easy for them to say. This thing's completely fried. What exactly am I supposed to do here? Invent time travel?
What's going on?
Leave.

speaker: NPC #850077
anh_en: The broadcast Echo here is on the fritz. Wait, friend... You seem to know a thing or two about Echoes. Got any secret tricks for a glitchy one like this?
Try talking some sense into it.
Repair it with frequency sensing.
Give it a kick to warn it.

speaker: NPC #850077
anh_en: Talking some sense into it, huh? I see... Guess my words ain't cutting it... Sigh, all I know are the work banters. How am I supposed to truly reach an Echo?

speaker: NPC #700113
anh_en: You know, I find watching people argue is way more entertaining than watching them fight.

speaker: NPC #700113
anh_en: Sparring or match, in the end, the stronger fighter always comes out on top.

speaker: NPC #700113
anh_en: All the clashes between two souls eventually come down to only flesh and bone. And their moves may only tell you their personalities and skills.

speaker: NPC #700113
anh_en: But arguing? That's where things get really colorful. Folks keep digging up all kinds of clever tricks and dirty secrets just to hit where it hurts.

speaker: NPC #700113
anh_en: You know how one wrong step can send you sprawling? Same with words. Say the wrong thing at the right time, and it'll cut straight to the bone.

speaker: NPC #700113
anh_en: In any argument, anyone who blows their top first loses the fight, no matter how it ends.

speaker: NPC #700113
anh_en: See what I mean? Arguments make for way better entertainment, don't they?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Oh—Welcome to the Hotel Leonidas—

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Such a lovely place—

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Such a lovely face——

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Plenty of fine wine among the steam of baths—

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Any time of year, you can sing it here—

speaker: NPC #850079
anh_en: Hey there, traveler from afar! Did my tune catch your ear? Come, share a drink with me!
It's more like you are making noises...
Leave.

speaker: NPC #850079
anh_en: Come on, friend, you don't know the half of it! Those Carnevale shows over in Ragunna have really given the city a buzz. Just all the stories are enough for me to picture how spectacular they are!

speaker: NPC #850079
anh_en: See how beautifully they put it—"Why lead a life of restraints? Why not live like there's no tomorrow!"

speaker: NPC #850079
anh_en: In Septimont, it's all politics, gladiator fights, and hunting from dawn till dusk... Scheming this, fighting that... Honestly, doesn't it wear people out? Wars are never really over. I'd take the laid-back luxury of the bathhouse over those brawls any day.

speaker: NPC #850079
anh_en: And a couple of days ago, uh, what's her name... oh right, Cilania, started going on about how I was slandering Septimont with my nonsense, and now she wants to challenge me to some kind of Honor Duel.

speaker: NPC #850079
anh_en: Oh dear, she's serious serious... This spells trouble for yours truly! Better sing my heart out while I still can, before she lops off my lovely head.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Medic, how far do you expect us to go in this Agon?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Top eight, maybe?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Top eight? You're supposed to be playing none other than the genius Gladiator, Contender Lupa!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Miss Lupa would never say something like that!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Understood, Captain! The Blue Furies is aiming for the championship this time!

speaker: NPC #850080
anh_en: A fleeting bloom, an undefeated genius!

speaker: NPC #850081
anh_en: Anyway, if you're interested, come check out our matches!

speaker: NPC #850080
anh_en: One moment, she was gazing at the mountain city, the next she hurled into the blazing moments between life and death—Is the legendary fighter a prisoner bewitched by fate, or a white eagle soaring above the wind?

speaker: NPC #850080
anh_en: Let us lift the veil of history! All the thrills await you in the Blue Furies' gladiatorial spectacle! Stay tuned!

speaker: NPC #850081
anh_en: Follow the Blue Furies! Thank you, everyone! Follow us! Vote for us! Bet on us! Thank you, everyone!
What are you doing?
Leave.

speaker: NPC #850081
anh_en: Hey, wait... could you be {PlayerName}, the one who won the Laurel at the Carnevale? I've heard about you from the First Mate! Didn't expect to actually run into you here.

speaker: NPC #850081
anh_en: We're the Blue Furies from Ragunna, and we're currently promoting our team for the next match. What you just saw were some of our new ideas.

speaker: NPC #850081
anh_en: All these wild gladiator matches in Septimont are perfect stages for us. And lately we've been working their real stories right into our plays.

speaker: NPC #850081
anh_en: Ladies and gentlemen! At the head of the team—wearing an arm band—Our Captain, LEFT HOOK!

speaker: NPC #850081
anh_en: And behold! That massive figure right beside him, his fellow Echo!

speaker: NPC #850081
anh_en: The one who can quiet every child in Ragunna City—

speaker: NPC #850081
anh_en: The legendary—CUDDLE—WUDDLE—!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Ugh, the jobs this Order System keeps throwing at me are getting crazier by the day...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: What even is this? Room 301, Ragunna Bay Annexe, Old District...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Old District? Hasn't that place been underwater for ages?

speaker: NPC #850081
anh_en: Behold, friends, feast your eyes on this dashing warrior's heroic pose!

speaker: NPC #850081
anh_en: {Male=His;Female=Her} sword is unstoppable, and {Male=his;Female=her} name is on everyone's lips!

speaker: NPC #850081
anh_en: As the names foretell: A lightning that kindles the sky! A roving one that drifts across the land like a cloud!

speaker: NPC #850081
anh_en: The Champion of the Great Agon this year—{PlayerName}!

speaker: NPC #850247
anh_en: Did I start hallucinating from eating those expired salted fish on sale...?

speaker: NPC #850247
anh_en: Why can't I see a single Credit in my wallet...

speaker: NPC #850247
anh_en: Twice made it into the Gladiator's Agon main event, conversational in three languages, and proficient with five different Echoes. Such a versatile talent is now open to any hiring.
How about finding a job at a workshop?
Restaurants could always use a hand, right?
Looks like you have to try your luck in a new city.

speaker: NPC #850247
anh_en: That was also the first plan I could think of. Surviving in Septimont was all about skill and nerve... but...

speaker: NPC #850247
anh_en: After the Silva Family incident, everyone who knew me couldn't run fast enough. And strangers? Just hearing "Sylvester" makes them look like they've seen a raging Dark Tide.

speaker: NPC #850247
anh_en: Honestly, have they ever used their heads? If I were rigging matches, would I still be scraping by like this?

speaker: NPC #850247
anh_en: I've tried that before, but the truth is... not a single workshop is willing to hire someone with no relevant experience.

speaker: NPC #850247
anh_en: Even at the Septimont Craft Guild's apprentice recruitment fair, they line up candidates' credentials like ledger entries. Diplomas here, awards there. Some recruiters go so far as to judge works on the spot...

speaker: NPC #850247
anh_en: They're hiring apprentices, but want at least three years of experience. Seriously?

speaker: NPC #850247
anh_en: It's not like I've never tried to carry plates before... but you know how it is When you've spent your life in the arena, fine work like that isn't exactly second nature. There's bound to be some stumbles at first.

speaker: NPC #850247
anh_en: Good {Male=Sir;Female=Ma'am}, for just 5,000 Shell Credits a month, you can hire me, Sylvester, as your personal attendant!

speaker: NPC #850247
anh_en: Last week, I broke a cup, then a customer took offense to my "thuggish appearance" and said I lacked service manners. The boss fired me on the spot. Hell, right before he booted me, he actually said, "You should check out your manners. Plenty of others would kill for this job..."

speaker: NPC #850247
anh_en: Try my luck in a new city... Wait, you mean Ragunna? Hmm... that might not be a bad idea. The Scratchy crew mentioned it too. Said the place is something different now since the Carnevale...

speaker: NPC #850247
anh_en: Thank you, friend. I'll think over your advice!
Why are you in such a rush to find a job?
Leave.

speaker: NPC #850247
anh_en: Well, when House Silva fell, suddenly we, their Gladiators, were all unqualified...

speaker: NPC #850247
anh_en: I never got the bonuses and wages they owed me. Worse yet, thanks to the contract, I'm now on the hook to repay the investors. I can't clear the debt, the interest keeps piling up, and now I'm branded as a dishonest debtor...

speaker: NPC #850247
anh_en: Still, I'm the one holding up my family. I have to earn credit so my little brother and sister can go to school.

speaker: NPC #850247
anh_en: Ah, what am I supposed to do now?
Why not look for a job at the arena?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Ever dreamed of being a Septimont Gladiator? Now's your chance! First week FREE! Sign up today!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Tailored courses just for you, with one-on-one expert coaching!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: If I take your courses, will I really be able to fight the TDs, like those legendary knights?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Absolutely! In Septimont, we forge gladiators in the fire of real combat!

speaker: NPC #850247
anh_en: W-wait, aren't you the one who told me to come to Ragunna? I can't believe it's really you!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Oh, you're the one from the Silva Family...

speaker: NPC #850247
anh_en: Yes! You have no idea how much I owe you! After your advice, I figured, why not? I then reached out to a few friends in the Blue Furies. Next thing I know, I'm sitting down with the Montellis!

speaker: NPC #850247
anh_en: See? Septimont's gladiatorial combat is exploding in Ragunna! There's something about the raw passion and honor in the sport that just captivates people.

speaker: NPC #850247
anh_en: I never thought someone like me would have my own business one day!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: The Montelli family, huh...

speaker: NPC #850247
anh_en: Yeah, the head of their family even told me that the past doesn't completely define a person. Even someone like me could end up being a bridge between Ragunna and Septimont.

speaker: NPC #850247
anh_en: Haha, I don't really get what those big shots are thinking about, but thanks to your suggestion, I don't have to worry about work or money anymore.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Hey, what happened to Sylvester, that deadbeat who used to hang around here? Haven't seen him in ages.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: I heard he went to Ragunna and landed a new job, making quite a bit of Credit there

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: The Order really treats him that well? You can make that kind of money just working for someone?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Nah, you heard the wrong story. It has nothing to do with the Order. He just got in good with the Montellis.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Thank you! Thank you all! Please, no need to go any further!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: It's about time now. Fifth Hunting Group—let's move out!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: May applause greet you! May your courage shine like the eternal sun!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Recovery potion, checked; bandages, got two extra rolls... mm-hmm.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Provision—Who swiped a whole pack? Huh, what's this?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Who brought in a barbecue rack? Hey, our prey isn't for eating!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Look! It's our Hunting Group!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Folks, we're back!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: May applause greet you! Congratulations, warriors!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Welcome back to the city!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Hey, look! That's our Hunting Group!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: My, I've never seen so many Echoes before!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: What's that? That thing that looks like a giant crocodile!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 3
anh_en: That's a rare Kerasaur Echo! Gotta capture this moment!

speaker: NPC #850071
anh_en: Beep! Lollo Logistics—We Promise, We Deliver! You have a new mail order to deliver! A friendly reminder: we currently have a backlog of work orders. Please complete your current deliveries as soon as possible. Any delays could affect your performance evaluation!

speaker: NPC #850072
anh_en: Been asking every local in Septimont for hours. Turns out the address is in the Old District, which is flooded already. How exactly am I supposed to deliver there? Even if I could swim down, it's not like there's anyone waiting underwater for this package!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Can you find the recipient?

speaker: NPC #850072
anh_en: It's not really a person, just some company's official address. Let's see... The recipient is "New Federation Black Beach Virtual Resonance Chain Technology Leasing Corp, Ltd."

speaker: NPC #850072
anh_en: What a convoluted name. How does a New Federation company even end up registered in Septimont? Is it one of those shell companies?

speaker: NPC #850072
anh_en: No thanks. I'm not getting in a boat in Rinascita. You know what happens to boats around here? They're cursed!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Cursed?

speaker: NPC #850072
anh_en: Haven't you heard? There was this white-haired merchant with his fancy new ship. Custom-built luxury job. Twin engines, wind-resistant, the whole "unsinkable" deal. First voyage near Rinascita? Boom. A giant whale comes out of nowhere and launches the thing into orbit.

speaker: NPC #850072
anh_en: Rumor has it that whale still won't come to the bargaining table. And since insurance won't touch international waters, the poor guy almost lost his shirt.

speaker: NPC #850072
anh_en: No, wait! Docking my performance again? That's brutal! Ever since I came to Septimont, scoring an A has been completely out of reach!

speaker: NPC #850072
anh_en: Yeah, just a few hundred meters on paper, but getting to the Hilltop means taking the cable car and climbing forever! Who even makes these performance metrics?!

speaker: NPC #850071
anh_en: Courier, please get yourself together! When facing challenges, we encourage self-reflection over complaints about the system!

speaker: NPC #850072
anh_en: Right, self-reflection... but how am I supposed to deliver this anyway? Turn into a merfolk and swim there?
What's going on?
How about you row over and check out those ruins on the water?
Leave.

speaker: NPC #850072
anh_en: Oh, you must be {PlayerName} that Chief Advisor Ma mentioned, right? I can really use your help now. This bloody system seems to be acting up again.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: No need to wait now. I just got word... our Hunting Group won't be back today.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: No need to wait? Tell me, what exactly happened?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: They... faced off against an Overlord-Class TD to protect the civilians nearby.

speaker: NPC #850083
anh_en: I'm not that little crybaby you remember now, Father. The weak girl I once was… is long gone.

speaker: NPC #850083
anh_en: All that we are is forged by our own honor and our victories in battle. The sons and daughters of the Odle Family are born to be as radiant as the sun.

speaker: NPC #850083
anh_en: So, I'm not here to argue with you today. Father, I've come to say goodbye.

speaker: NPC #850083
anh_en: All because I am your daughter. I want to be your daughter. I am Cilania of the Odle Family. I am Cilania the Gladiator, who bears our honor.

speaker: NPC #850084
anh_en: No... Cilania, my daughter...
Silently watch the girl and her father argue.
Leave.

speaker: NPC #850084
anh_en: You are missing the point, Cilania. Yes, trees will grow tall and shoots will grow lush, and one day, my daughter, you'll have a happier life, far from this home. But not yet. Not now.

speaker: NPC #850083
anh_en: I... don't need your protection anymore. I'm strong now. I've grown up. I can stand on my own as a gladiator!

speaker: NPC #850084
anh_en: No, you don't understand. I swore an oath to the esteemed one in Septimont that as long as I draw breath, I will not let you set foot on that battlefield again.

speaker: NPC #850084
anh_en: A daughter of the Odle Family is meant to embrace love and family, not clutch a weapon among the dead and dying. Cilania, you don't need to burn so fiercely, like the sun. Why not simply… shine gently as one of Septimont's little stars?

speaker: NPC #850083
anh_en: I understand how you feel, but I didn't become a Gladiator to find happiness, Father.

speaker: NPC #850083
anh_en: That rainy night, you carried me in your arms and carved a way through the TD Outbreak in the Sanguis Plateaus. To this day, people still talk about how the Odle Family stole an orphan right back from death's grip.

speaker: NPC #850083
anh_en: Catalino, I challenge you to an Honor Duel!

speaker: NPC #850083
anh_en: You miserable coward.
Quietly observe.
Leave.

speaker: NPC #850079
anh_en: Oh come on, young lady, have mercy! Why won't you let go of a washed-up nobody like me?

speaker: NPC #850079
anh_en: If you're itching for a fight, there are plenty of star contenders in this city. Why not go challenge one of them to an all-or-nothing duel?

speaker: NPC #850083
anh_en: You, a Hunting Group hero, now cower before a woman's sword? You've brought shame upon the name of Septimont, Catalino!

speaker: NPC #850079
anh_en: All this talk of heroes and honor… My lady, aren't you one of the few who made it out of that place alive? Don't you get it? Honor means nothing when you face the Dark Tide. So why rush back just to throw your life away?

speaker: NPC #850083
anh_en: Cut the crap and face me in the duel!

speaker: NPC #850079
anh_en: I'm done with fighting... If you really can't let go of that battle, do it.

speaker: NPC #850084
anh_en: Cilania, my daughter...

speaker: NPC #850084
anh_en: It's not that I wish to deny you your own path.

speaker: NPC #850084
anh_en: You just never realize... that your fate was foretold by the esteemed one long ago.

speaker: NPC #850084
anh_en: Ah, Priestess Iuno... it seems fate was never mine to rewrite.

speaker: NPC #850084
anh_en: Cilania, my daughter...

speaker: NPC #850084
anh_en: It's not that I wish to deny you your own path.

speaker: NPC #850084
anh_en: You just never realize... that your fate was foretold by the esteemed one long ago...

speaker: NPC #850084
anh_en: The esteemed one? But... who actually said those words?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Hey there, dark-haired {Male=handsome man;Female=beautiful lady}.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: You don't look like you're from around here... Mind if I ask you a few questions for a quick interview?

speaker: NPC #850085
anh_en: Hey there, traveler! Judging by your outfit, you must know a thing or two about fashion.

speaker: NPC #850085
anh_en: Oh? That's unexpected... Well, it seems that I need to work harder to be the trendsetter.

speaker: NPC #850085
anh_en: So, do you prefer the Septimont or Huanglong styles?
Huanglong's.
Septimont's.
Don't like any of them.
Not interested, sorry.

speaker: NPC #850085
anh_en: Right, your outfit already gave it away. Indeed, there's something about hometown style. It just feels like home, no matter where you are.

speaker: NPC #850085
anh_en: Oh wow, we've got the same taste! Septimont's designs have that unmistakable beauty, don't they?

speaker: NPC #850085
anh_en: Lightweight, clean-cut, but so full of geometric flair. Always so daring!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Hello, this is the customer who ordered a sample from you a while ago.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Could you please check if the order that was sent out might have gotten mixed up with the custom design?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: So you're saying... nothing got mixed up? Everything was recreated perfectly, just like the design?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Whisss (inhale)—Haa (exhale)—

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Rats and mud! Who runs a business like this?!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Don't worry, I'm doing great here!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Work's been a breeze every day, like I'm on vacation. I even took a dip in the sea today! The project's coming along great...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Colleagues? Oh, oh, yeah, I get along just fine with my coworkers, no worries.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Our team leader even promised us a promotion and a raise just a few days ago...

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Courier Lane is in the middle of a call and doesn't notice your arrival.

speaker: NPC #850072
anh_en: Tired? Not really. Sometimes, yeah, a bit, but how should I put it? You know how our company is, right?

speaker: NPC #850072
anh_en: Lollo Logistics goes global now! We've made a real name for ourselves. Brand new equipment, contracts with huge international clients. We're not just some small-time delivery crew anymore.

speaker: NPC #850072
anh_en: Don't worry... Once I've earned enough credits, I'll head back to Huanglong and take all of you to Mingting. That way, my little sis can go to school there.

speaker: NPC #850072
anh_en: Alright, love you, Mom. See you tomorrow.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Have you heard? Maji just got promoted again.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: He's already up to Tier 8 now, with some mouthful of a title, "Senior Expert Regional Business Chief Advisor" or something...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: How many Shell Credits does he make a year with that rank?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: You don't get it, it's not just about Shell Credits for him anymore.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Oh, hello, Chief Advisor Ma? Sorry to bother.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: It's us—Biao and Li! We joined Lollo Logistics together, remember?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Uh, you don't really remember? Hmm... I...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: We used to have staff meals together, remember? Like that time you got so sick after eating we had to drag you to the clinic?

speaker: NPC #850335
anh_en: We Septimont branch was named Most Valuable Department last month, but someone anonymously called our team a bunch of freeloaders on the company forum...

speaker: NPC #850335
anh_en: I mean, why are people making such a big deal out of this rating system? We're all part of the same company, right? Sure, they get the flashy road shows while we handle the grunt work, but we're still on the same team!
That makes sense.
Leave.

speaker: NPC #850335
anh_en: Sure, we promise, we deliver! But none of that happens unless every single one of us does our part. That's what matters.

speaker: NPC #850335
anh_en: This new rating system? It just turns all our hard work into cold numbers.

speaker: NPC #850336
anh_en: Strategy, the approach you take to accomplish a task... "Segmentation," grouping users or functionalities... "Track," a particular field or industry...
What are you muttering about?
Leave.

speaker: NPC #850336
anh_en: Haha, I've been cramming all these corporate buzzwords. Gotta keep up. Everyone's parroting Chief Advisor Ma's favorite phrases these days!

speaker: NPC #850336
anh_en: Honestly, they all mean the same thing in the end, but that's how the bosses talk in meetings now. This kind of lingo at least makes us sound professional, and maybe even well-educated.

speaker: NPC #850075
anh_en: The Scratchy's exhibition match is about to start. Switch the channel! Or we'll miss the opening show!

speaker: NPC #850075
anh_en: I'm challenging you to an duel!

speaker: NPC #850076
anh_en: Shh, quiet! This part's crucial! Hey, why did that guy just turn around? Now the team's out of sync! Sheesh, what a waste... That was such a golden opportunity!

speaker: NPC #850075
anh_en: Hurry, switch the channel now! That round's finished—
Keep listening to the two.
Leave.

speaker: NPC #850076
anh_en: Switch it back, now! Who wants to watch that circus team? Do you fans drawn in by the commercial hype even understand the competition? Do you know what real competitive sport is? Can you even follow the contenders' technical moves and grasp the flow of the match?

speaker: NPC #850075
anh_en: Here we go again... I've been watching gladiator matches since before they even had double elimination, and now you're questioning my understanding? What really grinds my gears are fans like you, acting like you know everything, all high and mighty.

speaker: NPC #850076
anh_en: Hmph, so what? You're just a plastic fan who spends all day watching the entertainment teams. No matter how many years you watch, you'll always be a weakling who can't even get into the basic-tier events.

speaker: NPC #850075
anh_en: What's the big deal with the entertainment teams? What's so wrong about bringing people fun with a good show? You... You may trash-talk my fighting skills, but don't you dare disrespect my taste in gladiator matches!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: To be honest, the Blue Furies' matches are actually pretty fun to watch.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Yeah, anyone who can pull off fancy moves wouldn't be lacking in skill, right?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Well, it does seem nice when everyone's having fun, all lively and relaxed...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: If making it more entertaining is what keeps it alive, then it's worth doing.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Looks like I'm running low on Shell Credits… Guess I'll have to come back another time.

speaker: NPC #1485
anh_en: I look forward to your next visit. This world of wild dreams is always open to you.

speaker: NPC #1490
anh_en: Bakie, don't let it burn!

speaker: NPC #1490
anh_en: Chop, chop, chop, the orders are coming in hot, hot, hot!
No, I'm good, really.

speaker: NPC #1490
anh_en: Are you sure? I heard you've been very busy running around today!
I appreciate it, but I'm okay.

speaker: NPC #1490
anh_en: Make sure you eat well, no skipping meals, you hear!

speaker: NPC #1490
anh_en: Bakie's stove will be crackling and ready for you whenever you want it!

speaker: NPC #1490
anh_en: Also, no cappuccinos after lunch, or I'll be mad at you!
Noted.

speaker: NPC #1490
anh_en: The pizza paddle is firing sparks!

speaker: NPC #1490
anh_en: Bakie, it's time for a break! Don't overwork yourself, I'll squirrel these orders away!

speaker: NPC #1490
anh_en: Ding! Banker's Boost Platter, fresh out of the oven!

speaker: NPC #1490
anh_en: Ding! Gondola Tea and Pastry Tower!

speaker: NPC #1490
anh_en: Ding! Margherita's Victory Feast, served up with flair!
Your business is on fire...

speaker: NPC #1490
anh_en: Ah, {PlayerName}!

speaker: NPC #1490
anh_en: Feeling hungry? I'll whip up the Gold Star treatment for you anytime you like!

speaker: NPC #1490
anh_en: Phew... finally done for the day, and it all went smooth as butter!

speaker: NPC #1490
anh_en: Ah! It's {PlayerName}!

speaker: NPC #1490
anh_en: Bakie! Fire up a special treat, quick!

speaker: NPC #1490
anh_en: So late, my friend! Your stomach must be growling.
Margherita—
Bakie—

speaker: NPC #1490
anh_en: Margherita's doors are open for you anytime.

speaker: NPC #1490
anh_en: And don't forget, no going hungry in Ragunna!

speaker: NPC #1490
anh_en: Welcome to Margherita's! Your pizza will be hot and fresh in no time!

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Looks like I'm running low on Shell Credits… Guess I'll have to come back another time.

speaker: NPC #1490
anh_en: Come by more often—don't be a stranger!

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Mercurio extends his hands confidently, as if to say, "How may I help you today?"
I'm here to deliver some Monnaie I found.
Thanks. I'm good at the moment.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Mercurio applauds, as if to say, "Thank you for returning these Monnaie. Please accept this as a token of our gratitude. On behalf of Averardo Vault, we thank you."

speaker: NPC #50068
anh_en: Here's to a world of discoveries and wonders! Welcome to the Pioneer Association of Ragunna.

speaker: NPC #50068
anh_en: Whenever you need it, C-MOSS and I will be ready to capture every important moment for you.

speaker: NPC #50068
anh_en: I'm confident that we'll create many treasured memories here in Ragunna.

speaker: NPC #50068
anh_en: Pleasure to meet you! I am Fulmine, the head of the Wutherium Film Studio. We are the visual production division of the Pioneer Association.

speaker: NPC #50068
anh_en: Umm... Did you happen to pick up any film on your way here?
What kind of film?

speaker: NPC #50068
anh_en: Well, like the ones on my head.

speaker: NPC #50068
anh_en: My Resonance power, "Film Memory," lets me turn memorable moments and dreams into strands of film-shaped hair.

speaker: NPC #50068
anh_en: Nifty, right? Sometimes even lost ideas resurface in the film!

speaker: NPC #50068

anh_en: Some of it is a bit... personal. If anyone ever saw them, I'd just die of embarrassment—ahhhh!

speaker: NPC #50068

speaker: NPC #50068

I promise.
No promises!

About yourself
Goodbye

speaker: NPC #50068

anh_en: Come back later.

Buy something.
Come back later.

anh_en: Come back later.

anh_en: That aroma, it's pretty soothing... I'm starting to relax.
