anh_en: Yes. By extracting medicinal essences and blending them with aromatic substances, we create a special "Mist Potion."

speaker: NPC #50104
anh_en: With each breath, the mist alleviates discomfort, almost imperceptibly. It's a secret art of the Fisalia family.

speaker: NPC #50104
anh_en: Poison or cure, harm or heal—it lies entirely in the user's intention.
What's your intention then?

speaker: NPC #50104
anh_en: I'm only trying to help those in need.
You run this place alone?

speaker: NPC #50104
anh_en: As you may have gathered, I'm a Fisalia pharmacist. Our name isn't exactly welcome here in Ragunna...

speaker: NPC #50104
anh_en: Rumors about the family echo through the streets—people call us "The Poison of Ragunna."

speaker: NPC #50104
anh_en: It's sad... they seem to find tales of the Fisalias more interesting than the truth.

speaker: NPC #50104
anh_en: If someone sees you here, you may find yourself entangled in their rumors as well.
This is...?

speaker: NPC #50104
anh_en: I do hope this won't weigh on your mind during your time in Ragunna. You have more pressing matters to attend to.
I'm not one of those people.
I'm not bound by Ragunna's rules.

speaker: NPC #50104
anh_en: The only rumor that's true—you really are special.

speaker: NPC #50104
anh_en: Thank you, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #50104
anh_en: My apologies, I sensed your fatigue and took it upon myself to help.

speaker: NPC #50104
anh_en: Are you... feeling any better?
It caught me off guard a little...
I'm feeling... much better.

speaker: NPC #50104
anh_en: There's no need to be afraid. This is just my regular "Mist Therapy."

speaker: NPC #50104
anh_en: Wonderful. This treatment of mine is called "Mist Therapy." I'm glad it serves you well.
Mist Therapy?

speaker: NPC #50104
anh_en: Welcome to Rosemary's Apothecary, where your perfect potion awaits.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Looks like I'm running low on Shell Credits… Guess I'll have to come back another time.

speaker: NPC #50104
anh_en: If anything feels off, I'll be here to assist straight away.

speaker: NPC #1485
anh_en: Ready to take the stage?

speaker: NPC #1485
anh_en: Tell me, what role do you feel like playing today?

speaker: NPC #1485
anh_en: A see-through mask? Tasteless.

speaker: NPC #1485
anh_en: A firework cane? Oh, please...

speaker: NPC #1485
anh_en: But you, mon chou, you wouldn't disappoint me with you request, would you?

speaker: NPC #1485
anh_en: Whispering Mask, Echo in Finery, Regal Songbird...

speaker: NPC #1485
anh_en: The names and titles the people in Ragunna have for me far exceed the roles I've ever played.

speaker: NPC #1485
anh_en: Oh, how many eyes have danced on this invisible shell, weaving tales of my true face?

speaker: NPC #1485
anh_en: You could say that their imaginations have given me a thousand different visages.

speaker: NPC #1485
anh_en: What about you? What am I in your mind's eye?

speaker: NPC #1485
anh_en: I sense that, from you, I might finally hear the truth I've been waiting for.
An improv showcase.
I want to know about you.

speaker: NPC #1485
anh_en: Take a look, darling. The Masked Reverie has every prop your heart could desire.

speaker: NPC #1485
anh_en: Or perhaps these don't quite tickle your fancy? Yearning for something a bit more... fantastical, mm?

speaker: NPC #1485
anh_en: A perfume grenade, a pistol ring, or... a luxurious velvet bomb?

speaker: NPC #1485
anh_en: What I crafted for Carlotta, I can certainly craft for you.

speaker: NPC #1485
anh_en: I have to say, the requests I've been getting recently... Ugh, so dreadfully uninspired!

speaker: NPC #1485
anh_en: A blade in the shoes? Boring.

speaker: NPC #1485
anh_en: Welcome to the Masked Reverie. Allow me to adorn you with a new identity.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Remember, you're not just plastering cement! You're building the very walls of this city!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: We are the Association of Architects! We are the builders of Septimont!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Architects! Pledge your hearts for the future of Septimont!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Sheesh, I thought I was here for construction work. No one told me I'm supposed to be donating organs...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: The Association of Architects is so awful...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Pledge your hearts for the future of Septimont!

speaker: NPC #850327
anh_en: This Wall of Morta standing before you is Septimont's first line of defense.

speaker: NPC #850327
anh_en: As individuals, your names may become forgotten, yet through your tireless efforts, your contributions will live on forever as an integral part of Septimont!

speaker: NPC #850327
anh_en: Architects! Pledge your hearts for the future of Septimont!
Listen in on the architect's speech.
Leave.

speaker: NPC #850327
anh_en: Over a century, four chairman of the Association of Architects devoted their lives to the Wall of Morta. Four generations, transforming it from a simple fence used to ward off animals, into a behemoth holding back the tide.

speaker: NPC #850327
anh_en: The project began with the founders of the Association, later passing on to their descendants through the generations. To this day, the Association continues to perform its regular maintenance.

speaker: NPC #850327
anh_en: It was here that my great-grandfather reinforced the Wall of Morta during the Second Dark Tide. He excavated the earth with the help of a Diggy Duggy from Ragunna and erected steel rods, laying the foundation for the reinforcement work.

speaker: NPC #850327
anh_en: Later, the same Diggy Duggy accompanied my grandfather to drive away the Tacet Discords that were disrupting their construction work.

speaker: NPC #850327
anh_en: When I first set eyes on the Wall of Morta, my father told me stories of how countless Septimont families contributed to the cause, just like we did.

speaker: NPC #850327
anh_en: Whether nobleman, commoner, or Echo. In the construction of the city's future, they all had the same identity: Citizens of Septimont.

speaker: NPC #850328
anh_en: Goodness... Such a shame our chairman didn't choose the career of a motivational speaker...

speaker: NPC #850329
anh_en: Pledge your hearts for the future of Septimont! Pledge your hearts for the future of Septimont!
Listen in.
Leave.

speaker: NPC #850328
anh_en: Calm down, Flamaxis! Are you out of your mind?

speaker: NPC #850329
anh_en: Doesn't your heart swell with pride upon hearing those words? Where's your sense of honor?

speaker: NPC #850329
anh_en: Morta, Decuma, and Nona. Three great walls. All built by our Association!

speaker: NPC #850328
anh_en: ...But no matter how well they were built, you're still out here plastering cement, aren't you?

speaker: NPC #850329
anh_en: So what? I'm still young! Being an apprentice is great, and easy to find jobs! If you think construction work is so hard, I don't think you'll fare very well doing something else!

speaker: NPC #850330
anh_en: How could it just disappear like that?! I'm 100% sure it was right here a moment ago!

speaker: NPC #850330
anh_en: If people find out I was using all of my salary to buy limited edition card packs... As an adult, that's equivalent to a death sentence!

speaker: NPC #850330
anh_en: But if someone were to ask me to give up my Peaks of Prestige addiction... No, that's impossible! A life without PoP would be as meaningless as living as a Tacet Discord!

speaker: NPC #850330
anh_en: I'm begging you, great guest from afar! Just follow the river and I'm sure you'll find something!

speaker: NPC #850330
anh_en: How could this happen? My money! My money, my soul... My only hope!
What happened?

speaker: NPC #850330
anh_en: The money I hid here is gone, but there aren't any other footprints here. Did it get washed downstream?

speaker: NPC #850330
anh_en: You look quite nimble, my friend. Perhaps you could help me? If you could find my money for me, I'd be happy to repay your efforts.
Leave it to me.
Why don't you contact the bank?

speaker: NPC #850330
anh_en: You're a lifesaver! If you just follow down the river, I'm sure you'll find clues!

speaker: NPC #850330
anh_en: Because... my family doesn't know that I play Peaks of Prestige! And if they were to check my bank records...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Oh, what do I do? If I don't get that money back soon...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: My life will be in ruins!

speaker: NPC #850330
anh_en: How about it, friend? Have you found the money yet?
Found it.
No, not yet.

speaker: NPC #850330
anh_en: OHHH! You are truly my savior! Give it here...

speaker: NPC #850330
anh_en: Oh, I see... Well, do keep looking, please. Just follow the river and I'm sure you'll find something!

speaker: NPC #850330
anh_en: My benefactor! My savior! Oh, thank you! Thank you! You've found it!

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: With great pain, Samousas hands you the box of money before being dragged away by Favnia...

speaker: NPC #850330
anh_en: Now I'm one step closer to buying my next card pack... And if I finally manage to draw that Echo card, I'll become the ultimate duel master!
Just as Samousas thanks you, a woman walks over to you.

speaker: NPC #850331
anh_en: Samousas? What're you doing here? Did I just hear you yell "card pack" and "ultimate duel master"? What's this all about?

speaker: NPC #850331
anh_en: You're not planning on playing Peaks of Prestige, are you? And where'd you get that money from?

speaker: NPC #850330
anh_en: Eek! Favnia! I-I didn't... I'm n-not... This is not my money! My friend here was asking me for some safekeeping! A-And I was just about to give it back to you, isn't that right?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Samousas give you a look.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: ...That's right, of course.

speaker: NPC #850331
anh_en: Well, is it now? Then you'd best give it back, Samousas!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Ladies and gentlemen! Thank you all for coming. The show is about to begin!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Coming up next: A magic show in the skies. Brought to you from Ragunna!

speaker: NPC #850323
anh_en: Visitor from afar, come thou to bask in the power of my Master?

speaker: NPC #850323
anh_en: Well, I digress... Though my Master is no longer with us, Their powers live on within Their remains...

speaker: NPC #850323
anh_en: Locate and bring me the Remnant Energy from Their remains, and I will gladly share Their power with you.
Master?
You have an odd way of speaking.

speaker: NPC #850323
anh_en: Behold! Their wings so great, they blot out the heavens! Even eons after death, Their majestic form looms still like the lofty peaks!

speaker: NPC #850323
anh_en: This power. It's precisely why I call Them my Master.

speaker: NPC #850323
anh_en: Odd? Ahem... Well, it's quite clear that this is my way of showing respect for my Master... As written within the novels, you see.

speaker: NPC #850323
anh_en: Wait, don't look at me like that! D-Do you not feel empowered under the presence of the mighty dragon?!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: But I don't feel any frequency from it...

speaker: NPC #850323
anh_en: You... Why won't you understand that size matters? Nobody these days appreciates the charisma of dragons!!

speaker: NPC #850332
anh_en: Hello there, friend... I get the feeling I know you from somewhere...
Perform in the flying magic show.
Let me think about it...

speaker: NPC #850332
anh_en: Phenomenal! The flying magic show is about to begin!

speaker: NPC #850332
anh_en: No problem at all. When you're ready, just come back and we can begin any time!

speaker: NPC #850332
anh_en: Ah, I remember now! You're {PlayerName}, the Laureate! From the Carnevale!

speaker: NPC #850332
anh_en: Oh, praise the Sentinel! I can't believe I've met my idol! G-Greetings! Oh, right! Would you be interested in participating in my flying magic show, {PlayerName}?
I'm interested.
Maybe next time.

speaker: NPC #850332
anh_en: Fantastic! I'm currently conducting a performance tour around Septimont. The show is fairly simple: just fly through the air with an Echo and perform in different locations along the flight path.

speaker: NPC #850332
anh_en: What do you think? Sounds easy, right? I know it'll be a piece of cake for someone like {PlayerName}!

speaker: NPC #850332
anh_en: Just to offer the crowd our best performance possible, make sure you keep a low altitude. Oh, and do keep in mind the time...

speaker: NPC #850332
anh_en: Care to give it a try, {PlayerName}? With your help, I'm certain we can spread even more charm of the show to the people of Septimont!

speaker: NPC #850332
anh_en: Well? Are you ready to perform in the flying magic show?

speaker: NPC #850332
anh_en: With your help, I'm certain we can spread even more charm of the show to the people of Septimont!
Perform in the flying magic show.

speaker: NPC #850332
anh_en: Phenomenal! The flying magic show is about to begin!

speaker: NPC #850332
anh_en: No problem at all. When you're ready, just come back and we can begin any time!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Now that I think about it, this Plushie Village seems a bit different from the one in Ragunna.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Hmm... Is there anything we can do to get rid of these stains?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: How about a Tubpup from Ragunna? I remember there were lots of free-roaming Echoes around the Plushie Village in the Garden of the Lost.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: I'll help them search around a bit whenever I find time and go back to Ragunna.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You look around and notice that the Echoes all seem to look rather downhearted.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Sensing your concern, Teensy Weensy hurries to point at the tear marks across the Echoes' bodies.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Wait... Did something happen on your way here? You all look a bit... dirty.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: I can't understand what you're saying, but I can tell you're all thinking about getting squeaky clean again, right?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Teensy Weensy nods frantically at you.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The Tubpup seems to be looking for something...

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: That being said... I've never actually tried going through the morph painting in the village...

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Well... Here goes nothing.

speaker: NPC #50068
anh_en: Ah, finally! {PlayerName}! I hear you've made it back to the Plushie Village in Ragunna?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You tell Fulmine what happened at the Plushie Village in Septimont.

speaker: NPC #50068
anh_en: I see. Perfect, I was just about to ask you a similar favor.

speaker: NPC #50068
anh_en: Ever since Teensy Weensy and the gang went off to Septimont, those new Echoes were having trouble fitting in.

speaker: NPC #50068
anh_en: If you don't mind, {PlayerName}. I'd like you to help guide them through the morph painting's Sonoro Sphere and reach Septimont.

speaker: NPC #50068
anh_en: After all, they could use the extra hands to help set up their new village, right?

speaker: NPC #50068
anh_en: I'll leave this task to you, {PlayerName}. Let me know if you need anything!

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: After Fulmine hangs up, Tubpup looks at you, eyes filled with anticipation.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Nice. That's a lot better!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: What's this?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The Echoes seem extremely thrilled to welcome their new friend.
With Tubpup's help, the Echoes are cleaned and shiny again in no time. As music sounds all over Plushie Village.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You received a present from the Echoes.

speaker: NPC #850323
anh_en: Well, I digress... Though my Master is no longer with us, Their powers live on within Their remains...

speaker: NPC #850323
anh_en: Locate and bring me the Remnant Energy from Their remains, and I will gladly share Their power with you.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Somewhere, the flames begin to burn stronger...

speaker: NPC #850323
anh_en: Oh... How can this be? I am unable to sense anything from the Master's flame...

speaker: NPC #850323
anh_en: But They have slumbered here since before the founding of Septimont! In ancient Septimont, this place was known as the trial grounds, where the noble deeds of legendary heroes were written throughout history...

speaker: NPC #850323
anh_en: Why would countless warriors of Septimont come all this way if not to inherit the dragon's powers?

speaker: NPC #850323
anh_en: I fail to understand...

speaker: NPC #850323
anh_en: Visitor from afar, what visions have you gathered from the flames you kindled?
I didn't see anything...
A dragon with burning wings ripping the earth apart?
A giant hurling lightning bolts to slay a dragon?

speaker: NPC #850323
anh_en: You... Do you have to be so blunt? If even a Resonator like you were unable to feel any powers...

speaker: NPC #850323
anh_en: Ripping the earth apart... It sounds like a beast that brings nothing but destruction! Wait, it's just like that new TV series, isn't it?

speaker: NPC #850323
anh_en: Hurling lightning bolts... Wait, isn't this from that classic foreign mythology?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: After all these years, there's barely any frequency left...

speaker: NPC #850324
anh_en: I can tell you boast incredible skills just by looking at you, my friend! I wonder, have you noticed those two elite warriors atop the towers?

speaker: NPC #850324
anh_en: People say they were once the supreme and legendary Gladiators of Septimont. Three years ago this very day, this very location, they agreed to meet each other in glorious battle... Now that they've both completed their trainings, they've returned to Septimont to fulfill their promise...

speaker: NPC #850324
anh_en: Stories like this simply write themselves! I've got to learn more about them before they exchange blades!

speaker: NPC #850324
anh_en: What kind of emotions do they bring into battle? Could it be a furious thirst for vengeance, a lonesome yearning for defeat, or an explosive mixture of admiration and hatred? I must find out!

speaker: NPC #850324
anh_en: May I ask you to go and give them an interview? I'm sure they'd be willing to open up to a master such as yourself!

speaker: NPC #850324
anh_en: Please. If you can do me this favor, I'll have adequate rewards ready for you once you return.

speaker: NPC #850325
anh_en: Kaimastos... It's unbelievable to think your obsession has reached such heights.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You interview Artemus on his current thoughts.

speaker: NPC #850325
anh_en: Are you going to put this in the newspaper? In that case...

speaker: NPC #850325
anh_en: Echoes are the embodiment of a Gladiator's soul. For your twisted soul, Kaimastos, I shall set it right!

speaker: NPC #850325
anh_en: Oh, could you add one extra line in there for me? Write: Do you love Peaks of Prestige? Then visit the Double Six Games of Septimont! Get a unique anniversary card with your first purchase, for free! Plus, receive additional discounts if you sign up for our membership, and earn a chance to grab the legendary Dark Wizard Echo set every tenth consecutive purchase!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Legendary Dark Wizard?
Artemus summons his Echo.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Isn't that just a Chop Chop?

speaker: NPC #850326
anh_en: Artemus! My arch nemesis! At last, I've awaited this day far too long! I shall crush you with my own hands, just as I've dreamed of!

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You interview Kaimastos on his current thoughts.

speaker: NPC #850326
anh_en: My current thoughts? Hmm... How about you record the events that will occur here? Especially the moments of Artemus's defeat beneath my feet!

speaker: NPC #850326
anh_en: Heed my summoning! My soul, my pride, my most powerful servant—White-Flames Blue Dragon!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Wait, is he about to summon the Dragon of Dirge?!
Kaimastos summons his Echo.

speaker: NPC #850326
anh_en: Aaahahaha! Now tremble in despair, Artemus! I will shatter your dreams along with your honor!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: And it's just a tiny little Drake...

speaker: NPC #850324
anh_en: Oh, you're back! How'd it go? Tell me! What did the two legendary Gladiators have to say?

speaker: NPC #850324
anh_en: Two young passionate warriors, born from completely opposite backgrounds, yet both equally burdened with the weight of destiny, as they rush forth on a collision course of growth, betting their souls in a dark duel with their pride at stake...

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Sulpicia hands you the rewards, then proceeds to retreat into her own world.
This is probably going to disappoint...
They weren't actually legendary gladiators per se...

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You summarize the interview with the Peaks of Prestige players.

speaker: NPC #850324
anh_en: Ahhh! So that's how it is... That is rather...

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Looks like you'll need to find a different source of inspiration...

speaker: NPC #850324
anh_en: That is rather brilliant!!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Huh?

speaker: NPC #850324
anh_en: It's a splendid topic! I've already got a complete outline in mind! Thanks a million, and here's a reward for your time!

speaker: NPC #850117
anh_en: It's all my fault. I never should have insisted we try new gear. If I hadn't been so persistent, Deosthene wouldn't have gotten hurt from that TD...

speaker: NPC #850116
anh_en: Now's not the time for that! Deosthene, can you hear me?

speaker: NPC #850115
anh_en: Ugh...

speaker: NPC #850116
anh_en: It's a deep wound, but he's still with us, and we've managed to stop the bleeding. I can't believe how terrible this armor is. It cracked on the first hit!

speaker: NPC #850117
anh_en: This is beyond repair... You really can't cheap out on stuff like this. It's even worse than the gear we use during training.

speaker: NPC #850117
anh_en: So, what do we do? Go back and find that merchant?

speaker: NPC #850116
anh_en: We need to get Deosthene to a doctor first. Oh, I've got plenty of stuff to say to the scump when we see him!

speaker: NPC #850117
anh_en: Hey, you little thief! You're trying to get someone killed, selling junk like this?

speaker: NPC #850114
anh_en: Sounds like user error to me. Like I told you, they're Gladiator gear. You're supposed to use them in tournaments and not against Tacet Discords!

speaker: NPC #850114
anh_en: I've only ever promised a cheap price tag, if I might add. I bought this batch off of Annika. If you've got problems with the quality, go take it up with her. Plus, I never said they come with a free warranty or customer service.

speaker: NPC #850116
anh_en: Squirm all you want! You're coming with us to the Ephor's Palace. Let's see what they have to say about your tricks there!

speaker: NPC #850114
anh_en: H-hold on a second! I just remembered, Annika did tell me that batch of gear was labeled defective. Ugh, how can I forget something so important? This whole getting old thing isn't easy, I tell you. I do apologize!

speaker: NPC #850114
anh_en: May I propose this, I'll pay you back three times what you paid. And I'll cover your friend's medical bills while I'm at it!

speaker: NPC #850114
anh_en: Look, I'm just a simple man trying to put food on the table... How about we pretend this never happened, ok? Please don't take this to the Ephor!

speaker: NPC #850116
anh_en: You're not getting off that easy. We let you off the hook this time, but what happens if others fall victim to your crimes again? We're putting an end to this right now!

speaker: NPC #850115
anh_en: Sorry for all the trouble, guys. I'm just glad I made it out alive. I'm never gonna cheap out again...

speaker: NPC #850116
anh_en: Well, as long as you've learned your lesson. How's your wound? You sure you don't want to take a few extra days off?

speaker: NPC #850117
anh_en: Yeah! Why are you out of the hospital already? I-I even felt bad and took a few of your shifts for you...

speaker: NPC #850115
anh_en: Hahaha. Well, knock yourself out! It's just a scratch, really. It should be fine as long as I don't move around too much.

speaker: NPC #850115
anh_en: But what should I do with all the credits I got for compensation? There's still quite a bit left after paying my medical bills.

speaker: NPC #850116
anh_en: Oh yeah! Didn't they say someone was building a school for orphans of fallen soldiers? Why don't you donate it all to them?

speaker: NPC #850115
anh_en: Not a bad idea! That's my good deed for the year sorted too. That settles that!

speaker: NPC #850118
anh_en: Hmm? What's on your mind, Mom?

speaker: NPC #850119
anh_en: Hehe, I'd like to know as much as you do. I remember her name goes something like... My... My... Hmm? Strange, what was that girl's name? I can't remember all of a sudden..?

speaker: NPC #850118
anh_en: ...Mom?

speaker: NPC #850119
anh_en: Ah. Forgive me. I felt a bit light-headed there for a moment. I need a bit of rest. I'll be better in no time.

speaker: NPC #850119
anh_en: Just thinking about the news I saw last night. Something about that champion Gladiator everyone's talking about... Her name's Lupa, right? She looks quite the warrior!

speaker: NPC #850119
anh_en: I think so, too.
Yep. Lupa's the best!
I'm stronger than she is.

speaker: NPC #850119
anh_en: Wow, she even gets your seal of approval? Seems like there's a lot to look forward to, then.

speaker: NPC #850119
anh_en: Really? Well, I can't wait to see you in the finals, then!

speaker: NPC #850119
anh_en: I once visited Septimont to watch the Agon about twenty years ago. I don't remember most of the details, but I'll never forget the amazement I felt watching them compete.

speaker: NPC #850118
anh_en: Mom, who was the champion twenty years ago? Was she as great as Lupa?

speaker: NPC #850120
anh_en: We've known you for quite a while now, old man. How is it that we've never seen you sell a single item?

speaker: NPC #850122
anh_en: Hehe! Warms my heart to hear it, youngsters.

speaker: NPC #850121
anh_en: Yeah! Want us to give you a hand, old timer?
I can lend a hand too, if you want.
This gear doesn't seem too bad.

speaker: NPC #850122
anh_en: Please, spare me the jokes. If you'd really wish to help me, perhaps you could buy a few of my wares?

speaker: NPC #850122
anh_en: You've got a good eye! Everything in my shop is of the highest quality. It's just too bad none of the other passersby have senses as good as yours. They think my gear is antiquated.

speaker: NPC #850122
anh_en: Sigh... I remember back in the day, people used to fight over my goods. There weren't enough to go around! You know that foreign Gladiator who won the championship twenty years ago? I'd say she owes half her victory to me! But ever since my voice has gotten hoarse, I can't hawk my wares so well, so no one buys from me anymore.

speaker: NPC #850120
anh_en: Again with the story twenty years ago... As far as I'm concerned, there's no one cooler or stronger than Lupa. When I grow up, I want to buy some of your gear, old timer, then go ask Lupa to be my mentor!

speaker: NPC #850121
anh_en: Me too! Don't worry, old man. We'll be your shop's ambassadors!

speaker: NPC #850122
anh_en: It's getting dark. Why don't you two head on home? I'll be fine here on my own.

speaker: NPC #850120
anh_en: We wanna watch the cable cars a bit more. Remember when we sneaked away from home that one time, Talla? Man, did they let us have it when they caught up with us...

speaker: NPC #850121
anh_en: I remember. The sunset from the cable car was unlike anything I've seen! We should just tell them we're going to watch the Agon next time instead of sneaking out.

speaker: NPC #850120
anh_en: Sounds like a plan to me! Hey! We customers are walking over from the cable cars!

speaker: NPC #850122
anh_en: Remember what I taught you?

speaker: NPC #850121
anh_en: Yep! If they're tourists, we tell them these are Septimont souvenirs and ask them if they want to buy something to remember their trip.

speaker: NPC #850120
anh_en: If they're Gladiators, then we tell them this is the same kind of gear that Gladiator champions used to equip back in the day. If they buy it, it'll make them just as strong!

speaker: NPC #850122
anh_en: That's it. I'll be counting on you both!

speaker: NPC #850119
anh_en: How impressive! You know, Linnea, last time your father and I visited here, this place had nothing more than a single tent. I never imagined it'd grow into such a nice small town!

speaker: NPC #850119
anh_en: Give me a minute. I'm curious now. Let me look around a bit more.

speaker: NPC #850118
anh_en: Mmm... Okay, I'll give you another five minutes.

speaker: NPC #850118
anh_en: Do you like it here, Mom?
You've been here before?
What was it like back then?

speaker: NPC #850119
anh_en: Yes, it was about twenty years ago. My husband and I visited for our honeymoon.

speaker: NPC #850119
anh_en: It used to feel like we were in a desert. Basically just a camp with a few tents scattered here and there.

speaker: NPC #850119
anh_en: Are you here on vacation as well? I hear the Ephor ordered this place built not too long ago, so they could keep close monitoring of the Blightcloud.

speaker: NPC #850119
anh_en: I've never seen construction work done so efficiently in Septimont... Even the Gladiators are involved! Makes you wonder if there's something else going on behind the scenes...

speaker: NPC #850118
anh_en: Let's head home, Mom. Dad said we have to be indoors where it's safe by nightfall!

speaker: NPC #850102
anh_en: Phew... Oh, it's you! Didn't think we'd run into each other here.

speaker: NPC #850102
anh_en: Applause...? What? Oh, yeah. I remember that means something like "good luck" here, right?

speaker: NPC #850102
anh_en: Thank you. Hope you enjoy your time in Septimont as well! Look me up if you ever come to Huanglong.
Got your access pass issue figured out?
You look exhausted.

speaker: NPC #850102
anh_en: I was able to get a temporary one, albeit with a bit of work. I'll get an official one once my application goes through.

speaker: NPC #850102
anh_en: Yep! I had to run from one office area to another just to get my temporary pass sorted... Really experienced the true joy that is being stranded somewhere with no proper identification.

speaker: NPC #850102
anh_en: Anyway, I'm absolutely pooped. Sightseeing around the city will have to wait until tomorrow.

speaker: NPC #850102
anh_en: I'm gonna go drop my luggage at the hotel, then head to the baths and just relax for a while.

speaker: NPC #850102
anh_en: I hope they've got rooms left...
May applause greet you!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Phew! F-Finally, I made it to the market.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Let's see... Tomorrow I need to get a new acces pass, then go buy some merch, and... You know what? I'll think about it after I find the hotel.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Nobody seems to be thrilled to be on duty... Is it because of the finals?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: That's right. Everyone wants to get home and watch the tournament. Of course, they're a bit distracted...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I've heard the Blightcloud's been acting up lately. Here's hoping nothing bad's about to happen...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Don't jinx it! I'm just a normal grunt. It's not like I'm some warrior like the Ephor...

speaker: NPC #850102
anh_en: Where did my pass go? Weird, it was in my pocket a second ago.

speaker: NPC #850102
anh_en: But I told you I can't find it! What are you going to do? Arrest me?

speaker: NPC #850103
anh_en: Fill out a form, and I'll guide you through the application for a new one. I'll explain your situation to my superiors.

speaker: NPC #850102
anh_en: You're a good person, after all...

speaker: NPC #850103
anh_en: I'm afraid I can't let you in without your access pass! I'm not making that mistake again.
What mistake?
What happens if someone loses their access pass?

speaker: NPC #850103
anh_en: I really don't want to talk about it... Long story short, I got bamboozled... Sigh, it's left a stain on my career that's for sure!

speaker: NPC #850103
anh_en: Normally, it'll take three days to get renewed. Or you can try your luck at the lost and found.

speaker: NPC #850102
anh_en: I'm not lying to you! I-I just can't find it. Really! Just let me in, please. I'll show you my pass later once I find it.

speaker: NPC #850103
anh_en: No can do. I had a Huanglong Taoist girl show up once with a similar story of how she lost her pass. Next thing I knew, she tricked me with a fake card as a distraction and sneaked into the city!

speaker: NPC #850103
anh_en: I got chewed out by my superior for that one. So yeah. No pass. No entry!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: You know, I've always been a fan of the Beasts Beneath. There's no way they're not taking home the title this year!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: You're full of crap! What happened to supporting Scratchy? Now that the Beasts are winning, you're switching sides...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I mean, who doesn't like being on the winning side? Ugh... Wish I could go see the tournament in person.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Well, it just so happens I have an extra ticket for the Beasts match. We can go watch it when we're both free.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Lupa's team won. No surprises there. Still, I'm proud of you, Beasts Beneath! May applause greet you!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Oh? Not calling yourself a longtime Lupa fan, are you now?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Please. After today, we're all Lupa fans! Some people already watched the replays of her finals match a dozens times.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Well, it was an incredible match, after all. Such a great victory.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: My pass is about to expire, but I'm having so much fun! There are still a ton of places I haven't visited yet.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: That's just how it is. It's our first visit to Septimont, so they only gave us five days.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Oh, time, I wish you'd freeze at this moment! I want to go have another round at Solis!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: You really are something... Let's just go see if we can apply for an extension.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Things have been getting more eventful around the Citadel lately. Fistfights happening in my neighborhood every night...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: ...We're doing our best.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: You know, we get dozens of reports of assaults like yours every day. We just can't get to them all.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Just head home for now, and you'll hear from us. And try to stay indoors after dark.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: You're back late tonight. Did you run into trouble out on the hunt?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Not me. Others.. We came across a three-man team that got torn apart on our way back. Held us up a bit.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Their gear seemed new, though. Wonder how they got hammered so badly...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Maybe they were sold crappy gear? Unlucky bastards...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: ...Is this the latest data on the Blightcloud? Why is there so much activity?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: I'm just as surprised as you are. The Ephor was right to be concerned. Things are worse than we expected...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: I'll round up some idle hands together during the day to go take a closer look. I'll leave the reports to you.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: ...Got it. This is urgent. I'll go bring the brass up to speed.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: You remember that move during the match last night? They were all like... WOOSH! BAM! SMACK!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: You're talking about when they opened with an upward thrust with the spear, then followed up with a quick jab, right? So cool!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: That's the one! I'm adding it to my training plan. From now on, it's gonna be my killer move!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Uh... I mean, it's definitely cool and all, but please don't shout out your every single move during training. People will think we're weird.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Daddy, Daddy! When are you coming home? Mommy and I miss you!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: M-Mommy's worried about you just eating that soldier food. She keeps talking about how it's not unhealthy...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Don't worry, Daddy will be home in a couple of days. Tell Mommy I'm doing fine here.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: It's getting late. Head on home now. And be careful!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Ugh... I've been on all these shifts lately, I haven't even gotten a chance to go home... Wonder how my wife and daughter are doing.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Oh, right! For my next time off, I'll take them on a vacation!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: It's been so long since we've gone out as a family... I can't wait!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I check the map. We need to make a right up here if we want to get to the market.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Aw, what? Weren't we going to go get some finals merch?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Ugh, fine. Let's stop by the hotel first for a quick rest, at least. My legs are killing me...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: I'll just go on my own then. You head back and rest all you want!

speaker: NPC #850104
anh_en: Let me go, please! I have to find my child!

speaker: NPC #850105
anh_en: You stay put for now. I'll round up anyone not on duty and organize a search party. But listen to me carefully. Do not take a single step outside this Citadel!

speaker: NPC #850105
anh_en: Calm down, ma'am. Give me the details. Slowly.
What happened?
You lost your child?

speaker: NPC #850104
anh_en: I ran out of Bamboo Irises while preparing medicine for her grandmother yesterday, and I planned to ask the Gladiators to help me gather some. I guess my daughter overheard me.

speaker: NPC #850104
anh_en: I couldn't find her anywhere when I got back home this morning. All I found was a note saying she went out to gather herbs. She's most likely left the Citadel.

speaker: NPC #850104
anh_en: So, please. Let me go find her!

speaker: NPC #850105
anh_en: Just take it easy, ma'am. We have a highly active Blightcloud on our hands. How are you going to protect yourself out there against the TDs?

speaker: NPC #850104
anh_en: B-But...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Do you think I should be a soldier or a Gladiator when I grow up, mister?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Why the sudden question?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Our teacher is making us write a paper about our future dreams. But I don't know which one to pick...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: I see... Then I suggest picking the soldier. You have a set routine as a soldier. It might save you a bit of work on that paper.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: You're looking to buy some new equipment? What's your budget?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: I need to keep it within around a month's salary. But quality is my No.1 requirement. I'm not getting scammed by junk again.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Well, you can rest assured, friend. Oh yeah, I have those tickets you wanted.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 3
anh_en: Thanks! I'll come get it after my shift. Finally, I can go see the troupe's performance!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I can't find my access pass. How about you cut me some slack and just let me through?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Rules are rules! You're not getting through the Citadel without an access pass!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I could really use a bath and have something yummy right now...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I also really want to go see a match at the Colosseum, go sunbathing at Leonidas Plaza...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Ugh... When is it my time to take a break?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Have you seen my daughter? Did anyone see her come through here?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Please calm down, ma'am. Can you describe your daughter to me in detail?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: S-She turns eight this year. She was wearing... Oh no! I forgot what she was wearing!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Please be safe, Lilia...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Did you find the missing child?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: No. We've swept the vicinity and got nothing. At this point, all we can do is try our luck at Mournfell Canyon.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: ...Got it. Then I'll head out there and have a look around. I'll let you know if I find anything.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: You saved my daughter! Thank you! Thank you!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Say thank you to the nice man, Lilia!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: ...Thank you, sir.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 3
anh_en: Just doing my job, sir. Now, little girl. Remember, from now on, no sneaking out of the Citadel all on your own again, okay?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Ugh, the wound that I got from saving that kid is still killing me... I may have gone a little bit too far.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Did you see it, Mom? I fulfilled my duties as a soldier today.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Now I have the strength to protect others... just like you once protected me.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: ...I miss you, Mom.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Hard work is the only path to true strength!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: I'm gonna be just like you one day!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 3
anh_en: What exactly is the difference between soldiers and Gladiators?

speaker: NPC #850106
anh_en: May applause greet you! Welcome to the Citadel, recruits. As you'll be assigned your duties tomorrow, I'd like to open it up to any questions or feedback regarding your duties.

speaker: NPC #850107
anh_en: Captain Drusus, could you share with us some of your stories from the past? I wish to become someone like you, but I'm not exactly sure how to train myself.

speaker: NPC #850106
anh_en: Let's save the stories for when we're off-duty. As far as training goes... Well, it's not really something I can cram into a few words. Make the most out of every training opportunity you can get. Keep your eyes peeled when carrying out your duties. Practice. Learn. Growth in perseverance.

speaker: NPC #850106
anh_en: What about you? Got anything on your mind?

speaker: NPC #850108
anh_en: I-I'd like to know the difference between Gladiators and soldiers. It's my first day, so I'm not really sure how things work around here.

speaker: NPC #850106
anh_en: No need to worry. Soldiers and gladiators both fight for honor. Both are respectable. You'll get used to this place faster than you think.

speaker: NPC #850108
anh_en: Got it. Have you ever thought about becoming a Gladiator, Captain Drusus? With your skills, you'd be sure to do well in the tournaments!

speaker: NPC #850106
anh_en: Hahaha! An interesting suggestion!. But one I'll have to decline I'm afraid. I've got some promises to keep with my old comrades in arms.

speaker: NPC #850106
anh_en: Besides, I love what I do now! It's truly a joy, watching you all grow day by day into true guardians of Septimont!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Night patrols are also our responsibility. There's no room for mistakes...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Then have me go beyond the Citadel. I heard we're short on manpower out there.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 3
anh_en: Beyond the Citadel...? Sounds like there will be trouble around every corner.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: You got this, Lupa! No matter how you do in the finals, I'll always support you!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: With her capabilities, the win's in the bag for sure! I want to get stronger too... Wish I could be in the same training room with Lupa...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 3
anh_en: Is she really as tough as they say she is? I mean... could there be a chance she's cheating?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: See? I told you all Lupa was going to win the championship!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Did you see her moves during the finals? I've watched the replays over and over, trying to recreate her moves.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 3
anh_en: I guess I was wrong about Lupa... It's all pure strength, plain and simple.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: You're a quick learner! Won't be long before you can start heading out to the Sanguis Plateaus.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: I heard that's where the Blightcloud is located. Have you ever been out there, Captain?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Sure have. I'll be honest, I'm not fond of doing recon work out there...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: When's our next Sanguis Plateaus mission, Captain?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Hold your horses, now. We'll go when the higher-ups give us an assignment.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I even picked up some new gear just for the occasion. Can't wait to test them out on some TDs!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: ...Make sure you give them a good inspection first. You don't wanna rush things, buying beat-up gear.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Clearance sale! Everything goes! Best prices in the market! Come check out the best gear in Septimont!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: That's quite the discount on that fine gear you got there.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 3
anh_en: The quality doesn't seem too bad... But it's a little cheap, don't you think?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 4
anh_en: Yeah. Feels too cheap to be true. Let's just stick with the rookie stuff for now.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: How is that Deosthene's armor just shattered on the first hit? I mean, that's crazy if you think about it.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: He was wearing the gear we just picked up today. You don't suppose we got cheated, do you?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: I should've talked you guys into not buying that crap.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: No use dwelling on that. Stay with us, Deosthene! I'll go find you a doctor!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I've only ever promised a cheap price tag. I never said they come with a free warranty or customer service!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Save it! Your cheap knock-off almost got my friend killed, you know!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 3
anh_en: You're coming with us to the Ephor's Palace. Let's see what they have to say about your tricks there!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Sorry for all the trouble, guys. Glad I made it out alive. I'm never gonna cheap out again...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Back on the job already? You sure you don't a few extra days off??

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 3
anh_en: ...I take half of the blame. I'll be sure to stop you guys next time!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: This place has changed so much over the last twenty years... The last time your father and I visited was to watch the Agon.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: The Agon? Who was the champion, Mom?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Her name goes something like My... Strange, what was that girl's name again?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I'm sorry, I can't remember all of a sudden. I just remember it was a young lady.

speaker: NPC #850107
anh_en: Captain Drusus, when will we be assigned field missions? I've done pretty much everything there is to do around the Citadel. I think it's about time we get to see some action. I've always had an interest in recon missions in the Sanguis Plateaus...

speaker: NPC #850108
anh_en: I share the same thought. But I know my skills need more work, and I'd just be holding everyone back...

speaker: NPC #850106
anh_en: You're still too early for field missions. We won't let you venture beyond these walls until we're sure you can protect yourselves.

speaker: NPC #850107
anh_en: But I can manage my own! I may not be as strong as you, Captain, but I can handle the average TD just fine!

speaker: NPC #850106
anh_en: I was once your age myself, so I understand the passion to get out there and prove yourselves. How about this, next time I go out on a mission, I'll bring you all with me. You can stick around, and maybe you'll learn something.

speaker: NPC #850107
anh_en: Really?! Thank you! I won't let the opportunity go wasted, sir!

speaker: NPC #850106
anh_en: I like your hustle. Keep an eye on him for me, Tullia. Don't let him go charging in like a lunatic at the first sign of a threat, like he always does during training.

speaker: NPC #850108
anh_en: Yes, Captain...

speaker: NPC #850108
anh_en: I-I mean. I won't, Captain!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Everything's changed a lot around here... When did they build the little town? I don't remember it being here last time.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Are those unused materials stacked over there, Mom?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I believe so. Seems like they're not done with the construction work yet...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I had a foreign Gladiator who made all the way to the finals wearing my gear about twenty years ago!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: That's quite a long time ago. We weren't even born yet!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 3
anh_en: Yeah. You think that Gladiator can go up against Lupa, old timer?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Interested in getting some new weapons and armor? You won't find better deals on quality gear! Volume over profit, that's our game.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: We're not gonna get too many customers at this time of the day, old timer. See, there's not even much people on the cable cars.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 3
anh_en: Yeah. Why don't you tell us more stories about that Gladiator you mentioned?
Are you talking about Lupa?

speaker: NPC #850109
anh_en: That's right. I'm a Lupa superfan! I've watched replays of every single one of her matches at least a million times now!

speaker: NPC #850110
anh_en: Same here! Every time I watch those replays, I learn something new. How to handle a spear, tactics, small techniques... Feels like there's so much to learn, and they are all so practical, too.

speaker: NPC #850110
anh_en: She's guaranteed to snatch that championship, given how much more powerful she is than everyone else.

speaker: NPC #850111
anh_en: I wouldn't underestimate the other contenders, though. Also, don't you find it a bit fishy how easily she wins literally every match?

speaker: NPC #850110
anh_en: What's there to be fishy about? It's pure Lupa roflstomp! Besides, Lupa's not the cheating type!

speaker: NPC #850109
anh_en: My thoughts as well! You watch what you say about my idol!

speaker: NPC #850111
anh_en: I'm just raising an educated suspicion... Don't get all worked up about it!

speaker: NPC #850109
anh_en: Hey! Aren't you one of Lupa's teammates? I didn't recognize you last time. Congrats on winning the championship!
Thanks.
Want an autograph?

speaker: NPC #850109
anh_en: Can't wait to see more of you guys in the future!

speaker: NPC #850109
anh_en: Really?!

speaker: NPC #850109
anh_en: You guys were so amazing in the finals... Could you teach us some of your techniques? We wanna be great just like you!

speaker: NPC #850110
anh_en: Can you give me some pointers first? I've got tons of questions about that combo move you did...

speaker: NPC #850109
anh_en: Hey, back of the line! I was here first!

speaker: NPC #850111
anh_en: Can you help me tell Lupa that I'm sorry for accusing her of cheating earlier?

speaker: NPC #850112
anh_en: I know you've probably already gone over this in your manual, but there are things I still need to remind you again before you head out to the Sanguis Plateaus.

speaker: NPC #850113
anh_en: Please. Go ahead, Captain.

speaker: NPC #850112
anh_en: First, conduct routine monitoring of the Blightcloud's trajectory when you're hunting TDs in the Plateaus. Its movements are normally confined to a single zone, but we have a High Tide imminent. Be on your guard at all times.

speaker: NPC #850112
anh_en: Second, in the event of a Verdant Growth of the Blightcloud, your main priority is to ensure data and records collected from the Blightcloud remain intact.

speaker: NPC #850112
anh_en: Remember, the lives of all Septimontians depend on the data you hold in your hands. The odds of our people's safety increase, even if only one person manages to pass on that data.

speaker: NPC #850113
anh_en: Understood. By the blaze of glory, I will ensure the success of this mission.

speaker: NPC #850112
anh_en: You're just as blood-boiling as you were when you first joined. Anyway. Happy hunting. If you think there's not enough action out there, we can go a few rounds after you get back.

speaker: NPC #850112
anh_en: Let me guess, you're chomping at the bit thinking about getting out on the Sanguis Plateaus and proving yourself hunting TDs that you're not even interested in any other missions, am I right?

speaker: NPC #850113
anh_en: How did you guess that, Captain?

speaker: NPC #850112
anh_en: It's written all over your face. Besides, I get hotheaded kids like you every year.

speaker: NPC #850112
anh_en: Either way, make sure you're well prepared before you go out on a hunt, especially when it comes to your gear. We had a kid on a team just a while back who tried to save some money on cheap gear. Got himself a busted up real bad in the end. Still in a hospital bed.

speaker: NPC #850113
anh_en: I mean, the gear I bought was pretty cheap, but that's probably because I got a discount as a regular customer at Banagher's... I think?

speaker: NPC #850112
anh_en: Why don't you test them out on the TDs around the Citadel first? That way, if your gear isn't up to spec, you'll just end up with a few scrapes and bruises. Better than dying, wouldn't you say?

speaker: NPC #850113
anh_en: Ugh... I hope I didn't get scammed. I put a whole month of my salary on this kit. If it turns out to be garbage, I'll be living off scraps until my next payday.

speaker: NPC #850114
anh_en: Don't miss out! Clearing out my inventory and passing the savings on to you! Get the same premium gear used by top-tier Gladiators for just 30% of their original price!

speaker: NPC #850115
anh_en: Relax. My treat. This gear is so cheap, even if it falls apart after a few steps, we won't have lost much.

speaker: NPC #850115
anh_en: 30% of their original price? Feels a bit fishy...

speaker: NPC #850116
anh_en: You sure you're not trying to pass off some crappy gear? How's the quality?

speaker: NPC #850117
anh_en: Let's try somewhere else. If there's one thing I've learned over all these years, it's that you get what you pay for.

speaker: NPC #850114
anh_en: Of course not! Ask anybody and they'll tell you that old Banagher's as trustworthy a merchant as they come!

speaker: NPC #850114
anh_en: I'm sure you've heard of Annika, right? She and I are currently in a collaboration, that's why I'm able to offer such great prices! Tell you what, seeing as you're all new recruits, I'll make you an even better deal. Buy two, get one free! Take it as a bit of charity from me!

speaker: NPC #850115
anh_en: You've got my attention. We'll take three gear sets, then. We need new equipment anyway.

speaker: NPC #850114
anh_en: Fantastic! Thanks for your business!

speaker: NPC #850117
anh_en: You sure this is okay?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: That Angartitus fellow is acting stranger by the day...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Always chasing after that man Aerius for lessons.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Overheard him saying "Master, I burn for progress!" Can you believe it?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Hey, did you watch the newcomer's match the other day?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: I did. A promising contender, indeed.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Yes. I'm embarrassed to say this, but the youngin's got...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Got more talent than when you first started out, right?

speaker: NPC #850259
anh_en: Youth, fire, talent... That kind of mix always shakes up the arena. The crowd loves it. Opponents hate it. The future is bright for that one.

speaker: NPC #850260
anh_en: But I hear this newcomer has zero understanding of the rules. Turns down bribes, swings too hard, offends the wrong names... The noble Houses are starting to lose sleep.
Listen in.
Leave.

speaker: NPC #850259
anh_en: A Gladiator who has a bit of backbone and temper is a good thing. Reminds me of when I was young. As for the rules, he'll come to understand them sooner or later.

speaker: NPC #850260
anh_en: Sure, but you don't have "later" if you're retiring soon. What if he ends up across from you before then?

speaker: NPC #850260
anh_en: You wouldn't want to end your glorious career in disgrace, would you? The young rise quickly, old friend.

speaker: NPC #850259
anh_en: Hmph... You're not wrong. If I met him now, my odds... let's just say, they ain't what they used to be.

speaker: NPC #850260
anh_en: Hehe. I may have a way to keep the boy's career... quiet. For a few years, at least.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: That's it. I'm done. I'm handing in my resignation to the Ephor's Palace tomorrow!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Well, this is a surprise. What happened?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I'm sick and tired of being pushed around by the nobles and my superiors all day long...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: It's okay. Quit if you want, I'll take care of our financials.

speaker: NPC #850261
anh_en: You want to handle our financials? How, exactly? I-I was just venting... I'm still going to show up for work tomorrow...

speaker: NPC #850262
anh_en: Nobles... Just you wait. If I keep winning like this, we could be nobles someday.

speaker: NPC #850262
anh_en: There's no way you're going back to work. No point torturing yourself. Don't worry, we have money now. I've been winning match after match lately. Half the teams in town are trying to poach me.
Listen in.
Leave.

speaker: NPC #850261
anh_en: But what if you lose a match, or get injured...

speaker: NPC #850262
anh_en: Eh, it's just money. Don't worry, worst case, I'll nab some weapons from the other side and sell 'em. We'll get by.

speaker: NPC #850261
anh_en: I-I was just dreaming about switching jobs. I didn't say I wanted you to pay all the bills by yourself.

speaker: NPC #850261
anh_en: It's just that ever since the Ephor left the Palace for the High Tide, no one's kept the nobles in check. They've been doing whatever they please...

speaker: NPC #850261
anh_en: Huh... I'm sure jealous of those Ragunnesi officials serving the Sentinel. Beats serving nobles.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Sir Pableus, your family's business is really making waves recently.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: The commercial value of top-tier contestants can't be overstated.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Haha, we're merely assisting with a bit of promotional work, that's all.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Such modesty. This is already one of the most anticipated events in Septimont!

speaker: NPC #850263
anh_en: I'll be honest, Sir Pableus. Our House is very interested in sponsoring this tournament.

speaker: NPC #850263
anh_en: I came to you today to ask if you might mediate a small request.  We'd like to customize some icons and numbers on the contenders' projections...
Listen in.
Leave.

speaker: NPC #850264
anh_en: Ah… so that's why you've come. Well, I'm sure we can negotiate a deal.

speaker: NPC #850264
anh_en: I can see where you're going with this. Live betting odds during the matches, correct? Though, you know how particular the Gladiator managers can be...

speaker: NPC #850263
anh_en: We understand the game. No need to worry. If this goes through cleanly, we'll do an even split. The managers. You. Me. How about that?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: What kind of stunt was that?! We were just seconds away from closing the bets...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: They put fifty million Shell Credits on the Red Dragons out of nowhere!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Hmph. How shameful of them.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: And to make it worse, no warning. Not a whisper.

speaker: NPC #850263
anh_en: How selfish of them! Giving us only 30% of the gains. Do these new nobles have no dignity?

speaker: NPC #850263
anh_en: Don't tell me you weren't aware of their little stunt, Sir Pableus?

speaker: NPC #850264
anh_en: M-me? How would I know anything about that...?

speaker: NPC #850263
anh_en: Please. The Red Dragons were on the ropes. Then, just as the betting closed, they're back on their feet like nothing happened! With acting like that, they should be performing with the Troupe of Fools in Ragunna!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I've recently taken notice of a young Gladiator, Mother.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: She's a commoner, but made it all the way to Septimont on her own…

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: You must be referring to Calanthe.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: You've heard about her as well?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Word is, you're the most seasoned hand in the whole security team.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Been through a lot when I was young, that's all.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: What were things like before the Ephor took office?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Before the Ephor? Hah... those days...

speaker: NPC #850265
anh_en: Yes, I've heard of her... Indeed, as a newcomer, she does exhibit excellent reflexes and agility.

speaker: NPC #850265
anh_en: But listen well, my daughter. It's not enough to measure the potential of a Gladiator by their weapon alone.
Listen in.
Leave.

speaker: NPC #850266
anh_en: But didn't you just praise her, Mother? With adequate training, surely she could...

speaker: NPC #850265
anh_en: I said look into their eyes. That's what tells you everything. We don't invest in anyone who breaks at the first crack.

speaker: NPC #850265
anh_en: We need fighters like Lupa. Eyes locked on the enemy's throat, always calculating the kill. That's someone who wins, or dies trying.

speaker: NPC #850265
anh_en: Your judge of character requires more work, Missoula.

speaker: NPC #850266
anh_en: Y-Yes, Mother...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: These new Gladiators are a useless bunch of fools!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Calm down, madam. There's no need to get so worked up...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: You incompetent buffoons! We paid a fortune for this batch of nobodies. I want my money back!

speaker: NPC #850267
anh_en: Oh, the nerve! Do you remember how they bragged, Laocoon? Big mouths, zero skill, and don't even get me started on their attitudes!

speaker: NPC #850268
anh_en: Well… looking at it another way, at least we're among the first Houses to start prepping for next season?

speaker: NPC #850267
anh_en: Oh, thank you for that dazzling optimism, Laocoon. Maybe next year we'll just stumble across another batch of miracle Gladiators like last time?

speaker: NPC #850267
anh_en: Be realistic. Stop putting all your hopes on new recruits and learn what it means to be a Gladiator, would you?

speaker: NPC #850268
anh_en: Yes, these are the worst by far, madam... Only a handful barely made the cut, and Lupa still crushed them five to zero.
Listen in.
Leave.

speaker: NPC #850267
anh_en: When was the last time we lost so miserably? If this keeps up, our House's name will be dragged through the gutter!

speaker: NPC #850267
anh_en: I've lost count of how many times we've shuffled the instructor. But nothing is changing for the better.

speaker: NPC #850268
anh_en: There's little I can do. The teams I used to lead were all finalists and championship teams!

speaker: NPC #850268
anh_en: Now I'm handed a roster of greenhorns like this "Decimus." The boy plays nothing but defense. Just another fish too small to stir the water.

speaker: NPC #850267
anh_en: At this rate, we'll lose the Blue Furies match. And after that, if we lose to the Scratchy, there will be nothing left to lose to.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I bet those Ragunna fools wouldn't last a minute in a fight. What do you think?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Oh, for sure. That Order of theirs does nothing but pray to the Divinity.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 3
anh_en: How do you expect to protect your own people with just prayers?

speaker: NPC #850269
anh_en: If the Sentinel truly watches over these lands, They would surely need warriors worthy of fighting at Their side.

speaker: NPC #850269
anh_en: Well said! You are truly a person of wisdom! Praise Septimont. Praise the Ephor!

speaker: NPC #850269
anh_en: Strength and glory. These virtues must course through every Rinascitan's veins! Only the strong can lead our people forward!

speaker: NPC #850269
anh_en: An outlander? Then I must introduce you to the many tales of our great Ephor...

speaker: NPC #850270
anh_en: Hmph. Only those with strength of will deserve that honor. Blind faith will be the death of the Rinascitans. It's already caused Ragunna to grow stagnant.

speaker: NPC #850271
anh_en: The Ragunnesi leaders are hopelessly conservative. In strength, in vision, in presence—they can't hold a candle to our Ephor.

speaker: NPC #850269
anh_en: What are your thoughts on the matter, friend? Why can't they see it? That only someone as powerful as our Ephor has the right to lead?
The Ragunnesi bear a heavy burden.
Praise Septimont. Praise the Ephor!
Me no understand. I not from here. (mumbling gibberish)

speaker: NPC #850269
anh_en: We're all Rinascitans, and yet the divide between us runs so deep...

speaker: NPC #850269
anh_en: If The Order keeps tightening its grip, Ragunna will cut itself off entirely, and with it, the spirit of our people will wither.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Ugh. Will you please stop reading those Ragunnesi romance novels!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: But, Mother! Isn't worshiping heroes what we Septimontians are all about?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: You're daydreaming if you think that fantasy fodder counts as heroic.

speaker: NPC #850272
anh_en: Ragunna authors and their hack novels! They're messing with your head!

speaker: NPC #850272
anh_en: The nonsense they peddle! A banished Ragunna scion crosses the great seas to Septimont, finds true love after becoming a Gladiator Champion, and lives happily ever after...

speaker: NPC #850272
anh_en: Then after three years pass, he returns to Ragunna as Imperator's chosen hero to seek revenge on the nobles who once framed him.
Listen in.
Leave.

speaker: NPC #850273
anh_en: But Mother... he's truly an amazing Gladiator. Don't you wish your own daughter to marry a hero of great honor like that?

speaker: NPC #850250
anh_en: Septimont was a different place back then. Lowborn Gladiators like us barely had scraps to fight over, let alone eat.

speaker: NPC #850250
anh_en: Couple rounds in, can't even hold your Echo together. You drop, eyes wide as moons, just in time to watch some noble put on a show.

speaker: NPC #850250
anh_en: That's the truth of old Septimont, lad. So while you're still breathing? Be grateful the Ephor only needs you standing guard.

speaker: NPC #850251
anh_en: Really? I heard Septimont in those days had many legendary figures.
Listen in.
Leave.

speaker: NPC #850251
anh_en: I've heard stories about those Gladiators. Sure, the Ephor made short work of them, but still, they say their drinking cups were made of pure gold...

speaker: NPC #850250
anh_en: Heh. Gold cups? Hah. That's nothing. The madness of that area is far beyond your imagination.

speaker: NPC #850251
anh_en: Bet if I was born back then, I'd have been the top hound in the hunting party!

speaker: NPC #850250
anh_en: You? Back then, the grass on your grave would be knee-high by now.

speaker: NPC #850250
anh_en: I've seen plenty of your kind. Fresh out of boot camp, all puffed up. One sip of poison wine before the match, and you're twitching in the sand.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: This won't cut it. Gladiating isn't just about the fight...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: It's politics. People. Power plays.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: But... isn't it just about signing the strongest fighter?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Don't be so naive. Brute force alone won't get you anywhere.

speaker: NPC #850252
anh_en: Remember Mya? From Ragunna? She made it to the end and won The Grand Agon years ago.

speaker: NPC #850253
anh_en: Betting on Mya, who had the highest odds of winning, wasn't a gamble. It was the safety net every House agreed to in silence.

speaker: NPC #850252
anh_en: No one knows where she went afterward, but she proved that skill alone can take anyone to the top...
Listen in.
Leave.

speaker: NPC #850253
anh_en: Heh, Mya? You think that was skill? That was the most funded tournament in history. Coincidence? I think not.

speaker: NPC #850252
anh_en: The most funded tournament in history? I-I don't know what you mean, Mother...

speaker: NPC #850253
anh_en: What if I told you it was our wager on Mya that bought this family its seat at the high table?

speaker: NPC #850252
anh_en: But that can't be. She didn't have a patron, she fought for herself!

speaker: NPC #850253
anh_en: Oh, my foolish daughter. Agons and their patrons are nothing but a cover for the game of chess played behind the scenes. If you wish to keep yourself on the board, then you'd better know how to play your pieces correctly.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Say, who do you think is the best Gladiator?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: It depends... But I'd go for Lupa if you ask me.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 3
anh_en: Lupa is the real deal, no doubt. But if the Ephor ever entered the ring? All bets are off.

speaker: NPC #850254
anh_en: Aha! So even you think Lupa is the strongest out there! I knew it!
Me, of course.
It's Lupa.
It's the Ephor.

speaker: NPC #850254
anh_en: Hah?! You're serious! Well, you do give off... quite the aura. You're not secretly some legendary warrior from the old tales, are you?

speaker: NPC #850254
anh_en: Ha! I knew Lupa was unbeatable! No one can take down our champion!

speaker: NPC #850254
anh_en: Are you sure? But I've never actually seen the Ephor in action before...
Listen in.
Leave.

speaker: NPC #850255
anh_en: For now, maybe. But strength can fade. My father once told me what the Ephor was like in the old days...

speaker: NPC #850255
anh_en: Pure strength combined with will and skill, no tricks or borrowed power. That's what I call the mark of a true champion.

speaker: NPC #850254
anh_en: Is the Ephor the strongest Gladiator in history?

speaker: NPC #850256
anh_en: Careful, Ricken. Such titles don't pass clean through time, they bend to the age that bore them.

speaker: NPC #850254
anh_en: Ugh, too bad. If only the heroes of each era could have the chance to fight it out.

speaker: NPC #850254
anh_en: Hey, you there {Male=Sir;Female=Miss}, who do you think deserves the title of strongest Gladiator?

speaker: NPC #850254
anh_en: All the lads think Lupa is the strongest Gladiator around. But I think her partner also deserves more credit.
Each has their strengths.
I've no use for titles.

speaker: NPC #850254
anh_en: Each has their strengths... Well, then. What are your strengths, {PlayerName}?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: I know a bit of everything.

speaker: NPC #850254
anh_en: But it's the title of "strongest" we're talking about... By the blazing sun, what is it you're after then, {PlayerName}?
Listen in.
Leave.

speaker: NPC #850255
anh_en: I agree. That outlander is a force to be reckoned with.

speaker: NPC #850255
anh_en: Both of them bear the Lioness's blessing… I wonder what'd happen if they faced off against the Ephor.

speaker: NPC #850256
anh_en: If you strip away Resonance ability... then yes, I'd say the Ephor still holds the advantage.

speaker: NPC #850255
anh_en: True. But in a real combat scenario, things would never be so cut and dry...

speaker: NPC #850254
anh_en: Ah. You must be the champion, {PlayerName}! I'm glad to finally meet you in person!

speaker: NPC #850254
anh_en: Tell me, {PlayerName}. Who do you think is the greatest Gladiator of them all?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Your words were truly inspirational, Master Aerius.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Now the Ephor has entrusted me with an important task. I will not fail Septimont.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: I see you're finally learning how to sound the part.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: But do you really understand what the task calls for?

speaker: NPC #850257
anh_en: Of course. You have to trust me, Master Aerius. My problem is that I'm too honorable and principled. Makes me an easy target if things go sideways.

speaker: NPC #850258
anh_en: The Ephor is preoccupied with High Tide preparations, she won't have the time... Plus, helping her resolve difficult matters and manage Septimont affairs is the service she expects from us.

speaker: NPC #850258
anh_en: Stick with me. I've got enough old fox tricks to keep you learning till your hair is gray.

speaker: NPC #850258
anh_en: Matters only become serious once they're exposed. The same words in different mouths don't carry the same weight.
Listen in.
Leave.

speaker: NPC #850257
anh_en: I see your meaning. I'll return the gift first thing tomorrow morning. Septimont isn't a place you can do business just by throwing money around. If they wish to see the Ephor, they'll have to go through proper channels.

speaker: NPC #850258
anh_en: Oh, you're being unreasonable again. No one said they shouldn't follow protocol. But we don't have to slap their hands just for knocking at the wrong door… especially when it's the Montellis.

speaker: NPC #850258
anh_en: This isn't about your intentions, it's about finesse. If you're working under the Ephor's roof, you put her, and Septimont, first. That's how you stay three moves ahead of the rest.

speaker: NPC #850257
anh_en: So you're saying... I should accept their gift. Then nudge them through the departments, make sure they visit all the right desks?

speaker: NPC #850257
anh_en: But what if the Ephor learns of this? She's always had zero tolerance for this kind of thing...

speaker: NPC #850391
anh_en: Wow! I didn't expect anyone to find me hiding in the bushes under the bridge!

speaker: NPC #850392
anh_en: Thank you… for finding me.

speaker: NPC #850392
anh_en: I really wish I could stay and play with everyone…

speaker: NPC #850393
anh_en: Meow— Meow—

speaker: NPC #850394
anh_en: How did you do that? That's amazing! All the nearby cats came running!

speaker: NPC #850395
anh_en: Excuse me. Could you take a picture of me on the rooftop?

speaker: NPC #850395
anh_en: Thank you! Now I can tell my grandpa and grandma that I've been in a big city.

speaker: NPC #850395
anh_en: …Hm? Ah, so this is my last wish…

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: It's been so long, and I still haven't seen anyone hit the jackpot…

speaker: NPC #850396
anh_en: Whoa! I didn't expect you to hit the jackpot on every capsule machine!

speaker: NPC #850396
anh_en: Could you be… the legendary "Super Fortune of Honami"?
There's a legend like that here?
Huh… that's an interesting title.

speaker: NPC #850396
anh_en: Well, I suppose that's the end of my duty keeping an eye on these capsule machines…

speaker: NPC #850396
anh_en: …I hope you'll share that fortune with more and more people...

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The receiver hums with a steady beep. You patiently wait… until the call finally connects.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (Well… It's pretty bad all right.)

speaker: NPC #850379
anh_en: Hello, hello. This is Namipon from Shashou Caffe. I wish you a happy day, every day. How may I help you?
Oh, it's the mysterious coffee-making capybara.

speaker: NPC #850379
anh_en: Passenger? How are you… Ah, I see. You must be calling from a telephone booth?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: How do these telephone booths even work? I didn't dial a single number… and it just patched me to you.

speaker: NPC #850379
anh_en: Hehe, those are the Booths of Whim set up by the City Hall. If you can't decide who to call, they'll just randomly pick one for you.

speaker: NPC #850379
anh_en: Although… that's all they really do these days, not to mention their connection drops out all the time…

speaker: NPC #850380
anh_en: *Static crackles*

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The receiver hums with a steady beep. You patiently wait… until the call finally connects.

speaker: NPC #850397
anh_en: Those unfulfilled wishes shall guide you toward that very place.

speaker: NPC #850397
anh_en: I have faith in you. Faith that you can reclaim a future where everyone is free to live as they please and be happy.

speaker: NPC #850397
anh_en: So go. March forward towards that tower.

speaker: NPC #850397
anh_en: If only I could lay eyes on that starry sky above the Black Shores one last time...

speaker: NPC #850397
anh_en: It's me. Sumika. I believe this is the first time we're speaking to one another over the phone.
Who?
Do we... know each other?

speaker: NPC #850397
anh_en: If you can hear this recording, then it means… you're the one who can uncover the truth.

speaker: NPC #850397
anh_en: What I'm about to tell you are events I've uncovered during my time in Honami—

speaker: NPC #850397
anh_en: First, this city is trapped in an endless loop. Everything resets.

speaker: NPC #850397
anh_en: Second, its citizens are no longer alive.

speaker: NPC #850397
anh_en: Third, you are the "observers" who can step outside that loop. Or so I've come to believe.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The receiver hums with a steady beep. You patiently wait… until the call finally connects.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: This man is in another telephone booth, embraced by the rain, his forehead pressed to the glass as he remains silent as if he is praying.
(Stay silent)
Where are you now?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You remain quiet until the rain's rhythm fades, followed by a series of cold beeps telling you the call has ended.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Your voice can never possibly be the Yoko he spoke of, and you can hear his breathing grow faster on the other end.

speaker: NPC #850381
anh_en: Where… am I now? I have no idea. Yoko… How should I know…

speaker: NPC #850381
anh_en: …Yoko.

speaker: NPC #850381
anh_en: There's so much I want to say to you in person. So many I wish to share…

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: This sounds like a confession from an absolute stranger who somehow found a connection in the cluster of telephone wires.

speaker: NPC #850381
anh_en: I've thought it over. There's nothing in this world I want more than you.

speaker: NPC #850381
anh_en: Even if this entire city falls apart. I still want to see you now.

speaker: NPC #850381
anh_en: I just… want to go home with you.

speaker: NPC #850381
anh_en: *Calm breathing*

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The sound of rain can be heard in the background. An image surfaces in your mind—

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The receiver hums with a steady beep. You patiently wait… until the call finally connects.
Maggie—

speaker: NPC #850383
anh_en: Oh, my old friend! I can't believe it! I thought this was another one of those clients calling about a missing package.
You're doing customer service now?
Looks like your responsibilities have expanded.

speaker: NPC #850383
anh_en: Don't even get me started. One of our logistics convoys just got robbed in the New Federation. We lost several trucks of packages! Gone!

speaker: NPC #850383
