anh_en: Complaints have been pouring in since… So basically, everyone who's got time to spare got pulled over to customer service to fill the spots.

speaker: NPC #850383
anh_en: Ahem… I'm still on the clock, and the recording's still on. Alright, how may I be of assistance today?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: I'll let you get back to it. Hanging up now. You've got this, Maggie.

speaker: NPC #850383
anh_en: Thank you! Oh, wait! Please rate my service before you hang up—

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The signal cuts out before you can even respond.

speaker: NPC #850382
anh_en: Hello, Lollo Logistics at your service. For package tracking, press 1. For service inquiries, press 2. For customer service, press 3. You may also use voice input—
(Press 3)
I need customer service!

speaker: NPC #850382
anh_en: Connecting you to our customer service representative. Please hold… For quality assurance, your call may be recorded.

speaker: NPC #850382
anh_en: Voice input detected…

speaker: NPC #850382
anh_en: Connecting you to our customer service representative. Please hold… For quality assurance, your call may be recorded.

speaker: NPC #850383
anh_en: Hello! This is account manager Maji. How can I help you today?
Hello.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The receiver hums with a steady beep. You patiently wait… until the call finally connects.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Could you pass along a message to Cantarella for me? Tell her... the Laureate wishes her well.

speaker: NPC #850384
anh_en: Of course. I'm certain your words will bring her comfort.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You exchange a few more words, then end the call.

speaker: NPC #850384
anh_en: Thank you for calling Rosemary's Apothecary. This is Rosemary speaking.
Hello.
It's been a while.

speaker: NPC #850384
anh_en: Ah... that voice. Laureate, is it you?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Yes, it is. I didn't expect this line to reach all the way to you. How are things over there?

speaker: NPC #850384
anh_en: The demand for medicine in Rinascita has been overwhelming lately. The Fisalia family is doing everything we can to aid the reconstruction following the crisis.
I'm sure it's been rough for you.

speaker: NPC #850384
anh_en: I have to say, Milady's the one who's worked the hardest of all. She's been traveling nonstop, busy managing the reconstruction efforts.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The receiver hums with a steady beep. You patiently wait… until the call finally connects.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: I'm doing well. Speaking of which, you guys didn't get caught in any danger when the Dark Tide surged across the Plateaus, did you?

speaker: NPC #850386
anh_en: We managed. Those Tidespawn were terrifying, but Isth, Iaen, and the Gladiators that were with us held the line as best we could.

speaker: NPC #850386
anh_en: It was all thanks to you and your companions... even though it was a hard fight, we still made it out alive to see dawn break over the Plateaus.

speaker: NPC #850386
anh_en: Oh! And my thesis has already—

speaker: NPC #850387
anh_en: *Thrilled roar*

speaker: NPC #850386
anh_en: Wait, Iaen, you're getting too close! Ouch—!

speaker: NPC #850380
anh_en: Beep— Beep— Beep—

speaker: NPC #850385
anh_en: *Confused roar*
I'm sorry?
Hello?

speaker: NPC #850385
anh_en: *Happy roar*

speaker: NPC #850386
anh_en: Hm? Sounds like Isth just heard a familiar voice... Is that you, {PlayerName}?
Tulia?
And... the Scourgewing?

speaker: NPC #850386
anh_en: Yes, it's us! How have you been? I heard you left Rinascita some time ago.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The receiver hums with a steady beep. You patiently wait… until the call finally connects.
Sounds like you had yourself a good hunt.

speaker: NPC #850388
anh_en: Hmph. Let's just say I ran into a few surprises while collecting Tacet Discord samples.

speaker: NPC #850388
anh_en: Now, then. What's the trouble? Send me your location and I'll be there.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You give Galbrena a quick rundown about what happened in Honami.

speaker: NPC #850388
anh_en: A telephone booth that makes random calls… Reaching even at this distance. Interesting.
Where are you now?

speaker: NPC #850388
anh_en: Long story short, somewhere far from civilization. Barren, hostile, crawling with danger.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Well, be careful then. Once you finish your task, head back to the Black Shores as soon as you can.

speaker: NPC #850388
anh_en: Understood. I'm not in much of a place to chat either, so I'll cut it here. Oh, and—

speaker: NPC #850388
anh_en: I promised to hang out with you the other day. I'll make it up to you when I get the chance.

speaker: NPC #850380
anh_en: *Heavy gunfire and explosions*
Hello?
Hello, is anyone there?

speaker: NPC #850388
anh_en: Hold tight. This won't take long.

speaker: NPC #850380
anh_en: *Gunfire and explosions intensify*

speaker: NPC #850380
anh_en: *Guns cocking*

speaker: NPC #850388
anh_en: …Alright. I'm back.
Galbrena?

speaker: NPC #850380
anh_en: *Water rippling*

speaker: NPC #850389
anh_en: I am waiting. Fish in Mengzhou are far craftier than those in Jinzhou.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: …Is this really just about fish? Or are you trying to tell me something?

speaker: NPC #850389
anh_en: That depends. But when I am fishing alone, hearing a familiar voice isn't completely unwelcome.
Are you fishing?

speaker: NPC #850389
anh_en: Tell me… what have you seen on your journey?
…Oh, that'd take a while.
Maybe I should start from when I left Rinascita…

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You talked on and off for quite a while, until the signal finally cut out.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You hear "Beep—Beep—" from the other end. You wait patiently, until the call finally comes through.

speaker: NPC #850389
anh_en: ...Why so quiet?

speaker: NPC #850389
anh_en: It hasn't been long since we last met. I didn't expect to hear from you.
How did you know it was me calling?
Qiuyuan… are you setting me up?

speaker: NPC #850389
anh_en: I can tell by the rhythm of your breathing.

speaker: NPC #850389
anh_en: No, I remember the rhythm of your breathing.

speaker: NPC #850389
anh_en: ...Hmm, it slipped away again.

speaker: NPC #850390
anh_en: Ah, you got me!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Hey, did you hear? There's a secret gang that's been recruiting lately.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: You mean the one that only accepts people who drink that weird cup of tea?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Yeah, that's the one. Wait, those folks over there... they look like members of that gang.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: You want to start a band, right?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Yes. If possible, I'd like to be the lead vocalist and guitarist.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: That's unexpected. I thought a rich girl from a posh school would never be into this.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: …I was in a band once, actually. A friend invited me.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Whaaat?! You actually downed the whole cup of tea without even flinching?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Do you even know what was in it? You're a tough one...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 3
anh_en: Who knows? So… does that mean I'm in?

speaker: NPC #1422
anh_en: I've been waiting for thirteen years and seven months… When will you come back to me?

speaker: NPC #1422
anh_en: If this tunnel truly grants wishes, then let mine be this: may you return, safe and sound.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Are you… a student from the nearby school? Skipping class today?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: …What about you? Lazing about in the park to skip work?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I'm an adult. I have my reasons. Besides, the view here is nice.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Adult, you say? You don't look much older than me.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: You really know how to talk. So, want something to drink?

speaker: NPC #850357
anh_en: Come and spread excitement all over the world with ██████ Brigade.\n\nWe don't bother with ordinary people. But if you're a Resonator, a time traveler, or even an alien beyond Solaris, then come seek us out!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (What's that on the sand? Some special pattern?)

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: A strange manhole cover painted with the image of Namipon. A special frequency lingers on it.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Teenage Mutant Ninja Capybaras, heroes covered in fur! Rodent Power!

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Hmm... This cover smells fishy. Should we take a look?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (That tennis ball hopper over there... Is that some special frequency on it?)

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Ugh... What a smell... Somethin' weird must've happened at a table around.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Manager, I... I want to play tennis...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: ...I see. Then let's aim for the national championship!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Hold fast until the final moment, and never give up.

speaker: NPC #850355
anh_en: Excuse me, {Male=sir;Female=miss}... I think I lost my Namipon plushie.
Do you remember where you might've dropped it?

speaker: NPC #850355
anh_en: Well... I've searched everywhere but still couldn't find it. The only place left is that garden in Underground Street—the one with the beautiful cherry blossoms.

speaker: NPC #850355
anh_en: But... I'm too tired to go there myself. Could you please help me look for it, {Male=sir;Female=miss}?

speaker: NPC #850356
anh_en: Happy eleventh birthday, our sweet, sweet Shion!\nMom and Dad are doing well, just as we promised you. No more quarrels between us.\nShion… we just hope you can live a happy life in the world beyond.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You sense a faint, lingering frequency. The girl you met seems to have gone.
(Leave the plushie here.)

speaker: NPC #1422
anh_en: Thank you, {Male=sir;Female=miss}...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: You have one chance. Descend three steps, and you may join me as an ally.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: What happened... I'm sure I just tried going up the stairs!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Why am I... still standing here?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: The report is in, and we're officially done here.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Well… didn't think I'd get attached to this place.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: A whole year will do that to you.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Right. I think I'll visit again, as a tourist.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: ...I don't know what possessed his lordship to come to such a backwater place.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Beats me. I'm only here because I was told to be.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Same. I'm heading back once it's over.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Let's hope his lordship survives the "charm" of this place.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: The Dark Tide's way worse than we thought… What a mess.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Yeah, now they're short on fighters.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: I'm gonna pack up and head back to the camp.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: May howls of triumph follow you. Good luck, brother.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: So this is the town with the limited-edition merch? Where's the shop?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Be patient. I heard it's a street vendor.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Maybe it's not time yet. Let's wait a bit longer.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Even we are not allowed into the hunting grounds?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: It's for the best. Safety takes priority.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Let's follow command and do what we can to support them.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Right… I just hope everyone makes it back safe.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Think they'll reassign us to the city once construction's done?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Probably… but I wouldn't mind staying here.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Me neither. I'll bring it up with the captain as soon as the assignment comes in.

speaker: NPC #750196
anh_en: Finally, a transfer back to the city... This construction took longer than I expected.

speaker: NPC #750196
anh_en: Alright, calm down a bit. You're just about the most dedicated fan I've ever seen.

speaker: NPC #750196
anh_en: So, any plans for your bonus this time? Don't tell me you're sinking it all into gladiator merch again.

speaker: NPC #750197
anh_en: Hehe, that's my partner! You do know me.

speaker: NPC #750196
anh_en: ...Just don't come begging me for dinners when you're broke.

speaker: NPC #750197
anh_en: Grueling work. We were pulling double shifts to have it ready for the inspection.

speaker: NPC #750197
anh_en: After this, I'm taking a long break and catching up on all the Great Agon matches.
Is the contruction over?
You've earned it. Get some proper rest.

speaker: NPC #750196
anh_en: Yeah, it's over. What a grind. But at least we finished on schedule.

speaker: NPC #750197
anh_en: You said it… Wait, hold on! Aren't you the Champion who won with Lupa? I'm a huge fan! Please, can I get your autograph?

speaker: NPC #750197
anh_en: I can't believe I ran into the Champion out here… My friends are never going to hear the end of this!

speaker: NPC #750197
anh_en: I've bought so much of you and Lupa's merch! Some of it's even limited edition!

speaker: NPC #750198
anh_en: It's amazing how quickly Septimont came together! Last time I was here, it was still fenced off.

speaker: NPC #750198
anh_en: If you're afraid, we can buy some merch and leave right after.

speaker: NPC #750199
anh_en: Okay, let's not stick around too long. I don't know why, but the Sanguis Plateaus give me the creeps…

speaker: NPC #750199
anh_en: Hmm? You mean this town's new? Seriously?
I can confirm that. It's true.
Last time I came through, it was only half-built.

speaker: NPC #750199
anh_en: Astonishing! What's it for then? Seems awfully grand if it's just a tourist stop...

speaker: NPC #750198
anh_en: Yes! That's when I visited, too!

speaker: NPC #750198
anh_en: They say it was built as an outpost to observe the Blightcloud. That's why it went up so fast.

speaker: NPC #750199
anh_en: I heard that from a friend, too. Do you think the Blightcloud will affect the city? I'm kind of worried… maybe we should head back soon.

speaker: NPC #750198
anh_en: It'll be fine. We must have faith in Ephor Augusta! She's already on the Plateaus hunting with the Gladiators, right? Just wait for good news.

speaker: NPC #750200
anh_en: So, why didn't you join the hunt on the Plateaus? Old wound flaring up again?

speaker: NPC #750200
anh_en: They'll be fine. Have a little faith in the captain. Also, the Wootters are backing them up, so they are in good hands.

speaker: NPC #750200
anh_en: Now they're likely still on the move. I'm sure they'll get in touch once they're back at the camp.

speaker: NPC #750201
anh_en: You're right. Let's do a quick inventory and get the next supply shipment ready.

speaker: NPC #750201
anh_en: To be honest, my hands haven't been the same since the last injury. Can't keep a grip on my weapon for too long.

speaker: NPC #750201
anh_en: …Thought I would drag everyone down, you know.

speaker: NPC #750200
anh_en: Same here. They wouldn't clear me because of my condition. I'd give anything to be out there with the team.
You can still help in the rear.
Let's trust the Ephor's judgment.

speaker: NPC #750200
anh_en: I know. That's why I'm here, doing everything I can to support the hunt.

speaker: NPC #750201
anh_en: Yeah. Took me a while to accept it, but I get it now.

speaker: NPC #750201
anh_en: I wonder how they're doing… This Blightcloud is fiercer than usual. I hope they stay safe.

speaker: NPC #750202
anh_en: The Sanguis Plateaus... The travel guide says we're not allowed to go, right?

speaker: NPC #750202
anh_en: The bard telling it looked demented. I tried asking him for details, but got no answers.

speaker: NPC #750203
anh_en: Who knows. It's probably nothing, no happiness, just one of his wild dreams.

speaker: NPC #750203
anh_en: I admit I'm curious, but with the ways things are now, forget it… I don't want to run into those frenzied Dark Tide creations.

speaker: NPC #750202
anh_en: Agreed. Better to stay alive.

speaker: NPC #750203
anh_en: That's right. It's said to be extremely dangerous, not a place for anyone.

speaker: NPC #750203
anh_en: Tourists like us should just watch the Agon and stay out of the trouble.

speaker: NPC #750202
anh_en: Shame. I was hoping to see the legend for myself.

speaker: NPC #750202
anh_en: You look like a first-time visitor too. Are you also here for the legend of the hunting grounds?
Legend of the hunting grounds?
What's that?

speaker: NPC #750203
anh_en: Just a story I heard. It says if you reach Manes Deep in the hunting grounds with "two lives," you'll become the Hero of Heroes and find true happiness.

speaker: NPC #750202
anh_en: And do you believe that? I've been wondering, what could "two lives" possibly mean? And the "happiness"… is it wealth? Or power?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Vacation time! I can finally go home and rest!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: You've earned it. I'll handle the last bits here.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: That was quick! Didn't expect it to be finished already.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Enough marveling. We need to find that merch before it sells out!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: By the sun, I wish I could've joined the hunt.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Yeah. Would've been great if the captain had taken us along.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: So this is it for us… Shame we can't join the hunt.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Forget it. No legend's worth risking our lives for.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: So, what's your plan for your break? Gonna stock up on gear or watch a few matches?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Might take a little trip. A rare chance, this is. I've always wanted to see Huanglong.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Nice choice. I keep saying I'll go, but I never have the time.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Next break, we make it a trip for two.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: The inspection is just a few days away! Why are half of the buildings still unfinished? It's stressing me out!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: The Blightcloud is constantly changing, so our blueprints keep changing too....

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: But we must persevere in order to keep Septimont safe!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: You're right. I need to calm down and be patient...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I've been hauling construction materials in the city every day. My back is killing me.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: On the bright side, the overtime we've done will help us meet the deadline.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: That's right, we've done everything we can. The rest is for the Ephor to handle. What are you planning to do after this?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: I want to rest. I don't want to do anything or think about anything. I just want to zone out in bed.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Based on our present construction speed, we'll miss the deadline.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Erisa, can I trouble you to work overtime for the next two days? Erisa? Are you listening?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Ah! Sorry, I was thinking of my little sister.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: O-overtime, right? Sure, leave it to me!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Don't worry. Sarina is very capable. I'm sure she won't have any problem at her job.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: That's why I'm worried. She's always been rather headstrong, and she hates following instructions.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: It's her first job and she's working in the Ephor's Palace. I'm worried that she'll quarrel with her mentor...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: ...That's a possibility. I'll check how she's doing next time I report back to the city. Hopefully, everything's fine.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: How was the hunt? Did anything unusual happen?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: So many things happened. It'll take ages just to tell you about the Tacet Discords we saw driven mad by the Blightcloud.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: All I can say is that the situation is even worse than we expected. Luckily, the Ephor had a backup plan or else we'd have been toast.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Yes, indeed. It must've been tough on you. Just submit your report, and go rest.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Rest early. There is a lot to do tomorrow.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: I want to, but I can't sleep...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Missing home? Me too. Let's head back to the city together when we're done.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Erm... Actually, I'm just hungry.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: ...Interested in gold jewelry?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: My prices are low. Tell me what you want, and I'll find it for you.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: The gold jewelry you wanted is now in stock. I'll sell it to you at 30% market rate. What do you say?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: That's so kind of you. In your eagerness, you've been caught red-handed. I've only just received this theft report, and you've already turned yourself in!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Y-you're police?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: That's right. And you're under investigation. Come with me!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: As you can see, this zone is under construction. There's nothing worth visiting here.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: No wonder everyone here is either a soldier or a Gladiator... I guess we're in the wrong place for sightseeing?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 3
anh_en: Yeah... So roughly when will this place be ready? Looks like it still needs some work.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Well... only the person in charge knows when we'll be done.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Septimont only began developing cable cars in earnest as a means of transportation after the seawater had flooded these areas. It took us several years to build them, and even more years to establish a reliable operating line.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: I see... will the sea level continue to rise?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: We do get aqua alta from time to time, they're generally controllable. There's no need to worry.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 3
anh_en: Luckily, the cable car is here... Otherwise, we'd be exhausted!

speaker: NPC #850123
anh_en: There's a problem. The quantity of materials we have doesn't match the records...

speaker: NPC #850123
anh_en: The schedule is already very tight as is. If we keep rushing, my guys won't be able to handle it.

speaker: NPC #850124
anh_en: That's not up to me... but I'll see what I can do.

speaker: NPC #850124
anh_en: Check again. Did you miss anything?

speaker: NPC #850123
anh_en: I've checked three times! No matter how many times I check, the missing materials won't magically appear!
What happened?
Did someone steal something?

speaker: NPC #850123
anh_en: We've checked several times, but the quantities just do not add up. If we can't fix this, we'll fall behind schedule.

speaker: NPC #850123
anh_en: I don't think so. These materials aren't worth much. Perhaps they got lost in transit.

speaker: NPC #850124
anh_en: I'll report this to my superiors and tell them to ship another batch.

speaker: NPC #850123
anh_en: And what about the delay this causes? It's not our fault. Can we get a deadline extension?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Look at the claws and that tail... Woah, doesn't the shape of this Blightcloud look like a dragon?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: ...How did you come up with a dragon? I only see a huge black cloud.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: You've changed. You weren't always like this. In the past, you'd let your imagination run wild with me.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: I'm not in the mood. The team I support is competing today, but I can't go see them live, and I'm upset about it.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Sorry, my protective gear was destroyed by Tacet Discords. I'll need a few days to repair it before I can hunt with you.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: I'll lend you mine. Recently, Tacet Discords affected by the Blightcloud have become even more aggressive. They'll attack from miles away.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: The Sanguis Plateaus is very dangerous now. We shouldn't rush in without being fully prepared.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: ...If you're interested in this purchase, I can lower the price a little.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: The quality does look good. But this belongs to a series, right? Do you have the others?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Sure, I have them all!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Closing sale! Buy two, get one free! Don't miss out!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Buy a set to get 20% off and a free stylish sticker!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I can't believe that I found the set I've always wanted... And at such a cheap price!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Where did you buy this? I want to get a set too!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: See that vendor shouting about discounts? I bought it there!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Have you heard? The Ephor came here for an inspection, and she specifically mentioned the need to speed up construction.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Did she come the day I took leave? Sigh... we've been so busy lately. Did she issue any targets?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: She just thanked us for our hard work. Oh, right, she brought us some food and drinks as well. I took yours for you. I'll go get them after our shift.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: You've been working too long. Isn't it time to take a break?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: I'll stand guard for a while longer. Those guys on the next shift just returned from the frontlines. Let them rest a little.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Soft-hearted people really aren't suited to military life... Oh well, I'll stay with you for a while too.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Where is this? I don't think this is the arena we're looking for...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Obviously, we're lost! I told you that we should've turned left back there.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Oh no, we're going to miss the competition.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Forget about that. Look, they're selling merch here. Do you want to take a look?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: ...Something something Coast. Means this place, right?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Gah, this address is so blurry. I can't read it...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: It doesn't have a return address either... How am I supposed to contact anyone?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I didn't expect to have to travel so far to deliver a parcel... Oh well, at least I get to enjoy the scenery!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Such a rare opportunity.  I should take a scenic detour before heading back.

speaker: NPC #850125
anh_en: We've just received orders from the Ephor. The deadline has been moved forward again, and we need to bring in more workers from the city.

speaker: NPC #850125
anh_en: Oh my, isn't that just like you when you first started working? Your words were blunt, your actions were hasty, and you were always impatient for results.

speaker: NPC #850126
anh_en: R-really? I do remember that I was a bit overenthusiastic, but I wasn't that annoying, right?

speaker: NPC #850125
anh_en: I'm just messing with you. We can talk about it some other time. Let's focus on work now.

speaker: NPC #850125
anh_en: We'll also need to send someone to keep tabs on the Blightcloud. I will discuss these matters with the Ephor later. Erisa, I entrust all on-site supervision work to you.

speaker: NPC #850126
anh_en: Sure, sure...

speaker: NPC #850125
anh_en: Why are you so distracted? Are you still worried about Sarina?
Who is Sarina?
That name sounds familiar.

speaker: NPC #850126
anh_en: Sarina is my little sister. She recently graduated, and now she's working.

speaker: NPC #850126
anh_en: It's a long shot... but did you see her at the Ephor's Palace?

speaker: NPC #850126
anh_en: Her post at the Ephor's Palace is her first job. She's always been rather impatient. She hates regulations and bureaucracy. All she cares about is getting the right result.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Are you the acolyte who's been proselytizing on behalf of The Order of the Deep? I already told you we don't believe them, so stop being a nuisance.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: No, you've got the wrong person! Ephor from above, I wouldn't dare do such a thing!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Sigh... I don't even know what to say right now.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Friend, we don't say "Ephor from above." Can't you do a bit of research before coming here?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Did I tell you about the acolyte I saw earlier today? I can't believe an acolyte that dumb exists!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: You've already told me three times. I know it by heart!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Very well, then surely you won't mind another retelling.

speaker: NPC #850127
anh_en: ...Okay, I've noted your feedback. You can take a break, and I'll submit the Sanguis Plateaus report for you.

speaker: NPC #850128
anh_en: Yawn... I do feel sleepy. I've stayed up too long on too many nights recently...

speaker: NPC #850128
anh_en: I'll be resting. Call me when I'm needed.

speaker: NPC #850128
anh_en: Thanks. By the way, what's up with everyone here? They are either super busy, or they look burnt out. What happened?

speaker: NPC #850127
anh_en: Our schedule is very tight, and everyone is pushing hard to avoid delays. We've been shorthanded for weeks now.
That sounds tough.
Why are you so busy?

speaker: NPC #850127
anh_en: This concerns the lives of everyone in Septimont. I swear on my honor that I'll finish this job.

speaker: NPC #850127
anh_en: We must finish construction before the Blightcloud moves. Time is short, and this is very important, so everyone is working as hard as possible.

speaker: NPC #850128
anh_en: I see. I thought everyone was acting weird because they were affected by the Blightcloud... But I guess in a way, they are indeed affected by the Blightcloud.

speaker: NPC #850127
anh_en: ...Don't waste your time on such nonsense. You should sleep now. I still need your help with an investigation tomorrow!

speaker: NPC #850127
anh_en: Shouldn't you still be sleeping now? Why are you here in camp at this hour?

speaker: NPC #850128
anh_en: Hi... I dozed off for a while, and then I woke up. There's something on my mind and I can't sleep.

speaker: NPC #850127
anh_en: What is it? Is there a problem with your accommodations?

speaker: NPC #850128
anh_en: Well, sort of. But the main reason is that I'm so close to those Fluffy Gryphons. I'm too happy to sleep!

speaker: NPC #850127
anh_en: ...Happy? Or hyper? As a Gladiator who hunts all year, you must've seen them all the time, right?

speaker: NPC #850128
anh_en: I'm happy. Besides, it's not the same. I've loved Fluffy Gryphons since I was a child. They're my favorite because they're so cool and strong. Sadly, I can only watch them from afar, and I can't pet them.

speaker: NPC #850127
anh_en: Why? Did something happen in the past? Were you chased by a Fluffy Gryphon as a youngster and left with childhood trauma?

speaker: NPC #850128
anh_en: No, I'm allergic to feathers... Are you okay? Do you wanna rest for a while?

speaker: NPC #850129
anh_en: You're a new guest, right? Although you look pretty strong, I still don't think you should go to the Sanguis Plateaus unprepared.

speaker: NPC #850129
anh_en: Just use mine. You already owe me so much, I can't have you dying on me.

speaker: NPC #850130
anh_en: I feel bad about this. Wait a minute, let me write out an IOU...

speaker: NPC #850129
anh_en: Get lost! Who wants your barely legible IOU! Swear on your honor, and do not forget it!

speaker: NPC #850130
anh_en: Indeed. Look, the protective gear I wore through countless battles over the years has been destroyed by Tacet Discords... such a pity.
Thanks for the advice.
How should I prepare?

speaker: NPC #850129
anh_en: We don't want to see innocent people injured. As Septimontians, we should resolve our own issues.

speaker: NPC #850130
anh_en: Better gear and better weapons... Just kidding, I'm the one who needs them.

speaker: NPC #850130
anh_en: We will head to the Sanguis Plateaus again to hunt soon. If the situation improves, the next time we meet will be when we're on the hunt.

speaker: NPC #850129
anh_en: Let's not get ahead of ourselves. We haven't been tasked to hunt yet. In the meantime, we should get a better set of weapons and gear.

speaker: NPC #850130
anh_en: But I sent all of my savings to my mother and sister...

speaker: NPC #850131
anh_en: Hey there! Looking for gladiator merch? I have everything here at a reasonable price!

speaker: NPC #850131
anh_en: Nevertheless, I still consider myself lucky! At least, I have a proper job. Hahaha! I believe that if I hang in there, things will get better!

speaker: NPC #850131
anh_en: I have your merch too! Do you want a stand or a bracelet? The same gourd decorations are also available as pendants!
Why are they so cheap?
Didn't know I was so popular...

speaker: NPC #850131
anh_en: I don't get a lot of foot traffic here, so I'm trying to increase sales by lowering prices! Earning less is better than earning nothing at all!

speaker: NPC #850131
anh_en: The economy isn't doing too well, and it's hard to run a business. I can holler all day and not sell a single thing.

speaker: NPC #850131
anh_en: But what choice do I have? If I don't work hard, I can't afford rent and food...

speaker: NPC #850131
anh_en: Average people like me can't become Gladiators or join the army. We can only make a living by the grace of others.

speaker: NPC #850132
anh_en: Let's do our best and fight for the chance to be noticed by the higher-ups! Then maybe, we can be promoted to work in the city!

speaker: NPC #850133
anh_en: Good luck! When you've made it, don't forget about me!

speaker: NPC #850133
anh_en: Hmm? You don't want to be here anymore? I don't mind staying. The work is tough, but at least we're not supervised by city officials, which makes me feel more comfortable.

speaker: NPC #850132
anh_en: I want to get promoted. One day, I will work directly for the Ephor and build a successful career.

speaker: NPC #850133
anh_en: I admire your passion... but I just want to be an ordinary soldier until I retire.
You have my support!
Lying flat has its perks...

speaker: NPC #850132
anh_en: With your support, I'm even more motivated!

speaker: NPC #850133
anh_en: Right? Having a normal job is already a feat, so don't overthink it.

speaker: NPC #850132
anh_en: In any case, building this camp is a good opportunity, and I'm going to make use of it.

speaker: NPC #850133
anh_en: We've been doing so much overtime lately... How are you physically holding up?

speaker: NPC #850132
anh_en: I'm okay. I sleep well, I eat regularly, and I'm also taking supplements. I'll be fine.

speaker: NPC #850133
anh_en: No, that's not healthy at all. What you need is good rest and a healthy diet. You shouldn't be doing the bare minimum to look after yourself.

speaker: NPC #850132
anh_en: ...Isn't it okay to work hard once in a while?

speaker: NPC #850133
anh_en: No. I'm ordering you not to work overtime. Pass your work to me and go back to sleep now!

speaker: NPC #850134
anh_en: Lollo Logistics: We Promise, We Deliver!

speaker: NPC #850134
anh_en: On the bright side, I got the rare opportunity to visit this place.

speaker: NPC #850134
anh_en: When my job here is done, I'm going to take a break and walk around to admire the scenery.

speaker: NPC #850134
anh_en: Judging from your appearance, you're not a Septimontian either, right?
That's right.
I'm a real Septimontian!

speaker: NPC #850134
anh_en: Yeah, Septimontians don't usually come here.

speaker: NPC #850134
anh_en: Hahaha, as much as you try, you don't sound like a Septimontian.

speaker: NPC #850134
anh_en: I came here on a delivery run. But I can't find the recipient at all, and now I'm stuck with this parcel.

speaker: NPC #850134
anh_en: I've asked the Gladiators in the area. They're not too sure either, but they think he passed away a few years ago during a hunt.

speaker: NPC #850134
anh_en: Sigh... here's hoping the sender miswrote the recipeint's name.

speaker: NPC #1422
anh_en: …Thank you, stranger.

speaker: NPC #1422
anh_en: I can… finally go home now.

speaker: NPC #50242
anh_en: …Ichika. My pen name is Ichika.

speaker: NPC #50243
anh_en: I'm Aoba. Sorry, I... I don't remember anything.

speaker: NPC #50242
anh_en: Me neither. But I believe…

speaker: NPC #50242
anh_en: Someone once wrote letters to me and saved my life in the Tacet Field. That must've happened in the past.

speaker: NPC #50243
anh_en: Yeah. I've always remembered that I've been searching for someone, all this time.

speaker: NPC #50242
anh_en: …Then, how about we say that today is the day we first meet?

speaker: NPC #50243
anh_en: Sure. Why not?

speaker: NPC #50242
anh_en: …Ichika. My pen name is Ichika.

speaker: NPC #50243
anh_en: I'm Aoba. Hm? …Wait. I remember now. We met yesterday.

speaker: NPC #50242
anh_en: Yes. Yesterday was the first day of our reunion after we parted. And today… is the next day.

speaker: NPC #50243
anh_en: …So time is moving forward now.

speaker: NPC #50242
anh_en: The sun's still bright. Why don't we take a walk in Central Park?

speaker: NPC #50244
anh_en: Hey, human. It's me talking, meow!

speaker: NPC #50244
anh_en: I mean, don't end up like the humans here, meow.

speaker: NPC #50244
anh_en: Oh, and one more thing: watch that tower. You humans love building dangerous toys, meow.
A talking black cat?
Ebony Gatekeeper… is that you?

speaker: NPC #50244
anh_en: Nothing shocking about that! In this city of strangeness, there are even talking capybaras, meow.

speaker: NPC #50244
anh_en: Who's that supposed to be, meow? I'm just a black cat, born and raised right here in Honami.

speaker: NPC #50244
anh_en: Anyway, a word of advice: you and that black-haired girl are both "outsiders." Careful you don't get swallowed up, meow.
…You know about Chisa?
What do you mean by that?

speaker: NPC #50244
anh_en: That girl? A while back she gave me some weird-tasting canned fish, meow.

speaker: NPC #50244
anh_en: Hey, great human. It's me talking, meow!

speaker: NPC #50244
anh_en: Looks like you and that black-haired girl did something real big inside that tower, meow.

speaker: NPC #50244
anh_en: Most people in this city had their wishes fulfilled and "left" with no regrets, meow.

speaker: NPC #50245
anh_en: I've got a bold theory about Honami. No one else wants to hear it, though. Are you interested?

speaker: NPC #50245
anh_en: Believe it or not, I'll find a way to prove my theory. Just watch.

speaker: NPC #50245
anh_en: …So you're saying my theory's correct? That explains everything. Ugh, my head hurts…

speaker: NPC #50245
anh_en: Maybe this whole place is just an endless summer dream.
Go on.
Just how "bold" are we talking here?

speaker: NPC #50245
anh_en: This city's already been destroyed. And everyone living here—including us—is already dead.

speaker: NPC #50245
anh_en: Surprised? I didn't just make it up. At some point, this place doesn't feel like what it used to be.

speaker: NPC #50245
anh_en: We can't go anywhere. Strange stuff keeps happening everywhere. Yet everyone acts like it's normal.
(Stay silent.)
(Tell him the truth.)

speaker: NPC #50245
anh_en: Oh, it's you again.

speaker: NPC #50245
anh_en: You know, I'm greedy. But once I check off every last wish, just like the others here…

speaker: NPC #50245
anh_en: I think I'll finally "wake up" from this summer dream.
Hi.
How've you been?

speaker: NPC #50245
anh_en: Ever since something happened in Neon Tower, my head feels much clearer.

speaker: NPC #50245
anh_en: By the way, I've started writing a wish list.
A wish list?

speaker: NPC #50245
anh_en: Yep! I'm jotting down everything I want to do. It's tough, because my list is super long.

anh_en: Well… officially, she acts for the good of the whole nation, so she doesn't respond to trivial, personal desires.

speaker: NPC #50247
anh_en: But I heard… if you're lucky enough to meet her in person, you might be blessed with good fortune.

speaker: NPC #50246
anh_en: Listen! I had the worst dream ever...

anh_en: Oh? Did someone steal your snacks again?

anh_en: I'm not joking… I dreamed… Honami and so many other places were all destroyed…

speaker: NPC #50246
anh_en: And the miko who's supposed to protect us was gone too.

speaker: NPC #50247
anh_en: That's… really scary. But somehow… I feel like it wasn't just a dream.

speaker: NPC #50248
anh_en: Alright! Next, I'll bring pop anime culture into Honami Crossing.

speaker: NPC #50249
anh_en: Miss… I'm afraid Master would never approve such a proposal.

speaker: NPC #50248
anh_en: Hmph, like I care. Don't you think the Crossing is dreadfully boring as it is?

speaker: NPC #50248
anh_en: Not a single shop leaves any real impression… Well, Shashou Cafe stands out a little, I suppose.

speaker: NPC #50248
anh_en: By then, we'll have more anime merchandise shops and mascots parading down the street to attract customers.

speaker: NPC #50249
anh_en: Sigh... The higher-ups of the corporation will certainly raise objections.

speaker: NPC #50237
anh_en: Haha… sorry about that. That was a pretty terrible confession, huh?

speaker: NPC #50237
anh_en: Ahem, sorry. Kumi complained about this before. Sometimes my delusions slip out loud.
Don't worry. I'm just passing by.
Think of it as practice for next time.

speaker: NPC #50237
anh_en: Thanks. I'm not giving up yet. Guess I just haven't gained enough affection points.

speaker: NPC #50237
anh_en: Don't worry. I'm not giving up yet. Guess I just haven't gained enough affection points.

speaker: NPC #50237
anh_en: Kumi and I… we were kind of childhood friends. Got separated when we were kids. Never thought we'd reunite in high school.

speaker: NPC #50237
anh_en: Ugh... The "devil" in my right hand is starting to ache. I'll be in better shape to trigger the Confession Event tomorrow!

speaker: NPC #50248
anh_en: Hey! Where did you go? Just vanished after saying something like, "I have no more regrets"…

speaker: NPC #50248
anh_en: Did I ever allow you to disappear like that? Did you forget the promise we made when we were kids?!

speaker: NPC #50248
anh_en: ...I swear I won't be this willful anymore.

speaker: NPC #50248
anh_en: Just please... don't leave me alone...

speaker: NPC #50238
anh_en: Senpai, you idiot… You don't understand my feelings at all...

speaker: NPC #50238
anh_en: Sigh... Senpai's always like this… calling me out and confessing on a whim.

speaker: NPC #50238
anh_en: If it's me, he'll just take it as a joke like all the other times.

speaker: NPC #50238
anh_en: But he's the one who's forgotten what happened.
What do you mean?
Is there another reason you turned him down?

speaker: NPC #50238
anh_en: Actually… we've been together for a long time. But somewhere along the way, he forgot. And ever since then, he's kept coming to confess again and again.

speaker: NPC #50238
anh_en: …I feel like this has happened many times already. Like we're stuck...
Like in a loop?

speaker: NPC #50238
anh_en: Yes. At first, I thought something was wrong with me. But these last few days, I've started to believe it's really happening.

speaker: NPC #50238
anh_en: Could you tell him for me?

speaker: NPC #50237
anh_en: Haha… dumped again. Another failed confession, huh?
(Tell him what Kumi said.)

speaker: NPC #50237
anh_en: She really said that? Well… it's not like I don't remember anything.

speaker: NPC #50237
anh_en: It's just… those memories feel too fuzzy, too good to be true.

speaker: NPC #50237
anh_en: Maybe I've just been too scared to accept that those happy moments were real.
But now, you get to decide.

speaker: NPC #50237
anh_en: Thanks. I'll talk to Kumi right away.

speaker: NPC #50237
anh_en: Kumi… I… I'm sorry.

speaker: NPC #50238
anh_en: We've already lived a happy life, haven't we?

speaker: NPC #50238
anh_en: Senpai, you know, half the time I don't understand what you're talking about.

speaker: NPC #50238
anh_en: You're not a Resonator, but you always say things like, "There's a mysterious power sealed in my right hand" or "My eyes can see the future"...

speaker: NPC #50238
anh_en: And you just kept spouting some quotes from who-knows-where and treating made-up things like common knowledge...

speaker: NPC #50238
anh_en: But still, I tried. I kept trying to remember, to understand... because I wanted to know more about you.

speaker: NPC #50238
anh_en: I didn't reject you because I disliked you. It's just... we're already together, and you don't need to do that anymore!

speaker: NPC #50237
anh_en: I see... So that's what you really meant. I get it now.

speaker: NPC #50237
anh_en: No more confessions, Kumi. From now on, let's just... talk more. Be together, happily.

speaker: NPC #50238
anh_en: Yeah. That'll do, Senpai.
What are you doing here?

speaker: NPC #50239
anh_en: Mm… you're right. Even if they moved somewhere else, they must be busy, just like always.

speaker: NPC #50239
anh_en: I've been doing what they told me... I even learned how to cook.

speaker: NPC #50239
anh_en: So I'll wait a little longer. Maybe they just want to surprise me.

speaker: NPC #50239
anh_en: Hello… I'm waiting for my Daddy and Mommy to come home.
Why here?

speaker: NPC #50239
anh_en: Aunties and Uncles said Daddy and Mommy went to a place really, really far away, so we can't meet for now.

speaker: NPC #50239
anh_en: But every year on this day… they ride the sea waves back home to visit me.

speaker: NPC #50239
anh_en: Today's the day. I've been waiting so long, but… they still haven't shown up.

speaker: NPC #50239
anh_en: Do you think… maybe Daddy and Mommy forgot about me?
No, they're probably just busy.
…Maybe they trust you to take care of yourself.
Hi.

speaker: NPC #50239
anh_en: But I promised them I'd see every beautiful place in our hometown for them.
You can do it.
...I'll be cheering for you.

speaker: NPC #50239
anh_en: Thank you… I'm sorry. It's just... when you leave, I think I need to cry a little longer.

speaker: NPC #50239
anh_en: Hello. I… I saw Daddy and Mommy just now.
Really?

speaker: NPC #50239
anh_en: Yes. It was only for a few minutes, but… they really came back from the water to see me.

speaker: NPC #50239
anh_en: Mommy hugged me so tight, and Daddy patted my head just like he used to.

speaker: NPC #50239
anh_en: It felt like a dream. I was so happy… but also so sad. Is that strange?
Not at all.
You waited so long for this. It's only natural to feel so.

speaker: NPC #50239
anh_en: …Actually, I know. Mommy and Daddy… and I aren't supposed to be here anymore.

speaker: NPC #50241
anh_en: Ugh… why's it taking so long? Sigh... It's already past my curfew. Mom and Dad are gonna kill me.

speaker: NPC #50241
anh_en: If it keeps up like this… when am I ever gonna get home?
You're just going to keep waiting?
I don't think it's coming.

speaker: NPC #50241
anh_en: Yeah… I don't wanna walk. Last time I went home in these leather shoes, my feet swelled up like balloons.

speaker: NPC #50241
anh_en: Ew, don't say stuff like that at night. The bus will come.

speaker: NPC #50241
anh_en: It's not like I'm the main character in some creepy urban legend… right?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Ugh! I can't force my way into the rift! It's like something's pushing me back!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: That's enough. If Valentina finds out you tried something so reckless again, you'll be writing reports.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Keep your guard up. We don't know what might come crawling out next.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Hello there! I'm here to rescue our very first "victim" of the emergency.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Kuku... Hard drive... full... Can't eat... more data...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: You met the black-haired girl from Honami?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Ku! You weren't around. My drive shaft started acting up, and I just happened to run into her.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Didn't expect her to spot the issue right away, and she helped fix my foot!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Ugh... Passing through the rift didn't feel great…

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: That's all you've got to say after a full field investigation in Honami?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: It's a shame... I only got to see it after it was already destroyed.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: This Sonoro's size... It's way beyond what we estimated.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: That means... everything we knew before was just the tip of the iceberg.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: That blue figure just now… Was that Shorekeeper?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Yeah. That's the first time I've seen her show up in person.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: There's way more abnormal data than we expected… Sigh... So much for my short comp leaves...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: The analysis speed… It just can't keep up with how quickly these new frequencies are popping up……

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Kuku... The last crisis also started with an abnormal frequency, remember?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: It's alright! Tethys already has a solid contingency plan in place!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: But, kuku... wasn't it Tethys that broke down last time?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Kumi, there's something really important I want to tell you...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: I'm sorry, Senpai. You're a good person... but I can't go out with you.

anh_en: Wait, what?! I didn't even say it yet!

anh_en: Finally, this crisis is over. I can head back to the charging station now…

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Once I finish analyzing this batch of data, I'm going to Rinascita to resume my vacation...

anh_en: No, no. I need to sleep first.

anh_en: It's really something to think about. That special algorithm for detecting and tracking unknown frequencies...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Sumika-senpai was the one who refined it, back in the day.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Oh! It's you again, amazing Bloom Bearer!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: You're the big hero who saved the Black Shores and Shorekeeper. Now you've saved Honami City as well!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Why did that abnormal frequency show up near the Black Shores?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Hey! Humans over there. I'm here, meow.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: That's right. It's me talking, meow!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Daddy... Mommy... When are you coming back from the sea...?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Daddy... Mommy... I'll be good, I promise. I won't let you down.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Excuse me. Haven't we... Have I met you somewhere?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: I... I thought so too.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Then, may I have your name...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Hey, hey, Nanao, got any wishes you're really dying to see come true?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Why the sudden question?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Hehe, I was just thinking about those stories of our legendary miko and got curious!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: That faint, flickering city... Is it an illusion?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I've never seen anything like it near the Black Shores...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Emergency protocol activated. The Black Shores needs us.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Power at full capacity. Fully-equipped. Ready to initiate extermination mode at any time!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Keep tabs on the frequency exchange between the rift and the outer world.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Kuku! Monitoring systems at 100%! No frequency can get past me!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I feel like I've seen this city in a certain part of Tethy's database before...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: But where exactly?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: The Heroes of Heroes bled, raged, and grieved just like any of us.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: But, in every tale, they were always so brave.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Have you never known fear? Have your hearts never faltered?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: O Heroes of Heroes, the formidable symbols of glory in Septimont…

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Behold, friends, the Three Heroes' Crest, a monument to the heroes of legend!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Fabius, Atilius, and Valeria...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Each of the great Heroes of Heroes once stood upon these very stones.

speaker: NPC #750212
anh_en: Greetings, friend. Have you come to witness the majesty of the Three Heroes' Crest?
Not right now.

speaker: NPC #750212
anh_en: But the way those three peaks form a crest, combined with the visits of three Heroes of Heroes, has carved that name into the heart of every Septimontian.

speaker: NPC #750212
anh_en: There are many stories about that. The most widely believed one tells that they heard voices from within their souls on these mountains.
What did the Heroes of Heroes do here?

speaker: NPC #750212
anh_en: From then on, they understood their duty as Heroes of Heroes, tempered themselves and finally led Septimont to greatness.

speaker: NPC #750212
anh_en: But tales are just tales. What really happened, I'd like to know myself.

speaker: NPC #750212
anh_en: The true origin of this name is lost to time now.

speaker: NPC #750212
anh_en: Others say they ventured here to hunt the strongest of the Dark Tide creations, or even to pull out some legendary sword from the stone… Heh, you know how these Ragunna tales go.

speaker: NPC #750212
anh_en: I'm Lydus, a guide of the Three Heroes' Crest. If there's anything you wish to know about this place, ask away.
Why are they called the Three Heroes' Crest?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Stories don't show you a gun without firing it.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: So… you think the waterfall hides the way in?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Something feels off about the lay of this land...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: The question is, where do we start?

speaker: NPC #750213
anh_en: My gut tells me something extraordinary's inside this mountain.

speaker: NPC #750213
anh_en: Could the entrance be behind the waterfall?

speaker: NPC #750213
anh_en: But what if snakes are guarding it? They wouldn't bite, would they?

speaker: NPC #750214
anh_en: Leaving everything to Septimont… Ah, of course. Heroes like them always give their all for the people.
I'd leave everything to Septimont.
I truly am a Hero of Heroes.
I've never thought about it.

speaker: NPC #750214
anh_en: Whatever they kept probably meant nothing to anyone but themselves…

speaker: NPC #750214
anh_en: Well I'll be damned. What a twist!

speaker: NPC #750214
anh_en: Truth be told, I'm none other than Drake, the treasure hunter you've probably heard about in tales.

speaker: NPC #750214
anh_en: Well, great Hero of Heroes, if you've got any leads on the treasure, I'd be honored to lend my expertise.

speaker: NPC #750214
anh_en: And should we uncover it one day, I'd be more than happy to share it with you.

speaker: NPC #750214

anh_en: Could someone have beaten us to the treasure?

anh_en: Really? I'd hate to think so.

anh_en: How about you go check behind the waterfall?

speaker: NPC #750213
anh_en: Did someone just slip through there...

speaker: NPC #750213
anh_en: Must've been my imagination.

anh_en: No way anyone could cross a waterfall like that so easily.

speaker: NPC #750213
anh_en: Unless that was a Hero of Heroes.

speaker: NPC #750214
anh_en: I don't plan to wrestle that waterfall. Also, I have a hunch the treasure inside has already found its rightful owner.

speaker: NPC #750214
anh_en: Haha, don't be nervous. Just offering my congratulations. May the heroes' legacy serve you well.

speaker: NPC #750214
anh_en: Am I right, my friend?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: O great Fabius, Atilius, Valeria...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: The Heroes of Heroes, lend me your courage!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Watch over me and all who fight beside me.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Let our hunt be fierce, and our victory certain.

speaker: NPC #800326
anh_en:
Of the Three Heroes' Crest, beyond the legendary exploits of its Heroes of Heroes, there is another story seldom told.

A young Gladiator once climbed the summit alone after a hunt under the cover of night. When he returned to camp, his fellows were astonished, for this "Dragon Slayer" bore upon his body more than a hundred wounds, great and small. He had clearly endured a harrowing battle, a trial beyond imagining.

The Gladiator smiled wryly, admitting his defeat. Many would remember it as the "Flawless Hero's" first failure. His second, the tragedy of Fabianum, would follow not long after.

That Gladiator was Magno, the former Ephor of Septimont.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Mm… careful! I smell a powerful frequency.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: ...Is it coming from the top of the Crest? Let's check it out.

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: Warrior who ascends this peak, we shall grant you a trial—

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: Hearken to your heart's rhythm, hold fast your sword, and stand before us… until you rise above us.

speaker: NPC #800318
anh_en: The die is cast. Our conquest shall not cease...

speaker: NPC #800319
anh_en: Unyielding, unbroken, stands Septimont.

speaker: NPC #800320
anh_en: Show me to whom shall victory kneel!

speaker: NPC #800321
anh_en: Go now, warrior, to the memorial shrine. You have earned this honor...

speaker: NPC #800321
anh_en: O brave, peerless warrior... regrets we still bear.

speaker: NPC #800321
anh_en: Has Septimont cast off the shadow of its own glory? Has it withstood the calamity fate ordained?

speaker: NPC #800321
anh_en: ...And Rinascita... has it found unity at last?

speaker: NPC #800322
anh_en: Fabius, who bore the "Expedition Banner"—led the people across raging seas to the highlands. There he laid the bedrock of Septimont.

speaker: NPC #800322
anh_en: Atilius the Monument—stood firm against the Dark Tide's onslaught, the unbroken bulwark against calamity.

speaker: NPC #800322
anh_en: Valeria the Untarnished Blade—slew city-felling monsters in an endless hunt, etching naught but victory in her wake.

speaker: NPC #800325
anh_en: ...Mighty Heroes who slumber here, grant us your guidance once more...

speaker: NPC #800325
anh_en: If fate withholds its omens, who then shall deliver Septimont from ruin?

speaker: NPC #750301
anh_en: Me hope next year, Wootters have friends' party again.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: Ah, {PlayerName}, it's you. I was just about to… get in touch.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: Er… well… I'm on it. Really I am!

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: Now that I've seen them again, I'm brimming with new ideas. Right now, I'm gathering more data.
Good luck with it.
Don't forget to mention me in your acknowledgements.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: Thanks! I'll work twice as hard. No delay.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: Absolutely. I gave you my word.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: No wonder Isth was so excited back there. It sensed you nearby.
So you all came to the Plateaus.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: Yes, this is a perilous front line, but also my home. I was born and raised in the Gladiator camp here.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: And Iaen and Isth have, as always, made their way to the heart of a disaster.
Have they come to warn people?

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: Not this time. The Dark Tide is already a well-known threat. I guess what they are trying to communicate is… the resolve to stand against the disaster.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: But at least now there's a moment to rest. See how soundly Iaen's sleeping?
By the way, how's your paper coming along?

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: It seems my instincts were quite spot on.

speaker: NPC #850296
anh_en: Whatever happens… I'm sure we'll meet again under this sky.

speaker: NPC #850300
anh_en: *A soft, friendly rumble*

speaker: NPC #850300
anh_en: *A gentle grunt as it tries to rub against your shoulder*

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Iaen is fast asleep now, and it's nothing like the troubled slumber during its imprisonment. This one is quiet and dreamless.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (Is this… residual frequency of Wootters? Looks like they have something to say…)

speaker: NPC #750301
anh_en: Wootters, like us. You see stone shrines nearby?

speaker: NPC #750301
anh_en: This place is all dark doom. Gladiator friends made these for us long, long ago.

speaker: NPC #750302
anh_en: To remember Wootters.
So you are already…

speaker: NPC #750301
anh_en: Yes. The shrines let Wootters stay. In this way.

speaker: NPC #750301
anh_en: We must get ready. Will you tell our friends about party?

speaker: NPC #750301
anh_en: They are in shrines. You call them, they come.
Sounds easy enough.
This is my first request from Wootters.

speaker: NPC #750301
anh_en: You are good human. Wootters not stingy. We bring gift for you.

speaker: NPC #750300
anh_en: Woo ta, woo ta ta… Woo ta.

speaker: NPC #750302
anh_en: Dried fish. Best in Septimont.

Abby, do you like dried fish?

speaker: NPC #750302
anh_en: Woo ta ta, too bad.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: It's... okay, I guess. No, wait, the aged fish here's probably got some freaky frequencies mixed in. Could taste really weird.

speaker: NPC #750301
anh_en: No worry. Wootters joking. Our gift makes you happy.

speaker: NPC #750301
anh_en: Please help with the Wootter party.
