speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: That's odd. Didn't know Wootters could become ghosts. Initiating interpreting mode…

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Abby begins to interpret the Wootters' language from inside your Tacet Mark.

speaker: NPC #750301
anh_en: Woo, I'm Woona. This is Woodo. We're having a once-a-year friends' party.

speaker: NPC #750302
anh_en: Yes, yes. But we have a problem. Other Wootters no hear us.
Your friends are…

speaker: NPC #750303
anh_en: Woo… What invitation?
(Tell it about the party)

speaker: NPC #750303
anh_en: Is it… Wootter friends' party? The last one is not long ago, ta?

speaker: NPC #750303
anh_en: Okay… okay. I know. Will come on time.

speaker: NPC #750304
anh_en: Woona's party? I go, I go, ta.

speaker: NPC #750304
anh_en: Today, me helped a lost person again. Still holding the record.
There's a record for that?

speaker: NPC #750304
anh_en: Yes. Wootters cannot fight anymore. But can guide people out.

speaker: NPC #750304
anh_en: Although they no always see us…

speaker: NPC #750305
anh_en: Gaspard? You here?
No, wrong person.

speaker: NPC #750305
anh_en: Yes… you smell different, ta.

speaker: NPC #750305
anh_en: Me can't recall his face, though we fought so long together…
Are you waiting for him?

speaker: NPC #750305
anh_en: He came every year to clean the shrine and talk to us. Now many years me no see him.

speaker: NPC #750305
anh_en: It's okay. Woona knows best. Me will ask her about him at the party.

speaker: NPC #750306
anh_en: May applause greet you!
That's the spirit!
You're the most energetic one around here.

speaker: NPC #750306
anh_en: Ta ta. By the eternal sun, me will arrive at the party on time!

speaker: NPC #750307
anh_en: Woona's... invitation? Too late for me…
The Wootter slowly fades away in front of you.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Its frequency has just disappeared… It can't hold its shape any longer.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: …As a Common Echo, it should've returned to the nearby Nexus.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: So… we might meet it again one day?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (You find no "Ghost" Wootters' frequencies near the stone shrine, but you still receive the Wootter's promised gifts.)

speaker: NPC #750301
anh_en: Woo, friends no here yet. Please look for shiny stone shrines on road.

speaker: NPC #750301
anh_en: We stay here and cheer for you, ta.

speaker: NPC #750301
anh_en: Thank you! You called all Wootters. I thought this year's party would fail.

speaker: NPC #750301
anh_en: So me will stay till last Wootter gone. Party is to check on everyone.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: But, Woona… when all your friends have gone, you will be so lonely.

speaker: NPC #750301
anh_en: No lonely. Because this is my last wish, ta.
Thank you for everything, Woona.

speaker: NPC #750301
anh_en: Not just me. As long as someone comes here, any Wootter will try to help.

speaker: NPC #750301
anh_en: Woo, so happy… Another perfect party.

speaker: NPC #750301
anh_en: If Wootters go back to that <ano=Nexus Beacon>big pillar</ano>, all old memories go bye-bye.

speaker: NPC #750301
anh_en: Wootters no want to forget them. So we try really hard to stay.
Why is that?

speaker: NPC #750301
anh_en: Wootters are just "shadows" here. One day we go poof. Friends get fewer every year.

speaker: NPC #750301
anh_en: And, no Gladiator friends will come back to see us.
Have they forgotten about you?
Could it be that they already…

speaker: NPC #750301
anh_en: They all died in battles, ta. Me no tell other Wootters. Because many are still waiting.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Woona, why… do you seem to know more than other Wootters?

speaker: NPC #750301
anh_en: Because me live long enough. Long ago, my Gladiator friend died covering others.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: May your souls burn ever bright... as you ride the winds of Septimont to the land of glory.

speaker: NPC #750258
anh_en: Hail, Champion! May applause greet you!
What are you doing?

speaker: NPC #750258
anh_en: Every year, after the hunt, I come here to bring flowers to my old comrades. I pray their souls are in eternal glory.

speaker: NPC #750258
anh_en: Year after year, hunt after hunt, I've grown old. Before long, it'll be my son placing flowers in my stead.

speaker: NPC #750258
anh_en: Heh. Maybe as soon as next year.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Look at how vibrant this year's flowers are. Wonderful.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Let them pave the path for the fallen, so their glorious souls suffer no more.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: My comrades... May your souls applaud for what we've achieved...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Our war with the Dark Tide has come to an end, and this time, we emerge victorious!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Ma, the flowers are even more beautiful than last year.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I'm sure your father is proud to see you walk the path of a Gladiator.

speaker: NPC #750259
anh_en: Do you think my father's soul is still here? I remember you saying that a Gladiator's soul travels along the path of flowers... before resting in the Vale of Glory.

speaker: NPC #750260
anh_en: Maybe he left his blessings here, hoping you'd carry his legacy and rise as a prominent Gladiator.

speaker: NPC #750259
anh_en: Yes, I made him a promise. And I will keep it!

speaker: NPC #750259
anh_en: I've already been approved. Next year, I'll be able to join you in the hunt.

speaker: NPC #750260
anh_en: Oh, my dear child. We're all very proud of you.

speaker: NPC #750204
anh_en: O traveler from afar. Do you find Septimont's moon appealing?

speaker: NPC #750204
anh_en: Ah, the moonlight. Beautiful, isn't it? Whether it's during the hunt or when we're resting. It always hangs high in the sky, illuminating me with tranquility.

speaker: NPC #750204
anh_en: Oh, sweet moon, was there someone like me, pouring their loneliness out to you hundreds of years ago?
I do.
I don't.

speaker: NPC #750204
anh_en: You do? Then it seems I've found a fellow moon gazer.

speaker: NPC #750204
anh_en: Well, that's a shame. I really did believe I'd meet a fellow moon gazer here.

speaker: NPC #750204
anh_en: My apologies for asking such a question out of the blue. I hope I didn't startle you, and please don't take me as a strange person.

speaker: NPC #750204
anh_en: It's just... I haven't spoken to anyone for a long time, and got hot-headed to strike up a conversation.

speaker: NPC #750204
anh_en: Being part of the hunt has left me gravely exhausted, both body and soul. The days are spent engulfed in the terror of battle, and only moonlight can keep those creatures from hiding...

speaker: NPC #750204
anh_en: Only when bathed in moonlight do I feel I've recovered myself again.

speaker: NPC #750205
anh_en: Excuse me, I was wondering if you've seen a young beautiful Priestess with dark blue hair around here?

speaker: NPC #750205
anh_en: I came here to ask Lady Iuno to look into my fate. See if there's any possibility of realizing my dreams in the future.

speaker: NPC #750205
anh_en: It's rather embarrassing to visit her at Tetragon Temple for a selfish matter like this. I wouldn't want to disturb the other Priestesses at work.

speaker: NPC #750205
anh_en: Since there are rumours of people meeting her here, I will continue to wait patiently for my opportunity... Or perhaps this wait is also part of her prophecy?
You mean… Iuno?
You can try your luck at Tetragon Temple.

speaker: NPC #750205
anh_en: That's right. Do you know her? Could it be we were destined to cross paths here...?

speaker: NPC #750205
anh_en: You are correct, in normal cases. But the Priestess I am looking for is rather unique.

speaker: NPC #750205
anh_en: Her name is Iuno, the most gifted Priestess throughout the history of Septimont.

speaker: NPC #750205
anh_en: I've heard that Priestess Iuno would come here for a walk during her leisure time. So I've decided to try my luck and hope that I can bump into her.

speaker: NPC #750205
anh_en: I am not a Gladiator born from Septimont, so my knowledge of Septimont's Priestesses is rather superficial.

speaker: NPC #750205
anh_en: I was quite skeptical about how the Priestesses are able to perceive the future. But that was before I saw Iuno's prophecy of Septimont's calamity with my own eyes.

speaker: NPC #750205
anh_en: Graced by moonlight, this tree stands tall, bridging the heavens and the earth. For generations, it has silently watched over the hunting grounds, a steadfast witness to the stories of Septimontians.

speaker: NPC #750205
anh_en: Do you have the same feeling as I do?

speaker: NPC #750205
anh_en: There's always this tingling feeling that I've forgotten something important. And yet I can't for the life of me recall what it was.

speaker: NPC #750205
anh_en: Such magnificence... You share the same sentiment as I do, don't you?
Did you get to see Iuno?
Did you get your wish fulfilled?

speaker: NPC #750205
anh_en: Iuno? Who may that be?

speaker: NPC #750205
anh_en: Strange... Have we met before? And did I mention anything about a wish?

speaker: NPC #750205
anh_en: For some reason, I've been visiting this tree every night ever since I arrived at the hunting grounds.

speaker: NPC #750205
anh_en: Whenever I take in this breathtaking view, a strange sense of loss will always weigh heavily on my heart.

speaker: NPC #750205
anh_en: Am I... am I really here every night just for the view?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: This is a tree that yearns for moonlight.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Only after nightfall does it emit its unique radiance.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: ...Just like me.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Whether I stand on battlefields or wastelands, oh, sweet moon, you're always there for me.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Only when bathed in moonlight do I truly belong to myself.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: This is the first time I've seen leaves like these...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: They are related to those in Maroonwood, but why do they exhibit blue shades?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Fascinating...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: This is truly a remarkable place...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: That Priestess... She's still not here yet.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Why do I come here every day?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Am I attracted to these views to this extent?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Or are there reasons beyond that?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Speaking of which, I've never been to the Sanguis Plateaus myself…

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Hmm… I wonder if I'll ever get the chance to cross blades with the Dark Tide creatures.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: But aren't you a clerk? Do you even know how to hunt?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I was a Gladiator before I took this post! When the time comes, you'll see what I'm really made of!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Hey, I heard you went to Ragunna. How was it?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: The Carnevale was amazing! I saw so many unforgettable performances.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: If I get the chance next year, I'll definitely watch the troupe's show again.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I want to see it too! Take me with you next time!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Sigh... I'm really not cut out for paperwork...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I've made up my mind! I'll sign up for a Gladiator certification next month!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: One day, I'll head to the Plateaus and prove what my worth!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Did you hear? The Champion this time was absolutely incredible!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Really? Stronger than the Ephor?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Well... I was working overtime, so I didn't see it myself.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: But they say the Champion wields a blade two hundred meters long! Imagine that!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Though the Ephor comes from a humble background, she's proven herself through strength.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: But that Priestess… Reckless, willful, always bending the rules to her own ends...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Sigh... What a headache...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: She's earned quite a reputation in the Senate.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: It's a disgrace to Septimont to have someone of such origins as our Ephor.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: But now's not the right time to unseat her. I must wait.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: The true Hero of the Heroes will rise in time and take her place!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Want to make a bet? I'll have that palace guard laughing in under a minute!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: You wish! Alright, I'll bet you a dinner you can't pull it off.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: He's never seen my signature funny face! Just wait, you'll be buying me dinner!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Greetings, Champion.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Is there something you've come to discuss?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Welcome, Hero.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Thanks to your efforts, the crisis has been resolved.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Are you joining the hunt this time?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Tell me, which do you prefer: hunting or gladiating?

speaker: NPC #750206
anh_en: An honor to talk to you, Champion of the Great Agon.

speaker: NPC #750206
anh_en: Those creatures are wilder and more vicious than any Gladiator. If you're truly set on joining the hunt, make sure you're well prepared.

speaker: NPC #750206
anh_en: May applause greet you. I'll be here, awaiting the triumphant return of you and Her Excellency.

speaker: NPC #750206
anh_en: I watched the Final where you and Lupa fought side by side. That was a remarkable victory.
Thank you.
The credit goes to Lupa.

speaker: NPC #750206
anh_en: No need for modesty. Your strength has already proven itself.

speaker: NPC #750206
anh_en: Contender Lupa is a force to be reckoned with, but your prowess is unquestionable as well.

speaker: NPC #750206
anh_en: Speaking of which, I hear you're accompanying Her Excellency to the Sanguis Plateaus for the hunt?

speaker: NPC #750206
anh_en: Forgive my candor, but hunting and gladiating are not cut from the same cloth. A champion in the arena isn't necessarily a skilled hunter.

speaker: NPC #750206
anh_en: Agons are battles between people. But hunting? Hunting is a harsh contest of survival between humans and the Dark Tide creatures.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Your skill leaves a lasting impression!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I'll keep sharpening my edge with you as my goal!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Greetings, Champion.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: It's an honor to see you before the hunt begins.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Augusta! You are our eternal Hero of the Heroes!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I shall sing your praises as your loyal servant until the end of time!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Welcome, distinguished guest.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: If you'd like to know more about the Ephor's Palace, feel free to ask.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Welcome to the Ephor's Palace.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Is there anything I can assist you with today?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: May applause greet you, traveler from afar.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: If you have questions about the Agons, I'm happy to help.

speaker: NPC #750206
anh_en: Welcome back, Champion. The other warriors have already told me of your deeds on the Plateaus.

speaker: NPC #750206
anh_en: I must apologize for my earlier remarks. You've more than proven yourself, the strongest among all.
Thank you.
You're flattering me.

speaker: NPC #750206
anh_en: Thanks to your efforts, the crisis was resolved swiftly. On behalf of the Ephor's Palace, you have my deepest gratitude.

speaker: NPC #750206
anh_en: According to our Septimontian customs, we always hold a feast after a victorious hunt.

speaker: NPC #750206
anh_en: However, this time the situation was more severe than expected. While the danger has passed, many from the Palace are still dealing with the aftermath. We can't prepare the feast just yet.

speaker: NPC #750206
anh_en: Please grant us a little time. In the meantime, enjoy what Septimont has to offer—its culture, its sights, and its spirit.

speaker: NPC #750207
anh_en: Hunting and gladiating share the same root. But over time, they've grown into different paths.

speaker: NPC #750207
anh_en: That's why we train every day to prevent such a tragedy. With the Ephor leading us, I believe we stand ready. No calamity can shake us when we fight to protect our people.

speaker: NPC #750207
anh_en: Tell me, Champion, which do you prefer: hunting or gladiating?
Hunting.
Gladiating.

speaker: NPC #750207
anh_en: I see. A hunt on the Plateaus tests not just strength, but courage and clarity of mind.

speaker: NPC #750207
anh_en: Gladiating is a symbol of glory and of civilization itself. It brought prosperity to Septimont and became a cultural emblem we hold dear.

speaker: NPC #750207
anh_en: Whether it's hunting or gladiating, both are pillars of Septimont's traditions.

speaker: NPC #750207
anh_en: Gladiating is grueling, but it offers Gladiators a path to honor and fame. Hunting, by contrast, is rooted in duty.

speaker: NPC #750207
anh_en: If the Sanguis Plateaus were to fall, the Blightcloud would sweep in, unstoppable. It would devour all of Septimont in an instant, and the City of Glory would be lost to history.

speaker: NPC #750207
anh_en: Champion, your performance during the hunt was remarkable.

speaker: NPC #750207
anh_en: It pains me to see that shift. But I had to adjust training schedules to match the trend.

speaker: NPC #750207
anh_en: But now, after what you've done, everyone in Septimont is speaking of hunting. I believe your example will draw more Gladiators to take up the mantle of hunter.

speaker: NPC #750207
anh_en: Your skill and awareness are on a level few could dream of. I can hardly imagine the battles you've fought to forge such ability.
Thank you for the compliment.
You fought well too.

speaker: NPC #750207
anh_en: Your timely aid made all the difference. With your help, we kept the damage to a minimum. You have our deepest thanks.

speaker: NPC #750207
anh_en: Next to you, I've still got much to learn. But you're my goal now, and I'll keep sharpening my edge until I can stand as your equal.

speaker: NPC #750207
anh_en: Do you remember what I said before, about the difference between hunting and gladiating?

speaker: NPC #750207
anh_en: In the beginning, the Agons were meant to train Gladiators, to temper them through combat and prepare them to defend Septimont's honor.

speaker: NPC #750207
anh_en: But over time, they became more of a spectacle than training. A show, deviating from the cause it once served.

speaker: NPC #750208
anh_en: May applause greet you, Champion. I'm a devoted admirer of yours, and it's an honor to finally meet you.

speaker: NPC #750208
anh_en: I don't entirely share their views, but as a noble myself... there's only so much I can say or do.

speaker: NPC #750208
anh_en: Still, I do hope she proves them wrong and manages to change the old fools' minds in the Senate.

speaker: NPC #750208
anh_en: I take it you've come to the Ephor's Palace to speak with Her Excellency about the hunt?
How did you know that?
Nah, you're wrong.

speaker: NPC #750208
anh_en: It wasn't hard to guess. The nobility greatly admires what you've accomplished so far. We believe you'll help usher in a new era for Septimont.

speaker: NPC #750208
anh_en: Hehe, very well then, I'll take your word for it.

speaker: NPC #750208
anh_en: If I may offer a word of advice as a noble, don't grow too close to the Ephor. Best to keep a healthy distance.

speaker: NPC #750208
anh_en: It's true that Ephor Augusta has had her share of accomplishments... but many still doubt her ability to lead all of Septimont.

speaker: NPC #750208
anh_en: There are people who are more suitable for her position. Frankly speaking, many among the nobility see her merely as a seat warmer until the true Hero of Heroes appears.

speaker: NPC #750208
anh_en: Augusta, Hero of the Heroes. I didn't expect her to truly prove herself.
So now you acknowledge her.
She won't bring disgrace to that title.

speaker: NPC #750208
anh_en: Indeed. Her deeds speak clearly enough.

speaker: NPC #750208
anh_en: I must admit, she has proven herself worthy of leading Septimont. To some, she's already becoming one of the greatest Ephors in our history.

speaker: NPC #750208
anh_en: The nobles' view of her has begun to shift. Of course, it takes more than a day to overturn the old prejudices, but many have already let go of their former bias.

speaker: NPC #750208
anh_en: As her supporter, I'm glad to see more nobles taking up the hunt, fighting alongside Her Excellency and me.

speaker: NPC #750208
anh_en: As for those stubborn old voices in the Senate... Time has a way of silencing doubt.

speaker: NPC #750208
anh_en: I believe under Ephor Augusta's rule, more will come to see her as she truly is.

speaker: NPC #750209
anh_en: Greetings, Champion. It's an honor to meet you. I serve here at the Ephor's Palace. Part of my duties include coordinating Her Excellency's schedule.

speaker: NPC #750209
anh_en: As for your weapons... Oh, I see. You can carry them in the Palace with Her Excellency's personal permission.

speaker: NPC #750209
anh_en: The only thing I must remind you of is to keep your voice down within the Palace halls.

speaker: NPC #750209
anh_en: If there's anything else you should be aware of, I'll inform you promptly.

speaker: NPC #750209
anh_en: If this is your first time visiting, would you like me to give you a quick briefing?
Please do.
Will it be long?

speaker: NPC #750209
anh_en: Understood. Let me gather the key points. It won't take much of your time.

speaker: NPC #750209
anh_en: I'll keep it brief. Just the essentials.

speaker: NPC #750209
anh_en: In general, Her Excellency handles the internal affairs of Septimont in the mornings. Afternoons are reserved for external matters like diplomacy and trade.

speaker: NPC #750209
anh_en: Normally, it takes three to four weeks to schedule an audience with Her Excellency. However, given the urgency of the hunt in the Sanguis Plateaus, that rule doesn't apply to you.

speaker: NPC #750209
anh_en: You've also been granted special clearance. No paperwork required, unlike other envoys.

speaker: NPC #750210
anh_en: Greetings, visitor. How may we assist you today?
Assist in what?
I haven't decided yet.

speaker: NPC #750210
anh_en: That depends on your needs. We handle trade requests, public feedback on official decisions, and more.

speaker: NPC #750210
anh_en: I see. In that case, allow me to give you a brief overview.

speaker: NPC #750210
anh_en: For example, if you're applying for temporary residence in Septimont, turn left and proceed to the appropriate window for qualification screening.

speaker: NPC #750210
anh_en: If you have questions regarding recent decisions, the Senate can provide detailed explanations.

speaker: NPC #750210
anh_en: Don't worry. Most matters concerning Septimont can be handled right here. Once your application is submitted, you can expect a response within three to five working days in general.

speaker: NPC #750210
anh_en: Take your time to consider what you'd like to inquire about. We're always here and ready to help.

speaker: NPC #750211
anh_en: Welcome to the Ephor's Palace! I'm in charge of Agon-related matters. If you have any questions, feel free to ask.

speaker: NPC #750211
anh_en: It's not uncommon for Gladiators to skip an Agon entirely, choosing instead to focus on training in the hopes of getting better results next time.

speaker: NPC #750211
anh_en: But I doubt any of that will trouble you. With you and Contender Lupa on the field, I can't imagine anyone standing in your way.

speaker: NPC #750211
anh_en: Wait, aren't you the Champion of the Great Agon? I'm a huge fan! Never thought I'd get to meet you here in person.
Thank you.
I didn't expect to run into a fan here either.

speaker: NPC #750211
anh_en: You signed up right away without stopping by to inquire, so I thought I missed my chance to see you.

speaker: NPC #750211
anh_en: Hehe, well... in Septimont, it's harder to find someone who isn't your fan these days.

speaker: NPC #750211
anh_en: Usually, Gladiators stop by here first to ask about the Agon details, like how many teams have signed up, or what the rules will be.

speaker: NPC #750211
anh_en: Each tier of Agon comes with different rewards, rules, and levels of attention. Knowing the details helps with planning and strategy.

speaker: NPC #750211
anh_en: Most contenders think it through carefully before applying to strive for a better result. And they'll come for a full consultation before making a move.

speaker: NPC #850305
anh_en: Hello, are you here on business?
I want to buy some gifts.

speaker: NPC #850305
anh_en: Oh, thank you so much! I can finally meet my sales quota for this month. And I thought my goose was cooked, haha...

speaker: NPC #850305
anh_en: Sorry, I said too much, didn't I? Anyway, I'm happy to be of service!
Well, let's see some items.

speaker: NPC #850305
anh_en: How is it? Is there something I can help with?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Come do business anytime! Happy to be of service!

speaker: NPC #850305
anh_en: We meet again! Are you here on business again today? Welcome, welcome! Happy to be of service!

anh_en: Hey! How long do you plan on boring my student with those ancient histories?

anh_en: Aw, c'mon... It's just a leave request slip. No need to be so serious about it, right, Ms. Melnyka?

anh_en: Aye, sir.

anh_en: Did you figure out what the problem was?

Daily necessities from Jinzhou

Hand-crafted souvenirs

anh_en: True, the things we're used to seeing in Mt. Firmament might be interesting to outsiders.

speaker: NPC #900044

anh_en: Hehe, it's nothing really, just that Hongzhen has gotten a lot busier now that it's easier to come to Mt. Firmament.

speaker: NPC #900044
anh_en: But my business is still the same as always, neither good nor bad. Most of my customers are regulars from the town.

speaker: NPC #900044
anh_en: The visitors just come in, browse, and leave without buying anything.

speaker: NPC #900044
anh_en: So I thought maybe I should get something new in, stuff I've never sold before.
Are you looking for advice from me?

speaker: NPC #900044
anh_en: Yes. You're not from here, so you probably their preferences more than I do. So please, give me some suggestions.

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: Since you don't come to Hongzhen often, {PlayerName}, how about we shoot the breeze for a while?

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: All this just feels surreal, like a dream.

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: There were a lot of people opposing my decision to step down as the Mayor of Hongzhen.

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: I get it. Even though Xinyi's ancestors were from Hongzhen, she came to the mountains later on. While her abilities are impeccable, her way of doing things is still a bit different from the locals here.

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: But back then, I kept thinking, what if Mt. Firmament could open up to the outside world again? After staying in isolation for all these years, Hongzhen has already fallen behind the rest of the world.

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: For the sake of future generations, Hongzhen needs some fresh blood. Clinging to old ways just isn't sustainable.

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: And it all worked out better than I ever imagined. See, Mt. Firmament's door is opened again, and Hongzhen is still running smoothly in every aspect.

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: Letting Xinyi take over was the smartest move I've ever made.
Hello, Uncle Fu.
Pardon me, but do I know you...?

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: It's been a long time, hasn't it, youngster?

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: The last time we met was in a secret chamber here...

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: Hahaha, you young people sure are blunt. It's okay. There's nothing to remember this old man by, anyway.

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: But you can call me Uncle Fu like everybody in Hongzhen does, if you don't mind.

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: The last time I saw you was in a secret chamber here...

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: Mt. Firmament was in dire straits back then. It's hard to imagine it being peaceful again in such a short time, let alone more prosperous.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Uncle Fu gazes into the horizon, too lost in his thoughts to notice anyone around him.

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: No idea what happened to the young ones who ventured outside of Mt. Firmament... I hope nothing bad happened to them.

speaker: NPC #1344
anh_en: Hopefully, they'll come back once in a while. This is their home, after all.

speaker: NPC #900027
anh_en: The stone wall before you is called the Water Shadow Screen. It is naturally formed by years of continuous erosion from the waters of Sagaci Springs.

speaker: NPC #900027
anh_en: What's notable is that it inspired the ancestors of Hongzhen to invent a delightful form of entertainment—the Water Shadow Play.

speaker: NPC #900027
anh_en: All you need to do is gather some maple leaves that are scattered throughout the mountains and cut them into various shapes. Then, by using small twigs to manipulate them, the shadows of the leaves will dance in the water, bringing fascinating stories to life.

speaker: NPC #900027
anh_en: And that's why brewing and sipping tea while watching a Water Shadow Play became the favorite pastime for the folks of Mt. Firmament.

speaker: NPC #900045
anh_en: Have you given more thought to what we talked about before, Yucang?

speaker: NPC #900046
anh_en: I thought about it, but... I'm sorry, I want to stay here.

speaker: NPC #900045
anh_en: What can you do here? You have to go out, get yourself to Jinzhou to accomplish great things, or the Magistrate saved your life for nothing.

speaker: NPC #900046
anh_en: Sigh. I'm staying exactly because the Magistrate saved me.

speaker: NPC #900046
anh_en: If all of us young people leave, what will become of Hongzhen?

speaker: NPC #900046
anh_en: I feel since the waterway is open now, there will be plenty of opportunities for me in Mt. Firmament, too.

speaker: NPC #900046
anh_en: The Magistrate almost traded his life for the peace we have in Mt. Firmament now. I want to defend it to repay him.

speaker: NPC #900045
anh_en: You sure you're not coming?

speaker: NPC #900045
anh_en: Sigh... Never mind. I know I can't talk you into it.

speaker: NPC #900047
anh_en: Hey, what is a little cat doing in the pool?!

speaker: NPC #900047
anh_en: Don't panic, kitty-kitty. I'll get you out of there right now!

speaker: NPC #900048
anh_en: Please keep it down. The cat doesn't like loud noises when it's enjoying the hot spring.

speaker: NPC #900048
anh_en: Oh, and its name is Tiger, not kitty.

speaker: NPC #900047
anh_en: Enjoying the hot spring? Stop messing with me, little girl. All cats hate water.

speaker: NPC #900048
anh_en: I'm not messing with you. Cats in Mt. Firmament don't.

speaker: NPC #900048
anh_en: Well, that's not entirely true, I guess... They don't like the streams. Maybe they just prefer Sagaci Springs...

speaker: NPC #900048
anh_en: Hey, look, Tiger heard us and is swimming our way!

speaker: NPC #900047
anh_en: This is odd. The cat does seem fine and well...

speaker: NPC #900047
anh_en: Interesting... I wouldn't believe it if I didn't see it for myself.

speaker: NPC #900047
anh_en: I wonder what makes Sagaci Springs so special...

speaker: NPC #900047
anh_en: Maybe I should try it myself sometime?

speaker: NPC #900049
anh_en: Don't forget the soil samples.

speaker: NPC #900050
anh_en: I won't. You keep the rest safe for now.

speaker: NPC #900049
anh_en: Mt. Firmament is rich in geothermal resources thanks to its unique geological and soil composition.

speaker: NPC #900049
anh_en: The water supply is also a factor as well, of course.

speaker: NPC #900049
anh_en: I had read about similar cases in research files before, but seeing the plumes of steam rising in the frigid wind in person is still quite marvelous.

speaker: NPC #900049
anh_en: The scenery here is gorgeous. Make sure to get a full-body shot of me!

speaker: NPC #900050
anh_en: Three, two, one... Done.

speaker: NPC #900049
anh_en: Wait, let me switch up my pose. Snap a few more pics of me.

speaker: NPC #900050
anh_en: Why do we need so many photos? We're not here to sight-see.

speaker: NPC #900049
anh_en: Well, I want us to have some mementos. Who knows when we'll be back?

speaker: NPC #900049
anh_en: Besides, I want to give some of them to Yuanzhi. If her family doesn't allow her to study in Jinzhou, it may be long before we see her again.

speaker: NPC #900050
anh_en: That is true...

speaker: NPC #900049
anh_en: You'll miss Yuanzhi too, right, Xunwei? Why don't I take a photo of you, too?

speaker: NPC #900050
anh_en: No thanks, I really don't look good in photos. I'm better off leaving it to Yuanzhi's memory.

speaker: NPC #900027
anh_en: Oh, it's you.

speaker: NPC #900027
anh_en: I appreciate what you did last time. I think I got a lot better since then.

speaker: NPC #900027
anh_en: Now everyone loves to hear my Mt. Firmament stories, and quite a few want me to be their guide.
Congrats.
You did it all on your own.

speaker: NPC #900027
anh_en: Well, I couldn't have done it without your suggestions and encouragement.

speaker: NPC #900027
anh_en: Of course, I can't be complacent. I learned much of Mt. Firmament's history from these documents.

speaker: NPC #900027
anh_en: The more I learn, though, the more I realize how little I knew before.

speaker: NPC #900050
anh_en: Color, transparent, slightly blue.

speaker: NPC #900050
anh_en: Temperature... 41.

speaker: NPC #900050
anh_en: Characteristics...

anh_en: The sample vials and containers are ready. As for specific traits, that's for lab analysis to determine.

speaker: NPC #900050
anh_en: Take a break while I sort out the data from today.

speaker: NPC #900049
anh_en: Sure. I'll text Wei. I wonder how he's doing over there.

speaker: NPC #900049
anh_en: Hey, the scenery is pretty over here, too...

speaker: NPC #900049
anh_en: Snowflakes dance among the silver trees... Can't believe I'm seeing what I read in books in real life.

speaker: NPC #900049
anh_en: I'll send the samples to the lab later. We should get a report back in two days.

speaker: NPC #900049
anh_en: Also, I checked out the test results. We're still missing several key data for building the spatiotemporal variation model...

speaker: NPC #900050
anh_en: Okay, I'll sort that out, too, when I get back. Wei can handle the survey as normal on his end. We'll focus on the missing data tomorrow. That's more efficient this way.

speaker: NPC #900050
anh_en: You did well today.

speaker: NPC #900049
anh_en: Just doing my job.

speaker: NPC #900049
anh_en: Oh, when the survey is done tomorrow, let's grab Wei and visit Yuanzhi.

speaker: NPC #900050
anh_en: Sure. Let me leave Wei a message.

speaker: NPC #900051
anh_en: Mom, why is that lady holding a white board?

speaker: NPC #900052
anh_en: Uhh... I don't know...

speaker: NPC #900051
anh_en: That board has so many words and pretty pictures on it! I wanna go take a look! I wanna talk to that lady!

speaker: NPC #900052
anh_en: Be good, Sibao. She's busy. Let's not bother her.

speaker: NPC #900051
anh_en: Hmm... Okay then.

speaker: NPC #900053
anh_en: Are you guys interested in Mt. Firmament tea?

speaker: NPC #900053
anh_en: I heard it took seven steps to make tea outside this mountain: preparing teaware, warming teaware, putting in the tea, brewing the tea, discarding the first batch, pouring the tea, and then serving the tea.

speaker: NPC #900053
anh_en: It's not much different from our local tradition, though we're a little more particular.

speaker: NPC #900053
anh_en: Just on warming the teaware alone, we don't use boiled water but a scoop of the Sagaci Springs water, heating it with the spring's natural heat.

speaker: NPC #900053
anh_en: The teaware would get an earthy aroma from the heat, so when you pour the tea, your nostrils are greeted with a scent as if the leaves were freshly plucked from the snow.

speaker: NPC #900053
anh_en: Here, I just made it with the premium Firmament snow tea leaves. Try it.

speaker: NPC #900054
anh_en: Let's agree we want safety over adventure on this trip.

speaker: NPC #900054
anh_en: I have too little information on Mt. Firmament, so let's focus on scouting this time.

speaker: NPC #900055
anh_en: You're the expert, so of course I'll follow you.

speaker: NPC #900055
anh_en: But, I'm not going to skip any nice scenery we come across, either.

speaker: NPC #900055
anh_en: The two of us are among the first to sign up for a visit to Mt. Firmament. I've worked hard for a long time to get us this opportunity.

speaker: NPC #900055
anh_en: The magazine has saved a spot for us, so we've got to offer something unique.

speaker: NPC #900054
anh_en: Worry not, I'll make decisions accordingly.

speaker: NPC #900054
anh_en: Since we're traveling together, I'm responsible for your safety.

speaker: NPC #900028
anh_en: No, no...

speaker: NPC #900028
anh_en: Or maybe yes? Let's just do it this way.

anh_en: Anyone who has signed up can get a pamphlet about Mt. Firmament here. It contains detailed information on lodging and travel.

speaker: NPC #900056
anh_en: If you haven't signed up but are interested, please come and sign up here.

speaker: NPC #900056
anh_en: The Pioneer Association is an open organization. We welcome everyone with an adventurous spirit.

speaker: NPC #900056
anh_en: Whew... Now the crowd has died down. I can finally take a breather.
