speaker: NPC #900056
anh_en: Mt. Firmament is still a mystery to outsiders, after all.

speaker: NPC #900056
anh_en: So when the news of the open waterway broke, all of our signed adventurers, photographers, and reporters wanted to come.

speaker: NPC #900056
anh_en: Naturally, business has picked up as a result.

speaker: NPC #900056
anh_en: On top of that, with the association just setting up shop in Hongzhen, everything's getting mixed up. I have to tackle issue after issue, and I haven't had a proper rest in days.

speaker: NPC #900056
anh_en: I need to get back to my business now. I still have some documents to file. Talk later.

speaker: NPC #900089
anh_en: Say, would you be interested in checking out Mt. Firmament's famed Sagaci Springs?

speaker: NPC #900089
anh_en: Other than the Sagaci Springs, we also offer medicinal, floral, and alcohol baths.

speaker: NPC #900089
anh_en: Need a place to rest? We have accommodations too.

speaker: NPC #900089
anh_en: There's nothing more relaxing than enjoying a soak in the Spirit Sand Spring and then having a good night of sleep.

speaker: NPC #900028
anh_en: Oh no, none of the tricks work anymore...

speaker: NPC #900057
anh_en: The last we left off, the TD Outbreak had just hit and ravaged the land. Our Hongzhen ancestors staunchly defended the mountain but were on their last legs...

speaker: NPC #900057
anh_en: In the bleakest moment, however, a powerful figure came riding in from the East!

speaker: NPC #900057
anh_en: The figure's eyes shined like stars under the dark clouds. {Male=He;Female=She} merely pointed a finger for the Mianloong Chamber to open and the Sentinel to pierce through the sky.

speaker: NPC #900057
anh_en: In the Sentinel's glory, the Tacet Discord could not move another inch or cause any harm.

speaker: NPC #900057
anh_en: As the dark clouds dispersed and light returned to Mt. Firmament, the people were safe once more.

speaker: NPC #900057
anh_en: As for who the mysterious figure was and the legendary tales that followed, stay tuned until next time!

speaker: NPC #900057
anh_en: Sigh, this is still not interesting enough. Got to work on the hook some more.

speaker: NPC #900057
anh_en: Huh? Hey there, are you looking for a story?

speaker: NPC #900057
anh_en: Unfortunately, I'm still getting a new script ready... I didn't expect the people in Hongzhen to be so enthusiastic. I see I still have a lot to learn.

speaker: NPC #900057
anh_en: Not to mention everyone would get bored if I kept telling the same stories. I must figure out how to make them engaging!

speaker: NPC #900057
anh_en: Yinyu suggested that I should add some details to attract younger audiences, and I think that's a good idea.

speaker: NPC #900057
anh_en: You are not from around here, right? If you're not in a hurry, try the Spirit Sand Spring. It's wonderfully relaxing. Throw in the scenery and I wouldn't trade places with anyone.

speaker: NPC #900057
anh_en: But you do look kind of familiar. Where have I seen you before...?

speaker: NPC #900057
anh_en: Where, indeed... My memory these days...

speaker: NPC #900042
anh_en: It seems a lot of visitors have been getting sick lately...

speaker: NPC #900042
anh_en: I hope there's enough medicine to go around.

speaker: NPC #900042
anh_en: My elbow is a bit sore... Ow...

speaker: NPC #900042
anh_en: Should I get some salve for it?

speaker: NPC #900042
anh_en: Never mind, let me get through this first.

speaker: NPC #900044
anh_en: Come one, come all!

speaker: NPC #900044
anh_en: This is your only place for Hongzhen specialties!

speaker: NPC #900044
anh_en: What would a customer from the outside be interested in?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: What's there to be afraid of? We are supposed to aim high!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: But if we all leave, what will happen to Hongzhen?

speaker: NPC #900047
anh_en: Is that...?!

speaker: NPC #900028
anh_en: Judging from the size of Hongzhen, everyone probably knows each other. It's only a few steps to drop something off, so why would they need Lollo Logistics?

speaker: NPC #900028
anh_en: What about places farther away, like Loong's Ridge or Loong's Crest?

speaker: NPC #900028
anh_en: I don't think anyone lives there. Even if there were people, I never learned any skills to survive in outdoor snow, so it would actually be faster for the locals to deliver for themselves.

speaker: NPC #900028
anh_en: Forgive me. I was too occupied to notice you were here!

speaker: NPC #900028
anh_en: Are you receiving or sending a package? Oops, never mind. I forgot we just opened in Mt. Firmament and haven't received anything from the outside yet...
I'm just checking the place out.

speaker: NPC #900028
anh_en: No problem. Let me know if I can help.

speaker: NPC #900048
anh_en: What are you looking at?

speaker: NPC #900089
anh_en: Check out the special delicacies of Spring's Taste!

speaker: NPC #900089
anh_en: Buy any one menu item and get a voucher for the Spirit Sand Spring!

speaker: NPC #900089
anh_en: Still need to come up with something new...

speaker: NPC #900089
anh_en: Enjoy the spring and snow at the same time...? Yeah, that would work...

speaker: NPC #900089
anh_en: Come and enjoy our all-new medicinal hot spring!

speaker: NPC #900089
anh_en: A short soak relieves fatigue, a longer soak strengthens the body, and regular soaks prolong life!

speaker: NPC #900028
anh_en: I didn't know it could be done that way...

speaker: NPC #900028
anh_en: I guess I made the right choice.

speaker: NPC #900028
anh_en: I must thank you.

speaker: NPC #900028
anh_en: I won't be quitting anytime soon, at least.
What for?

speaker: NPC #900028
anh_en: I saw how much the local girl you helped has blossomed. You know, the one named Yinyu. She's now a famous guide in Hongzhen.

speaker: NPC #900028
anh_en: Her story doesn't have much to do with me, but I'm truly motivated by her growth.

speaker: NPC #900028
anh_en: When Lollo Logistics decided to expand into Mt. Firmament, I volunteered for the job, only to run headlong into a bunch of messy problems.

speaker: NPC #900028
anh_en: I even considered transferring back to Jinzhou or quitting altogether.

speaker: NPC #900028
anh_en: But then I saw Yinyu making us locals proud and building herself quite a name as a guide.

speaker: NPC #900028
anh_en: And it made me think, maybe I could ship Mt. Firmament's specialties to Jinzhou using Lollo Logistics and help local sellers reach new markets.

speaker: NPC #900028
anh_en: I don't know if it will work, but Mt. Firmament is a different animal. Instead of sticking to traditional logistics services, it might be better to incorporate some local flavor.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Mommy... Who are these people...?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Don't be scared, mommy's here. Shall we go home now?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Um... I wanna play a while longer... Please?

speaker: NPC #900030
anh_en: Hey, kid. Where are your parents?
It's dangerous there. Get down now!

speaker: NPC #900029
anh_en: My parents are working.

speaker: NPC #900029
anh_en: I always play here.

speaker: NPC #900029
anh_en: Or else I'd be bored out of my mind since I don't have anyone to play with...

speaker: NPC #900030
anh_en: Then why don't we build a snowman together? Come down first. Let's build a big one.

speaker: NPC #900029
anh_en: Well... I guess it has been a while since I last built a snowman... Okay then.

speaker: NPC #900030
anh_en: Here, let's give it a nose.

speaker: NPC #900030
anh_en: Can you help me borrow one of those self-moving suitcases? You know, the ones that have four wheels at the bottom and can follow travelers around.
What do you need that for?

speaker: NPC #900030
anh_en: The stuff on Mt. Firmament can hardly interest Yanning anymore.

speaker: NPC #900030
anh_en: If I don't step in, I'm worried that the kid will do something dangerous again when her parents aren't around.

speaker: NPC #900030
anh_en: That's why I want to find something interesting for Yanning.
Leave it to me.

speaker: NPC #900030
anh_en: Thank you so much!

speaker: NPC #900030
anh_en: Done!

speaker: NPC #900030
anh_en: ...Still feeling bored?

speaker: NPC #900029
anh_en: I've made tons of snowmen before, so I'm kind of over it...

speaker: NPC #900029
anh_en: I think it's more fun to climb up to higher places...

speaker: NPC #900030
anh_en: Hi, friend! Can you help me with something?
Are you talking to me?

speaker: NPC #900066
anh_en: What's up? You need a hand or something?
You tell the young traveler in front of you about borrowing the self-moving suitcase and the whole story behind it.

speaker: NPC #900066
anh_en: That's it? Sure, no biggie.

speaker: NPC #900066
anh_en: But you'll have to wait until I've unpacked everything from the suitcase. I'll head to the hotel first. Let's meet here at sunset.
Alright.

speaker: NPC #900030
anh_en: Well? How did it go?
You tell Gulan about your progress.

speaker: NPC #900030
anh_en: Perfect. We'll meet you at the spot you mentioned at the agreed time.

speaker: NPC #900030
anh_en: I can't thank you enough.

speaker: NPC #900029
anh_en: Hey, what's that? It looks amazing!

speaker: NPC #900030
anh_en: Maybe what Yanning truly needs isn't just interesting things, but someone's company.

speaker: NPC #900029
anh_en: It's running around after me!

speaker: NPC #900030
anh_en: Do you like it?

speaker: NPC #900029
anh_en: Yeah! I do! It's so much more interesting than climbing!

speaker: NPC #900066
anh_en: Haha, I'll be here on Mt. Firmament for the next few days taking care of some business. Just take the suitcase, no rush in giving it back.

speaker: NPC #900030
anh_en: Thanks! This suitcase really helps.

speaker: NPC #900030
anh_en: Also, I must thank our friend here for running around everywhere for us.
It's nothing.

speaker: NPC #900030
anh_en: But... this isn't a long-term solution. I really need to have a talk with Yanning's family when I meet them.

speaker: NPC #900026
anh_en: Mommy, these grown-ups... I've never seen the outfits they're wearing before...

speaker: NPC #900031
anh_en: Well, Zhichun, that's because they come from outside Mt. Firmament.

speaker: NPC #900026
anh_en: What... What's it like outside Mt. Firmament? Is it scary? Grandpa said it's full of monsters...

speaker: NPC #900031
anh_en: Grandpa was talking about a long time ago. It's similar to our town now, with lots of people living there.

speaker: NPC #900032
anh_en: Hey, we got a big crowd today. This is great.

speaker: NPC #900032
anh_en: Any more than this and my eyes won't be able to keep up.

speaker: NPC #900032
anh_en: It's those brats again... I told them not to mess with the guests' stuff. What's so interesting about those walking suitcases, anyway?

speaker: NPC #900032
anh_en: This won't do, I need to go over and have a word with them.

speaker: NPC #900032
anh_en: Three new faces... Yup, got it.

speaker: NPC #900032
anh_en: Another peaceful day.

speaker: NPC #900032
anh_en: Uneventful is the best event we can hope for.

speaker: NPC #900032
anh_en: It's quite chilly today. Gotta remind Jiye to keep warm at night when I'm back.

speaker: NPC #900032
anh_en: Nothing suspicious happened last night, right?

speaker: NPC #900033
anh_en: Everything's fine...

speaker: NPC #900033
anh_en: You?

speaker: NPC #900032
anh_en: Same old, same old for the both of us.

speaker: NPC #900032
anh_en: Say, since the Midnight Rangers are here, shouldn't we retire?

speaker: NPC #900032
anh_en: Look at you with that stubborn temper of yours. I was just spewing random thoughts. Why are you taking it so seriously?

speaker: NPC #900032
anh_en: Sigh. You know, the future of Hongzhen is in young people's hands. It's time we let go.

speaker: NPC #900032
anh_en: You're... What is it again... {PlayerName}! Right?

speaker: NPC #900032
anh_en: But the joy we're relishing now is all thanks to you kids.

speaker: NPC #900032
anh_en: Out with the old, in with the new. The younger generation is pushing forward. Times sure are changing.
Right
Wrong
Do you know me?

speaker: NPC #900032
anh_en: Hehe, you're the savior of Mt. Firmament, {PlayerName}. The people of Hongzhen are forever in your and the Magistrate's debt.

speaker: NPC #900032
anh_en: You kids sure love to joke around. I may be old, but my eyes are still sharp.

speaker: NPC #900032
anh_en: You're the savior of Mt. Firmament, {PlayerName}. The people of Hongzhen are forever in your and the Magistrate's debt.

speaker: NPC #900032
anh_en: Hehehe, there's nothing in town I don't know about, much less you and the Magistrate. You're the saviors of Mt. Firmament.

speaker: NPC #900032
anh_en: Hongzhen suffered the TD Outbreak generations back. It was Sentinel who preserved the town.

speaker: NPC #900032
anh_en: See those Midnight Rangers?

speaker: NPC #900032
anh_en: From then on, we guardians have been tasked with keeping watch from high places all day, ready to alert everyone at the slightest sign of trouble.

speaker: NPC #900032
anh_en: Hehe, let me toot my own horn for a moment—Jiye and I were the first ones to sense the Temporal Disruption and notify everyone.

speaker: NPC #900032
anh_en: But the disruption was just an accident. Hongzhen hasn't had major problems for years under the Sentinel's blessings.

speaker: NPC #900032
anh_en: So we are the only guardians left in Hongzhen from our generation.

speaker: NPC #900032
anh_en: Ever since Mt. Firmament opened, Midnight Rangers are stationed here. Saw 'em today, young and full of spirit. More impressive than Jiye and I ever were.

speaker: NPC #900032
anh_en: So I thought maybe it's time these two old fogeys hang it up.

speaker: NPC #900032
anh_en: However, Jiye is just too stubborn, especially in his old age.

speaker: NPC #900032
anh_en: Well, I can't blame him, really. He's been at it for most of his life and just can't let go.

speaker: NPC #900032
anh_en: What a relief. I was worried my old bones wouldn't last much longer, but now there's someone to carry on after me.
Why is that?
Have you crossed paths with the Midnight Rangers as well?

speaker: NPC #900032
anh_en: You asked the right question. There's a story behind it. Only a handful of young Mt. Firmament locals know about it.

speaker: NPC #900032
anh_en: Actually, Jiye and I are town guardians.

speaker: NPC #900032
anh_en: When we were young, we learned to fight from a master, before deciding to follow his footsteps and become guardians.
Town guardians? You protect Hongzhen?

speaker: NPC #900032
anh_en: Yes. Speaking of which, Hongzhen has been through some really tough times. Ever since the TD Outbreak, the elders established a tradition of having guardians.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Won't that man be cold wearing so little...?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: And that strange lady, she's always in a long white gown.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Who are they, Mom?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: I'm not sure, either...

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The old man seems to be napping. Best not to disturb him.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The old man is watching every passerby with sharp eyes.

speaker: NPC #900034
anh_en: Xunwei and Lili aren't in town today. I wonder where they went...

speaker: NPC #900034
anh_en: I really do envy Wei...

speaker: NPC #900034
anh_en: I want to be like them...

speaker: NPC #900034
anh_en: Yi'an has been feeling down lately...

speaker: NPC #900034
anh_en: Talk to him when you have the time.

speaker: NPC #900034
anh_en: Excuse me, but did you just get back from the mountain? Did you see Xunwei and Lili?
But you're from Hongzhen, so how did you know them?

speaker: NPC #900034
anh_en: There was a blizzard a few days ago. They and Wei took shelter in my house. We chatted and got to know each other.

speaker: NPC #900034
anh_en: From then on, they come to see me whenever they're free and share all kinds of interesting things.

speaker: NPC #900034
anh_en: Like why Scarefrost Deer have heart-shaped fur and how Airsailers feed themselves...

speaker: NPC #900034
anh_en: I never thought I could see the world through such a perspective. Things I thought couldn't be any more ordinary turned out to be so interesting and... valuable.

speaker: NPC #900034
anh_en: Maybe I'm daydreaming here, but I thought perhaps I could become a Huaxu researcher, too, like Xunwei, Lili, and Wei.

speaker: NPC #900034
anh_en: At least I'm working toward that goal.
Being a researcher takes a lot of effort.
That's a nice aspiration, but how do you plan to achieve it?
Nice aspiration. Good luck.

speaker: NPC #900034
anh_en: They are both researchers from Huaxu Academy, wearing uniforms, and are about my age.

speaker: NPC #900034
anh_en: Lili told me that, too, but I'm determined.

speaker: NPC #900034
anh_en: I think there are very few things in this world that are easy... If they all take an effort anyway, might as well do what you like.

speaker: NPC #900034
anh_en: I plan to head to Jinzhou to study.

speaker: NPC #900034
anh_en: I must take my first step. More doing, less talking. That's what I learned from Xunwei.

speaker: NPC #900034
anh_en: But before I do that, I want to say goodbye to Yi'an.

speaker: NPC #900034
anh_en: Yi'an is my best friend. We grew up together. I don't want him to be troubled by my decision.
Yes.
Nope.
Maybe, but I can't recall for sure.

speaker: NPC #900034
anh_en: I see, so they did go into the mountain for research.

speaker: NPC #900034
anh_en: It's okay. I'm guessing they're still in the mountain doing their research.

speaker: NPC #900034
anh_en: It's okay. I'm guessing they're still in the mountain doing their research.

speaker: NPC #900034
anh_en: I'd really like to see Xunwei and Lili's work routine. I think I can learn a lot even just by watching them work.

speaker: NPC #900026
anh_en: Maybe not that many, but I've never seen so many strangers in my life.

speaker: NPC #900026
anh_en: I-I'm just a little scared. But they seem quite interesting.

speaker: NPC #900026
anh_en: And Mom said I can say hi to them when I'm with trustworthy grown-ups.

speaker: NPC #900026
anh_en: But... But...
I can introduce you to them.

speaker: NPC #900026
anh_en: Really?
(Introduce the person in a white gown.)
(Introduce the person wearing a bamboo hat.)
(Introduce the person in a blue uniform.)
That's everybody.
Hello.

speaker: NPC #900026
anh_en: Hua... Huashi Academy... That's such a difficult name to pronounce.

speaker: NPC #900026
anh_en: But I now know everyone in a white gown is very impressive, very smart!

speaker: NPC #900026
anh_en: Logistics person of Lollo Logistics... Hehe, that sounds like one of Grandma's tongue-twisters.

speaker: NPC #900026
anh_en: I know the people wearing bamboo hats deliver stuff to people now.

speaker: NPC #900026
anh_en: Midnight Rangers... I like that! Easy to remember and has a nice ring to it!

speaker: NPC #900026
anh_en: So the people in neat blue uniforms are here to protect us!

speaker: NPC #900026
anh_en: Thank you. I'm trying my best to remember them!

speaker: NPC #900026
anh_en: Mmm... after hearing you tell me all that, I'm suddenly not scared anymore...
What are you looking at?

speaker: NPC #900026
anh_en: Oh, it's you. I remember you!

speaker: NPC #900026
anh_en: It was you and the Magistrate who saved us all!
Several researchers from Jinzhou happen to pass by. Zhichun clings to you, nervous and curious.
What's wrong?

speaker: NPC #900026
anh_en: That's because... because a lot of grown-ups have come here lately.

speaker: NPC #900035
anh_en: I don't get it. Why leave Mt. Firmament?

speaker: NPC #900035
anh_en: Sigh... How should I bring it up to Yuanzhi?

speaker: NPC #900035
anh_en: I don't see anything wrong with relaxing in the sun every day.

speaker: NPC #900035
anh_en: I'd live that way for the rest of my life if I could.

speaker: NPC #900035
anh_en: You're not a Hongzhen local, are you? Where are you from? Jinzhou?

speaker: NPC #900035
anh_en: Uh, if I may... I've noticed that a lot of people from outside are always so busy, rushing around as if they've got something urgent to attend to, and they never seem to stop.

speaker: NPC #900035
anh_en: I... I don't want my best friend to end up like that too...
It's a much more fulfilling and colorful life outside Mt. Firmament.
We're not rushing, just working hard.
You can relax and have fun anywhere if you want to.
Maybe your friend doesn't enjoy this kind of life.

speaker: NPC #900035
anh_en: But Mt. Firmament has its appeals, too. There are lots of things I haven't done yet.

speaker: NPC #900035
anh_en: Ahem, just to be clear, I'm not lazy or anything. I still take care of my responsibilities and do what needs to be done.

speaker: NPC #900035
anh_en: But the lifestyle outside Mt. Firmament has to be different, right? I just don't see her living the same carefree life out there.

speaker: NPC #900035
anh_en: Let me put it this way... I grew up with Yuanzhi, so I know full well what she likes.
You could say that.

speaker: NPC #900035
anh_en: But ever since Mt. Firmament connected with the outside world, it's like she's become another person...
Why don't you go ask her how she really feels?

speaker: NPC #900035
anh_en: I've never discussed things like this with her before... Let me think about it...
I have no idea, either.

speaker: NPC #900035
anh_en: I could say that?

speaker: NPC #900035
anh_en: No idea?

speaker: NPC #900035
anh_en: Well, still an outsider, no matter how you slice it.

speaker: NPC #900035
anh_en: Can you tell me what's cool or interesting out there, then?

speaker: NPC #900035
anh_en: I got a friend... who's been talking about leaving Mt. Firmament to see the outside.

speaker: NPC #900035
anh_en: But I just don't get it. What's so special out there that it's worth giving up this comfortable life for?

speaker: NPC #900035
anh_en: Have you talked to Yuanzhi yet?

speaker: NPC #900035
anh_en: Well, I'm not trying to say who's right or wrong. Everybody has their own perspective.

speaker: NPC #900035
anh_en: But I've realized that I just don't know Yuanzhi as well as I used to.

speaker: NPC #900035
anh_en: We've been friends for years, so I can understand her...

speaker: NPC #900035
anh_en: But I've realized that I just don't know Yuanzhi as well as I used to.

speaker: NPC #900035
anh_en: You're probably right all along...

speaker: NPC #900035
anh_en: I've realized that I just don't know Yuanzhi as well as I used to.

speaker: NPC #900035
anh_en: The gap between me and her seems to grow wider and wider...

speaker: NPC #900035
anh_en: Regardless, I still respect her decision to become a researcher. After all, it's the path she's chosen for herself.

speaker: NPC #900035
anh_en: I wouldn't like it either if she were telling me how to live my life.

speaker: NPC #900035
anh_en: She's my friend, so the least I can do is wish her happiness.
(Nod.)

speaker: NPC #900035
anh_en: She told you everything, I presume?

speaker: NPC #900035
anh_en: She wants to go to school in Jinzhou and maybe become a researcher... That's what she said.

speaker: NPC #900035
anh_en: Being a researcher doesn't sound that impressive to me...

speaker: NPC #900035
anh_en: I think staying at home and sticking around Mt. Firmament is pretty great.
There are pros and cons in either choice.
What Yuanzhi needs is your understanding.
You're just afraid of losing a friend.

speaker: NPC #900036
anh_en: Come, try my freshly dried fruit.
How do you make these?

speaker: NPC #900036
anh_en: That's easy. Let me show you.

speaker: NPC #900036
anh_en: You get some berries in advance and wash them in cold mountain spring water.

speaker: NPC #900036
anh_en: Then you cut them up, marinate them in a jar of sugar overnight, sun-dry them on a warm day, and they're guaranteed to be a treat.
That sounds simple.
That sounds complicated.

speaker: NPC #900036
anh_en: It does sound simple, but my child still can't manage it for the sake of his life. Sometimes he tries to help me, but usually, he just ends up causing more trouble than it's worth.

speaker: NPC #900036
anh_en: Hehe, you are just like my child. He thought it was hard, too. Though he still tries to help me sometimes, usually he just ends up causing more trouble than it's worth.

speaker: NPC #900036
anh_en: Sigh. He's no longer in town now. I have no clue how he's doing outside Mt. Firmament...

speaker: NPC #900036
anh_en: Not your taste, huh? Well, I have no clue what you foreign kids like or dislike. Guess I'll try something else when I return home.
(Take the dried fruit.)
(Wave and decline.)

speaker: NPC #900036
anh_en: Come on, don't be shy. Take it!

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Mrs. Qiu stuffs a handful of dried fruit in your hand.

speaker: NPC #900036
anh_en: Give it a try. How is it? Do you like it?
Yes.
No.

speaker: NPC #900036
anh_en: Grab more if you like it. I was worried it wouldn't suit your foreign taste buds!

speaker: NPC #900036
anh_en: Here's the dried fruit you wanted, Danhua.

speaker: NPC #900044
anh_en: It's all right. I was just wondering. The decision is all yours, naturally.

speaker: NPC #900036
anh_en: ...Sigh, sorry about that.

speaker: NPC #900036
anh_en: That's the case for everybody. I used to complain about him causing trouble when he was home. Now that he's gone, I have no one to help me and I miss him so terribly.

speaker: NPC #900036
anh_en: Where do you want them? I'll put them up for you.

speaker: NPC #900044
anh_en: No worries, Mrs. Qiu. You just take it easy and leave the heavy lifting to me.

speaker: NPC #900044
anh_en: Oh, I have something I would like to talk to you about.

speaker: NPC #900044
anh_en: The dried fruit you made is wonderful, but there just isn't enough of it. Even we Mt. Firmament locals have a hard time getting them, let alone folks from other places.

speaker: NPC #900044
anh_en: So, is it possible for you to make a couple more baskets at a time?

speaker: NPC #900036
anh_en: Well, I still have a jar at home. Just tell anyone who wants it to come to me.

speaker: NPC #900036
anh_en: But a couple more baskets... That's going to be tough.

speaker: NPC #900036
anh_en: As you know, my son left Mt. Firmament some time ago, leaving me all alone in the house. I just don't have the energy to do it all by myself...

speaker: NPC #900026
anh_en: Mom, that lady in the blue, uh, uniform is a Midnight Ranger.

speaker: NPC #900026
anh_en: And that man in the long white gown is a Hua... Hua...

speaker: NPC #900031
anh_en: Hehe, Huaxu—

speaker: NPC #900026
anh_en: Yeah, a researcher from Huaxu Academy.

speaker: NPC #900026
anh_en: Oh, oh, and I know him too! He's a logistics person of Lollo Logistics!

speaker: NPC #1343
anh_en: It's you, {PlayerName}. It's been a while.

speaker: NPC #1343
anh_en: Oh, you should stick around longer this time. Try the Sagaci Springs, or check out the Water Plums.

speaker: NPC #1343
anh_en: Sorry I can't hang out with you this time. Lady Xinyi's got me joining up with the Midnight Rangers from Jinzhou, so I'll be pretty occupied for a while.
Thank you. It's okay.
I prefer to be alone, anyway.

speaker: NPC #1343
anh_en: Sure! Anytime you need something, just hit me up. Happy to help, always!

speaker: NPC #1343
anh_en: How's your trip so far? Hongzhen has changed a lot, hasn't it?
It's a lot busier than before.
It's a lot safer than before.
Not as much as I imagined.

speaker: NPC #1343
anh_en: Well, Hongzhen is what it is now, all thanks to you and the Magistrate.

speaker: NPC #1343
anh_en: Yeah, thanks to you and our Madam Magistrate, the old Hongzhen is back.

speaker: NPC #1343
anh_en: Haha, that is true. Hongzhen was a peaceful, happy town before the Temporal Disruption.

speaker: NPC #1343
anh_en: Yeah, thanks to you and our Madam Magistrate, the old Hongzhen is back.

speaker: NPC #1342
anh_en: What are you doing here, {PlayerName}?

speaker: NPC #1342
anh_en: Of course, that used to be my and Bingge's duty, but now that the Midnight Rangers are here, I'm not needed as much.
You know Mt. Firmament better than the Midnight Rangers.
The arrival of Midnight Rangers should make things easier for you.

speaker: NPC #1342
anh_en: Well, I'm a local, after all, so of course I know more than the rangers. Lady Xinyi sent me and Bingge to assist them probably for the same reason.

speaker: NPC #1342
anh_en: But I'm not the talker Bingge is. The rangers are all right, but we just can't seem to find any common interest.

speaker: NPC #1342
anh_en: That should be the case, but I'm not the talker Bingge is. The rangers are all right, but we just can't seem to find any common interest.

speaker: NPC #1342
anh_en: In Bingge's words, it's a style clash... and that frustrates me.
Embrace the differences and stay true to your own style.
Just take it easy, they'll understand.

speaker: NPC #1342
anh_en: You're right. I'm a country bumpkin and don't know much, but I know the ancestors came here from all over because of the due to TD Outbreak, yet they all got along in the end.

speaker: NPC #1342
anh_en: Did you come back to visit or see Lady Xinyi?

speaker: NPC #1342
anh_en: Maybe Bingge did hit it on the nail. You can't rush friendship.
And you are...?
I know you, you are Shoufeng.

speaker: NPC #1342
anh_en: Well, we met each other briefly in the secret chamber during the Temporal Disruption, though we never got to talk much.

speaker: NPC #1342
anh_en: But I remember you very well, hero of Hongzhen.

speaker: NPC #1342
anh_en: I knew you'd recognize me!
What have you been up to lately?

speaker: NPC #1342
anh_en: Standing guard, working my shift... The usual.

speaker: NPC #900031
anh_en: Zhichun is still little. It's natural for her to be scared of strangers.

speaker: NPC #900031
anh_en: But she's curious and loves to play, so she keeps wanting to go out...

speaker: NPC #900031
anh_en: Well, that's just how kids are.

speaker: NPC #900031
anh_en: Being with her is the best comfort I can offer.

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: {PlayerName}? You're an honored guest. Please feel free to ask anything and make yourself at home.

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: Though the Mianloong Chamber lies vacant now, the Sentinel still returns to Mt. Firmament occasionally. After all, this is where they first descended, and it holds many remnants of their past.

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: Without all the politics, Sentinel has more freedom now as well.

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: Hongzhen belongs to Jinzhou, so it's logical for the Midnight Rangers to be here.

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: Not to mention with the new waterway access, there are unscrupulous parties eyeing Mt. Firmament, especially the ruins and relics.

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: Considering most folks in town are civilians, safety is a concern.

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: I think the Magistrate sent the Rangers to keep peace in Mt. Firmament and Hongzhen.
How are things with the Midnight Rangers?
Bingge should be working with them right now.
Shoufeng should be working with them right now.

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: Mt. Firmament has been in isolation for too long, so the rangers naturally have problems communicating with the locals.
(About how things are in Hongzhen lately.)

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: I sent Bingge and Shoufeng to work with the rangers. They both grew up in Mt. Firmament without much outside contact, but they are reliable and smart.

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: I believe it's also a matter of time before the City Hall takes over Mt. Firmament.

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: It's good to look around and visit old friends.

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: You're always welcome in Hongzhen.
(About the Sentinel.)
(About the Midnight Rangers.)
I'm just taking a look.

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: Thanks for asking. Thanks to the Magistrate's plan, Hongzhen is getting back on track.

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: The old era is over. Mt. Firmament is no longer isolated. To the people of Hongzhen, it means more opportunities and possibilities.

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: But not everyone will come here with a noble intent...

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: Yes. This is still not the time to let our guard down. Luckily, the worst is behind us. We just need to give Hongzhen some time and faith.

speaker: NPC #900037
anh_en: Hey... Wait, haven't we met before?

speaker: NPC #900037
anh_en: That's right. In the chamber, right? I remember seeing you with a pink-haired girl and the Magistrate too.

speaker: NPC #900037
anh_en: Left quite an impression on me.
What do you offer here?

speaker: NPC #900037
anh_en: Trinkets and knickknacks. I'm just a small merchant trying to make a living.

speaker: NPC #900037
anh_en: My wife got hurt during the Temporal Disruption, and that drove up the expenses.

speaker: NPC #900037
anh_en: But fortunately, Mt. Firmament is now accessible to the outside. More customers means more money for me to fill the gap.

speaker: NPC #900027
anh_en: Spring's Taste? I know where it is!

speaker: NPC #900027
anh_en: Just... follow this road.

speaker: NPC #900027
anh_en: That way... Hmm, I'm getting lost myself...

speaker: NPC #900039
anh_en: There's nothing about this plant anywhere...

speaker: NPC #900039
anh_en: What? Silver Lotuses have something to do with the Sentinel? It sounds like a myth, but still, it could be a nice subject for a paper...

speaker: NPC #900038
anh_en: What's wrong?

speaker: NPC #900038
anh_en: Oh, what you got there is a Silver Lotus. We use it for food. It's nothing special.

speaker: NPC #900038
anh_en: If you're interested, I can give you some from my house.

speaker: NPC #900039
anh_en: Thank you, ma'am, but it's all right. I can pick some when I do my research in the mountains.

speaker: NPC #900038
anh_en: Okay, whatever you like.

speaker: NPC #900038
anh_en: Come over for dinner, I'll make my signature Silver Lotus dish.

speaker: NPC #900039
anh_en: Won't that be too much trouble?

speaker: NPC #900038
anh_en: No trouble at all! You don't get that outside Mt. Firmament. It is said Silver Lotuses only grow in snow patches where the Sentinel has been.

speaker: NPC #900040
anh_en: Why is this treasure chest not spitting anything out...?

speaker: NPC #900041
anh_en: That's not a treasure chest, Great-Great-Grandpa. It's a vending machine.

speaker: NPC #900040
anh_en: A vend-what?

speaker: NPC #900041
anh_en: A vending machine...

speaker: NPC #900041
anh_en: See, you feed it Shell Credits according to the listed price.

speaker: NPC #900041
anh_en: Then press the button underneath the item you want.

speaker: NPC #900040
anh_en: Okay, okay, I got it now.

speaker: NPC #900040
anh_en: Isn't this just a stall in the form of a machine?

speaker: NPC #900041
anh_en: Well, you could say that, yes.

speaker: NPC #900041
anh_en: You're not from around here, are you?

speaker: NPC #900041
anh_en: Nevertheless, Great-Great-Grandpa Sihong is our patriarch. That's for sure. He could recognize all the stuff our family brought with them when they moved from Mt. Firmament to Jinzhou.

speaker: NPC #900041
anh_en: The reason I came to Mt. Firmament is to trace my roots. The older folks in my family always wanted nothing more than to return to their hometown and reunite with long-lost relatives.

speaker: NPC #900041
anh_en: But they passed away before making it happen...

speaker: NPC #900041
anh_en: So you could say I've come with all their wishes and dreams on my shoulder. I feel grateful and blessed to have met Great-Great-Grandpa Sihong.
How are you two getting along?
It doesn't seem like you're communicating well with him.

speaker: NPC #900041
anh_en: He's treating me just fine, especially given the generation gap between us. Then, you add Mt. Firmament's isolation on top—of course, there are communication issues.

speaker: NPC #900041
anh_en: Well, one step at a time.
Nope.
How about the old man from earlier in the day?

speaker: NPC #900041
anh_en: What a coincidence. I'm from Jinzhou, here to trace my roots. I should be around for a while.

speaker: NPC #900041
anh_en: We're all outsiders. Why don't we get acquainted, so we can help each other out in town?

speaker: NPC #900041
anh_en: You mean Great-Great-Grandpa Sihong? I walked him home before the night got cold.
Great-Great-Grandpa? Are you related?

speaker: NPC #900041
anh_en: According to my family history, he's my grandfather's grandfather.

speaker: NPC #900041
anh_en: But given how unstable time moved in Mt. Firmament before, it could be off.

speaker: NPC #900042
anh_en: What's wrong? Let me take a look.

speaker: NPC #900027
anh_en: Um, sorry...

speaker: NPC #900027
anh_en: I haven't even been to many of the places in Mt. Firmament.
Practice more and you'll be more confident.
Learn more and you'll be more confident.

speaker: NPC #900027
anh_en: I see... Thanks for the suggestion. I'll work on that.
What's wrong?

speaker: NPC #900027
anh_en: Oh, I thought you were asking for directions...
You don't like people asking you for directions?

speaker: NPC #900027
anh_en: Somewhat... We have a lot of tourists in Mt. Firmament now. They don't know their way around, and I want to help them in my spare time.

speaker: NPC #900027
anh_en: Normally, I don't have problems speaking, but when it comes to pointing the way or talking about Hongzhen, I stutter and freeze up...

speaker: NPC #900027
anh_en: I'm afraid I'd give the wrong information. I have no confidence at all.
Aren't you a local?

speaker: NPC #900027
anh_en: Yes, I'm from Hongzhen, but most of my knowledge about the town comes from my family. I'm no expert.

speaker: NPC #900042
anh_en: Yes, it's nice to have someone to chat with. This is relaxing for me.

speaker: NPC #900042
anh_en: To be honest, I still feel a lingering fear whenever I think about the Temporal Disruption in Mt. Firmament. Even though it's in the past now, I'm still tense as a tightrope.
Why is that?

speaker: NPC #900042
anh_en: It's just that I'm worried I won't be able to manage everything or that the supplies in my shop might run short.

speaker: NPC #900042
anh_en: Things were dire at the time. It was inevitable that people would get hurt even with the Magistrate and Lady Xinyi holding down the fort.

speaker: NPC #900042
anh_en: That's why I've seen a lot of patients lately. Some have injuries that could cause complications later if not treated correctly.
Your hard work is appreciated.

speaker: NPC #900042
anh_en: I can't deny it's hard work, but it's also my duty as a healer to treat patients. I chose to do it, so no complaints.

speaker: NPC #900042
anh_en: Sigh, I just hope everyone will get well soon.

speaker: NPC #900043
anh_en: Sigh, it's great to be young, not like this old body, aches, and pain everywhere.

speaker: NPC #900043
anh_en: Head south down that road and you'll find a delightful hot spring.

speaker: NPC #900043
anh_en: You should check it out when you get a chance.  Trust me, Mt. Firmament's Sagaci Springs will not disappoint.

speaker: NPC #900043
anh_en: Can't even leave the house without Zhonglin’s prescriptions and those magic Sagaci Springs.
(Ask about Zhonglin's prescriptions.)
(Ask about the Sagaci Springs.)

speaker: NPC #900043
anh_en: Zhonglin's been studying medicine in his grandfather's footsteps since childhood and is now our most trusted doctor here. He's the one we see to treat illness.

speaker: NPC #900043
anh_en: His prescriptions don't always conform to convention, but you can't argue the result.

speaker: NPC #900043
anh_en: Not to mention after all these years, he knows our conditions the best, so I trust him.

speaker: NPC #900043
anh_en: Haha, you're asking the right guy. I can be a chatterbox when it comes to our local Sagaci Springs.

speaker: NPC #900043
anh_en: I don't know much about the medical theory behind it, but I know I feel great and relaxed when I get into one.

speaker: NPC #900044
anh_en: Come one, come all... That's the phrase I learned from foreign customers. What do you think?

speaker: NPC #900044
anh_en: Anything you like over here? Affordable price, guaranteed.

speaker: NPC #900044
anh_en: All right, feel free to come back.

speaker: NPC #900044
anh_en: Say, why don't you pick out something else?

speaker: NPC #900027
anh_en: Hongzhen was founded very early. It was thriving when Jinzhou was just an idea.

speaker: NPC #900027
anh_en: Back then, Hongzhen rivaled Jinzhou now.

speaker: NPC #900027
anh_en: That's also the reason many scholars believe Hongzhen is not only the ancestral land of the early settlers of Jinzhou, but also the predecessor of Jinzhou itself.

speaker: NPC #900027
anh_en: As you can see, the houses that have been preserved in town share many similarities with Jinzhou architecture.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I heard the front lines were pretty intense.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Yes, I've heard about it too. Thankfully, it's all over now, and the rain has stopped.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 4
anh_en: The goods have been piling up for so long. Finally, we can start shipping them out!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 3
anh_en: Yes. All thanks to that Rover.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 5
anh_en: Mom, mom! Where is that powerful person?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 6
anh_en: {Male=He;Female=She} will be here in a minute. How about we listen to the storyteller's tale of that person first, okay?

speaker: Tân Chỉ
anh_en: You're back, hero! With that monster gone, Jinzhou will be bustling again in no time!

speaker: Tân Chỉ
anh_en: It's gonna be a blast! Oh, right, the Moon-Chasing Festival is coming up! You should stick around and enjoy the fun!

speaker: Tiểu Du
anh_en: Ah, it's you! Lady Jinhsi's esteemed guest!

speaker: Tiểu Du
anh_en: Th-thank you... for protecting everyone!

speaker: Trì Gia Văn
anh_en: Thank you, Rover. You ended the conflict with the least price to pay and saved the lives of many Midnight Rangers.

speaker: Trì Gia Văn
anh_en: Seeing you and the general back here safe and sound, I just...

speaker: Trì Gia Văn
anh_en: ...Sorry, I got a bit too excited. Anyway, nothing matters more than coming back safely.

speaker: Người Kể Chuyện
anh_en: Oh, it's you. I was just thinking that it's about time I paid you a visit.

speaker: Người Kể Chuyện
anh_en: I've been here telling stories for many years, recounting countless legends, tales, and anecdotes. Now, for a change, I can be a listener.

speaker: Người Kể Chuyện
anh_en: You've become part of a new story. If you've got time, come over for a chat with me!

speaker: Xiulan
anh_en: You're back, Rover. Must've been a tiring journey back to the city, right?
Only after the rush do I feel the aches all over my body. Once I've wrapped up my current tasks, I plan to take a break.

speaker: Xiulan
anh_en: And you should also take some time to relax from all the hustle and bustle.

speaker: Xiulan
anh_en: Last time we met was at the Rearguard Camp. I was too busy then... I didn't realize you were the guest Magistrate mentioned. I didn't even get a good look at you. Now, you're a hero of the Midnight Rangers.
How's the Rearguard Camp now?
How have you been?

speaker: Xiulan
anh_en: Things are much better than before. The war is over, no more casualties, and the medical staff can finally catch their breath.

speaker: Xiulan
anh_en: However, as a Rearguard, there are a lot of trivial matters that I've got to attend to. This rain... it's just too heavy.
But everything will be fine. Whether it's about Rearguard or Jinzhou.

speaker: Xiulan
anh_en: Pretty much the same as before, I'll have to get back to work after our chat.

speaker: Xiulan
anh_en: Even though I've been given a vacation... now's not the time. I've got to sort out the aftermath.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Septimont is importing large quantities of Ragunna spices and alabaster. It seems we've chosen the perfect time to enter the market.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Lucky for us, the Order relaxed trade restrictions around the Carnevale. Without that, this deal might've been a gamble.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Who knows how long these good days will last...

speaker: NPC #900286
anh_en: Hello, are you here to do business with the Montelli family as well?
Something like that.
I'm actually a member of the family.

speaker: NPC #900286
anh_en: The Montelli are sharp with coin, but they honor their word. Good business partners, if you can trust them.

speaker: NPC #900286
anh_en: Is that so? Guess that means you're a high rank. Most of the staff are stuck in those drab uniforms.

speaker: NPC #900286
anh_en: We're brothers traveling between Ragunna and Septimont. We deal in commodities, art auctions, and, of course, high-stakes competitions.

speaker: NPC #900286
anh_en: Perhaps one day, we'll find ourselves working together on a venture.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Well, I'll be! A golden fountain... This place is practically drowning in riches!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: What happens if you throw a coin in and make a wish, I wonder?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Oh, that's easy. You'll end up being carted off to pay a fine.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Hey, what's that in the sky?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: It's stunning, like a pair of glowing wings...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Quick, snap a shot! Might be worth sending to Wutherium Film Studio!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: There are perks to working the front desk, like sneaking out for a bit of fresh air now and then.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Everything really alright? Your schedule looks packed with tasks.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Work's still work, no matter how you stretch it. Only the moments when you slack off truly belong to you.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: I really envy your laid-back attitude.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Wow, even the clouds here are golden, just like...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: …Just like Ragunna's Golden Fried Cutlet.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Keep it down, will you? You're ruining the mood with all that chatter.

speaker: NPC #900279
anh_en: Ah, my friend, come to admire the sunset too? This kind of beauty doesn't come around often.

speaker: NPC #900281
anh_en: Tsk, why aren't they here yet? That man has no concept of time.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Ugh, I'm late. Black Alley business. I got held up.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: What happened? Don't say our home got raided.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Eh, just a few young bucks fighting, didn't know when to quit. Almost turned into a bloodbath.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: On to more serious matters. Find anything useful while you were staking out Montelli's turf?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Shh, quiet down... do you want someone overhearing us?

speaker: NPC #900281
anh_en: ...The "prime goods" we've been after? Yeah, the Montellis got their hands on them. They're locked up in the Vault now.

speaker: NPC #900282
anh_en: Hmph, used to do side jobs for them. Not even a scrap of respect now.
What are you all talking about?

speaker: NPC #900281
anh_en: I'm sorry, {Male=sir;Female=ma'am}, we were just discussing the collection auction here.

speaker: NPC #900281
anh_en: Averardo Vault at night truly has a charm of its own, doesn't it?

speaker: NPC #900282
anh_en: ...No doubt.

speaker: NPC #900347
anh_en: These stairs just keep going, don't they?

speaker: NPC #900347
anh_en: Did you notice the grand building at the top of the stairs? Many see it as a symbol of a new age.
Are you here for business as well?

speaker: NPC #900347
anh_en: Of course, I have a rather significant collection item to store—

speaker: NPC #900347
anh_en: Only here could I escape those insufferable Acolytes, the pestering editors, and those gatherings of writers full of the same tired clichés.

speaker: NPC #900283
anh_en: Recent security reports came in. We need to tighten vigilance.

speaker: NPC #900284
anh_en: Is someone really targeting this place? This is supposed to be the safest spot in all of Rinascita.

speaker: NPC #900285
anh_en: You're new here, so you might not know, but "breaking into the Vault successfully" is something some folks can brag about for a lifetime.

speaker: Speaker_790_Title
anh_en: Combat isn't just about strength. You need skills and wisdom too when facing enemies on the battlefield.

speaker: Speaker_790_Title
anh_en: You there, looking to put on some training? Good training keeps you sharp. The enemies won't go easy on you out there.

speaker: Speaker_790_Title
anh_en: Absolutely. But let me be clear, I am not condoning cowardice.

speaker: Speaker_790_Title
anh_en: I will give my life for Huanglong anytime, but I've also witnessed too many pointless deaths.

speaker: Speaker_790_Title
anh_en: I do not want to see our new recruits make the same mistakes. My purpose is to teach you how to avoid them and give you a better chance at life.

speaker: Speaker_790_Title
anh_en: Do not rush blindly into battle like those before you. You deserve more than that.

speaker: Speaker_790_Title
anh_en: While winning is important, the battlefield is constantly changing.

speaker: Speaker_790_Title
anh_en: Avoid rushing for success and making costly mistakes. Focus on improving your skills and knowing what actions to take.

speaker: Speaker_790_Title
anh_en: Remember, you have many years ahead of you. You should prioritize staying alive.

speaker: Speaker_790_Title
anh_en: Greetings.
What can you teach me?

speaker: Speaker_790_Title
anh_en: Combat skills and tactics. Or anything you're willing to learn, as long as I have it.

speaker: Speaker_790_Title
anh_en: Practicality is key on the battlefield. Years of combat have taught me that. If you want fancy tricks, go elsewhere.

speaker: Speaker_790_Title
anh_en: I'll teach you how to survive, and how to win.
Is surviving more important?
Is winning more important?

speaker: NPC #700488
anh_en: Honestly? I think the Spacetrek Collective's emblem has way better design sense.

speaker: NPC #700488
anh_en: The infinite universe, the pre-Lament spacecraft… It all harmonizes so well with Solaris's own longitudes and latitudes.

speaker: NPC #700488
anh_en: Compared to that, what's the Academy crest's double helix even supposed to mean?
Is one strand for humanity, and one for the Exostrider?

speaker: NPC #700489
anh_en: Or maybe it symbolizes knowledge being passed down through generations?

speaker: NPC #700490
anh_en: Oh, there are lots of interpretations. But the official handbook says this—

speaker: NPC #700490
anh_en: The thirst for knowledge is in humanity's very genes. It is the key that allows civilization to knock on the door of the future.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Compared to that...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: What's the Academy crest's double helix even supposed to mean?

speaker: NPC #700508
anh_en: Alright everyone, our analysis of the ice-core samples from the Roya Frostlands has given us some crucial data—

speaker: NPC #700508
anh_en: We even suspect the <te href=750035>Etheric Sea</te> didn't just physically separate Solaris from the rest of the universe. It may have isolated its very laws.

speaker: NPC #700508
anh_en: Could the new order reshaping Solaris have originated from that mysterious floating sea itself?
…So you're saying Solaris's physics just stopped working?

speaker: NPC #700508
anh_en: Hehe, that's a bit of academic hyperbole. The laws of physics still exist, there are just far too many new variables for our models to handle.

speaker: NPC #700508
anh_en: Anyway, the key to all of this likely lies where the planet's axis and magnetic poles now converge.

speaker: NPC #700508
anh_en: It's the leading theory in the field right now.

speaker: NPC #700508
anh_en: It supports a daring hypothesis: Solaris once experienced a catastrophic shift of both its axis and its magnetic poles.

speaker: NPC #700508
anh_en: Think about the force required to shake an entire planet in an instant, far beyond just tectonic activity.
…Only a global Lament could cause that.

speaker: NPC #700508
anh_en: Exactly. Ah, you're a freshman from Rabelle College, aren't you? Sharp insight.
I'm flattered. Just following your reasoning, Professor.

speaker: NPC #700508
anh_en: …Very well. Moving on.

speaker: NPC #700508
anh_en: In the aftermath, the <te href=750035>Etheric Sea</te> spread, engulfing Solaris and completely transforming its ecology.

speaker: NPC #700508
anh_en: The cascade of effects that followed triggered the largest mass extinction in recorded history.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Solaris once experienced a catastrophic shift of both its axis and its magnetic poles.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Think about the force required to shake an entire planet in an instant, far beyond just tectonic activity.

speaker: NPC #700535
anh_en: Ugh... Whose bright idea was it to store rations in the trash compartment?!

speaker: NPC #700518
anh_en: Cut them some slack. That's just B.1.N.G.O.'s temp unit. Engineering's stretched thin right now.

speaker: NPC #700535
anh_en: Yeah, but watching B.1.N.G.O. pull an energy gel sachet out of the trash and shove it into my mouth... Ugh, it makes me feel physically ill.

speaker: NPC #700518
anh_en: Be grateful. Without its emergency supplies, you'd be in the infirmary by now.

speaker: NPC #700518

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Leo, don't listen! Good children shouldn't hear such things!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 3
anh_en: *Ragunna curse* the Order! You... coward! Coward! Liar! Liar! Coward! Liar!

speaker: NPC #900146
anh_en: Wow! Cool! Let me listen!

speaker: NPC #900147
anh_en: Leo! No! Good children shouldn't learn that! Ugh, I'll need to figure out how to separate it from the rest of the Fae Ignises...
What happened?

speaker: NPC #900148
anh_en: Well, this Fae Ignis somehow picked up some foul language, and it just can't stop using it.

speaker: NPC #900149
anh_en: *Ragunna curse* the Order! You're a *Ragunna curse* coward! Coward! Liar! Liar!

speaker: NPC #900148
anh_en: See? Just like that.

speaker: NPC #900149
anh_en: Coward! Coward! Coward!

speaker: NPC #900148
anh_en: I really don't know where it learned that. Could it be that these words were the reason the Order banished it?

speaker: NPC #900149
anh_en: The Order! Liar! Liar! Liar!

speaker: NPC #900146
anh_en: Hey, let me tell you a little secret...
What secret?

speaker: NPC #900146
anh_en: Yesterday, Leo overheard Pan Cake whispering with all the Fae Ignises in the troupe, and Marianne's Fae Ignis joined in too!

speaker: NPC #900146
anh_en: Pan Cake taught them that! In fact, all the Fae Ignises in the troupe have picked it up now.

speaker: NPC #900150
anh_en: {PlayerName}, care for a one-of-a-kind glass of Troupe Strength?

speaker: NPC #900150
anh_en: When the performance ends, the audience rushes to catch their favorite actors for an autograph. It's all part of the charm!

speaker: NPC #900150
anh_en: How about a bottle?
One-of-a-kind?

speaker: NPC #900150
anh_en: Yes! Feast your eyes, this bottle is a special edition personally signed by the captain. It's rich and sweet, bold on the tongue, with a finish that's as invigorating as the captain's own presence on stage.

speaker: NPC #900150
anh_en: And here's another! This one's signed by our soprano, Tina. Care to give it a try?
Is there one signed by Roccia?
Ah, you're a collector, then?

speaker: NPC #900150
anh_en: The first mate is still a child! She doesn't drink this stuff.

speaker: NPC #900150
anh_en: These are my treasures.

speaker: NPC #900150
anh_en: At every performance, the troupe's actors bring out their own brews and sell them to the audience.

speaker: NPC #900151
anh_en: Scrub here... then give a little polish over there...

speaker: NPC #900343
anh_en: Wipe this side... wipe that side... Oh? Is there something you need?

speaker: NPC #900343
anh_en: When we first found Lario, he was covered in seaweed and barnacles, roaring in a way that could turn the bravest sailor's knees to jelly.

speaker: NPC #900343
anh_en: Captain Brant said everything was fine and went to speak to the creature alone. We were all a bundle of nerves, I'll tell you that much.

speaker: NPC #900343
anh_en: When he came back, he told us this big fellow's name was Lario. No harm intended, he said, just thought we "smelled nice" and wanted to be friends.

speaker: NPC #900343
anh_en: We didn't understand at first, but now we know Lario can't clean himself at sea, and over time, he gets covered in barnacles. Must be terribly uncomfortable for him.

speaker: NPC #900343
anh_en: Lario is an Echo, so nobody knows why barnacles still grow on him. Another mystery, I suppose.

speaker: NPC #900343
anh_en: Anyway, whenever we went ashore we gave him a good scrub. That's when we really started to bond. He was so happy he even let us dance on his back!

speaker: NPC #900343
anh_en: Now, every time we land in a new city, we give him another good bath. In return, he lets us set up a stage on his back and put on a performance.

speaker: NPC #900343
anh_en: Ah, looking back, it's been quite the journey, hasn't it?
About Lario...
What are you up to?

speaker: NPC #900343
anh_en: Ah, you've noticed Lario, have you? Ha!

speaker: NPC #900343
anh_en: Lario is an important member of the troupe. He carries our stage, and with it, our dreams.

speaker: NPC #900343
anh_en: We don't know where he came from or if there's another like him, but we've journeyed across many islands, gathering memories together.

speaker: NPC #900343
anh_en: A few days ago, the first mate found a record of a rare Echo called the "Pliosaurus Somnii" in the Montelli library. I wonder if it has anything to do with Lario.

speaker: NPC #900343
anh_en: If it's truly the legendary Pliosaurus Somnii... that would be something!

speaker: NPC #900343
anh_en: I'm giving Lario a good scrub. See all those barnacles? Still plenty of cleaning to do!

speaker: NPC #900152
anh_en: Have you finished reading the Order's new play? What do you think?

speaker: NPC #900153
anh_en: Alright then, Mask up. Let's run through another scene.

speaker: NPC #900153
anh_en: This Carnevale, we aren't who we used to be in Ragunna—we're the Fools who fight for equality, for freedom. That's who we must become.

speaker: NPC #900153
anh_en: Same tired themes again. Praising the doctrine, dictating morality... Always painting those sent on the Pilgrim's Sail as the scum of the earth.

speaker: NPC #900152
anh_en: Exactly! By the end of it, I almost felt like marching straight back to the city and slapping every one of them, just to show them how ridiculous their little play really is.

speaker: NPC #900153
anh_en: If all we're after is revenge, might as well join Aldric and become pirates. Go after Ragunna's merchant ships, raid the Order's Acolytes, take whatever we want.

speaker: NPC #900153
anh_en: But that'd make us no better than the heretics they love to write about in their dramas.

speaker: NPC #900153
anh_en: There would be no turning back. We'd have no voice left, no way to clear our names or expose Fenrico's lies.

speaker: NPC #900153
anh_en: We'd just have to watch everyone we love become tools used by the Order.

speaker: NPC #900152
anh_en: ...That's not the life I want.

speaker: NPC #900152
anh_en: I still want our story to be seen. The real story. Let the world see who we truly are.

speaker: NPC #900342
anh_en: I'm done. Inspiration's as elusive as the moon in the sky, and I'm just a headless seaweed adrift in the ocean...

speaker: NPC #900342
anh_en: I don't know what to do! Perhaps I am just a seaweed. Brainless, drifting with the tide...
What's wrong?

speaker: NPC #900342
anh_en: I'm... I'm the traveler without shoes, stumbling down a path to inspiration that's nothing but thorns... *cough*!

speaker: NPC #900342
anh_en: Alright, I'll confess. The truth is I just can't seem to write a thing.

speaker: NPC #900342
anh_en: I've got a handful of half-baked manuscripts, but none of them capture the life of the Blessed Maiden.

speaker: NPC #900342
anh_en: How did she grow up, and what aspirations did she set for herself? How were her studies in the seminary, and how did she pursue her dreams?

speaker: NPC #900342
anh_en: I'm at a loss. I can't even figure out the ending for this script. I talked with the captain about it earlier, and he's just as stumped.

speaker: NPC #900342
anh_en: Recently, I received a mysterious package. The captain says it's a private collection from the Fisalia family. No idea who sent it, but they must have had a soft spot for me...

speaker: NPC #900342
anh_en: After reading, I felt like I was on the verge of piecing it all together. But inspiration's like a shooting star. Every time I reach for it... poof! It slips through my fingers.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: What kind of fireworks display would fit the grand spectacle of Ragunna's Carnevale?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Fireworks shouldn't just light up the night... they need to dazzle in the daylight too!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Captain, oh Captain!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: What's next? We're going... um, where are we going? Hey!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Why did you hit me again?!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 3
anh_en: Haha, who told you to forget your lines—Ouch!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 4
anh_en: Alright, alright, focus everyone! Let's rehearse properly... Ow! What, now I'm getting hit too? Come on!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I've got it! I've got it!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Some Golden Fleece, a touch of unstable glazed young rock, and a feather from Pan Cake! I'll get consent first, I promise!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: After that, three happy Nimbus Wraiths. I'll use their laughter to catalyze a rainbow of flame.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Then, the grand finale—Boom! My power will set it all off!

speaker: NPC #900133
anh_en: Oh, dear friend! Keep your distance, will you? I wouldn't want to blow you up by accident!
Hold it in!

speaker: NPC #900133
anh_en: Whoops! Sorry, almost caused another disaster.
Another disaster?

speaker: NPC #900133
anh_en: It's a long story. You see, I was just accompanying my beloved Miranda to the Cathedral of Mercury to pray...

speaker: NPC #900133
anh_en: When wouldn't you know it, a pigeon feather landed right on my nose. Just as I was devoutly gazing at the Sentinel's statue, too... and then—sneeze!
So that's why you ended up being...

speaker: NPC #900133
anh_en: Exactly. The Acolytes thought I was a heretic trying to deface the statue. Without a second thought, they tossed me onto the Pilgrim's Sail.

speaker: NPC #900133
anh_en: I've spent years as a fireworks master in Ragunna without a single soul noticing. But one sneeze, and suddenly, I'm making headlines! Guess I finally got my moment.

speaker: NPC #900133
anh_en: You see the scar on my nose? The Acolytes were so afraid I'd sneeze on the Troupe of Fools that they actually clipped my nose before I boarded.

speaker: NPC #900133
anh_en: If it weren't for Brant saving me, I'd be breathing through my mouth for the rest of my life!
What's going on?

speaker: NPC #900133
anh_en: Speaking of odd things... if you manage to climb up to the Sentinel statue, you might find the little hole I left behind. My sneeze mark.
That's a bit absurd...

speaker: NPC #900133
anh_en: Absurd? This is Ragunna! At least I'm still alive to tell the tale.

speaker: NPC #900133
anh_en: Since I've been with the Fool's Troupe, business has been booming. Got me a solid group of customers.

speaker: NPC #900133
anh_en: When I was a fireworks master in Ragunna, business wasn't nearly this good. Now look at me, practically blowing up the competition! Ha!

speaker: NPC #900133
anh_en: I'm working on a new firework invention... Just about to let out a sneeze!
Sneezing?

speaker: NPC #900133
anh_en: Oh? Didn't they tell you? Every time I sneeze, it sets off a little explosion.

speaker: NPC #900133
anh_en: Before I close my eyes, wherever my gaze lands, boom! That's where the spark happens.
That's quite a special ability.

speaker: NPC #900133
anh_en: Aha! That's why I need to pluck a feather from Pan Cake. You see, just a little tickle on the nose with it, and I'll—

speaker: NPC #900133
anh_en: Ahhh—Achooo!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Ragunna... the false Righteous One... cloaked in divinity, divinity... hmm...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Father... Mother... It's me, Todd... Did you like my performance...?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Don't cry... I'm here... I'm home...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I get what you're saying... but I want a No. 65 Tubpup with Nuvola Pasta...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: It's so deep... It's all Troupe Strength in the Tubpup... I can't drink anymore...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Too much Tubpup... bad for your health...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I love you... but I can only see you in my dreams...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Look at our daughter... how adorable she is... Marina...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Can I see her one last time, please... Why... Why can't I see her face clearly...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Marina... Marina...?

speaker: NPC #900275
anh_en: Can't sleep either?

speaker: NPC #900275
anh_en: Knox was sent aboard the Fool's Sail before his newborn child even had a chance to open their eyes. And as kin of a "heretic," the future doesn't look kind.
So that's how it is...

speaker: NPC #900275
anh_en: During this Carnevale, we all have to hide our identities and take on roles in the Fool's Troupe as we return to Ragunna City, after so long.

speaker: NPC #900275
anh_en: We must suppress our desire to reconnect with old friends while trying to complete the Montelli family's mission. It's... complicated. So insomnia, I suppose, is inevitable.

speaker: NPC #900275
anh_en: That's why I need to create dreams for them, to help them get some rest.
Why do you hide your true identities?

speaker: NPC #900275
anh_en: Well, the Order doesn't know... but most of the Fool's Troupe are survivors from the Pilgrim's Sail.

speaker: NPC #900275
anh_en: The moment the Order uncovers the truth, our Fool's Elysium will burn to the ground. We have to keep our silence, no matter the cost.

speaker: NPC #900275
anh_en: In our plays, we sing to condemn the oppression, to shed light on the bloodshed… One day, all of Rinascita will know what Fenrico has done.
Take a break when you feel ready.
What's keeping you up?

speaker: NPC #900275
anh_en: Thank you… for taking the time to understand us, for wanting to know the Fools' story.

speaker: NPC #900275
anh_en: As you can see, it's only when I'm fully awake that I can "craft" their dreams.
What kind of dreams do you craft?

speaker: NPC #900275
anh_en: Hmm… it varies, really. Most of the time, I create beautiful visions to heal the regrets that weigh on their hearts.

speaker: NPC #900275
anh_en: But, from what I've seen, the fear of "boarding the Fool's Sail" appears to be so deeply rooted that the dreams don't always turn out as they hoped.
What are their regrets?

speaker: NPC #900275
anh_en: Todd, hailing from an underground theater troupe, was banished merely for using comedy to satirize the Order's tax policies...

speaker: NPC #900275
anh_en: Gideon's family was framed by the Acolytes. At his lowest, he could only find solace with a Tubpup. It became his shelter, his only home in the storm.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 3
anh_en: Who... who are you? How did you suddenly appear at sea? Why are you rescuing us?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 3
anh_en: I just want to return to Ragunna City… My belongings are still there, left behind in the rush.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Fede... we can't go back.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I understand your panic, Mr. Fede. But remember this—

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: In the eyes of The Order, a pilgrimage is no different from an execution...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: (Narrator: A mere infatuation is far from enough. What Chappell, now fallen to mortality, needs is a heart consumed by desire. Without it, anyone's love is nothing but a delusion!)

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: (Narrator: The doctrines that sever human desires and the silence, the tasteless laws and divine meals, now only provoke her instinctive revulsion—)

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: I don't need a sermon, Acolyte Bugatti. Either shut up or join me in enjoying this delicious Golden Crab Pie.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Don't look at me like that, Bugatti. I'm not the Acolyte you once knew.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Call me Chappell... My name is Chappell Romanya, Lord Bugatti.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Hmm… These botched recreations. But I guess I'll have to finish them off anyway.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: The taste and presentation might be lacking, but it's still edible!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Oh my! This one is... Poached Egg with Slug Relish, from "The Merchant of Ragunna."

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Seems the slug meat got overcooked. No wonder Gisle's jaw started twitching halfway through his lines...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: And here we have the Layered Yak Short Rib Bake... Must be the family feast main course from Act 3, Scene 6 of "The Lady of Camellya."

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Ugh, this yak meat is far too fatty. No wonder Heather's aria sounded like it was dripping in butter...

speaker: NPC #900140
anh_en: Hello there, {PlayerName}! I'm testing out some new recipes, but I won't invite you to sample them just yet.
All these dishes are...

speaker: NPC #900140
anh_en: Yes, inspired by the plays, you see. Though recreating them has proven to be a bit more troublesome than I anticipated.

speaker: NPC #900140
anh_en: Golden Crab Pie is one of my few triumphant creations!

speaker: NPC #900140
anh_en: I'm Rossini. I didn't get the chance to introduce myself during today's rehearsal. I used to work in the kitchens of the Order of the Deep, preparing meals for the council members.
Why did the Order exile you?

speaker: NPC #900140
anh_en: I merely enhanced the council's meals—naturally, in the best way possible.

speaker: NPC #900140
anh_en: The head chef accused me of using sinister methods to incite the Acolytes' appetites, corrupting their piety and undermining the Order.

speaker: NPC #900140
anh_en: Heretic, he called me...  a laughable but effective accusation.

speaker: NPC #900133
anh_en: Golden Fleece, burst forth in colorful flames! Wait, that's strange...
What are you up to?

speaker: NPC #900133
anh_en: I'm Kasper, the troupe's Fireworks Master. I'm experimenting with this Golden Fleece, you see.

speaker: NPC #900133
anh_en: It comes from the sighs of ancient dragons, the remnants of their flames. It was once used to make gunpowder.

speaker: NPC #900133
anh_en: But now, it will be transformed into the finest firework material!

speaker: NPC #900133
anh_en: No longer will it bring terror, but joy and laughter instead.

speaker: NPC #900133
anh_en: It will explode in the sky, lighting up Ragunna's sky!

speaker: NPC #900133
anh_en: But... there's still something missing... What could it be? Let me think a moment.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Focus, Doggins.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Look at me! I'm your audience. Break the fourth wall with your gaze!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Madame Nyarla has thrown us another curveball...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: The imaginative design of this stage truly aligns with Madame Nyarla's signature style—"a labyrinth of opulent, fevered dreams."

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: But why do I feel like this "fevered and opulent dream" has left me standed outside the gates?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: This new brew's potency should carry us through the entire Carnevale.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: If Brant manages to snag the Laurel this year, you can bet Troupe Strength will sell like hotcakes. Heh, heh, heh...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: This... this... is yet another baseless slander!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: If this religious play actually gets performed, how will my wife and daughter see me? How will the rest of the town see them?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: How are they supposed to live in Ragunna after this? Damn it!

speaker: NPC #900134
anh_en: I suspect we'll head for Lilyland next.

speaker: NPC #900135
anh_en: I'd wager that Septimont is more likely.
What are you doing?

speaker: NPC #900135
anh_en: We're debating our next destination. We're still on a Pan-Ragunna Tour, after all.

speaker: NPC #900135
anh_en: The Captain often says, "Wherever the applause calls, there we'll go to 'capture laughter.' With our craft, our wit, and a touch of our own flair, we'll claim what's rightfully ours."

speaker: NPC #900134
anh_en: True enough. But each island has its own tastes when it comes to theater. We'll need to tailor our efforts to make sure everyone feels the journey was worthwhile!

speaker: NPC #900135
anh_en: But, whether we head to the Lilyland's Sea of Flowers or the exhilarating spectacles of Septimont, it's up to the captain to decide!

speaker: NPC #900136
anh_en: Is there really no hope? If we head to Lilyland or Septimont... surely there's somewhere that will take us in...

speaker: NPC #900136
anh_en: Y-yes, thank you. I... we don't know how to thank you enough...

speaker: NPC #900137
anh_en: I... I don't know...

speaker: NPC #900138
anh_en: Wake up, Fede. No city-state will take in outcasts without identity, unable to prove their very existence. We've lost our status as citizens of Ragunna.

speaker: NPC #900138
anh_en: Even our papers... they've turned to nothing but scraps of useless parchment.

speaker: NPC #900136
anh_en: Is there really no one who'll take us in? I still have a few friends... I...

speaker: NPC #900138
anh_en: Your friends? Do you truly think they'd welcome "heretics" like us?

speaker: NPC #900136
anh_en: What would you have me do, Chantelle? The Order's just left us to die out here, haven't they? How could they do this to us...?

speaker: NPC #900137
anh_en: Mr. Federico, please... stay calm. You can stay here while you plan your next steps.

speaker: NPC #900138
anh_en: Thank you so much Ahem... Fid?

speaker: NPC #900139
anh_en: Oh, dearest Elisha... what shall our next ballet be?
Who are you talking to?

speaker: NPC #900139
anh_en: Ah, {PlayerName}, is that you? I was just asking Elisha what our next performance should be...

speaker: NPC #900139
anh_en: See, each island nation has its own preferences, you know.

speaker: NPC #900139
anh_en: Take Septimont, for example. They favor plays like "The Three Hundred Knights of Capitoline" and "Assassin's Journey"—you know, action-packed, filled with historical sagas and war. That's their thing.

speaker: NPC #900139
anh_en: I like them too, but Elisha doesn't share my enthusiasm.

speaker: NPC #900139
anh_en: She prefers heart-wrenching tragedies like "The Shape of the Ocean" or "The Perished Waterworld." You know, those tear-jerking stories that only the Riccioli people seem to appreciate...

speaker: NPC #900139
anh_en: But I can't stand that place. And let's be honest, tragedy is not in my wheelhouse. Ugh... it's so frustrating, Elisha, my dear Elisha...

speaker: NPC #900140
anh_en: Hey! Want to try my first latest dish?
Sure!
Maybe not...

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: No, no, no! No way! There's just no way!! You eat it, I'm not eating it!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Scared you enough to jolt you awake?

speaker: NPC #900140
anh_en: Hey! Are you sure you don't want to give it a try? I can guarantee this dish has a flavor like no other!
Your first dish?
Your latest dish?

speaker: NPC #900140
anh_en: Ah, yes! This is inspired by a performance I saw. A true Rinascita culinary creation, born from the stage!

speaker: NPC #900140
anh_en: Place a Goldcrest Scarab into a pie, baked with Mastic Nuvola and Viscum Berry... then nestle it in a Bell Crab shell, arranging it just so, to mimic the playful movements of the scarab...
Goldcrest Scarab?
Bell Crab's shell?

speaker: NPC #900140
anh_en: Yes, exactly! Isn't it fascinating? To help the actors truly feel their roles, I've gone all in to recreate these legendary dishes!

speaker: NPC #900140
anh_en: So, what do you think? Want to try this dish—the one that brings "Chappell Romanya" back to the mortal realm, but leaves "Acolyte Bugatti" with a most perplexed expression?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: What should I do, Mama Jemma? I can't go anywhere, and I can't sing...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: It's alright, I can't sing either, and I'm doing just fine here, aren't I?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Come on, let me show you around. Let's see what you might be able to do.

speaker: NPC #900141
anh_en: Hello there! Need some help?
What are you doing?

speaker: NPC #900141
anh_en: Jemma is comforting those recently exiled by the Order. I'll see if there's anything I can do to help.

speaker: NPC #900141
anh_en: The captain said if they're headed to the Riccioli Islands or Septimont, we should arrange for Echoes to help them avoid dragons and safely get to where they want to go.

speaker: NPC #900141
anh_en: Everyone's got their own path to walk, after all. Not everyone's going to stay here.

speaker: NPC #900141
anh_en: In the past, some have sought refuge with their families in the Riccioli Islands, while others ventured to Septimont, trading honor for a new identity, all holding onto the hope of one day returning to Ragunna.

speaker: NPC #900141
anh_en: And then there are those who turned to piracy. That's not really our way.

speaker: NPC #900141
anh_en: But that's fine, everyone's choices take them down different roads. Let's just help each other while we can!

speaker: NPC #900142
anh_en: One-two-three, perfect!

speaker: NPC #900142

anh_en: If we could fly, maybe we could chase them through the sky!

speaker: NPC #750282

speaker: NPC #750282
anh_en: An enemy no one could've prepared for. That thing… it shouldn't even exist in this world!

speaker: NPC #750282
anh_en: Victory was ours in the end, but the cost was steep...

speaker: NPC #750282

speaker: NPC #750283

speaker: Speaker_84_Name

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Something big!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 3
anh_en: ...Uh, we're talking about sample collection, right?

anh_en: All station staff, please update the Void Storm risk assessment promptly.

speaker: NPC #701006
anh_en: Does the chip still work?

anh_en: Yeah, still good.

speaker: NPC #701006
anh_en: Alright. If they ask you to take it out, just act clueless. Don't say anything unless they bring it up. If they do, just go, "What? How did that happen?!"

anh_en: ...See if that works.

speaker: NPC #701007
anh_en: You really think that'll fly?
