speaker: NPC #701008
anh_en: Welcome to the Spacetrek Collective Research Institute Station.

speaker: NPC #701008
anh_en: This station mainly serves institutional orders for the Spacetrek Collective Research Institute.

speaker: NPC #701008
anh_en: If researchers need personal shipping services, they only need to apply to the corresponding department supervisor a week in advance and pass a security review.
Can I use the shipping service?

speaker: NPC #701008
anh_en: This station currently does not provide shipping services for students, but you can contact your advisor for a special application.

speaker: NPC #701008
anh_en: Have a pleasant day.

speaker: NPC #701008
anh_en: If you need help with the station facilities, just ask me.

speaker: NPC #701008
anh_en: Please note that service to and from the Roya Frostlands will be temporarily suspended during Void Storm periods.
What is this place mainly used for?

speaker: NPC #701008
anh_en: This is a standard logistics transfer center. Our services include cargo receiving, inspection, high-speed sorting, and consolidation.

speaker: NPC #701008
anh_en: If you want to consult other services, please proceed to the Reception Hall.

speaker: NPC #701008
anh_en: Our center features standardized loading and unloading platforms and a vehicle dispatch system that can instantly handle all your receiving, storage, and dispatch requirements.

speaker: NPC #701008
anh_en: Additionally, we provide standard storage spaces with the highest fire protection rating. These units are equipped with advanced security and environmental control systems to meet the needs of any goods.

speaker: NPC #701008
anh_en: When necessary, we can also provide value-added services such as packaging reinforcement, labeling, and repackaging to accommodate subsequent transportation or specific customer needs.

speaker: Người Tiếp Dẫn
anh_en: Hello, welcome to the Spacetrek Collective Research Institute. How can I help you?
Collective Factory.
Well of the Threnodian.
I don't have any questions.

speaker: Người Tiếp Dẫn
anh_en: Our work is divided into three areas: Exoswarm properties and applications, Void Storm mitigation, and the Exostrider Reactivation Project.

speaker: Người Tiếp Dẫn
anh_en: You may already know our major achievements from the first two fields: Mechascouts, the Voidmatter Barrier, and the artificial sun.

speaker: Người Tiếp Dẫn
anh_en: The third project is classified. Details are restricted to authorized personnel.

speaker: Người Tiếp Dẫn
anh_en: If you wish to pursue access, you may apply through the Academy and sign an NDA. A specialist could then arrange a tour.

speaker: Người Tiếp Dẫn
anh_en: The Starward Riseway is a colossal elevator system connecting Lahai-Roi and the Roya Frostlands, named after its shape.

speaker: Người Tiếp Dẫn
anh_en: It uses the Exostrider's greatsword as its central support column and uses orbital propulsion tech for acceleration. It's the main hub between the underground and surface regions.

speaker: Người Tiếp Dẫn
anh_en: Under normal conditions, it's also Lahai-Roi's only link to the outside world.
Can you give me a simple introduction?

speaker: Người Tiếp Dẫn
anh_en: The Collective Factory is our primary facility for manufacturing Mechascouts and standardized weaponry.

speaker: Người Tiếp Dẫn
anh_en: It supplies the Spacetrek Collective's internal needs and allocates resources to our investors, proportionate to their contributions.

speaker: Người Tiếp Dẫn
anh_en: The "Well of the Threnodian" is located deep beneath the Research Institute. Access is strictly controlled.

speaker: Người Tiếp Dẫn
anh_en: It requires a massive daily supply of specialized coatings to resist contamination. It also serves as our only indirect window for monitoring Threnodian activity.

speaker: Người Tiếp Dẫn
anh_en: Very well. If you have any more questions, do let me know.

speaker: Người Tiếp Dẫn
anh_en: Please note, public areas within the Institute are open for viewing, but we ask that you do not disturb the researchers.

speaker: Người Tiếp Dẫn
anh_en: Very well. If you have any more questions, do let me know.
Which areas can I visit?
I don't have any questions.

speaker: Người Tiếp Dẫn
anh_en: Certainly. The Spacetrek Collective Research Institute is a borderless organization that brings together top scientific talent from around the world.

speaker: Người Tiếp Dẫn
anh_en: Besides the various research departments, the Institute consists of three main facilities: the Starward Riseway, the Collective Factory, and the "Well of the Threnodian."

speaker: Người Tiếp Dẫn
anh_en: Which would you like to know about?
What kind of research do you do here?
Starward Riseway.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Alright everyone! Before we go in, a quick reminder of the rules...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: After all these years of its light, seeing the Reactor's glow finally fade is a little bittersweet.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: It is. But I believe Helios's light will be just as enduring.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: That's our new sun...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Through every shock and stumble, its light persists... That's the glow of hope!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: This safety guideline is way too long...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: You must take it seriously, otherwise the consequences... are unimaginable.

speaker: NPC #701009
anh_en: This safety guideline is way too long...

speaker: NPC #701010
anh_en: You must take it seriously, otherwise the consequences... are unimaginable.

speaker: NPC #701009
anh_en: Prohibited: Using Solis Lens Array models to heat lunch boxes. Did someone actually try this for real?

speaker: NPC #701010
anh_en: Yep, and then forgot the food was still heating because of a last-minute meeting. By the time they found out, the food and table were already melted through. Just imagine how dangerous it was!

speaker: NPC #701009
anh_en: I'll bet... "Prohibited: Bringing Gemini Spores into the server room"?

speaker: NPC #701010
anh_en: Someone knocked over a petri dish. The spores got into the cooling vents. The next day, the whole server room... Well, it wasn't pretty...

speaker: NPC #701009
anh_en: Ouch...

speaker: NPC #701010
anh_en: It was... a beautiful, terrible fungal garden. A sight I hope to never see again.

speaker: NPC #701009
anh_en: So every insane rule here has an even more insane story behind it?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Are you really not planning to stay at the Institute?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: I prefer teaching students to being a researcher.

speaker: NPC #701012
anh_en: Are you really not planning to stay at the Institute? The team's saved a spot for you...

speaker: NPC #701013
anh_en: I prefer teaching students to being a researcher. Staying around those kids... makes me feel young, like I can still do something.

speaker: NPC #701012
anh_en: But there are those frustrating moments too, right? Like that student who did secret experiments in the dorm's basement and caused a complete blackout... I remember you were so red that your hands were shaking.

speaker: NPC #701013
anh_en: That's why I need to keep an eye on them, and give them guidance at the right moments. When I was in school, I had to learn everything on my own, not knowing right from wrong...

speaker: NPC #701013
anh_en: Things are much better these days. I can't have my students repeating the same mistakes I made.

speaker: NPC #701013
anh_en: Besides, even in a research group, you'll run into things that'll drive you crazy. It's the same no matter where you go, but students seem a bit more endearing.

speaker: NPC #701012
anh_en: Haha... You are still candid as ever.

speaker: NPC #701013
anh_en: But even when teaching at the Academy, you still have to complete research tasks and publish your results regularly...

speaker: NPC #701013
anh_en: But there's absolutely not enough time! If only there were forty hours in a day.

speaker: NPC #701014
anh_en: Beautiful... It's so beautiful! This is what I came here for!

speaker: NPC #701014
anh_en: By the way, friend, you're welcome to join our club! We can geek out over these beauties together!
What are you looking at?

speaker: NPC #701014
anh_en: The Startorch Express! Are you interested? See that? We're already using the third-generation trains!

speaker: NPC #701014
anh_en: The evolution of the Startorch Express, from the original RRH-101 to today's 300 series, is like a perfect snapshot of the Spacetrek Collective's own development!

speaker: NPC #701014
anh_en: But if you ask me... the most unique one is still RRH-251. It didn't rely on the Reactor's glow from the Drive. Instead, it used superconducting Repulsive Force tech, which doubled the train's stability on the Starward Riseway!

speaker: NPC #701014
anh_en: Too bad the first-gen models got scrapped fast. Their color scheme looked way too much like a Voidworm. A shame.

speaker: NPC #701014
anh_en: Only the "Squeezy Jelly" kept the old frame...
Squeezy Jelly?

speaker: NPC #701014
anh_en: The paint job's a dead ringer for Smiley Jelly packaging. That's what we in the Dynamic Boundaries Club call it.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Where are we heading?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: You mean the next train? Startorch Academy. The cafeteria is serving meat stew today.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: No, friend. I meant, where will we eventually end up?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Startorch Academy. To have meat stew.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: The pioneers who boarded these trains for the Roya Frostlands... They never came back.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Their will shall live on in the wind and snow.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Are you really leaving...?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: ...Yes. The Academy approved my application. I'm expecting they'll have me sign the confidentiality agreement this week.

speaker: NPC #700998
anh_en: Alright everyone! Before we go in, remember to stick with the group, and for the love of science, don't touch anything unless you're told to.

speaker: NPC #700998
anh_en: We are now entering the heart of the Exostrider project and the development of the artificial sun. It's humanity's frontier into the unknown. Bring your awe and curiosity, and watch the future unfold.

speaker: NPC #700998
anh_en: Who knows? This might be your future workplace.

speaker: NPC #700998
anh_en: The professors here are happy to answer questions, but keep it quiet if they're busy working.

speaker: NPC #700999
anh_en: This is so exciting... Last time I was here was for burning my Cassette!

speaker: NPC #701000
anh_en: I wonder if I'll get to meet Professor Mornye...

speaker: NPC #700445
anh_en: I hope we don't have to write a report on this visit...

speaker: NPC #701017
anh_en: Are you really leaving...?

speaker: NPC #701018
anh_en: I was just one tiny spark among thousands. As long as you all keep going... my dream hasn't gone out.

speaker: NPC #701017
anh_en: But...

speaker: NPC #701018
anh_en: ...Take care.

speaker: NPC #701018
anh_en: ...Yes. The Academy approved my application. I'm expecting they'll have me sign the confidentiality agreement this week.

speaker: NPC #701018
anh_en: Before I go, I'd like to visit the Institute and say goodbye to the professors.

speaker: NPC #701017
anh_en: But we need you! You wrote the correction algorithm for the Voidmatter sensor. The whole team relies on it!

speaker: NPC #701017
anh_en: It was just an accident. There's still hope... Your memories can be recovered!

speaker: NPC #701018
anh_en: ...Winnie, I can't even understand the paper I wrote last month.

speaker: NPC #701017
anh_en: We can start over! I'll help you, just like how you taught me before...

speaker: NPC #701018
anh_en: ...It's different. We're talking about decades lost. I... no longer have the courage to start over.

speaker: NPC #701018
anh_en: Professor Hermann once said that at Lahai-Roi, the one who lights the torch isn't always the one who carries it forward.

speaker: NPC #701179
anh_en: My mentor hasn't asked about my progress for a month. I hope she hasn't forgotten about me...

speaker: NPC #701180
anh_en: Then you'd better be careful. This is usually the calm before the storm.

speaker: NPC #701179
anh_en: I don't want to be left on my own. Ahhhhhhh...

speaker: NPC #701180
anh_en: Then take the initiative and go talk to her.

speaker: NPC #701179
anh_en: I'm a bit scared... My thesis isn't ready yet...

speaker: NPC #701180
anh_en: Can you just stop being a perfectionist for one time...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: ...I always get sick whenever I take the Starward Riseway.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: That shouldn't happen. It looks steep, but the passenger compartment is actually decoupled from the body and has an anti-gravity sim on the inside...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Then it's just me, I guess... I'm scared of roller coasters.

speaker: NPC #701019
anh_en: Hello, welcome to the Reception Hall.

speaker: NPC #701019
anh_en: Please take note of the list of prohibited items and behaviors and follow staff instructions.

speaker: NPC #701019
anh_en: The Cassette burning room is currently closed. For urgent requests, please register on this form.
Register.

speaker: NPC #701019
anh_en: Hmm... It looks like your Cassette is functioning normally and doesn't need to be re-burned.

speaker: NPC #701019
anh_en: Checking club activity application list...

anh_en: No record found. The institute does not accept ad-hoc applications. If needed, please apply via the campus webpage five Lahai-Roi days in advance.

speaker: NPC #701019
anh_en: Checking club activity application list...

speaker: NPC #701019
anh_en: No record found. Would you like me to help you contact someone?
No, thank you.

speaker: NPC #701019
anh_en: Have a pleasant day.

anh_en: How can we help you today? Do you need guided tours, Cassette burning, or club activity sign-in? Or do you have an appointment?
I'd like a guided tour.
I'd like to burn a Cassette.
I'd like to sign in for a club activity.
I have important matters to discuss.
I'm all good, thank you.

speaker: NPC #701019
anh_en: If you need to return to the Academy, please proceed to the transfer station.

speaker: NPC #701019
anh_en: If you'd like a tour of the Artificial Sun Lab, please complete your registration here and a member of our staff will guide you through the facility.

speaker: Nhân Viên Chuyển Phát Lollo
anh_en: How much longer do I have to wait?!
I see you've been here for a while.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Why? Are they still going through your stuff?

speaker: Nhân Viên Chuyển Phát Lollo
anh_en: There are just too many things to check.

speaker: Nhân Viên Chuyển Phát Lollo
anh_en: Commodity codes, production permits, tax verification, safety monitoring...

speaker: Nhân Viên Chuyển Phát Lollo
anh_en: I can understand, but...

speaker: NPC #701020
anh_en: Hello sir, about this certification number...

speaker: Nhân Viên Chuyển Phát Lollo
anh_en: But do you have to restart the entire process every single time you make a change?!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: This is my second Cassette re-burning application this month.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: What happened this time?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: An Ironhoof accidentally landed on my Terminal and did quite a number on it.

speaker: NPC #701190
anh_en: Section 3, Line 2... that's a very bold claim. But for the integrity of the group's work...

speaker: NPC #701190
anh_en: I suggest you cut that part out.

speaker: NPC #701021
anh_en: ...Okay.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: It takes 999 failures to pave the way for the 1,000th success.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: What if the 1000th fails too?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Then we start getting rid of the people trying to jinx it in the lab.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: What we are about to witness is the launch of "Helios"... Humanity's first step towards the future!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Now that I've been to the Research Institute too... I guess that makes me an intern here!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: ...That's some serious rounding up you're doing there.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Phew... that was close. Another blizzard right after I set the detector down again...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Such beautiful stars...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Don't you feel like our average IQ has gone up ever since coming here?!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: ...More like my cortisol levels have gone up.

speaker: NPC #50048
anh_en: Check the life support system's status every three hours.

speaker: NPC #50048
anh_en: Logistics is a critical part of the Institute's mission. We have a responsibility to provide a supportive environment for the research teams.

speaker: NPC #50048
anh_en: The frontiers of science aren't pushed by research alone. The logistics work that supports it is just as essential!

speaker: NPC #701022
anh_en: Understood, sir!

speaker: NPC #50048
anh_en: (Did I lay it on too thick?... Ah, well. They seem fired up.)

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Son of a... With all the freight lines down again, we can't get any raw materials. Everything's stalled again...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: I'm pulling every string I can. Trust me, I hate seeing these backlogs pile up too...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Uuuuuuuuuugh!

speaker: NPC #701023
anh_en: Okay. Good news and bad news. Which first?

speaker: Nghiên Cứu Viên
anh_en: The good news!

speaker: NPC #701023
anh_en: Transport's back online. Your materials just arrived.

speaker: Nghiên Cứu Viên
anh_en: That's great! And the bad news?

speaker: NPC #701023
anh_en: Because of the backlog, your crate is buried at the very back of the inspection bay. It'll take about 72 hours to clear it...

speaker: Nghiên Cứu Viên
anh_en: Oh, you have got to be—

speaker: NPC #701023
anh_en: Don't worry, at least you know how much longer you have to wait this time!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Aww... Look at this clearly written materials list. What a sight to see! I was born for this job.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: I don't get your excitement... But I'm counting on you...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: The log shows the fluid level of tank No.3 is dropping quickly... Need to note this down, I'll go check the equipment later.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Eugh... I'm so exhausted...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Executing mandatory command...

speaker: Nghiên Cứu Viên
anh_en: I'm so tired... Please, just leave me alone...

speaker: NPC #700505
anh_en: This is the mandatory command you issued three hours ago: "Wake me up and drag me to work no matter how I struggle and resist." Executing now.

speaker: Nghiên Cứu Viên
anh_en: ...Maybe I should research how to travel back in time... Is it too late to look for a Chronosorter...?

speaker: NPC #701024
anh_en: After reaching this altitude, the Sky Projection Array will switch to "deep space" mode.

speaker: NPC #701024
anh_en: Feels like floating in "space," right? Those floating Exostrider fragments around us encircle the Institute like an asteroid belt.

speaker: NPC #701024
anh_en: Until we breach through the <te href=750035>Etheric Sea</te>, this is as close to the real thing as we get. But it's enough... This view is magnificent in its own right.

speaker: NPC #701024
anh_en: It's a sky we built for ourselves.

speaker: NPC #701001
anh_en: Phew... that was close. Another blizzard right after I set the detector down again. How's your hand?

speaker: NPC #701002
anh_en: Just a bit of frostbite. I'll get N.A.N.A. to take a look at it later. Ugh, didn't expect the protective gloves to tear like that…

speaker: NPC #701002
anh_en: But collecting all this good data makes braving that harsh environment worth it! Our patience paid off!

speaker: NPC #701001
anh_en: By the way, I heard from the Roya in our group that there's a beautiful, unfrozen lake in a fjord somewhere out there. Wonder if we'll get to check it out...

speaker: NPC #701003
anh_en: Ugh... I just want a hot bowl of soup right now...

speaker: Nghiên Cứu Viên
anh_en: Hard to believe all this beauty was once just cold, dark cavern rock...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Exostrider above... just look at all those stars.

speaker: Nghiên Cứu Viên
anh_en: Humans look up at the stars to contemplate our place in the vast cosmos...

speaker: NPC #701025
anh_en: Whenever my mind hits a wall, I come stand here for a while.
Sounds really complicated...

speaker: NPC #701025
anh_en: Haha, you think? Are you... a student from Rabelle College? I'm counting on your generation to finally reach outer space. I'd love to be around to see it.

speaker: NPC #701025
anh_en: Hehe... It's like trying to negotiate with an ocean that makes all the rules but follows none. Still, someone has to learn how to talk to it.

speaker: NPC #701025
anh_en: Thank you for the conversation. Talking with the young always shakes the dust off my thoughts.

speaker: NPC #701025
anh_en: I once read that humans look up at the stars to contemplate our place in the vast cosmos.
Our place in the vast cosmos?

speaker: NPC #701025
anh_en: Yes, our place. It's like instinctively pulling up a map on your Terminal. Consciousness is always asking three big questions: Where did we start? Where are we now? And... just how far can we go?

speaker: NPC #701025
anh_en: That's where all science begins.

speaker: NPC #701025
anh_en: Hah... But now that humanity's right to explore outer space has been taken from us, all we can do is literally "dig deeper."
What is your research about?

speaker: NPC #701025
anh_en: My study focuses on the domain construction mechanisms of the <te href=750035>Etheric Sea</te> and its blockade effect on near-ground space flight.
Sounds interesting.

speaker: NPC #701026
anh_en: Now, everyone, this unattractive-looking cluster of plants is one of the Institute's "veterans," S-001 Fern Spore.

speaker: NPC #701026
anh_en: It came from the Spacetrek Collective's very first frostlands expedition. This ancient plant, extinct on the surface for ages, was preserved in the Roya Frostlands ice caps and revived by the Reactor Drive's light.

speaker: NPC #701026
anh_en: Today, its descendants are one of the primary ingredients in those highly efficient nutritional supplements that are so popular among you.

speaker: NPC #701026
anh_en: In a way, we're using a legacy from the distant past to fuel the expeditions of the future...

speaker: NPC #701027
anh_en: ..."Popular" among us...? Is he for real?

speaker: NPC #701028
anh_en: Ugh... Even after coming to the Academy, these freaking Fern Spores are still haunting me...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Astounding. This Rimewisp has undergone epigenetic adaptive mutation! Look how long it has maintained its bloom...

speaker: NPC #701029
anh_en: ...Professor Anslem's brilliance is unquestionable, but his rigidity is legendary. We'd have been sunk last time if not for Mornye and Warren stepping in...

speaker: NPC #701030
anh_en: Hah, Warren? That sanctimonious bastard is just reveling in the spotlight. Is even half his mind on the actual research?

speaker: NPC #701029
anh_en: Come on, that's not fair... He did secure last quarter's funding. And he's mediated plenty of project disputes...

speaker: NPC #701030
anh_en: ...Mediated? You mean getting rid of anyone who disagrees with him? And let's not forget, the Helios project wasn't even his to manage in the first place.

speaker: NPC #701030
anh_en: If Professor Mornye hadn't been keeping an eye on things, who knows what corner he might've cut.

speaker: NPC #701029
anh_en: Regardless... the project's progress is the priority.

speaker: NPC #701030
anh_en: See? I told you. While we were all fighting the Threnodian, Warren was in bed with the Fractsidus. The Fractsidus! It's unforgivable.

speaker: NPC #701030
anh_en: All our efforts over these years were almost completely destroyed!

speaker: NPC #701029
anh_en: To think Warren was capable of that... Thank the stars the New Solar Ceremony proceeded as planned, thanks to Mornye's oversight...

speaker: NPC #701029
anh_en: By the way, I hear the inquiry into Warren has already begun.

speaker: NPC #701029
anh_en: I wonder if there are other moles in the Institute... I heard someone from another project...

speaker: NPC #701030
anh_en: ...Enough. Why the sudden paranoia?

speaker: NPC #701030
anh_en: We work in a lab, not an interrogation room. This isn't something we should be thinking about.

speaker: NPC #701191
anh_en: This is the Artificial Sun Lab, the R&D hub for Project Helios. Please refrain from touching any equipment.

speaker: NPC #701191
anh_en: Also, avoid prolonged direct observation of Helios. It is, technically, a contained star.
Can you tell me more about it?

speaker: NPC #701191
anh_en: Certainly. "Helios," commonly referred to as the artificial sun, is an energy device built by the Spacetrek Collective. Its purpose is to replace the current sun above Lahai-Roi—the Exostrider's Drive. After we return the Drive to the Exostrider, it will continue to provide sustainable energy for Lahai-Roi's ecosystem.

speaker: NPC #701191
anh_en: This is our first step towards the future. We'll have a sun that belongs to humanity alone... Our success would be nothing short of historic.

speaker: NPC #701191
anh_en: We're working to ensure this new sun illuminates Lahai-Roi's future. It's why we're here.

speaker: NPC #701191
anh_en: ...Oh, it's you. You're the one who helped Professor Mornye launch Helios during the New Solar Ceremony, right? Never got the chance to extend my gratitude.

speaker: NPC #701191
anh_en: Thank you.
It was a collective effort.
I'm just a student. I didn't help much.

speaker: NPC #701191
anh_en: Haha... I won't deny that.

speaker: NPC #701191
anh_en: Haha, is that so? Let's leave it at that.
How's Helios running now?

speaker: NPC #701191
anh_en: Stable. Power systems, core output, and signal transmission are all in perfect sync. Not that we're letting our guard down.

speaker: NPC #701191
anh_en: Don't worry. We'll keep our new sun safe.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I just went to work yesterday, and now I'm working again today...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: ...All right, shutting down the "need a vacation" part of my brain. Time to switch on the "24/7 Lab Rat" mode...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Our launch window is approaching. There's still so much to do...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: We'll get a proper break once Helios is successfully launched...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Helios power output, stable... This is our new beginning! Finally...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: ...On to the next project. The work never stops, does it?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Haha.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: ALERT! ALERT! You have been working for more than 12 consecutive hours. Please proceed to the rest area! IMMEDIATELY! THAT MEANS NOW!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Wait... I haven't finished recording all the data yet... Just the last bit... Last bit...!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: All conditions remain unchanged, so why is the crystal purity dispersion so large... Did I wear my clothes in the wrong order today?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Did you say your prayers to the monocrystal furnace between steps six and seven?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: ...Oh, right.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I never imagined... to actually witness this day.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: It's almost done, Senior... I won't let you down.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Scientific research? It's quite simple, really.

speaker: NPC #701032
anh_en: Scientific research? In theory, it's simple. Form a hypothesis, design the test, collect the data, write the paper, publish...

speaker: NPC #701033
anh_en: That's the ideal scenario.

speaker: NPC #701034
anh_en: So... what's the not-so-ideal scenario?

speaker: NPC #701033
anh_en: Form a hypothesis, design the test, collect data while dodging Void Storms. Find the results are insignificant. Tweak the parameters. Discover an outlier. Spend three months chasing that ghost...

speaker: NPC #701034
anh_en: That sounds really hard... But then you get to have your work published, right?

speaker: NPC #701033
anh_en: Then you propose a new hypothesis.

speaker: NPC #701034
anh_en: ...What?

speaker: NPC #701032
anh_en: ...Will you stop traumatizing the intern?

speaker: NPC #701033
anh_en: It's harsh, but real. Welcome to the academic utopia, kid.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: The simulation results are too good to be true...

speaker: NPC #701035
anh_en: The simulation results are too good to be true. The energy curve matches our predictions, and the error margin is so razor-thin. If every test ran this smoothly...

speaker: NPC #701036
anh_en: We're after a verification model, not "the answer we want to see."

speaker: NPC #701036
anh_en: Remember that anomaly last month? Some "surprise data" might mask an underlying issue. One result proves nothing...

speaker: NPC #701035
anh_en: You're right... I'll go try and replicate the test conditions again...

speaker: NPC #701036
anh_en: You know, being happy to see good data is a healthy instinct. Unlike me. When things go too smoothly, my brain just goes, "Uh-oh. What did we miss?"

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: When's the next train for the surface leaving? Cargo is piling up to the ceiling...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: You'll have to ask the Void Storms...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: We're severely understaffed! Gotta find a way to trick... Uh, recruit the juniors for internships...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: You just said "trick," right?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: ...I just saw someone being taken away by a TARD-E Unit. What happened?!

speaker: NPC #701037
anh_en: ...I just saw someone being taken away by a TARD-E Unit. What happened?!

speaker: NPC #700566
anh_en: Oh... Relax. He was only hauled away for some rest. It happens a lot.

speaker: NPC #700566
anh_en: That's because the Sky Projection Array here simulates a low-orbit environment. We don't really get a proper day or night cycle.

speaker: NPC #701037
anh_en: Ugh, you're right... Stay here long enough, you completely lose track of time...

speaker: NPC #700566
anh_en: Yep, especially after an all-nighter. Your body clock just gives up. To stop us from total burnout, the TARD-E Units here are way stricter than the campus ones.

speaker: NPC #701037
anh_en: True, but watching someone get dragged away screaming "LET ME FINISH!" is still... a lot.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Heard our group's next project is... developing compressed food for the frostlands environment...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: You mean the all-in-one gel that's supposed to be an appetizer, stew, steak, and dessert?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Yep... Can you even imagine the taste? Is that stuff even food?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: The test results in this proposal are not definitive. It carries a 0.03% theoretical error margin.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: That's a negligible error! The new standard-issue weapon's energy output is operating with complete stability.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: You're ignoring the truth!!!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: The project goes online tomorrow!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I heard this story. There was once a researcher who worked all-nighters for a week straight, and ended up becoming part of the Research Institute...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Really?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: See this gear? It's his legacy. Now it auto-shuts down after eight hours of runtime. Can't override it. He built in his own work-life balance from beyond the grave.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: ...How do they calculate so quickly? We have the same human brains. Under the microscope, it's all gray matter, white matter, and myelin sheath. How did they pull that off?!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: ...Just let it go already. These are Roya we're talking about, and we're already making three times the progress. That's a good thing...

speaker: NPC #701038
anh_en: Wait, your team just got funding last quarter. Why are you in this list again? And 40% of the budget? When are you gonna stop overspending on unnecessary projects?

speaker: NPC #701039
anh_en: ...Who are you?

speaker: NPC #701038
anh_en: Relax, it's not gonna be a fistfight. We actually duel with... Peaks of Prestige. This guy can't beat me anyway.

speaker: NPC #701039
anh_en: What did you just say?
Actually, I'm somewhat of a Peaks of Prestige Duelist myself.
I'll be your mediator!

speaker: NPC #701039
anh_en: C'mon, cut the chatter. Let's get to the actual talking.

speaker: NPC #701038
anh_en: Strong words, kid. All right, then. If you can defeat us, we'll let you mediate. How's that?

speaker: NPC #701038
anh_en: How about you think it over? Don't say I didn't warn you. I defeated a Roya before.

speaker: NPC #701039
anh_en: What do you mean by "unnecessary projects"? Tell me, how exactly do you define that? The frequent Void Storm activity lately has already turned some of our monitoring equipment into scrap. Without replacements, should we just pull the data out of thin air?

speaker: NPC #701039
anh_en: And your team... Do you really need that much Tacetite for phase coating? Goodness me... and you've added another order. Are you having Tacetite for dinner? We don't even use that much in weapons development!

speaker: NPC #701038
anh_en: ...These are all necessary consumables!

speaker: NPC #701038
anh_en: I'm not gonna waste my time arguing with you. Let's do it the old way. We settle this over a duel. Winner gets 40%.

speaker: NPC #701039
anh_en: Bring it on! Don't go crying to the supervisor after I kick your ass!
Hey, no fighting!
Let's all just calm down...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Don't tell others I'm picking on a student. You came to us for a fight...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: When are those raw materials I asked for gonna come in? I've been waiting forever...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Still waiting to be sorted out. After those 2,314 packages, that is. The mechanical arms are already working in overdrive...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Good heavens...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I admire passion from the youth... Show me what you've got!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: No... My funding...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Ugh... Didn't expect that...

speaker: NPC #701039
anh_en: I—defeated—a—Roya—before—

speaker: NPC #701038
anh_en: Ugh, you...!

speaker: NPC #701039
anh_en: Hey, you're the one who said that to the face of a student. Are you going to tell {Male=him;Female=her} how you dragged that clueless Roya over, who had no understanding of the rules whatsoever?

speaker: NPC #701039
anh_en: And how that very Roya mastered the rules only after one round and stomped you in every game afterwards? Haha!

speaker: NPC #701038
anh_en: Argh! Shut up! Just shut up!

speaker: NPC #701040
anh_en: You're now inside the Cassette burning room. Please keep quiet at all times. How can I help you?

speaker: NPC #701040
anh_en: Each student has the opportunity to re-burn or update their Cassette data in each academic year. While the initial burn is provided for new students and staff, all burnings must be requested and scheduled in advance.

speaker: NPC #701040
anh_en: ...Unfortunately, Cassettes can only be used as storage devices and identity credentials at this time.

speaker: NPC #701040
anh_en: While the burned memory frequencies are a perfect theoretical match to the owner's originals, and could, in theory, stabilize the frequencies of someone affected by a Void Storm through reverse input, such attempts have never truly worked. We're still researching why.

speaker: NPC #701040
anh_en: So please remember, always prioritize your safety above all else.

speaker: NPC #701040
anh_en: Very well. Please keep it quiet, and feel free to look around.
What is a Rabelle Cassette?
I'd like to learn about Cassette burning.
Will a Cassette prevent memory loss?
Just looking around.

speaker: NPC #701040
anh_en: The Rabelle Cassette is a product of Scott Rabelle's frequency theory, a fusion of frequency observation technology and Exostrider technology. It can transfer memories and frequencies.

speaker: NPC #701040
anh_en: It acts as both your Spacetrek Collective ID and your primary travel credential within Lahai-Roi. Please carry your Cassette with you at all times.

speaker: NPC #701040
anh_en: Additionally, Cassettes cannot be consumed by Void Storms. So... they also serve as proof of existence for those who perished during the Void Storms.

speaker: NPC #701040
anh_en: All Cassette burning is completed within the Cassette burning room... Your Cassette is currently in optimal condition and doesn't need to be re-burned.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: So this is... where they burn the Cassettes?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: That's right. After you get your Cassette burned, you're officially a student of Startorch Academy.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: ...These are the FCRs and Cassettes recovered this time. They're in your care now.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Understood. So many... so young.

speaker: NPC #701040
anh_en: Professor Mornye visits the Cassette Depository occasionally and just sits here quietly for a while.

speaker: NPC #701040
anh_en: Occasionally, she'll pull up a damaged data file... and just... study it. Then instruct me not to delete it...
A damaged data file?

speaker: NPC #701040
anh_en: Oh, yes... but that specific one was overwritten recently. Sometime around when you enrolled, I think.

speaker: NPC #701040
anh_en: Strange...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: If someone could use all the memories I've recorded on this Cassette, would she be considered another version of me...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: ...This hypothesis is invalid. Current science cannot achieve full memory transference.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: So... what do you think of the Research Institute?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: ...Fishing for stars in a sea of data. Different roads, same destination.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: So... do you want to stay at the Institute?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: ...Sure.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: We will remember them. At every dawn and every dusk...

anh_en: Who the hell calibrated the TARD-E Unit's AI to be so hard! I haven't won a single round since yesterday!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: You must be kidding. You can't even beat an AI? That's a disgrace to our entire lab...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Look who's talking! Go on, try it yourself!

anh_en: Allow me to introduce you to the winner of our team's Peaks of Prestige duel—

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: ...Where? I don't see anyone?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 3
anh_en: *Cheerful ringing*

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Don't tell me it's this Clockatoo...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Exactly!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Wait... the TARD-E Unit's record... It's been beaten!!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Who? Who was it? How did anyone manage to defeat this near-unbeatable opponent...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Peaks of Prestige truly has infinite possibilities!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: ...And don't forget we have a research meeting tonight.

speaker: NPC #701004
anh_en: My brain's overloaded right now. Like, one good shake and everything will fall out...

speaker: NPC #701005
anh_en: But I've recorded everything we've learned in this visit. I'll sort it out and drop it in the group chat when I get back.

speaker: NPC #701189
anh_en: I finally saw Professor Wilford’s lab in person! Some things do add up, like his habit of not resetting the microscope. I knew it…

speaker: NPC #701005
anh_en: ...What's he talking about?

speaker: NPC #701004
anh_en: He still thinks Professor Wilford might be the one who set the Minerva's Treasure riddles three seasons ago...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I'm not sure if the administration will approve the funding, but hopefully it won't take forever.

anh_en: How much is missing? Let me do the math…

anh_en: Everything okay with security?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: No worries, we've double-checked everything.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: You go about your business. I'll let the neighborhood Patrollers know if anything happens.

anh_en: Hmmm? A report on the inspection and speculation about the First Resonator...

anh_en: Isn't this an ancient post? How did it get bumped up again?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Is that an analysis thread on Mr. Xiangli's latest research? That I'll have to check it out.

anh_en: This complaint really needs to go through, it's my last shot...

anh_en: Hopefully, they'll just temporarily lock my account this time...

anh_en: Hey, check it out! It's the first Resonance Nexus in Huanglong, part of our institute's collection. Isn't it gorgeous?

anh_en: Back when I was a student, I visited the institute once. When my hand touched its surface, the metal felt chilly, almost as if it was saying hello.

speaker: Viên Thải
anh_en: That's when I realized I had to work here someday. I wanted to stay with it.

anh_en: This antique item is more weathered and robust compared to other versions of the Resonance Nexus in Jinzhou. It's now a historical artifact of great significance.

speaker: Điền Mộng Lâm
anh_en: But it's consistently harder to maintain than other models and requires several specific parts for repairs.

anh_en: How long will you be gone this time? When are you leaving?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: I'm not sure. I'm planning a trip to Huaxu Academy HQ.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Hmmm...

anh_en: The Detection Stage lets us see all of Jinzhou's terrain, helping the Institute spot abnormal energy spikes quickly.

anh_en: Xiaoshi swings by regularly with updates. The Midnight Rangers are out there holding the line and can sometimes spot signs our devices miss.

anh_en: Ms. Zhang is super attentive. She's helped us dodge danger more times than I can count, and she's been on the job since I joined the Rangers.

anh_en: She intimidated me at first with her serious demeanor.

anh_en: Has the report been brought up yet?

anh_en: No, I wanted to confirm again.

anh_en: Why isn't it finished yet? How long has this been dragging on...

anh_en: Did you find those Ecoacoustics reports? The ones filed recently?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Hold on, let me see. Did they contact you?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Yeah, they want to review them again.

speaker: Chi Tú
anh_en: These are some docs Mr. Xiangli put together for us, sort of like... extra homework? A little gift from our resident genius.

speaker: Chi Tú
anh_en: He's always making breakthroughs so quickly, we struggle to keep up.

speaker: Chi Tú
anh_en: But we have to keep up. If you can't even try to keep pace, why bother being an academic?

speaker: Quần Quang
anh_en: Approaching the war zone ahead, Jinzhou residents without passage rights, please do not cross the line.

speaker: Bắc Cố
anh_en: I've fought hard for this opportunity. I hope I don't let Mr. Yhan down with my performance.

anh_en: Everything's normal. No anomalies to report.

anh_en: I think there's room for improvement. Look at these data.
