anh_en: But... I still have assignments to do...

speaker: NPC #701195
anh_en: Ah, I see. Then what about you, kind Shepherd? Our project could really use your support!

speaker: NPC #700375
anh_en: Maybe you should take this girl back first...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Could you please be our guide?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: If you're looking for someone to lead the way, this Drone is more than enough!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Is Daxton alright, Pa?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Don't you ever mention that name again. From this day on, you're our only child.

speaker: NPC #700376
anh_en: My goodness, Sif! Aren't you supposed to be at the Academy?

speaker: NPC #700376
anh_en: He tore off that poor creature's head and wears it as a mask. He's betrayed the Exostrider.

speaker: NPC #700377
anh_en: Oh, Brother... How could he?

speaker: NPC #700378
anh_en: The mind of an Outcast is beyond our understanding...

speaker: NPC #700378
anh_en: It'll take some time, Sif. But, darling, do try to forget about that person.

speaker: NPC #700377
anh_en: I'm working on a project that requires me to collect data from Atuja... I've been wanting to see you since yesterday!

speaker: NPC #700377
anh_en: Where's Daxton?

speaker: NPC #700378
anh_en: My dear child...

speaker: NPC #700376
anh_en: Don't you ever mention that name again. From this day on, you're our only child.

speaker: NPC #700377
anh_en: Why would you say that, Pa?! What happened to my brother?

speaker: NPC #700376
anh_en: It was three days ago. He murdered an Ironhoof in cold blood.

speaker: NPC #700378
anh_en: Sif... your brother is no longer a Roya.

speaker: NPC #700377
anh_en: No... No, that can't be! He'd never do such a thing!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Argh! Gosh, that hurts! Why are you pouring wax over it?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Just bear with me... This melted spider silk is good for your wounds.

speaker: NPC #700379
anh_en: I'm really sorry for the trouble… The research team is short on medical supplies. Thank you for offering us treatment.

speaker: NPC #700380
anh_en: You're welcome. Just tell me when you're ready.

speaker: NPC #700379
anh_en: Okay, I'm ready—Gosh, that hurts! Why are you pouring wax over it?

speaker: NPC #700380
anh_en: It's called Waxweaver's silk. When melted, it can help with healing wounds.

speaker: NPC #700380
anh_en: Just bear with me. It'll be over in a minute.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Analyzing Void Storm... Current environment: Safe. You may proceed with operations.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: You sure this thing can stop the Void Storm?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I want a pet Soliskin, too!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: A Pet? That's no way of referring to the Soliskin...

speaker: NPC #150084
anh_en: The Soliskin are so cute!

speaker: NPC #100122
anh_en: Chuuu!

speaker: NPC #150084
anh_en: I want a pet Soliskin too, Ma'am!

speaker: NPC #700381
anh_en: A pet? That's no way of referring to the Soliskin. They're our companions, and before that, they're independent beings bearing their own sacred duties.

speaker: NPC #700381
anh_en: We ought to treat them with respect, cherish their company, and provide aid when they're in need. And when the time comes that they've chosen their way, we will be there to see them off.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: So tell me this: Do Drones need time to unload their tanks or not, huh?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Look me in the eyes and answer the damn question!

speaker: NPC #700382
anh_en: ...But Drones have wings. Which means they can finish the job way faster than those mech reindeer!

speaker: NPC #700383
anh_en: Exactly! They're fast and they can fly! I bet they're way more efficient than the Ironhooves!

speaker: NPC #700384
anh_en: Oh, yeah? But they have tiny storage tanks, don't they? Which means they fill up fast, and they have to fly back and forth to unload.

speaker: NPC #700384
anh_en: More back-and-forth flying equals more time, doesn't it? All the while, the mech reindeer are still going, filling their oversized tanks without having to take a break.

speaker: NPC #700384
anh_en: So tell me this: Do Drones need time to unload their tanks or not, huh?

speaker: NPC #700384
anh_en: You two brag about how "efficient" Drones are all day long, come on—look me in the eyes and answer the damn question!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Once you arrive at Bjartr Woods, you make sure to do everything the Giant Soliskin says, okay? Don't make Mama... Don't me me worry.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Chuuu?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Why would Yngvar be chosen as one of the next Heliodic Six?

speaker: NPC #700425
anh_en: Yngvar never even bothered to care about the Soliskin. And he never joins the ceremonies. How was he chosen as one of the Heliodic Six's future successors?

speaker: NPC #700426
anh_en: Let's not talk about this here...

speaker: NPC #700425
anh_en: Why is that? Are you afraid? I'm simply stating the facts. Among all the candidates, Sigrika is clearly the one who meets the necessary qualifications!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Did you hear Yngvar is subject to disciplinary action by the Solisylum?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Serves him right! I told you he never deserved to be a successor in the first place!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Is the food I make really that awful?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Coo...

speaker: NPC #100197
anh_en: Why is it that Gugloo only eats the dried fruits Zahira brings?

speaker: NPC #100197
anh_en: Aye, I suppose I have little choice...

speaker: NPC #100197
anh_en: But still, how did that girl even know Gugloo wanted something different? Do you think she can really... talk to animals?

speaker: NPC #100197
anh_en: Is the food I make really that awful?

speaker: NPC #100198
anh_en: Coo...
Maybe.
No one is good at everything.

speaker: NPC #100197
anh_en: Every time Zahira stops by to trade, she leaves a little satchel of dried fruit just for Gugloo.

speaker: NPC #100197
anh_en: Whenever Gugloo eats from my hand, it ejects it just as quickly... But Zahira's treats? No upset, no mess.
So that's why Gugloo keeps having an upset stomach…
Maybe you should just buy more of Zahira's dried fruits.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Where is Foreseer Yngvar? Isn't he the Eye's successor?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Hush… That is not something we should speak of.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I knew it! Yngvar walks a crooked path.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: To think, even one named a successor to the Heliodic Six could fall to treachery...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Oh, guest from afar… You carry an aura not unlike that of the Soliskin.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Should I call you our guest, or... the Predicted One?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Is it true that you come from the "World Above"? What is it like there?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Joachim! Don't nose around in another's business...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Are you really the hero that was predicted to come?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: JOACHIM! Forgive him, my little brother's tongue runs faster than his manners…

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Did our ancestors always live in Bjartr Woods?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: No. Long ago, they lived in the World Above.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 3
anh_en: When I'm grown, I want to go and see it for myself!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Remember what I taught you yesterday? What should you do if you get lost in the wilderness?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Err… u-use the Terminal to navigate?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Wrong! You use your Sunstone! Ha… children these days, relying on electronics for everything…

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: No pushing, Lisan! Let Al and Gaib enjoy the sunshine too!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Chuuu...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: You could sow an entire field using the Academy's mechs…

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: That is the mechs doing the work, not you. Only by planting the seeds yourself can you know the true joy of harvest.

speaker: NPC #100199
anh_en: Sowing the fields by hand takes too long. With the Academy's mechs, you can do an entire field in one day!

speaker: NPC #700213
anh_en: That's the mechs doing the work, not you.

speaker: NPC #700213
anh_en: Only when your own fingers press the seeds into the earth, and your hands tend them with water, can you truly know the joy of harvest.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: The Recorder is the greatest among the Heliodic Six!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: No! It's the Binder!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 3
anh_en: I swear no one outshines the Shaper...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: When I roamed the World Above, what I missed most was the Reactor Drive's warm glow.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: You have really been to the frostlands above, sir?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Of course! There were giant mech elephants even bigger than your house! And mech birds, too…

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Are you certain this intel can be trusted?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Come on, I'm a senior researcher! Why would I sell you fake intel?

speaker: NPC #100201
anh_en: Are you certain this intel can be trusted?

speaker: NPC #100202
anh_en: Come on, I'm a senior researcher! Why would I sell you fake intel?

speaker: NPC #100201
anh_en: What if it is fake?

speaker: NPC #100202
anh_en: Then I'll just eat all this fruit myself. Seriously, trust me.

speaker: NPC #100202
anh_en: Students have been complaining about the ridiculously high price of fruit in the cafeteria… And so have I. They're all grown in the sheds of the Agronomy Wing, after all.

speaker: NPC #100202
anh_en: So if you sell these fresh, cheap fruits at the Academy, you'd definitely make a fortune!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Which button do I press to set the alarm…?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: *Buzzing noise*

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Ughhhh! SHUT UP! Phew… finally muted it.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I don't want to go to the village school! I want to ride a motorcycle and study at the Academy!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Then you will need to pass their tests… And I've heard the teachers there assign homework every day.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Uh… I-I changed my mind, Papa… I don't want to go to the Academy!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Can we really trust those people at the Research Institute? Do they even have what it takes to awaken the Exostrider?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: They can't even do five-digit multiplication in their heads. Trust them? I'd sooner trust that I'm an Exostrider.

speaker: NPC #100189
anh_en: No pushing, Lisan! Let Al and Gaib enjoy the sunshine too!

speaker: NPC #100190
anh_en: Chuuu...
Lisan...?
Who are Al and Gaib?

speaker: NPC #100189
anh_en: They are Soliskin. That big, stout one is Lisan. The lively one is Al. And this tiny one beside me is Gaib.

speaker: NPC #100191
anh_en: Chuu!

speaker: NPC #100189
anh_en: Aww, Gaib wants to cuddle with you. It really likes you.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: The one who walks Walle every day is me. No doubt, it favours me most!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Is that so? Then tell me why it curls up on my belly each night, hmm? Clearly, I'm the one it loves best.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 3
anh_en: Chuuu, Chuuu...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: You… already herded them out?! Tending their rounds is mine to keep! What's left for me now...?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Woof...

speaker: NPC #100192
anh_en: You… already herded them out?! Tending their rounds is mine to keep! What's left for me now...?

speaker: NPC #100193
anh_en: Woof...

speaker: NPC #100194
anh_en: *Contented mechanical whirring*

speaker: NPC #100192
anh_en: That researcher never mentioned you had such skill when he left you in my care...

speaker: NPC #100192
anh_en: I wonder how long his work in the frostlands will take... Either way, just promise me you won't lead the Exoswarm anywhere dangerous, aye?

speaker: NPC #100193
anh_en: Woof!

speaker: NPC #100194
anh_en: *Excited mechanical whirring*

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: The Academy's admission letter came just yesterday!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Sun above! Then you might meet Lady Sigrika in the flesh?

speaker: NPC #100195
anh_en: The Academy's admission letter came just yesterday!

speaker: NPC #100196
anh_en: Sun above! Then you might meet Lady Sigrika in the flesh?

speaker: NPC #100195
anh_en: More than just meet her… I might even study beside one of the future Heliodic Six!

speaker: NPC #100196
anh_en: Oh, what if you end up as DESKMATES!! You must surely bring back her autograph!

speaker: NPC #100195
anh_en: I know! So thrilled was I that I could not sleep a wink last night. After speaking with you, I fear I'll lose tonight's rest as well…

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: She cured Gugloo's upset stomach with but a gentle pat on its head… How did she do it?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Coo!

speaker: NPC #100197
anh_en: She cured Gugloo's upset stomach with but a gentle pat on its head…
That sounds suspicious...

speaker: NPC #100197
anh_en: Aye! She still hasn't told me how she did it either...

speaker: NPC #100198
anh_en: Coo!

speaker: NPC #100197
anh_en: How did that girl manage that?
What do you mean?
Who's Gugloo?

speaker: NPC #100197
anh_en: Gugloo is this little bird here. Lately it's been… Well, pooing and peeing all over my house.

speaker: NPC #100197
anh_en: I make my way selling handcrafts and berries, but Gugloo's messes have been vexing me greatly.

speaker: NPC #100197
anh_en: Then yesterday, when Zahira stopped by to restock some goods, she just gave Gugloo a pat, then suddenly the poor thing was well again!
That sounds incredible...

speaker: NPC #700366
anh_en: A trip to the Academy is more trouble than it's worth. I'm run ragged before more than a few items are sold.

speaker: NPC #700367
anh_en: All this hauling on your own? That's a fool's labor.

speaker: NPC #700367
anh_en: Here, take my Ironhoof. This old beast can carry your whole stockpile in one go.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I can never step into the same river twice…

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: It's not impossible!

speaker: NPC #700368
anh_en: The Exostrider will leave us, in time. The Luminous River that it gave us is always changing. Into the same river twice, one can never step.

speaker: NPC #850147
anh_en: It's not impossible! True, the river's flow, its volume, each drop within it is always changing...

speaker: NPC #850147
anh_en: But the river itself? Where it lies, it will stay, even when the Exostrider is gone.

speaker: NPC #850147
anh_en: Across endless time, a moment will come when the river is just as it is now.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: We should ask the Academy to build new highways through the woods...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: This must not be done!

speaker: NPC #700346
anh_en: A wider road means faster travel. Between the Academy and Bjartr Woods, our people could move with ease.

speaker: NPC #700346
anh_en: For our tribe's future progress, the road would be a boon.

speaker: NPC #700369
anh_en: What of the Exoswarm and Soliskin? Have you thought of them? Once the road is built, traffic will flow like a river without end. Their home will be torn down.

speaker: NPC #700369
anh_en: And if they try to cross that road… No! I would not see that. This must not be done!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Oh, sweetheart... Are you sure you want to carry so much back with you to the Academy?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: I'm sharing it with my classmates... They deserve to have some real food!

speaker: NPC #700370
anh_en: You're finally home, sweetheart! Are you hungry? Let me cook for you!

speaker: NPC #700947
anh_en: You're the best, Ma! I'll have three bowls of Smoked Meat Stew, five jars of Honeypot Jam, and ten servings of Fruit Crackle!

speaker: NPC #700370
anh_en: Oh, sweetheart. Is this to take back to your dormitory? Are you sure you want to carry so much back with you?

speaker: NPC #700947
anh_en: I'm sharing it with my classmates... The food they get at the cafeteria is awful. They deserve to have some real food!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: This thing... it is wrong, at first glance.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: That cannot be! The man swore it was the finest Jade Wood in all Lahai-Roi!

speaker: NPC #700359
anh_en: Looking to have your Jade Wood appraised?

speaker: NPC #700359
anh_en: Outcasts, there are. Shunned by both the Academy and their own tribe. They make a living from making Royan forgeries.

speaker: NPC #700359
anh_en: If you see a Roya in such clothes again… be on your guard. That was all they were permitted to take when they were cast out.

speaker: NPC #700360
anh_en: Yes! A look, please. Yesterday, I traded for it… But I am not sure how many Credits it would fetch beyond the village.

speaker: NPC #700359
anh_en: Let's see… What did you trade for it?

speaker: NPC #700360
anh_en: Three hundred Dusk Honeypots! I handpicked them all from Bjartr Woods!

speaker: NPC #700359
anh_en: Hmm… It is authentic. But it is not that old. You overpaid.

speaker: NPC #700360
anh_en: That cannot be! The man swore it was the finest Jade Wood in all Lahai-Roi!

speaker: NPC #700359
anh_en: Hear this well. "A thousand years to stone, ten thousand more to jade." The grain patterns on this one clearly have not reached that stage.

speaker: NPC #700359
anh_en: These rough marks on the surface… made by hand, they were. Do you remember the face of the one who sold it?

speaker: NPC #700360
anh_en: He looked like any ordinary Roya… except he wore a mask, and his clothes were tattered.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Fern Spores are good for your health!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: I'll pass, Ma. Please...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 3
anh_en: Chuuu!

speaker: NPC #700361
anh_en: Trust me, dear! Fern Spores are good for your health!

speaker: NPC #700361
anh_en: Then eat some of this Fern Spore! Food blessed by the Soliskin is sure to remind you of the grace the Exostrider once bestowed upon us!

speaker: NPC #700362
anh_en: But I don't want to eat something that's been stepped on…

speaker: NPC #700361
anh_en: Come on, just a bite! It's really good…

speaker: NPC #700362
anh_en: I said no!

speaker: NPC #700361
anh_en: What changed you, my son? You didn't use to be like this!

speaker: NPC #700361
anh_en: Your faith in the Exostrider must be shaking! That's the only reason you're refusing Fern Spores blessed by the Soliskin!

speaker: NPC #700361
anh_en: It's time I took you for some counseling with the Shepherd.

speaker: NPC #700362
anh_en: I'm fine...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: You're so dumb! Hahaha...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Stop laughing! I bet you can't get this one either!

speaker: NPC #700363
anh_en: …Next question, child. You'll need your Arithmetic Shells for this one.

speaker: NPC #700364
anh_en: Okay, ma'am! I have them in my hand!

speaker: NPC #700363
anh_en: If you put one stone in the first shell, two in the second, three in the third, and so on and so on…

speaker: NPC #700363
anh_en: After filling all one hundred shells, how many stones are there in total?

speaker: NPC #700364
anh_en: Five thousand… five thousand and twenty-five?

speaker: NPC #700363
anh_en: You need not rush. Take your time and think it over.

speaker: NPC #700365
anh_en: Haha! Can't work it out? You're so dumb!

speaker: NPC #700364
anh_en: Stop laughing! I bet you can't get this one either!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Come on, don't be shy! Even that mech reindeer's got better moves than you!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: So… it's like dancing more than walking, huh…

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: To Sol, the first to have brought the stars to our ancestors during the First Epoch.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: To the Exostrider, who gave us light and warmth in the Second Epoch.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 3
anh_en: To us, who will one day cross the last twilight of the Third Epoch.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: A trip to the Academy is just too much work than it needs to be…

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Here, take my Ironhoof.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You find a scientific survey log, but the writing on it has become unreadable, as if the whole thing had been shattered into thousands of puzzle pieces.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Your hand brushes against the camp's buildings. You recognize these imprints... You're certain a Void Storm swept through here.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: A few scattered hoofprints mark the ground... A mech reindeer was lost forever in the Void Storm.

speaker: NPC #700874
anh_en: Have you found a sponsor yet?
A sponsor?
I found one.

speaker: NPC #700874
anh_en: If you haven't got it sorted out yet, you'd better hurry...

speaker: NPC #700874
anh_en: You catch on quick...

speaker: NPC #700874
anh_en: You won't find goods like these anywhere else... When it's time to name your price, you'd better not have second thoughts.

speaker: NPC #700874
anh_en: I'll leave it at that for now... Just don't say I didn't warn you later if you don't bring enough Credits.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: What are you doing getting so close?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Don't even think about eavesdropping on us!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Haven't seen you around before... New to the "event"?

speaker: NPC #700875
anh_en: Were you at the last "event"? The buyers there really know how to put up a show...

speaker: NPC #700876
anh_en: I heard this is the one that broke the record for the highest bid?

speaker: NPC #700875
anh_en: Sure did. Most importantly... I supplied the whole batch.

speaker: NPC #700876
anh_en: That'd cover food and rent for half a year! How on earth do you sell for that kind of price?

speaker: NPC #700875
anh_en: You've still got a lot to learn... Take your time, kid.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: The intel was way off... We didn't find any "goods" at all!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Learning to doubt your intel is your first lesson in this line of work.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Are we really not leaving them any way out?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: We've already taken everything worth taking... The rest is just dead weight.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: If we could team up with that camp over there, we'd definitely rake in a lot more!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Forget it... They'll never catch on.

speaker: NPC #700877
anh_en: I never imagined there'd be so many fake Roya! They wear our clothes, yet in the shadows they commit unforgivable crimes...

speaker: NPC #100197
anh_en: There are plenty of former tribe people among the Outcasts, too.

speaker: NPC #700877
anh_en: How is that possible? The Exoswarm are the flesh and blood of the Exostriders... How could our own ever dare to harm them?

speaker: NPC #100197
anh_en: Even beasts do that.

speaker: NPC #700877
anh_en: But beasts kill to survive, not to turn a profit... Those people are worse than animals!

speaker: NPC #100197
anh_en: For survival...? Those banished from the tribe would never be accepted by the Spacetrek Collective either. How are they supposed to survive?

speaker: NPC #700877
anh_en: Are you defending them? You're a Shepherd... Why are you taking their side?

speaker: NPC #100197
anh_en: I'm not trying to deny their crimes. I'm trying to understand why they chose to go down the path of evil.

speaker: NPC #100197
anh_en: If we don't understand where evil began, how are we to know where it will end...?

speaker: NPC #700878
anh_en: This surveillance station has suffered a cyber attack... You, intern, write down this station's ID.

speaker: NPC #700879
anh_en: Got it, ma'am!

speaker: NPC #700879
anh_en: O-Oh... Okay, this is the nineteenth surveillance station that has been damaged... The station's number has already been uploaded!

speaker: NPC #700878
anh_en: The previous Exoswarm route detection data has already been leaked. We'll have to ask the Shepherds to reroute the next Exoswarm batch...

speaker: NPC #700878
anh_en: If we don't deal with this soon, even more tragedies could follow.

speaker: NPC #700879
anh_en: But, ma'am. Why would those Outcasts do something like this?

speaker: NPC #700878
anh_en: Even if we catch the culprit, we still can't read their mind...

speaker: NPC #700878
anh_en: The reason they commit their first act of evil is something only they will ever truly know.

speaker: NPC #700878
anh_en: But once they've done it the first time... After that, they get used to it, and in the end, they become nothing but "bloodthirsty beasts."

speaker: NPC #700878
anh_en: Get back to work. We have to prevent any more "beasts" from being born.

speaker: NPC #700420
anh_en: Do we really need all these clothes? I… I can barely breathe…

speaker: NPC #700421
anh_en: When we face the true cold of the frostlands, you'll be thankful for everything I insisted on bringing.

speaker: NPC #700421
anh_en: Just hold on a bit longer... Once we are out of the Riseway, the Hearthbear can take some of your load. And you can cuddle up to it for warmth.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Why are we so good at caring for the Soliskin and Exoswarm?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Because to roam and to herd is in our blood. A gift from our ancestors.

speaker: NPC #700422
anh_en: Papa, why are we better at caring for the Soliskin and Exoswarm than the researchers?

speaker: NPC #700423
anh_en: Long ago, our ancestors lived on the surface. Herders, they were. True nomads of the land.

speaker: NPC #700423
anh_en: This gift, Baldur did see within us. And a solemn duty he entrusted to us in kind.

speaker: NPC #700422
anh_en: Baldur… that is the Exostrider's other name, is it not?

speaker: NPC #700423
anh_en: Yes, child. Upon the Roya, it gazed. It saw the herder's gift in our blood and souls. And so, to us was given the tending of Soliskin and Exoswarm.

speaker: NPC #700422
anh_en: It sounds complicated...

speaker: NPC #700423
anh_en: Worry not for the old histories. Just remember, as long as the Exoswarm and Soliskin like you, a great Shepherdess you will be.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Wouldn't a construction rig be more efficient than these Flora Drones?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Think too little of the Exoswarm, you do... They are a part of the ecosystem itself.

speaker: NPC #700414
anh_en: Why would the Exostrider turn its components into this type of Exoswarm?

speaker: NPC #700414
anh_en: If it just needs to gather minerals and plants to repair itself, a construction rig would be far more efficient than these Flora Drones.

speaker: NPC #700415
anh_en: Think too little of the Exoswarm, you do... Mining and harvesting are just the tip of the iceberg.

speaker: NPC #700415
anh_en: These Flora Drones do not just harvest plants. They pollinate and seed as they work.

speaker: NPC #700414
anh_en: You mean, beyond their surface function, they also take on the same ecological role as their biological counterparts?!

speaker: NPC #700415
anh_en: Correct. Through a human lens, they may look like nothing but slow, inefficient carriers.

speaker: NPC #700415
anh_en: But you must step outside that bias. Ask yourself what a true creator would bring to a broken world.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Why can't we wear red in camp?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Go ahead, but only if you don't mind an Exoswarm using your backside for target practice.

speaker: NPC #700416
anh_en: ...Camp Rule number eleven, don't wear anything red.

speaker: NPC #700417
anh_en: Why? So we value freedom of thought, but not freedom of color?

speaker: NPC #700416
anh_en: Be my guest. Let me know how you enjoy an ironhoof's horns up your rear.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Let's follow that mech reindeer and see what it's up to...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Look, it's mining that Luxite ore... there's a Soliskin trapped inside!

speaker: NPC #700418
anh_en: It ignored every Luxite vein along the way, trekking all this way just for this one deposit… Why?

speaker: NPC #700418
anh_en: Come on, rookie! We'll follow that mech reindeer to find out.

speaker: NPC #700419
anh_en: Understood!

speaker: NPC #700419
anh_en: Ma'am, you seeing what I'm seeing? It's mining that Luxite ore... there's a Soliskin trapped inside!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: The mech reindeer looks like it's just shut down.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Maybe it only mines Luxite that has Soliskin trapped in it...

speaker: NPC #700418
anh_en: Once it finished mining and freed the Soliskin, it froze on the spot...

speaker: NPC #700419
anh_en: Do you think it only mines Luxite with Soliskin trapped inside it?

speaker: NPC #700418
anh_en: We might be looking at a new form of symbiosis between Exoswarm and Soliskin... Rookie, record everything! Don't miss a single detail!

speaker: NPC #700419
anh_en: On it!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Why are we carrying so many clothes? This pack is killing me...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: You'll be thanking me once we get to the frostlands.

speaker: NPC #700385
anh_en: You are not with the expedition team, are you? What are you doing here?

speaker: NPC #700386
anh_en: No, I'm not. But I was wondering if I could do a bit of field research here for my internship.

speaker: NPC #700385
anh_en: Do you have a faculty reference letter? Our team didn't receive any notice about a new intern.

speaker: NPC #700386
anh_en: Hey, relax! How about some Fruit Crackle to unwind? My price is way better than the Royan Market's. What do you say?

speaker: NPC #700385
anh_en: Get back to the Academy, now! Or I'm reporting you to Academic Affairs and your teacher! Selling snacks in a research camp... unbelievable!

speaker: NPC #700387
anh_en: Look, a Flora Drone!

speaker: NPC #700388
anh_en: By the stars, look at those mandibles! That magnificent abdomen!

speaker: NPC #700387
anh_en: And over there, a mech reindeer!

speaker: NPC #700388
anh_en: Ah! Those sturdy mechanical hooves! The intricacy of those antlers!

speaker: NPC #700387
anh_en: Which type of Exoswarm is your favorite?

speaker: NPC #700388
anh_en: The Sabercat Reaver, no question! Vicious thing nearly took my arm off last time.

speaker: NPC #700388
anh_en: But I still dream of getting closer...

speaker: NPC #50108
anh_en: Sensors go here, here, and over there. All three points.

speaker: NPC #700389
anh_en: Got it!

speaker: NPC #50108
anh_en: If my model is correct, there's a 63.42% probability that a Void Storm will develop in this region within the next two years.

speaker: NPC #50108
anh_en: Now we just need more precise data to prove it.

speaker: NPC #700389
anh_en: If this Void Storm prediction model works, can I be second author?

speaker: NPC #50108
anh_en: Your name will be there! After the Project Director, the Deputy Director, the other senior fellows... So, let's call you the eighth author. Or maybe even...

speaker: NPC #700389
anh_en: Even what?

speaker: NPC #50108
anh_en: Or maybe even the corresponding author!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: OW! Can't you see I'm getting stung by this Drone?! Get this stinger out!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: I told you not to get so close to working Exoswarm...

speaker: NPC #700390
anh_en: Phew... finally got it out!

speaker: NPC #700391
anh_en: Next time, let's just film the docile Exoswarm, okay?

speaker: NPC #700390
anh_en: Are you kidding? No risk, no reward! You gotta risk it for the biscuit. We will not stop until we get footage of these Drones!

speaker: NPC #700391
anh_en: So... we're going back to look for them, then?

speaker: NPC #700390
anh_en: What's the big rush? Let's find somewhere to rest first... my backside is still smarting from that last sting!

speaker: NPC #700390
anh_en: Make sure my face is centered in the frame at all times! Okay?!

speaker: NPC #700391
anh_en: You got it! Ready—three, two, one, rolling!

speaker: NPC #700390
anh_en: That's right, folks! We're now broadcasting live from a research outpost in Lahai-Roi!

speaker: NPC #700390
anh_en: And behind me, the fabled Exoswarm! Mysterious mechanical creatures, created from the Exostrider itself!

speaker: NPC #700390
anh_en: The one we're looking at now is the Mining Drone! Fully autonomous, capable of mineral extraction. Let's get a closer look for you all... OW! OW! IT STINGS!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Didn't expect a fully-equipped camp right in the middle of nowhere!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: We built it ourselves, every brick and panel...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: But how?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: With cannons, of course!

speaker: NPC #700392
anh_en: Didn't expect a fully-equipped camp right in the middle of nowhere!

speaker: NPC #700393
anh_en: It wasn't easy. Back then, we came here with two Mechascouts and a whole pack of Exoswarm to clear the land...

speaker: NPC #700392
anh_en: That must've been quite a sight.

speaker: NPC #700393
anh_en: It was. We raised every wall together—man, Mechascout, and Exoswarm. Brick by brick. Hard days... but good ones.

speaker: NPC #700392
anh_en: We owe our work here to you. What you did was incredible!

speaker: NPC #700394
anh_en: I heard these camps were all built by Exoswarm and Mechascouts. Is that true?

speaker: NPC #700373
anh_en: That's a load of scrap! The Mechascouts were busy fighting off Void Storms, and the Exoswarm only listen to the Roya! They weren't on construction duty!

speaker: NPC #700394
anh_en: Then how did they manage to build camps out here?

speaker: NPC #700373
anh_en: With cannons from the Department of Exostrider Engineering, of course! They had to blast the ground flat before laying the foundation.

speaker: NPC #700394
anh_en: Really? You saw this?

speaker: NPC #700373
anh_en: Well, no. But based on my absolutely rational deduction, I'd bet my degree it's true!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Hello?! Comms are down again? What's with the signal out here?!

speaker: NPC #700395
anh_en: Put it here! No, wait, over there! No, no, better make it here…

speaker: NPC #700396
anh_en: *System busy*

speaker: NPC #700395
anh_en: Careful with that! They are top-grade materials! If anything breaks, the Project Director will have my head!

speaker: NPC #700396
anh_en: *Electronic sighing*

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: You've got a special delivery!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Oh no, it's a "Crack & Bolt" fish jar! Everyone, hold your breath!

speaker: NPC #700397
anh_en: This camp is one of our safer resting points.

speaker: NPC #700397
anh_en: Everyone, sort your research samples and pack your gear. We move out for the main outpost soon.

speaker: NPC #700398
anh_en: I'm going to record everything I see in my field report!

speaker: NPC #100150
anh_en: The Roya probably understand the Exoswarm better than we do. I hope they won't mind me asking so many questions...

speaker: NPC #700399
anh_en: Everyone, make sure you've memorized all 192 safety protocols from yesterday! Avoid all potential risks!

speaker: NPC #700400
anh_en: Yes, ma'am!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I wish I could pack some snacks, but my bag's full…

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Put them in mine! You can't have a proper expedition without Noodle Buns!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: We'd better keep a close eye on the students this time.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Yeah. Every single one of them looks like a walking liability...

speaker: NPC #700397
anh_en: Now we've officially reached the observation zone. This location is perfect for monitoring the Exoswarm and the surrounding mechanical structures...

speaker: NPC #700401
anh_en: Look at the Mechascouts go! So much cooler than when they're just strolling around campus with their shields!

speaker: NPC #100150
anh_en: Do the mech reindeer ever get tired, working all year-round like that? They remind me of me during finals week...

speaker: NPC #700399
anh_en: Listen up, everyone! When observing the Exoswarm, check their surface for any Tacet Cores.

speaker: NPC #700399
anh_en: If you see one, it means they're contaminated by the Void Storm and could go berserk at any moment. Back away immediately!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Powering camp facilities this far out must be ridiculously expensive...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: This is where the Exoswarm's self-sufficiency really shines.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: You take a break. I'll do a headcount of the students.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: It's fine. I'll get the portable stoves ready.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Good idea. The students don't often get a cookout.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: They've probably had enough of the cafeteria's pre-packaged meals...

speaker: NPC #700397
anh_en: This is our last stop. The camp sits right along the Roya's grazing route, so you'll see quite a few of them around.

speaker: NPC #700397
anh_en: When you speak with them, be respectful of their customs. Mind your manners!

speaker: NPC #700401
anh_en: This is my first time meeting Roya outside of school! I can't wait to learn more about their culture!

speaker: NPC #100150
anh_en: I really hope they'll like the plant milk I brought... Maybe they'll share some stories about the Exoswarm with me.

speaker: NPC #700399
anh_en: A quick reminder! This is our final field day, so we're regrouping an hour earlier than usual. Be on time!

speaker: NPC #700400
anh_en: Okay!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Excuse me... do you see the Exoswarm as pets, or as livestock?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Hey, that's rude...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 3
anh_en: Hmph. The Academy is letting loose its half-tamed cubs again?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: In the first epoch, why didn't Sol warn you of the coming disaster?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 3
anh_en: Against It the floodwaters did rise, binding It in the heights. Only a single Eye was left in this world.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: So that's the origin of the "Eye of Sol"...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: We're really sorry for the intrusion.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 3
anh_en: Do not be sorry. A pleasure, it is, to have guests at our hearth.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: The last time I saw you was when I brought a previous class.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 3
anh_en: Yes. That feels like years ago now...

speaker: NPC #700402
anh_en: Everyone, meet my family. This is my mother, and this is my grandpa!

speaker: NPC #700403
anh_en: Hello, ma'am. Sir!

speaker: NPC #700404
anh_en: Nice to meet you! I brought some Squeezy Jelly from the Academy. It's actually very nutritious. I hope you'll enjoy it!

speaker: NPC #700405
anh_en: Such kindness you show! We should be the ones treating!

speaker: NPC #700406
anh_en: A long time, it has been, since this house held such life. You should come more often.

speaker: NPC #700402
anh_en: I will! Once we're on break, I'll bring everyone back again!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Excuse me, sir, how much is this dried fruit in Shell Credits?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: No need for Shell Credits. What do you think is fair? Trade that.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: So this is the Royan barter system the professor told us about!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: What a cute little bird!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: That's a Kronapuff. Fond of you, it seems.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Where do you usually buy your clothes?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Oh, we weave them ourselves.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: They're beautiful! Your hands must be so skilled, ma'am.

speaker: NPC #700402
anh_en: We should probably head back. Still got class tomorrow.

speaker: NPC #700404
anh_en: Thank you both so much for having us these past two days!

speaker: NPC #700405
anh_en: Leaving so soon? Stay for dinner! My Smoked Meat Stew, you must try.

speaker: NPC #700403
anh_en: Ah, I could smell the meat from miles away! My stomach's been growling...

speaker: NPC #700406
anh_en: Then until your bellies are full, you shall not leave. We made enough for all of you.

speaker: NPC #700402
anh_en: So, dinner first?

speaker: NPC #700400
anh_en: Dinner first!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: So this is the famous Fruit Crackle!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Haha, take care! The juice goes everywhere!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: It's so juicy... Oh shoot, it's all over my uniform!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Under this patch of Lichen rests my husband's relic...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I'm sorry! I shouldn't be here...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: It's all behind me now... The soil that nurtures tomorrow, he will become.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I never knew the Soliskin carried such an important duty…

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Please, bring any questions about the Soliskin or Exoswarm you have to me.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Thank you for sharing your knowledge, sir.

speaker: NPC #700408
anh_en: When the Baldur Calendar and Sol Calendar align once more, the Twilight Epoch will begin.

speaker: NPC #700409
anh_en: Uh… huh?

speaker: NPC #700408
anh_en: Then shall Baldur regain strength, and Hvedrungr awaken. Their battle will burn the skies, and plunge the world into an eternal winter...

speaker: NPC #700409
anh_en: ...Are you saying the Royan calendar predicts the Exostrider is going to fight a great foe someday?

speaker: NPC #700408
anh_en: The Roya, once shielded by Sol and warmed by Baldur's heart... to silence, we shall fall.

speaker: NPC #700409
anh_en: So, Baldur is the Exostrider, and Sol is, um... what? Sorry, could you maybe explain that part?

speaker: NPC #700410
anh_en: May I ask why your people don't settle within Bjartr Woods?

speaker: NPC #700411
anh_en: For the Soliskin, Bjartr Woods is home. It is there they rest, grow, and return to the Solistrees at the very end.

speaker: NPC #700411
anh_en: We Shepherds watch and tend to them, but disturb their rest we do not. Neither do we infringe on their freedom.

speaker: NPC #700410
anh_en: I see … so only Shepherds enter Bjartr Woods most of the time?

speaker: NPC #700411
anh_en: Yes, child. When we enter, we pitch only a small tent, so the forest remains theirs. That is also why Haldarheim was built outside the woods.

speaker: NPC #700411
anh_en: All things human—our rituals, our trade, our crafting—we do away from the woods. Only the Solisylum's calculations remain.

speaker: NPC #700411
anh_en: Only when we lay aside human noise and enter in reverence can we come close to the soul of the Soliskin and earn their recognition.

speaker: NPC #700412
anh_en: Good to see you again, sir. Do you come here every day?

speaker: NPC #700413
anh_en: Of course. Laziness never pays!

speaker: NPC #700412
anh_en: But why come to the camps instead of the Royan Market at the Academy?

speaker: NPC #700413
anh_en: Before I answer that, tell me, besides the cost of goods, what else eats a merchant's profit?

speaker: NPC #700412
anh_en: Rent? Wages? Storage? And...

speaker: NPC #700413
anh_en: And transport.

speaker: NPC #700412
anh_en: Oh, I get it now! Because this camp is near Bjartr Woods, it means a shorter trip and lower transport costs!

speaker: NPC #700413
anh_en: Hahaha! The mind of a merchant, you have!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: You Roya are walking computers, and we're barbarians in comparison...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: The Exostrider, the Roya follow. Your Sentinels, you follow.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: We have simply been guided down different roads.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: The Reactor's light has blessed the Roya for ages...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Yes. But it is time for a change.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Let's hope the light of Helios is as gentle and warm.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: How are the Soliskin adapting after the New Solar Ceremony?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: All is well. Helios's light, they do seem to love.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I dreamed about you last night, my friend...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: *Confused mechanical whirring*

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: In the dream, you were a real animal, and I was the mech herder...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: The Soliskin and Exoswarm all come from the Exostrider.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Then why do they look so different?

speaker: NPC #700561
anh_en: Do the Soliskin and other Exoswarm all really come from the Exostrider...?

speaker: NPC #700562
anh_en: Yes. They are both Baldur's creation, or who you refer to as the Exostrider.

speaker: NPC #700561
anh_en: Then why do they look so different?

speaker: NPC #700562
anh_en: The Soliskin are Baldur's "soul," and the Exoswarm are its "flesh." The same, they are not.

speaker: NPC #100122
anh_en: Chuluu!

speaker: NPC #700561
anh_en: Soul and "flesh"? What does that even mean...

speaker: NPC #700562
anh_en: That is the Roya understanding. The answer you seek, you must find for yourself, young one.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Yes! Good! I've got it!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Take your time, no rush...

speaker: NPC #700561
anh_en: Yes! Good! I've got it! The Soliskin and the Exoswarm really are both related to the Exostrider!

speaker: NPC #700561
anh_en: Ma'am, you're just in time. Let me share my discovery!

speaker: NPC #700562
anh_en: Take your time, young one. There is no rush.

speaker: NPC #700561
anh_en: Based on the archives I've reviewed and my field observations, the Exoswarm appear to be direct offshoots from the Exostrider's physical components.

speaker: NPC #700561
anh_en: And the Soliskin must originate from its neural matter! Following this logic, they might even retain pieces of the Exostrider's consciousness!

speaker: NPC #100122
anh_en: Chuchu?

speaker: NPC #700562
anh_en: The Soliskin come from Baldur's "heart," or "spirit." A mind, they do possess.

speaker: NPC #700562
anh_en: They can mend damaged Exoswarm. Just as the spirit sustains the flesh.

speaker: NPC #700561
anh_en: It seems my understanding of the Soliskin is only the tip of the iceberg... I must devote myself entirely to this endless pursuit of knowledge!

speaker: NPC #701129
anh_en: Spacetrek Explorer, go! Why are you staring at the wall?!

speaker: NPC #701130
anh_en: Don't catch me... Don't catch me...

speaker: NPC #701129
anh_en: You don't have a cleaning mode! When did you even break?!

speaker: NPC #701130
anh_en: Cleaning tool not detected. Please install a broom and retry—

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Spacetrek Explorer, go! Why are you staring at the wall?!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Activating sweeping mode. Commencing dusty corner cleaning—

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Hm, the Geospider can't fit through that crack...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: ...Should we just take its legs off?

speaker: NPC #700563
anh_en: Hm, the Geospider can't fit through that crack...

speaker: NPC #700563
anh_en: That won't be necessary... I suddenly feel a chill.

speaker: NPC #700563
anh_en: But we can't miss any environmental data... What do we do?

speaker: NPC #700564
anh_en: ...Should we just take its legs off?

speaker: NPC #700563
anh_en: Come again?

speaker: NPC #700564
anh_en: If not, we could try to drop it in? Or what if popped its casing and removed some non-essential components...

speaker: NPC #700563
anh_en: Before we came here I remember you mentioned your father's profession. What did he do again?

speaker: NPC #700564
anh_en: He was a butcher, upperclassman.

speaker: NPC #700563
anh_en: ...Let's call it a day and head back to camp.

speaker: NPC #700564
anh_en: Huh? We're stopping? But I have more ideas for dismantling—I mean, shrinking the Geospider's size!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Don't catch me... Don't catch me...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: TARD-E doesn't even come to campsites like this. What are you so scared of?

speaker: NPC #700565
anh_en: What if it DOES come? I'm dead... I'm so dead...

speaker: NPC #700565
anh_en: Don't catch me... Don't catch me... DON'T CATCH ME!

speaker: NPC #700566
anh_en: TARD-E doesn't even come to campsites like this. What are you so scared of?

speaker: NPC #700565
anh_en: You don't get it! Back at the Institute, it locked me in a two-square-meter room. I ran experiments for two days straight, without even sleeping.

speaker: NPC #700565
anh_en: I'll never forget the look on its face when it shut that door... Psychotic. Sociopathic. You can't fake that kind of look...

speaker: NPC #700565
anh_en: And I was late turning in my expedition report again yesterday! I can feel it... It's gotta be nearby!

speaker: NPC #700565
anh_en: Don't catch me... Don't catch me...

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The phantom vanishes the moment your hand comes close to it.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: What is this... Hmm? What's that sound around?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: This altar wasn't here earlier... Did it just appear out of thin air?

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: The offerings to the altars are incomplete. The ritual cannot be invoked...

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: Thou hast arrived, Appellant from Bonape...
Who are you?
Bona-what now?

speaker: NPC #750320
anh_en: I am the Ancient One. Thou mayest also call me the King in Armor. Lord of Bonape. Master of the Deep Dwellers...

speaker: NPC #750320
anh_en: And Bonape is my abode, the sunken city now lying at the seabed...

speaker: NPC #750320
anh_en: Appellant, prove unto me that thou hast the resolve to see this ritual to its end.

speaker: NPC #750319
anh_en: I never expected you'd take part in the ritual! The Deep Dwellers will surely be grateful for your noble deed, friend!

speaker: NPC #750319
anh_en: From a tome called The King in Armor.

speaker: NPC #750319
anh_en: According to this esoteric book, once we set up six altars and offer sufficient offspring, the Bell Crabs...

speaker: NPC #750319
anh_en: The underwater city of Bonape will rise from the sea, and the Ancient One shall awaken from his slumber and personally reward us for our noble deeds!

speaker: NPC #750319
anh_en: I can wait no longer, friend!
Who are the Deep Dwellers?

speaker: NPC #750319
anh_en: The Deep Dwellers are residents of the city of Bonape, a city far beneath the depths of the sea, beyond even the reach of the Dark Tide...

speaker: NPC #750319
anh_en: So long as we offer our most sincere worship to the Deep Dwellers and protect their offspring, they respond to our callings.
Their offspring...?

speaker: NPC #750319
anh_en: Bell Crabs.
Are you... serious?
Where's this all coming from?

speaker: NPC #750319
anh_en: Most certainly. It's all documented in the tome of The King in Armor.

speaker: NPC #750320
anh_en: Appellant of Bonape... Twelve more offspring of the Deep Dwellers art required to bring this ritual to fruition.

speaker: NPC #750320
anh_en: Show unto me that thou dost bear the resolve…
I have it here with me.
I still need some time.
Ancient One, are you okay?
Done acting?

speaker: NPC #750320
anh_en: S-Silence. I must count them...

speaker: NPC #750320
anh_en: They're all accounted for... Good work. Good work, indeed!

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The Ancient One begins laughing hysterically, a sound you've never heard before.

speaker: NPC #750320
anh_en: There're enough Bell Crabs here they'll last us the entire season. Mwahaha—
Like being cut off on the telephone, the Ancient One's voice disappeared just like that. In the meantime, you hear yelling noises in the distance.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: You robbing cheat!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: I know you're upset, but just calm down...

speaker: NPC #750319
anh_en: You cheating bastard! How dare you lie to me? You claimed this was a tome from a foreign land, but it's all completely fabricated!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (Well, that explains everything... Wait, why's there still noise coming from the statue?)

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You hear a sound, as if from the depths of the sea, emanating from the direction of the statue.

speaker: NPC #750322
anh_en: Iä... Iä... In his house at Bonape, our dead king waits, dreaming...

speaker: NPC #750321
anh_en: It's just something I wrote during my free time. All I wanted was to share it with you...

speaker: NPC #750321
anh_en: How was I supposed to know you were gonna take it so seriously? That's why I...

speaker: NPC #750319
anh_en: That's why you took advantage of it and sold it to me, and even had me go over all this "ritual" nonsense!

speaker: NPC #750319
anh_en: If I hadn't found those hidden speakers on the statue and traced them back to you hiding in the corner, who knows how long you would've kept me fooled!

speaker: NPC #750321
anh_en: It's just a few Bell Crabs, for crying out loud. You can have 'em back...

speaker: NPC #750319
anh_en: I bought an entire fishing gear set from you just to catch those Crabs, plus the shrimps to feed them!

speaker: NPC #750319
anh_en: I want my money back. The fishing gear. The shrimp. The King in Armor. All those Shell Credits you swiped from me!
The two argue on, pushing and pulling each other as they walk away.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The stone statue stands still, as though nothing ever happened...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: What is the meaning of this affront to the Deep Dwellers' altar...?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: There will be a reckoning!

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You get nothing from the stone statue, as though nothing ever happened...

speaker: NPC #750319
anh_en: Thank you, friend!
What are you doing here?
What is this altar for?

speaker: NPC #750319
anh_en: Oh... I just have a love for Bell Crabs, that's all. I'm giving them something to snack on.

speaker: NPC #750319
anh_en: If you ever come across statues like this in the future, put Bell Crabs on them, and I'll come offer them food.

speaker: NPC #750319
anh_en: The ritual... I mean, the feeding is quite tightly scheduled. I must proceed to the next statue. Farewell, friend.
As you still wonder about Phillips's words, he rushes off in a hurry.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (A Supply Chest? Did Phillips leave this here as a thank you, or...?)

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: The offering... Where is it...

speaker: NPC #750319
anh_en: My dear friend! Could you please help me find something?
What is it?

speaker: NPC #750319
anh_en: The Deep Dwellers'... I mean, the Bell Crabs' favorite: shrimp.

speaker: NPC #750319
anh_en: I must have dropped it somewhere on the way here... Please, help me, my friend. It's important to me. I'll repay you for your kindness!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: This must be the shrimp Phillips was talking about. Let's bring it back to him.

speaker: NPC #750319
anh_en: Yes, yes! It's exactly what I was looking for... Thank you so much, friend!
Is this something important?

speaker: NPC #750319
anh_en: Of course, it is crucial for the ritual... No, I mean it's crucial that I keep the Bell Crabs well fed.

speaker: NPC #750319
anh_en: Anyway, thank you for returning this to me... Here's a little token of my appreciation, friend.
Phillips turns away, but instead of feeding the Bell Crabs, he places the shrimp on top of the statue and leaves.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Did the altar just... wobble? Like it's finally broken free from restraints... Or was I seeing things?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: This altar wasn't here earlier... Did it just appear out of thin air?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The phantom vanishes the moment your hand comes close to it.

speaker: NPC #1557
anh_en: Farewell, ever-awake hunter. May our paths grant our wishes.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Now, the next target is...

speaker: NPC #1557
anh_en: Now, the next target is...
You've already cleared every commission.
The researchers can't even analyze the samples that fast.

speaker: NPC #1557
anh_en: If there's a need, I can handle other missions as well. Not just the TDs.
You should give yourself a break sometimes.
Why not stay in the Black Shores a little longer this time?

speaker: NPC #1557
anh_en: ...Okay.

speaker: NPC #1557
anh_en: Taking some time to watch the stars with you. That's not a bad idea.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Now what do I order...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Never heard of these before...

speaker: NPC #1557
anh_en: Hmm? We meet again, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #1557
anh_en: Yes. At long last, I've managed what I once could not.

speaker: NPC #1557
anh_en: Finally... But the people of Fabianum taught me that life cannot be sustained by hatred. If you let it consume you... Well, Chimera is a living example.

speaker: NPC #1557
anh_en: So, any recommendations here in Septimont? It's been too long. You know the city better than I do.
Want to visit the Caracalla Market?
Interested in the Gladiator's Agon?
Have you ever been to Tetragon Temple?

speaker: NPC #1557
anh_en: Caracalla Market... sounds like a lively place.

speaker: NPC #1557
anh_en: I should probably stock up on useful trinkets in preparation for my next hunt.

speaker: NPC #1557
anh_en: Gladiator's Agon... almost forgot about that. The most famous tournament of Septimont. It would be wrong not to see it.

speaker: NPC #1557
anh_en: I hear Miss Lupa is the most celebrated Gladiator at the moment? I would enjoy seeing her in action.
Didn't expect to see you here.

speaker: NPC #1557
anh_en: Ah, Tetragon Temple... No, I never visited as a child. Not out of fear. I simply thought knowing my fate too soon would rob life of its surprises.

speaker: NPC #1557
anh_en: Though I have no need of prophecy, I'll pay the place a visit.

speaker: NPC #1557
anh_en: But before that… care to sit and share a drink? My treat.
Can't say no to that.
I've still got things to take care of...

speaker: NPC #1557
anh_en: Life always gives reasons to pause. If all my bullets bought me this peaceful afternoon… I'd call it a fair trade.

speaker: NPC #1557
anh_en: I promised Augusta that once everything was settled, I'd come to Septimont City.

speaker: NPC #1557
anh_en: She meant to give me a personal tour, but the moment she stepped out of the Ephor's Palace, the Senators pulled her right back in.

speaker: NPC #1557
anh_en: So, here I am, walking the streets on my own.

speaker: NPC #1557
anh_en: Returning after years away... the homeland's wind is refreshing as always.
What's truly refreshing…
Because you defended your land and your people with your own strength.
Because you faced your enemy and ended it with your own hands.

speaker: NPC #1557
anh_en: Care to sit and share a drink? My treat.
Can't say no to that.
I've still got things to take care of...

speaker: NPC #1557
anh_en: Life always gives reasons to pause. If all my bullets bought me this peaceful afternoon… I'd call it a fair trade.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You sit with her before "Solis," each lost in your own thoughts, while the warm sun rests upon you...

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Time slips by in silence, and it suddenly occurs to you that perhaps you ought to say something...

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: As you hesitate, a breeze passes, lifting her hair. And she answers you with a faint smile, as if to say: This is enough.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: It brings back memories of your unspoken camaraderie in combat. Yes, in this silence too, you can both find peace. And that is enough.

speaker: NPC #1557
anh_en: Heading off already? All right.

speaker: NPC #1557
anh_en: I'll be setting out soon myself. Safe travels.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: The TD-sample commissions... ALL finished?!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Who on earth did it...

speaker: NPC #750093
anh_en: Good heavens! So many TD-sample commissions, all finished? Who could've done this?

speaker: NPC #750093
anh_en: The name listed is… A-Aalto? Th-that can't be right.

speaker: NPC #750093
anh_en: I've seen him here this whole time...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Prey eliminated… Time to line up the next one...

speaker: NPC #1557
anh_en: Prey eliminated… Time to line up the next one...
How has it been for you, being part of the Black Shores?

speaker: NPC #1557
anh_en: The Black Shore's network spares me the aimless searching. Now my targets are clearer, my aim sharper.

speaker: NPC #1557
anh_en: And this "Blake Bloom" opens doors more easily.

speaker: NPC #1557
anh_en: I think it stands for a power... completely unlike fear.

speaker: NPC #1557
anh_en: For me, it feels more like a "restraint." Out there alone, I have to watch how I carry myself. Just hope I haven't brought shame to the Black Shores.
I trust you. So do the rest of the Black Shores.
Don't fuss over rules. Do as you like.
If you cause any trouble, I'll take the blame.

speaker: NPC #1557
anh_en: Heh… so this is what trust feels like... I could get used to this.

speaker: NPC #1557
anh_en: Do as I like... Are you saying you trust me?
Back in the middle of the night?

speaker: NPC #1557
anh_en: All right. But no taking that back.

speaker: NPC #1557
anh_en: Rest easy. I have my own code. Some lines I'll never cross. And some... I'll never hesitate to.

speaker: NPC #1557
anh_en: So...
What comes after this?
Looks like you're leaving again?

speaker: NPC #1557
anh_en: Hunting. I don't waste chances to grow stronger. Strength leads to opportunity, and opportunity leads to action.

speaker: NPC #1557
anh_en: If you ever face trouble you can't handle alone, summon me. I'll be there.
I figured I couldn't keep you tied down here...
Do come back often. You're always welcome here.

speaker: NPC #1557
anh_en: Wherever we may travel...
Standing here at this hour is eerie.

speaker: NPC #1557
anh_en: I'll keep that in mind. Also, wherever we find ourselves...

speaker: NPC #1557
anh_en: ...We look up at the same stars.

speaker: NPC #1557
anh_en: Farewell, ever-awake hunter. May our paths grant our wishes.

speaker: NPC #1557
anh_en: It appears I'm not the only one still wide awake.

speaker: NPC #1557
anh_en: I came to deliver some TD samples and check if there were new missions. Picking this hour is just a force of habit.
I knew it was you.
You did them all by yourself?

speaker: NPC #1557
anh_en: Simple errands, no trouble.

speaker: NPC #1557
anh_en: By your terms, I suppose I'm now a Consultant of the Black Shores. Naturally, I should do my part.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: A Startorch Academy chair sits here, oddly out of place… Sit down and rest for a while?
Take a rest.
Not now.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Your eyelids grow heavy. In your drowsy haze, you sense a lingering frequency from the past…

speaker: NPC #200144
anh_en: I heard this from a student from Huanglong. Out there, beyond Lahai-Roi, there's this plant that grows straight and tall all year. Doesn't care about wind or rain.

speaker: NPC #200144
anh_en: People use it to build houses, furniture, and even for food and everyday stuff. They can't live without it.

speaker: NPC #200144
anh_en: And yet, despite all that, there's a saying, "When bamboo blooms, misfortune follows."

speaker: NPC #200144
anh_en: Because once it flowers, that's it. It dies. It may take decades before a new generation covers the mountains again... waiting for its one and only bloom.

speaker: NPC #200144
anh_en: And even if new shoots grow, the two generations are just...

speaker: NPC #200144
anh_en: Ah, whatever. Never mind.

speaker: NPC #200144
anh_en: ...I just think, if it had a choice, it'd probably still choose to bloom.

speaker: NPC #200144
anh_en: At least the next generation of bamboo would remember the sun and the breeze for it. Right?

speaker: NPC #200144
anh_en: The Solvein Heartwood... heh. You think a tree that big ever gets to bloom?
Sure it does.
No, I don't think so.

speaker: NPC #200144
anh_en: Haha, interesting. I thought so too.

speaker: NPC #200144
anh_en: Really? That... sounds painfully boring.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Building materials from a Roya camp, likely swept here by a Void Storm.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: A huge bag of Instant Wakeup Energy Gel Sachets, likely dropped by someone during an evacuation to escape a Void Storm.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Then again, whoever dropped this might've wanted to get rid of it anyway.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: A peculiar-looking plant that resembles... a giant Viscum Berry?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: It appears that Agro Wing students have spliced genes from prehistoric plant life with those of the Viscum Berry, resulting in this fascinating creation. A certain maiden from Rinascita would surely be very interested in their little experiment.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: But this hybrid plant wasn't unveiled at the Spacetrek Collective's conference, instead it turned up here. You're not sure if this is an abandoned experiment or if the lab itself was abandoned during the Void Storm.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You decide not to tell her.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: An old-fashioned transmitter. Its last recording was seventeen years ago. Though corroded by the Void Storm, it still barely works.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Its last transmitted message reads: ·—· · — ·—· · ·— —

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: To the nameless pioneers.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: A white origami bird with a soft, wintry frost still clinging to it.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: This one doesn't look like the ones you've seen.

speaker: NPC #850533
anh_en: Spacetrek Collective Research Institute - Field Report (Archived) Research Topic: Dynamic Characteristics of the Tacet Discord "Inferno Rider" and its Vehicle Research Location: Huanglong — Port City of Guixu Related Projects: Iterative R&D of the Expedition Motorbike Prototype I. Background A powerful Tacet Discord, designated "Inferno Rider," has been observed near the Port City of Guixu in Huanglong. The vehicle it utilizes operates with remarkable stability in post-Lament environments. Its structural design and movement patterns are expected to provide critical reference points for the development of our prototype expedition motorbike. II. Field Records Location: Port City of Guixu — Overpass Ruins By deploying sensors to capture kinetic data, we have determined that the "Inferno Rider" performs well above average in the following areas: · Control response logic at high speeds. · Maneuverability across uneven terrain. III. Technical Applications By reverse-engineering its movement patterns and structural features, the engineering team has implemented the following improvements to the expedition motorbike prototype: …………………… Researcher‘s Handwritten Note: The prototype is finished. I never imagined old tech from my hometown all those years ago would find a new life in an expedition motorbike. Even now, the mention of the "Inferno Rider" still strikes fear into people's hearts. I cannot erase the shadow cast by that Tacet Discord, nor can I truly give rest to the souls who perished long ago. At the very least, this prototype proves that our ancestors left more than just pain and terror behind. They also had hope for the future. This bike will carry forth their will, guarding the path for those who dare to explore.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: A holographic projection of the "Inferno Rider," likely used as reference material during the prototyping stages of the expedition motorbike.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Beside it lies a blueprint of the original design. Although the motorbike has undergone several iterations, its original appearance remains significant to this day.

speaker: NPC #850573
anh_en: Lolllo Logistics Order #29 Merchant: Mahe's Grocery Items: Chili Peppers: 10 Crates Vinegar: 10 Crates Hot Pot Base: 10 Crates Premium Sesame Oil: 10 Crates Rice: 50 Bags Eggs: 50 Crates Delivery Address: Student Dormitories, Startorch Academy In partnership with Lollo Logistics, Mahe's Grocery is proud to offer guaranteed delivery within 30 days of ordering. We stock a wide variety of specialty Huanglong snacks, seasonings, and kitchenware—perfect for Startorch Academy students! Order yours now while supplies last. Buy more, save more.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Honk honk♪

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: This place has got everything!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: A sofa bed, closets, and even a vending machine... But there's an expedition camp right around the corner. Who'd want to live inside a cave?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: A... Fluffguin?

speaker: NPC #850505
anh_en: Honk honk...honk. Honk, honk, honk.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: It cries out proudly, as though it understands the subject far better than you are.
(Pet.)
(Try to squeeze onto the sofa.)
(Discuss the history of the Spacetrek Collective.)

speaker: NPC #850505
anh_en: Honk honk♪

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: It rolls over, as if telling you not to forget its backside.

speaker: NPC #850505
anh_en: Honk honk?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: It stares at you indifferently and remains perfectly still.

speaker: NPC #850505
anh_en: Honk honk...

speaker: NPC #850482
anh_en: Dumdum! Are you in here?

speaker: NPC #850505
anh_en: Honk honk. (*Indifferent sounds*)

speaker: NPC #850482
anh_en: Please, come back with me, Dumdum. Do I have to beg on my knees?

speaker: NPC #850505
anh_en: Honk honk. (*Irritated sounds*)
Is this your Fluffguin?

speaker: NPC #850482
anh_en: Oh, hello...

speaker: NPC #850482
anh_en: This is my advisor's Fluffguin. Dumdum. She asked me to take care of it while she's gone.

speaker: NPC #850482
anh_en: Dumdum must've wandered off on its own. Thanks for finding it. I'd better bring it back to camp.

speaker: NPC #850505
anh_en: Honk honk. (*Irritated sounds*)

speaker: NPC #850482
anh_en: Huh? What do you mean you like it here...?

speaker: NPC #850482
anh_en: Uh-uh. My advisor told me to look after you. I'm going to get an earful after she gets back from calibrating the Exostrider and finds out you disappeared like that...

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Dumdum is so into it that you can't help but look at what it's reading. It appears to be a comic book about a boy who was neglected by his father and ended up becoming a pilot of a giant mech.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Meanwhile, Mija won't stop pleading.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Honk honk.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Dumdum is still enjoying itself.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You get a feeling that no matter how the future unfolds for Lahai-Roi, this Fluffguin's life will remain unchanged.

speaker: NPC #850584
anh_en: Surprise ahead!
You triggered the trap!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Chuluu! Chuluu!

speaker: NPC #850571
anh_en: Chuluu Chuluu! Chuluu!

speaker: NPC #850571
anh_en: Chuluu!

speaker: NPC #850571
anh_en: Chuuluu chuluu....Chuluu!

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Oh, it wants you to hide a stone in any one of these chests, and it'll tell you which one you picked.
Okay, let's play.

speaker: NPC #850571
anh_en: Chuluu! (*Determined sounds*)

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Chuu...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Chuluu! (*Pleased sounds*)

speaker: NPC #850571
anh_en: Chuu, chuuluu...! (*Vigorously shakes head*)
Alright, let's try that again.

speaker: NPC #850571
anh_en: Chuu!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Chuu...

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Hehe, I'll use Sensor to expose their tricks.

speaker: NPC #850572

anh_en: Ah, you're the young {Male=man;Female=lady} who was with Watcher Yangyang. Please give her my regards.

speaker: NPC #350117

speaker: NPC #350117

speaker: NPC #750609
anh_en: Watcher Yangyang being reassigned to Xuanfang Hold has been one of the few pieces of good news these days. Folks all wanted to thank her in person.

speaker: NPC #750617
anh_en: Hmm... I'm not seeing any major issues. A few more days, and they should be ready to hand over to the Ministry of War.

speaker: NPC #750619
anh_en: If not for the Fortress and Gorges War, we'd still be able to see its majestic mountain gate today...

speaker: NPC #750619

speaker: NPC #750619
anh_en: Whenever disaster strikes in Mengzhou and rebuilding is needed, Zhuojun Atelier often sends people to help.

speaker: NPC #750619

speaker: NPC #750619
anh_en: That Zhuojun Atelier had anything to do with the turmoil in Xuanfang Hold... truly, I cannot imagine it.

speaker: NPC #750619
anh_en: It is said that the Artisans who built Xuanfang Hold are still alive. Never left. They became "Celestials" who live as one with the mechanisms.

speaker: NPC #750619
